report:
Vidljiv manji koštani edem medijalnog kondila femura i medijalnog platoa tibije. Preostale koštane
strukture urednog su intenziteta signala.
Hondromalacija femoralne i tibijalne hrskavice, najizražnije u području opisanog koštanog edema
3°, u preostalim segmentima 2°. Opisano odgovara OA promjenama medijalnog kompartmenta.
Vidljiv veći izljev unutar koljenskog zgloba.
Prednji križni ligament izmijenjenog intenzitezta signala, može odgovarati parcijalnoj rupturi.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Prednji rog medijalnog meniska se nalazi izvan zglobne pukotine, izmijenjenog je intenziteta
siginala, degenerativne promjene straznjeg roga sa suspektnom rupturom.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova degeneracije ili rupture.
Segment lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta koji se hvata na lateralni menisk izmijenjenog
intenziteta signala, moguće u smislu parcijalne rutpure. Medijalni kolateralni ligamenti urednog
signala te se prate u kontinuitetu.
Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa i patelarnog ligamenta.
Bez znakova poplitealne ciste.
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba. Hondromalacija 1°patelarne
hrskavice.
translation:
Minor bone edema is visible in the medial femoral condyle and the medial tibial plateau. The remaining bone structures are of normal signal intensity.
Chondromalacia of the femoral and tibial cartilage, most pronounced in the area of the described bone edema grade 3°, in the remaining segments grade 2°. The described findings correspond to OA changes of the medial compartment.
A large effusion is visible within the knee joint.
The anterior cruciate ligament is of altered signal intensity, may correspond to a partial tear.
The posterior cruciate ligament is of normal signal and is seen in continuity.
The anterior horn of the medial meniscus is located outside the joint space, is of altered signal intensity; degenerative changes of the posterior horn with a suspected tear.
The lateral meniscus shows no signs of degeneration or tear.
The segment of the lateral collateral ligament that attaches to the lateral meniscus is of altered signal intensity, possibly consistent with a partial tear. The medial collateral ligaments are of normal signal and are seen in continuity.
Normal signal intensity of the insertions of the quadriceps tendon and the patellar ligament.
No signs of a popliteal cyst.
The congruence of the articular surfaces of the patellofemoral joint is normal. Grade 1° chondromalacia of the patellar cartilage.

report:
MRI  KNEE  -  RIGHT

TECHNIQUE:  Unenhanced multiplanar multisequence MR images of the knee.

CLINICAL INDICATION:  Right knee chronic pain, trauma. Some abnormalities on x-ray and ultrasound.

COMPARISON:  None.

FINDINGS:

Medial meniscus:  Intact.

Medial compartment articular cartilage:  Small focus of mild chondrosis central weightbearing aspect medial tibial plateau.

MCL:  Intact.

Lateral meniscus:  Minimal apical truncation of the lateral meniscal body compatible with a tiny partial nondisplaced radial tear. No meniscal extrusion.

Lateral compartment articular cartilage:  Scattered foci of mild chondrosis.

LCL complex:  Intact.

ACL:  Intact.

PCL:  Intact.

Quadriceps and patellar tendons:  Mild tendinosis involving the medial insertional fibers of the biceps tendon, without tear. Mild proximal patellar tendinosis without tear..

Patellofemoral alignment:  Normal. 

Patellofemoral cartilage:  Extensive fissuring of articular cartilage overlying the patellar articular surface with foci of full-thickness cartilage denuding at the patellar apex and along the lateral patellar facet.

Joint effusion:  Trace joint effusion in the suprapatellar recess. 

Intra-articular bodies:  None.

Bone marrow: As above. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

Popliteal fossa:  No additional abnormality.

Other findings:  None.


INTERPRETATION:
1. Tiny partial nondisplaced radial tear involving the body of the lateral meniscus with lateral meniscal extrusion.
2. Tricompartment chondrosis most pronounced involving the patellofemoral compartment, consistent with moderate patellofemoral predominant osteoarthritis of the right knee.
3. Mild quadriceps tendinosis without tear.

report: Zentrierte Stellung im rechten Kniegelenk. Zentrierte Stellung der Patella. Keine trochleäre Dysplasie. Regelrechter Knorpelbelag retropatellar. Gering streifige hypointense Signalveränderungen des Knorpelbelages zentral in der Trochlea mit subchondral kleinzystischen Veränderungen und Ödemsignal, hier V.a. fokal osteochondrale Läsion (5/15, 4/19 + 6/20). Keine wesentliche Chondropathie femoro-tibial im medialen und lateralen Kompartiment oder retropatellar. Keine wesentliche Gelenkspaltverschmälerung. Kleine umschrieben T2-hyperintense Läsion in der Femurmetaphyse mit 7 mm (5/19, 4/14), morph. passend zu einem Enchondrom. Gering Gelenkerguss, keine freienn Gelenkkörper. Intaktes vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband. Intaktes mediales und laterales Kollateralband. Unauffällige Darstellung des medialen und lateralen Meniskus bezogen auf Formgebung und Signalintensität. Intakte Darstellung der Quadriceps- und Patellarsehne. Unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Muskulatur und Weichteile.
translation: Centered position of the right knee joint. Centered position of the patella. No trochlear dysplasia. Normal cartilage covering retropatellar. Mild linear hypointense signal changes of the cartilage centrally in the trochlea with subchondral small cystic changes and edema signal, here suspicious for focal osteochondral lesion (5/15, 4/19 + 6/20). No significant femorotibial chondropathy in the medial and lateral compartment or retropatellar. No significant joint space narrowing. Small well-defined T2-hyperintense lesion in the femoral metaphysis measuring 7 mm (5/19, 4/14), morphologically consistent with an enchondroma. Mild joint effusion, no loose bodies. Intact anterior and posterior cruciate ligament. Intact medial and lateral collateral ligament. Unremarkable appearance of the medial and lateral meniscus with regard to morphology and signal intensity. Intact appearance of the quadriceps and patellar tendon. Unremarkable appearance of the surrounding musculature and soft tissues.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: History of right knee osteoarthritis. Chronic right knee pain. Focal pain inferior to the patella.
Comparison: Right knee radiograph [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. No evidence of marrow replacing lesion. Severe tricompartmental marginal osteophytosis. Proximal and distal patellar enthesopathy. 4 mm button osteophyte at the weightbearing medial femoral condyle.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. Trace Baker's cyst. 4 x 4 mm osseous intra-articular body at the anterior lateral tibiofemoral compartment.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Chronic degenerative maceration of the posterior horn and body. Meniscal body extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Large regions of full-thickness cartilage loss throughout both sides of the weightbearing aspect of the joint with associated subchondral signal changes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Complex tearing affecting the posterior horn, body and anterior horn, with dominant horizontal oblique undersurface component at the anterior horn.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage irregularity and thinning with areas of full-thickness cartilage loss at both sides of the joint near the tibial spine. Associated subchondral signal changes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage thinning with areas of high-grade fissuring at the patellar median ridge. Full-thickness cartilage loss at the lateral trochlea. Associated subchondral signal changes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Chronic complete tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 18 mm, top-normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Severe tricompartmental osteoarthritis. Small knee joint effusion with 4 mm intra-articular body at the lateral tibiofemoral compartment.
2.	Chronic complete ACL tear.
3.	Chronic degenerative tearing of both menisci.
4.	Small Baker's cyst.

promjenama, dif. dg. ruptura starijeg datuma.

report:
Findings:  There is a mild knee effusion. A mild fluid-filled Baker's cyst is noted.  There is incomplete tearing of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with partial extrusion of the medial meniscus from the joint. Myxoid degeneration of the posterior body and posteromedial corner of the medial meniscus is noted. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is evidence of subchondral impaction fracturing of the weightbearing aspect of the medial femoral condyle with surrounding marrow edema. Diffuse marrow edema is also seen in the whole of the medial femoral condyle. Mild diffuse marrow edema is also seen in the medial tibial condyle. Mild thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage is noted.  Normal lateral compartment articular cartilage. Moderate generalized thinning of the patellofemoral articular cartilage is noted with severe thinning and loss of the lateral patellofemoral articular cartilage and underlying bony change. 
 Conclusion: Changes associated with subchondral insufficiency fracturing of the knee (SIFK). Incomplete tearing of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with myxoid degeneration of the posterior medial meniscus. Moderate - severe patellofemoral degeneration noted.

Mild age-related thinning of tricompartmental articular cartilage, probably most apparent at the medial weightbearing compartment. Tiny focus of high-grade cartilage loss with associated faint focal reactive marrow changes is noted adjacent to the median ridge of the patella.  Small focus of grade 3 cartilage loss noted at the central portion of the lateral tibial plateau. Grossly unremarkable imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain after bending down 4 weeks ago.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small, ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Irregularity of the weightbearing lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau. Focal full-thickness fissuring at the posterior nonweightbearing lateral femoral condyle with subchondral edema.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss of the central trochlea with subchondral edema. Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss at the lateral patellar facet with full-thickness fissuring.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
High-grade lateral and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

translation:

The cartilage covering the articular surfaces of the tibia, femur, and patella is of normal thickness, homogeneous structure, and signal intensity. A hyperintense lesion is identified in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus with an oblique course, reaching the articular surface of the tibia. Lateral meniscus – normal appearance. Both cruciate ligaments, as well as both collateral ligaments, are traced to their attachment sites with normal shape, homogeneous structure, and signal intensity. MRI evidence of a lesion in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 3.

report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif-orta dereceli artmış. Ön çapraz bağda tam kat yırtık izleniyor. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Lateral menisküs gövdesi düzeyinde alt eklem yüzeyi ilişkilenen horizontal oblik longitudinal yırtık mevcut. Medyal menisküste interkondiler çentiğe deplase kova sapı yırtığı gözleniyor. Bunun yanı sıra gövdesi-arka boynuzu bileşkesinde küçük bir radyal yırtık bileşeni de eşlik ediyor. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler normal. Troklea displastik (DeJour tip B), patella laterale 8 mm translasyon gösteriyor. Caton-Deschamps indeksi 1,5 hesaplanmış olup patella yüksek yerleşimli. Ekstensör mekanizma bunların dışında korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.
translation: Mild to moderate increase in intra-articular fluid of the knee joint. A full-thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament is observed. The posterior cruciate ligament and collateral ligaments are normal. A horizontal oblique longitudinal tear involving the inferior articular surface is present at the body of the lateral meniscus. A displaced bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus into the intercondylar notch is observed. In addition, a small radial tear component accompanies at the body–posterior horn junction. Articular cartilage and bones are normal. The trochlea is dysplastic (DeJour type B), the patella shows 8 mm lateral translation. The Caton-Deschamps index is calculated as 1.5, indicating patella alta. The extensor mechanism is otherwise intact. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal.

translation:

Diffuse cartilage thinning in the lateral compartment.

translation:
RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: Grade II degeneration is observed in the lateral meniscus and medial meniscus. The posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. The signal of the anterior cruciate ligament is mildly diffusely increased. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. report:
МР находка:  Няма МР данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става, са с нормална форма. Изобразява се ограничена зона на костномозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на тибията. МР данни за овална костна лезия, разположена срединно в проксималната диафиза на тибията. Находката е с размери 6/5 мм и е с типична макроморфология на енхондром. 
Артикулиращият ставен хрущял на тибията и бедрената кост е със запазена дебелина и конгруентност. МР данни за увреда в задния рог на медиалния менискус. В него се изобразява хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход, която достига до края на менискуса без да има контакт с артикулиращите повърхности на тибията и фемура. МР данни за дегенеративни промени и увреда в задния рог на латералния менискус. Задният рог на латералния менискус е с дифузно повишен сигнален интензитет, като в нeго се изобразява и хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход. Линията не достига до артикулиращите повърхности на костите. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на медиалния менискус и на предния рог на латералния менискус. МР данни за частично скъсване на предната кръстна връзка. Тя е задебелена и с дифузно повишен сигнален интензитет. Задната кръстна връзка е интактна. МР данни за тотална руптура на медиалния колатерален лигамент. Лигаментът се проследява със запазена цялост и сигнален интензитет само в проксималната си част при залавянето си за бедрената кост. В средната си трета същият е с повишен сигнален интензитет, а дистално не се залавя за тибията. Латерален колатерален лигамент – б.о.  МР данни за малка зона на повишен сигнален интензитет в сухожилието на м. семимембранозус. Тази зона се намира в областта на залавното място на сухожилието за медиалния кондил на тибията. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Ретинакулуми на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на мускулус квадрицепс феморис - нормално изобразяване. Поплитеална ямка –  б.о. МР данни за едем в меките тъкани от медиалната страна на ставата, както и в подкожието на предната повърхност на подбедрицата. Заключение: МР данни за частична руптура на предна кръстна връзка – grade 2. Увреда в задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 2a. Дегенеративни промени и увреда в задния рог на латералния менискус – grade 2c. Руптура на медиалния колатерален лигамент. Ограничена зона на костномозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на тибията. Мекотъканен и подкожен едем. Тендинопатия на залавното място на м. семимембранозус за тибията. Енхондром в диафизата на тибията.
translation:
MRI findings: No MRI evidence of joint effusion. The bones forming the right knee joint are of normal shape. A limited zone of bone marrow edema is seen in the medial tibial condyle. MRI evidence of an oval bone lesion located centrally in the proximal tibial diaphysis. The finding measures 6/5 mm and has typical macromorphology of an enchondroma.
The articular cartilage of the tibia and femur has preserved thickness and congruence. MRI evidence of damage in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. A hyperintense line with horizontal course is seen within it, reaching the meniscal edge without contact with the articular surfaces of the tibia and femur. MRI evidence of degenerative changes and damage in the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. The posterior horn of the lateral meniscus shows diffusely increased signal intensity, with a hyperintense line of horizontal course also seen within it. The line does not reach the articular surfaces of the bones. Normal appearance of the anterior horn of the medial meniscus and the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus. MRI evidence of partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. It is thickened and with diffusely increased signal intensity. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. MRI evidence of total rupture of the medial collateral ligament. The ligament is traced with preserved integrity and signal intensity only in its proximal part at its femoral attachment. In its middle third it shows increased signal intensity, and distally it does not attach to the tibia. Lateral collateral ligament – unremarkable. MRI evidence of a small zone of increased signal intensity in the semimembranosus tendon. This zone is located at the insertion site of the tendon on the medial tibial condyle. Patella, patellar cartilage – unremarkable. Patellar retinacula – normal appearance. Patellar ligament and quadriceps femoris tendon – normal appearance. Popliteal fossa – unremarkable. MRI evidence of edema in the soft tissues on the medial side of the joint, as well as in the subcutaneous tissue of the anterior surface of the lower leg.
Conclusion: MRI evidence of partial rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament – grade 2. Damage in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 2a. Degenerative changes and damage in the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus – grade 2c. Rupture of the medial collateral ligament. Limited zone of bone marrow edema in the medial tibial condyle. Soft tissue and subcutaneous edema. Tendinopathy at the insertion site of the semimembranosus muscle on the tibia. Enchondroma in the tibial diaphysis.

translation:

translation:
On the series of MR images of the left knee, there is normal morphology and signal intensity of the collateral ligaments, anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments, and the iliotibial tract.
Complex tear of the body of the medial meniscus, with a horizontal component reaching the inferior articular surface extending into the posterior horn of the meniscus. In the region of the posterior horn, it communicates with the free edge of the meniscus, where a parameniscal cyst is located along the posterior aspect of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, measuring up to 2 mm in diameter.
The body of the medial meniscus is peripherally displaced beyond the joint space.
The lateral meniscus is of normal morphology and signal intensity.
Enthesophytosis at the insertion of the quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament. In the distal portion of the patellar ligament, there is an embedded bony body measuring 12x6 mm - consistent with Osgood-Schlatter disease.
Shallow fissures and cartilage defects of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial condyle, and the lateral facet of the patella (chondromalacia grade 2 according to ICRS classification).
Fissures and full-thickness delamination of the cartilage of the lateral tibial condyle (chondromalacia grade 3 according to ICRS classification).
The other visualized articular cartilages are of normal signal intensity.
Small amount of knee effusion, small popliteal (Baker's) cyst.
The other visualized bony, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

translation:
RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings:
The lateral meniscus is normal. The medial meniscus is extruded 5 mm medially from the knee joint space. There is decreased meniscal volume, and grade III degeneration is observed in the posterior horn and body. The posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. Signal change secondary to myxoid degeneration is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. Signal change consistent with tendinosis is observed at the proximal insertion level of the medial head of the gastrocnemius. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Cartilage integrity is markedly thinned at the medial facet of the patella. Focal signal increase is also observed in the medial retinaculum. Fluid increase is also observed in the pes anserine bursa. No joint effusion is detected. Signal intensities of the bony structures forming the knee joint are normal. Osteophytic spurring is observed at the corners of the bony structures at the tibiofemoral joint level. Joint space narrowing is observed in the medial tibiofemoral joint, with millimetric cyst and edema in the subchondral area of the medial tibial plateau adjacent to the joint. Cartilage destruction is observed in the femoral and tibial cartilages at this level. Findings are interpreted in favor of degenerative arthritis.
Conclusion: Gonarthrosis, medial extrusion of the medial meniscus, volume loss and grade III meniscopathy, myxoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, tendinosis of the medial head of the gastrocnemius, pes anserine bursitis, grade III chondromalacia at the medial facet of the patella.

report: МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става са с непроменена форма. Наличие на костномозъчен едем медиалния кондил на фемура. Артикулиращият хрущял на фемура и тибията е изтънен до липсващ от медиалната страна с белези на медиален остеоартрит със синовит. Липсва руптура на предната кръстна връзка. Нормално изобразяване на задна кръстна връзка. Изобразява се увреда в задния рог на медиалния менискус – 3 степен, както и увреда 2а в заден рог на латерален менискус. Нормално представен латерален менискус. Колатерални лигаменти със запазена цялост. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Медиално представена Бекерова киста. Заключение:  МР данни за остеоартрит със синовит медиално. МР данни за увреда на задния рог на медиалния менискус – 3 степен, както и 2ь увреда на заден рог на латерален менискус.  Бекерова киста. Ставен излив. Костномозъчен едем.
translation:
MRI findings: MRI evidence of joint effusion. The bones forming the left knee joint are of normal shape. Presence of bone marrow edema in the medial femoral condyle. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia is thinned to absent on the medial side with signs of medial osteoarthritis with synovitis. No rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament. Normal appearance of the posterior cruciate ligament. A grade 3 lesion is seen in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, as well as a grade 2a lesion in the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. Normal appearance of the lateral meniscus. Collateral ligaments are intact. Patella, patellar cartilage, retinacula – unremarkable. A Baker's cyst is present medially.

Conclusion: MRI findings of osteoarthritis with synovitis medially. MRI findings of a grade 3 lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, as well as a grade 2a lesion of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. Baker's cyst. Joint effusion. Bone marrow edema.

translation:
TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1 and proton density pulse sequences with fat signal suppression.

FINDINGS
- A moderate intra-articular joint effusion is observed.
- The menisci, the cruciate ligaments, the lateral collateral ligament, and the articular cartilage show no pathological findings. A partial injury (grade I) is observed at the femoral insertion of the medial collateral ligament.
- On evaluation of the anterior compartment and the extensor mechanism, bone marrow edema consistent with a bone bruise is observed on the lateral surface of the right femoral condyle, and similar edema in the medial aspect of the patella adjacent to an impaction osteochondral fracture. There is coexisting edema in the superomedial aspect of Hoffa's fat pad and an edematous appearance of the medial patellofemoral ligament. The findings are attributed to a prior spontaneously reduced lateral patellar dislocation.
- A shallow femoral trochlea is noted (sulcus angle 160 degrees) and a type II patellar morphology according to Wiberg. The findings predispose to patellar maltracking.

translation:
Normal articulation of the left knee joint. Small cystic changes at the dorsomedial tibia (3/124). Unremarkable bone marrow signal. Fibro-osseous lesions at the insertion of the quadriceps tendon (1010/44) and at the patellar tendon (1010/43), known from prior radiographic examination. No bone marrow edema. Mild predominantly superficial chondropathy of the patellofemoral compartment, particularly medially at the trochlea, with chondral irregularity retropatellar (6/22). Patella is centered in position.
Medial femorotibial compartment: mild irregularities of the cartilage surface without deep chondropathy. Lateral compartment: normal preserved cartilage covering. Morphologically unremarkable appearance of the lateral meniscus with unremarkable signal intensity. The medial meniscus shows mildly increased T2 signal in the posterior horn and pars intermedia (see e.g. 6/7). Anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments intact. Collateral ligament complex also intact. Moderate joint effusion.

report:
MRI RIGHT KNEE  (plain)

Clinical information:
Right knee instability. Anterior drawer test positive? Anterior cruciate ligament injury.

Technique: 
Multiplanar MR of the knee according to protocol.

Comparison: 
None

Findings: 

Menisci

Lateral meniscus: intact

Medial meniscus: Mild hyperintensity is seen at the posterior horn suggestive of intrasubstance degeneration. No definite tear. No parameniscal cyst. 

Ligaments

Anterior cruciate ligament: Intact fibers are present however caliber of these fibers is somewhat attenuated compatible with a remote low-grade partial thickness injury. No significant tibial translation.

Posterior cruciate ligament: intact 

Medial collateral ligament: Superficial and deep components intact. No periligamentous edema.

Lateral collateral ligament: The iliotibial band, biceps femoris tendon, fibular collateral ligament and popliteus muscle and tendon intact. 

Posterolateral corner structures: Intact

Extensor Mechanism

The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. The patella is normally positioned within the femoral groove. There is no retinacular disruption.

Fluid

No joint effusion or loose body. No Baker's cyst.

Osseous and Articular Structures

Bones: No fracture, stress reaction, or osseous lesion is seen.

Patellofemoral compartment: Marked patella chondral hypertrophy is seen measuring up to 1.0 cm in thickness at the patella apex. It appears heterogeneously hyperintense with regions of hypointensity, possibly due to mineralization. No evidence of invasion into the patella bone. It is closely abutting a medial plica. A possible loose body is also seen. Suspicious fissure also observed at the apex. Findings non specific in nature but favours to represent severe chondromalacia. Differential diagnoses such as focal synovitis and PVNS are less probable. 

Medial compartment: Mild chondrosis of the medial femoral condyle.

Lateral compartment: Mild chondrosis of the lateral femoral condyle.

Others:

Hoffas fat pad: clear

Muscles: No abnormal oedema. 

Neurovascular bundle: Normal 


COMMENT
Low grade, remote, partial thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. No tibial translation.

Marked heterogeneous hypertrophy of the articular cartilage of the patella measuring up to 1.0 cm in thickness at the patella apex. Signal in this irregular thickened cartilage is heterogeneously hyperintense on T2-weighted imaging and shows focal regions of hypointensity which may represent mineralization. Findings are favored to represent severe chondropathic change involving the articular cartilage of the patella.

report:
Trouvailles :

Il n’y a pas d’épanchement intra-articulaire significatif. Il y a un petit kyste poplité non-rupturé.

Il y a léger amincissement du cartilage avec fibrillation superficielle du compartiment interne. Il n’y a pas de région de perte de cartilage complet. Le compartiment externe et patellofémoral est sans particularité.

Il y a changements dégénératifs intra-substance impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure horizontale impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure s’étendant à la surface articulaire inférieure au niveau du corps. Il y a légère extrusion du ménisque au niveau du corps. Il n’y a pas de fragment méniscal déplacé. Le ménisque externe est sans particularité.

Autrement le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion :

1. Déchirure horizontale impliquant le ménisque interne sans fragment déplacé.

2. Légers changements dégénératifs du compartiment interne sans région de perte de cartilage complète.
translation:
Findings:

There is no significant intra-articular effusion. There is a small unruptured popliteal cyst.

There is mild cartilage thinning with superficial fibrillation of the medial compartment. There is no region of full-thickness cartilage loss. The lateral and patellofemoral compartments are unremarkable.

There are intrasubstance degenerative changes involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is a horizontal tear involving the body and posterior horn extending to the inferior articular surface at the level of the body. There is mild meniscal extrusion at the level of the body. There is no displaced meniscal fragment. The lateral meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise, the anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, extensor mechanism, medial collateral ligament, semimembranosus, popliteus muscle and tendon, distal biceps femoris, lateral collateral ligament, and iliotibial band are unremarkable.

Conclusion:

1. Horizontal tear involving the medial meniscus without displaced fragment.

2. Mild degenerative changes of the medial compartment without region of full-thickness cartilage loss.

report: МР находка: МР данни за контузионен костномозъчен едем в кондилите на фемура и тибията. Отокът в тибията е локализиран предимно срединно под интеркондиларните еминенции. Ставният хрущял на фемура и тибията е запазен. МР данни за руптура на предна кръстна връзка. Последната е едемна, с уголемен напречник. Виждат се едемни изменения и висок сигнален интензитет в проксималното залавно място на латералния колатерален лигамент. Последният е със запазен континуитет и лекостепенно нагънат ход. Дегенеративни промени в заден рог на медиалния менискус. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Визуализира се перисиновиална киста на нивото на медиалната глава на м. гастрокнемиус. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – без особености. Наличие на ставен излив. Заключение:  МР данни за руптура на предна кръстна връзка. Контузионен костномозъчен едем във фемура и тибията. Частична увреда на латералния колатерален лигамент. Ставен излив.
translation: MRI findings: MRI evidence of contusion-related bone marrow edema in the femoral and tibial condyles. Edematous changes and high signal intensity are seen at the proximal attachment of the lateral collateral ligament. The latter has preserved continuity and a mildly buckled course. Degenerative changes in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Normal appearance of the lateral meniscus. A perisynovial cyst is visualized at the level of the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle. Patella, patellar cartilage, retinacula – unremarkable. Presence of joint effusion. Conclusion: MRI evidence of rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament. Contusion-related bone marrow edema in the femur and tibia. Partial injury of the lateral collateral ligament. Joint effusion.

report: МР находка: Наличие на малък ставен излив. МР данни за тендинит сухожилието на мускулус квадрицепс феморис в областта на залавното място за пателата. Вижда се костномозъчен едем на пателата, най-изразен в горната и половина, в областта на залавното място на сухожилието на м. квадрицепс феморис. Наличие на инсерционит на лигамента на пателата. В областта на метадиафизата на тибията от латералната страна  се изобразява формация със смесена структура, бенигнена макроморфология. приблизително овална форма и размери 35/29мм. Находката в най-голяма степен съответства на енхондром. Изобразява се хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Лезията достига до края на менискуса, без видимо на достига до ставните хрущяли. Нормално представен латерален менискус. Кръстни връзки – б.о. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура, тибията и пателата е със запазена цялост. Ретинакулумите са със запазена цялост. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. Изобразява се мултилокуларна Бекерова киста с приблизителни размери 38/14мм. Разширени повърхности вени, по-големи от латералната страна. Заключение: МР данни за малък ставен излив. Инсерционит на сухожилието на мускулус квадрицепс феморис и на лигамента на пателата. Костномозъчен едем на пателата. Лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – 2a. Бекерова киста. Формация е метадифизата на тибията с макроморфология на енхондром.
translation: MRI findings: Small joint effusion present. MRI findings of tendinitis of the quadriceps femoris tendon at its insertion on the patella. In the metaphyseal-diaphyseal region of the tibia on the lateral side, a formation with mixed structure, benign macromorphology, approximately oval shape and dimensions 35/29 mm is visualized. The finding most likely corresponds to an enchondroma. A hyperintense line with horizontal course is visualized in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. The articular cartilage of the femur, tibia, and patella is intact. The retinacula are intact. Collateral ligaments – unremarkable. A multilocular Baker's cyst is visualized with approximate dimensions 38/14 mm. Dilated superficial veins, larger on the lateral side. Conclusion: MRI findings of small joint effusion. Insertionitis of the quadriceps femoris tendon and of the patellar ligament. Bone marrow edema of the patella. Lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 2a. Baker's cyst. Formation in the metaphysis of the tibia with macromorphology of enchondroma.

translation:
TECHNIQUE: The examination was performed with T1, pd/T2 fs, and T2* pulse sequences.

FINDINGS
- On evaluation of the medial compartment, there is a degenerative complex tear and subluxation of the medial meniscus, full-thickness erosion of the articular cartilage of the medial femoral and tibial condyles (ICRS Grade 4), as well as intense edema of the opposing surfaces of the medial femoral and tibial condyles, consistent with microtrabecular insufficiency fractures. Small marginal osteophytes are also present, one of which projects into the intercondylar notch.
- In the lateral compartment, there is a discoid meniscus which demonstrates a degenerative tear, while there is also folding of a meniscal fragment at the level of the intercondylar notch. The articular cartilage of the lateral femoral condyle shows thinning as well as chondrocalcinosis.
- On evaluation of the extensor mechanism, there is a congenitally shallow trochlea (sulcus angle 165°). Fissural erosions of the articular cartilage of the patella and of the femoral trochlea are also present.
- Intra-articularly, there is a small joint effusion and extensive synovitis with accompanying presence of numerous osteochondral loose bodies measuring 1–2 mm. Additionally, in the lateral aspect of the suprapatellar pouch, there is a projecting synovial formation measuring 1.1 cm with fat signal, which likely represents lipoma arborescens.
- The collateral ligaments and the posterior cruciate ligament appear normal. Myxoid degeneration is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament.

CONCLUSION:
1) Findings of extensive degenerative osteoarthritis in the medial compartment and early degenerative osteoarthritis in the lateral and anterior compartments.
2) Discoid lateral meniscus with a bucket-handle tear.
3) The findings of intra-articular synovitis and lipoma arborescens are attributed secondarily to degenerative osteoarthritis.
4) The findings from the extensor mechanism are consistent with patellar tracking dysfunction.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Internal derangement of left knee
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
There is mild subcortical marrow edema in the femoral condyles, medial tibial plateau, patella, and femoral trochlea likely related to osteoarthritis. There is moderate osteophytosis. There is a transversely oriented linear focus of decreased T1 and increased T2 signal subjacent to the medial tibial plateau articular cortex. This may represent reactive changes to 2 chondromalacia, but an occult minimal insufficiency fracture is possible. Alignment is anatomic.  Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small suprapatellar joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Minimal Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a complex tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus. There is mild medial extrusion of the meniscus.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is mild heterogeneous signal intensity of the chondral surfaces consistent with mild chondromalacia.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: There is mild heterogeneous signal of the cartilage without evidence of a discrete defect.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is severe chondromalacia patella.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. 

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.


IMPRESSION:
1. Complex tear of the medial meniscus.
2. Severe osteoarthritis.
3. Possible minimal occult insufficiency fracture medial tibial plateau.

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Small focus of low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the weightbearing medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Focal complex tear at the anterior horn/anterior root of the lateral meniscus. No extrusion. No displaced fragments.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Chondral heterogeneity and partial-thickness fissuring along the posterior lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild chondral heterogeneity along the lateral patellar facet without focal cartilage defect.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Borderline tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 18 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Small 10 mm nodule in the posteromedial subcutaneous tissues of the distal thigh is seen on survey sequences only. This could potentially represent a small sebaceous cyst, but is incompletely evaluated. Recommend focused ultrasound evaluation for further characterization. 

Mild semimembranosus bursitis. Mild pes anserine bursitis.

Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. No meniscal tear or ligamentous injury.
2. Mild semimembranosus bursitis and mild pes anserine bursitis.
3. Mild tricompartmental chondrosis.
4. Small 10 mm nodule in the posteromedial subcutaneous tissues of the distal thigh, seen on survey sequences only, could potentially represent a small sebaceous cyst, but is incompletely evaluated. Recommend focused ultrasound evaluation for further characterization. 

COMMUNICATION FOLLOW-UP: [REDACTED]

Arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Ön çapraz bağ tibia yapışma lokalizasyonunda belirgin sinyal artışı mevcuttur.Medial kollateral ligamanda belirgin incelmiş sinyal artışı ve çevresinde ödem ve sıvı artışı izlenmiş olup bu düzeyde medial epikondil seviyesinde milimetrik kistler, dejenerasyon ile uyumlu görünümler izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings:
The lateral meniscus is normal. The medial meniscus appears extruded. Signal changes consistent with an oblique tear are present in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. The posterior cruciate ligament and lateral collateral ligament are normal. There is marked signal increase at the tibial insertion site of the anterior cruciate ligament. There is marked thinning and signal increase in the medial collateral ligament with surrounding edema and fluid increase, and at this level, millimetric cysts and appearances consistent with degeneration are observed at the level of the medial epicondyle. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. No joint effusion has been detected. Fluid increase in the suprapatellar bursa and fluid increase at the level of the knee joint are observed. The signal intensities of the bony structures forming the knee joint are normal. A Baker's cyst with complex internal structure containing septations, measuring approximately 60x22 mm, is observed in the popliteal fossa.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain. [REDACTED].
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Focal osteochondral injury at the medial tibial plateau near the medial joint line with adjacent confluent bone marrow edema. No focal osseous lesion. Tricompartmental marginal osteophytosis.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. Small leaking Baker's cyst with internal calcific body. Multiple intra-articular bodies, including a 1.1 cm ossific body at the anterior joint recess and a 0.8 cm ossific body at the posterior joint recess. Post arthroscopy scarring of Hoffa's fat pad.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Diffuse complex degenerative tear of the medial meniscus, with maceration and complete radial tear at the posterior horn-posterior root junction. Posterior medial displacement of a meniscal flap in the region of the posterior root. Severe meniscal extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage irregularity with confluent regions of full-thickness cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage irregularity with areas of high-grade fissuring at the weightbearing aspect of the joint.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Confluent full-thickness articular cartilage loss at the lateral patellar facet and lateral trochlea. Articular surface remodeling at the lateral patellar facet. High-grade articular cartilage loss at the medial trochlea and medial facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Scarring.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon. Fragmentation of the tibial tubercle, reflecting the chronic sequela of remote Osgood-Schlatter disease.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Lateral patellar tilt and translation. No patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 18 mm, borderline elevated.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Small subchondral insufficiency fracture at the medial tibial plateau near the medial joint line with associated confluent bone marrow edema. No significant articular surface depression.
2.	Tricompartmental osteoarthritis, worst at the patellofemoral and medial tibiofemoral compartments, where it is severe. Small knee joint effusion with multiple ossific intra-articular bodies measuring up to 1.1 cm. Small leaking Baker's cyst.
3.	Complex degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus with dominant radial tear at the posterior horn-posterior root junction. Displacement of a meniscal flap to the posteromedial joint recess.

ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Αναγνωρίζεται ήπιο εµπιεστικό κάταγµα οπίσθιου έξω κνηµιαίου πλατώ (µη φορτιζόµενη επιφάνεια), µε συνοδό οστεοµυελικό οίδηµα του έξω και κεντρικού τµήµατος του απεικονιζόµενου τµήµατος της κνήµης. Μικρή περιοχή οστεοµυελικού οιδήµατος αναγνωρίζεται στον έσω µηριαίο κόνδυλο. Φυσιολογικοί απεικονίζονται ο οπίσθιος χιαστός σύνδεσµος καθώς και ο έσω και έξω µηνίσκος. Με παθολογικό σήµα και ήπια δίογκωση καθώς και µερική ασυνέχεια, ελέγχεται το εγγυς καταφυτικό τµήµα του πρόσθιο χιαστού συνδέσµου. Οι πλάγιοι σύνδεσµοι απεικονίζονται µε ήπια πάχυνση και οίδηµα, χωρίς ασυνέχεια. Από τον έλεγχο του προσθίου διαµερίσµατος οι τένοντες επιγονατιδικός και τετρακέφαλος καθώς και η επιγονατίδα ελέγχονται εντός του φυσιολογικού. Η επιγονατίδα έχει µορφολογία Wiberg II. Μετρία συλλογή υγρού µε αιµορραγικά στοιχεία παρατηρείται ενδοαρθρικά. Εντός του φυσιολογικού ελέγχεται ο αρθρικός χόνδρος. ΣΥΜΠΕΡΑΣΜΑ: 1. Μερική ρήξη πρόσθιου χιαστού συνδέσµου µε αίµαρθρο. 2. translation:
TECHNIQUE: The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

FINDINGS:
A mild impaction fracture of the posterior lateral tibial plateau (non-weight-bearing surface) is identified, with accompanying bone marrow edema of the lateral and central portion of the imaged segment of the tibia. A small area of bone marrow edema is identified in the medial femoral condyle. The posterior cruciate ligament as well as the medial and lateral meniscus appear normal. With pathological signal and mild swelling as well as partial discontinuity, the proximal insertion portion of the anterior cruciate ligament is evaluated. The collateral ligaments appear with mild thickening and edema, without discontinuity. From the examination of the anterior compartment, the patellar and quadriceps tendons as well as the patella are evaluated within normal limits. The patella has Wiberg II morphology. Moderate intra-articular fluid collection with hemorrhagic components is observed. The articular cartilage is evaluated within normal limits.

CONCLUSION:
1. Partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament with hemarthrosis.
2. Mild impaction of the posterior lateral tibial plateau.
3. Partial injury of the medial and lateral collateral ligaments.
4. Bone marrow edema (bone bruise) of the medial femoral condyle.

report:
Na učinjenim MR presjecima nalaze se areali hondromalacije četvrtog stupnja lateralne fasete
patele. Rubno vidljiva denudacija hrskavice medijalne fasete patele.
Hondromalacija drugog stupnja trohlearne hrskavice i kondilarne hrskavice.
Hondromalacija prvog stupnja tibijalne hrskavice.
Održani su križni ligamenti. Prednji križni ligament blaže degenerativno promijenjen na hvatištu
za tibiju.
Uz tibijalno hvatište stražnjeg križnog ligamenta formirane su intraosealne ganglion ciste do 5
mm. Osteofit posteriornog dijela tibije uz hvatište stražnjeg križnog ligamenta.
Medijalni menisk je blaže degenerativno promijenjen, bez evidentne rupture.
Lateralni menisk je blaže degenerativno promijenjen, vidljiva je parcijalna kosa ruptura u
području stražnjeg korijena meniska.
Kolateralni ligamenti su održani. Blaže entezopatske promjene proksimalnog hvatišta lateralnog
kolateralnog ligamenta uz nekoliko ispada signala koji mogu odgovarati sitnim kalcifikatima.
Primjeren prikaz iliotibijalnog trakta i tetive m. popliteusa te tetive m. biceps femoris.
Primjeren prikaz tetiva pes anserinus.
Ne nalazi se formirane Baker ciste. Nekoliko manjih ganglion cisti u posteriornoj zglobnoj čahuri.
Blaže entezopatske promjene tetive kvadricepsa.
Primjeren je prikaz ligamenta patele.
Bez signifikantnog izljeva u zglob.
translation:

Marginal denudation of the cartilage of the medial patellar facet is visible.
Grade II chondromalacia of the trochlear cartilage and condylar cartilage.
Grade I chondromalacia of the tibial cartilage.
The cruciate ligaments are intact. The anterior cruciate ligament is mildly degenerative at its tibial insertion.
Intraosseous ganglion cysts up to 5 mm are formed adjacent to the tibial insertion of the posterior cruciate ligament. Osteophyte of the posterior aspect of the tibia adjacent to the insertion of the posterior cruciate ligament.
The medial meniscus is mildly degenerative, without evident tear.
The lateral meniscus is mildly degenerative, a partial oblique tear is visible in the region of the posterior meniscal root.
The collateral ligaments are intact. Mild enthesopathic changes of the proximal insertion of the lateral collateral ligament with several signal voids that may correspond to small calcifications.
Adequate visualization of the iliotibial tract, the popliteus tendon, and the biceps femoris tendon.
Adequate visualization of the pes anserinus tendons.
No Baker's cyst is identified. Several small ganglion cysts in the posterior joint capsule.
Mild enthesopathic changes of the quadriceps tendon.
Adequate visualization of the patellar ligament.
No significant joint effusion.

report: МР находка: Няма данни за ставен излив.  Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става, са с нормална форма, структура и сигнален интензитет. Липсват зони на костномозъчен едем. МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – 3 стадий под формата на хиперинтензна лезия с кос ход достигаща до артикулиращата повърхност на тибията. В задния рог на латералния менискус не се виждат дегенеративни промени или менискални увреди. Предните рога са интактни. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Ставният хрущял на тибията и фемура е интактен, със запазена конгруентност. Колатерални лигаменти - б.о. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на меките тъкани. Заключение:  МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3.
translation: MRI findings: No evidence of joint effusion. The bones forming the left knee joint are of normal shape, structure, and signal intensity. No areas of bone marrow edema. MRI evidence of a lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 3, in the form of a hyperintense lesion with an oblique course reaching the articular surface of the tibia. No degenerative changes or meniscal tears are seen in the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. The anterior horns are intact. Normal appearance of the cruciate ligaments. The articular cartilage of the tibia and femur is intact, with preserved congruence. Collateral ligaments – unremarkable. Retinacula – unremarkable. Patella, patellar cartilage – unremarkable. Normal appearance of the soft tissues. Conclusion: MRI evidence of a lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 3.

report: Τεχνική: Η εξέταση έγινε µε ακολουθίες παλµών Τ1, PD fs, και Τ2 βαθµιδωτής ηχούς. Ευρήµατα: - Εικόνα οστεοαρθρίτιδας ιδίως εξεσηµασµένη στο έσω µεσάρθριο και την επιγονατιδοµηριαία άρθρωση, µε λέπτυνση και κατά τόπους εξάλειψη του αρθρικού χόνδρου, παρουσία πολλαπλών επιχείλιων οστεοφύτων σε αµφότερα τα µεσάρθρια και χόνδρινων ξένων σωµάτων στο πλαίσιο δευτεροπαθούς συνοβιακής χονδροµάτωσης. Κατά τόπους εστίες οιδήµατος του οστικού µυελού παρατηρούνται υπαρθρικά στο πλαίσιο της οστεοαρθρίτιδας. - Από τον έλεγχο των χιαστών συνδέσµων αναγνωρίζεται µυξοειδής εκφύλιση του προσθίου χιαστού. - Εκφύλιση παρατηρείται στους µηνίσκους αµφοτερόπλευρα µε παραµηνισκική κύστη παρά το σώµα του έξω µηνίσκου. - Σύµπλεγµα γαγγλιακών κυστών ελέγεται πέριξ της έξω κεφαλής του γαστροκνηµίου µυός. - Μικρή ποσότητα υγρού προεπιγονατιδικά είναι ενδεικτική προεπιγονατιδικής ορογονοθυλακίτιδας. Ικανή ποσότητα υγρού παρατηρείται ενδαρθρικά. - Ευµεγέθης κύστη Baker παρά την έσω κεφαλή του γαστροκνηµίου χωρίς εικόνα ρήξης. Συµπέρασµα: Εικόνα οστεοαρθρίτιδας ιδίως εξεσηµασµένης στο έσω διαµέρισµα και την επιγονατιδοµηριαία άρθρωση (στάδιο 4 Kellgren Lawrence). Λόγω της ασύµµετρης κατανοµής, πλέον εκτεταµένης στο επίπεδο της επιγονατιδοµηριαίας συµβολής τιθεται η υπόνοια CPPD.
translation:
Technique: The examination was performed with T1, PD fs, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

Findings:
- Image of osteoarthritis particularly pronounced in the medial compartment and the patellofemoral joint, with thinning and focal loss of articular cartilage, presence of multiple marginal osteophytes in both compartments and cartilaginous loose bodies in the setting of secondary synovial chondromatosis. Focal areas of bone marrow edema are observed subchondrally in the setting of osteoarthritis.
- On evaluation of the cruciate ligaments, myxoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament is identified.
- Degeneration is observed in the menisci bilaterally with a parameniscal cyst adjacent to the body of the lateral meniscus.
- A cluster of ganglion cysts is identified around the lateral head of the gastrocnemius muscle.
- A small amount of fluid prepatellarly is indicative of prepatellar bursitis. A significant amount of fluid is observed intra-articularly.
- A large Baker's cyst adjacent to the medial head of the gastrocnemius without evidence of rupture.

Conclusion: Image of osteoarthritis particularly pronounced in the medial compartment and the patellofemoral joint (Kellgren-Lawrence stage 4). Due to the asymmetric distribution, most extensive at the level of the patellofemoral joint, the suspicion of CPPD is raised.

report: МР находка: Няма данни за ставен излив. Костите формиращи дясната колянна става, са с нормална форма, структура и сигнален интензитет. Хрущялът покриващ ставните повърхности е със запазена цялост, хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Наличие на хоризонтална лезия с повишен сигнален интензитет в задния рог на медиалния мениск, не достигаща ставните повърхности. Ретинакулуми – без особености. Мастната тъкан на Хофа е с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Визуализира се единична Бекерова киста в поплитеалната ямка с типична локализация между сухожилията на m.semimembranosus и m.semitendinosus. Заключение:  МР данни за лезия в задния рог на медиалния мениск, както при grade 2a. Малка Бекерова киста с описаната локализация.
translation: MRI findings: No evidence of joint effusion. The bones forming the right knee joint are of normal shape, structure, and signal intensity. Presence of a horizontal lesion with increased signal intensity in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, not reaching the articular surfaces. Preserved structure and signal intensity of the anterior horn of the medial meniscus and of the lateral meniscus. The cruciate ligaments and collateral ligaments are intact with preserved signal characteristics. Retinacula – unremarkable. Hoffa's fat pad is of homogeneous structure and signal intensity. A single Baker's cyst is visualized in the popliteal fossa with typical location between the tendons of m. semimembranosus and m. semitendinosus. Conclusion: MRI findings of a lesion in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, consistent with grade 2a. Small Baker's cyst with the described location.

report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs anterior hornda grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Lateral menisküs hafif ekstrude görünümdedir.Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve horizontal yırtık izlendi.  Medial menisküs mediale doğru ekstrude görünümdedir. Ön çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal artışı izlendi.  Medial kollateral ligamen çevresinde hafif ödematöz görünüm mevcuttur ( grade I sprain ). Arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Patellar tendon normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinakulumlar normaldir.  Patellar kıkırdakta bütünlük kaybı , subkondral kemik iliği ödemi ve kistler izlendi (grade IV kondromalazi).Femur interkondiler düzey anteriorda yaklaşık 5x4 mm boyutlarında , patellar kemikte patellofemoral eklem yüzünde yaklaşık 8x4 ve 5x3 mm boyutlarında  osteokondrial defekt ve hafif kemik iliği ödemi izlendi.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda osteofitik sivrileşmeler ve tibiofemoral eklem medial düzeyde eklem mesafesinde daralma ve kartilajlarda bütünlük kaybı, subkondral kistler, subkondral kemik iliği ödemleri izlenmiştir ( dejeneratif artrit bulguları ).Gastrocnemius medial krusda tendonda sinyal artışı izlendi.Popliteal fossada 40x7 mm boyutlarında baker kisti izlendi.
translation: LEFT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: Grade II degeneration is observed in the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus. The lateral meniscus appears mildly extruded. Grade III degeneration and a horizontal tear are observed in the medial meniscus. The medial meniscus appears extruded medially. Signal increase consistent with myxoid degeneration is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. Mild edematous appearance is present around the medial collateral ligament (grade I sprain). The posterior cruciate ligament and lateral collateral ligament are normal. The patellar tendon is normal. The patella is normally positioned. The retinacula are normal. Loss of integrity, subchondral bone marrow edema, and cysts are observed in the patellar cartilage (grade IV chondromalacia). Osteochondral defects measuring approximately 5x4 mm at the anterior intercondylar level of the femur, and approximately 8x4 mm and 5x3 mm on the patellofemoral articular surface of the patella, with mild bone marrow edema, are observed. Osteophytic spurs in the bony structures forming the knee joint, joint space narrowing at the medial tibiofemoral compartment, loss of cartilage integrity, subchondral cysts, and subchondral bone marrow edema are observed (findings of degenerative arthritis). Signal increase is observed in the tendon of the medial head of the gastrocnemius. A Baker's cyst measuring 40x7 mm is observed in the popliteal fossa.

translation:
RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings:
The medial meniscus is extruded 4 mm medially from the knee joint. Volume loss is noted in the meniscus; grade III degeneration is observed in the anterior horn, posterior horn, and body. Grade II degeneration is observed in the anterior horn, posterior horn, and body of the lateral meniscus. Signal change secondary to myxoid degeneration is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament and lateral collateral ligament are normal. Periligamentous edema is observed in the medial collateral ligament. Edema is observed in the prepatellar subcutaneous fat tissue. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Mild fluid increase is observed in the suprapatellar bursa. Subcutaneous varicosities are observed in the medial aspect of the crural region near the knee. Joint space narrowing is present in the medial tibiofemoral compartment; a subchondral cyst measuring up to 18x8 mm and bone marrow edema are observed in the medial tibial plateau adjacent to the joint. Loss of cartilage integrity is observed in the femoral and tibial cartilages at this level. Millimetric osteophytic spurring is present at the corners of the bony structures.
CONCLUSION: Gonarthrosis, medial extrusion of the medial meniscus, volume loss and grade III meniscopathy, grade II meniscopathy of the lateral meniscus, myxoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, grade I sprain of the medial collateral ligament, prepatellar subcutaneous edema, subcutaneous varicosities at the crural level.

translation:
RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings:
The lateral meniscus is normal. The medial meniscus appears extruded, with signal changes consistent with a tear in its posterior horn. The posterior cruciate ligament, anterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. Increased fluid is observed around the medial collateral ligament. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Increased fluid is observed in the suprapatellar bursa. There are findings consistent with bone marrow edema at the level of the proximal tibia and the medial distal femoral epicondyle. The joint space is significantly narrowed at this level. There is a finding consistent with a Baker's cyst measuring 54x15 mm in the popliteal fossa.

translation:

Left knee pain.

Findings:
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Degenerative tear with predominantly marginal involvement of the anterior horn, body, and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with associated extrusion.
Complex tear with a predominantly oblique horizontal component of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with a partially displaced segment into the meniscotibial recess and regional soft tissue edema. Increased signal of the superolateral aspect of Hoffa's fat pad.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.

Impression:
Degenerative tear with predominantly marginal involvement of the lateral meniscus.
Complex tear of the medial meniscus with a partially displaced segment into the meniscotibial recess and regional soft tissue edema.
Chondropathy, grade 2 and 3 lesions of the weight-bearing zones of the femorotibial compartments and of the peripheral region of the lateral facet of the femoral trochlea. Full-thickness chondral ulcers with secondary bone changes of the patella.
Mild joint effusion with mild synovitis. Small uncomplicated popliteal cysts.

translation:
MRI OF THE KNEE JOINT

TECHNIQUE: The examination was performed on a 3T magnetic resonance scanner with PDFS and T1 sequences.

FINDINGS:
- Small subchondral osteophytic formations are noted corresponding to the medial and lateral compartments of the knee joint, with focal thinning of the articular cartilage particularly corresponding to the medial femoral and lateral tibial condyle (ICRS grade II-III), as well as pathological signal in the articular cartilage of the patella, findings in the context of mild osteoarthritic changes. There is coexisting subluxation-degenerative tear in the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus, possibly extending to the posterior root of it.
- The cruciate and collateral ligaments as well as the lateral meniscus appear normal.
- Normal appearance of the iliotibial band, the posterolateral corner, and the proximal tibiofibular joint.
- Normal appearance of the posteromedial corner and the pes anserinus.
- Small intra-articular fluid collection. Presence of a suprapatellar synovial plica.
- Bone marrow is evaluated with signal within normal limits. Presence of dilated vascular branches in the distal femoral diaphysis.
- Edematous appearance of the subcutaneous adipose tissue corresponding to the posteromedial aspect of the knee.

translation:

report:
MRI of right Knee with 
-3 Plane Localizer Right, Sag T2 frFSE FS, Sag T1 FSE, Sag PD frFSE FS, AX T2 frFSE FS, COR T2 frFSE FS, COR T2 frFSE, AX T1


* A lobulated hyperintensity lesion with internal septums in lateral subcutaneous layer of right knee to lateral suprapatellar region on F/S T2WI, about 3*9*11 cm in size, and subcutaneous infiltration, in favor of Morel-Lavallee lesion (chronic expanding hematoma/ seroma)
* Relatively lateral position of patella, reflecting lateral subluxation.
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
> Minimal joint effusion in right knee.
> Preservation of medial and lateral patellar retinaculum
> Mild interstitial increased signal in distal quadriceps tendon on F/S T2WI, in favor of mild tendinitis or Magic angle phenomenon.

Impression: 
1. Morel-Lavallee Lesions /chronic expanding subcutaenous hematoma/seroma in lateral aspect of right knee.
2. Lateral subluxation of right patella.
3. Mild tendinitis of distal quadriceps tendon; differential diagnosis of Magic angle phenomenon.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Three-week history of left knee pain after slipping on a wet floor and slamming knee into wall.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Osseous contusion involving the anterior peripheral aspect of the medial femoral condyle. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Tricompartmental marginal spurring, most notably along the medial tibiofemoral compartment.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate complex multilobulated Baker's cyst with calcified bodies and synovial proliferation.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex degenerative tearing involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn medial meniscus with severe meniscal extrusion of the body and displaced fragment within the meniscotibial recess. Superimposed reactive marrow edema at the medial tibial margin.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse full-thickness cartilage loss about the weightbearing medial femoral condyle with scattered areas of subchondral marrow edema and cystic change. Additional diffuse cartilage loss along the anterior and central medial tibial plateau with scattered subchondral marrow edema.


LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Degenerative signal posterior horn and posterior root with suspected degenerative tearing at the posterior horn-posterior root junction. No meniscal extrusion or displaced fragment.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss/fraying about the central weightbearing lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal partial thickness chondrosis central femoral trochlea. Patellar cartilage is intact. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Bowing of the medial meniscus secondary to adjacent medial meniscal pathology. Otherwise intact.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Grade 1 sprain characterized by periligamentous edema.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific subcutaneous soft tissue edema about the anterior knee. Mild deep infrapatellar bursitis. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Osseous contusion involving the anterior peripheral medial femoral condyle.
2.	Complex tearing of the anterior horn to posterior horn medial meniscus with severe meniscal extrusion of the body and displaced fragment within the meniscotibial recess.
3.	Tricompartmental chondrosis and osteoarthritis, severe involving the medial tibiofemoral compartment.
4.	Grade 1 sprain LCL.
5.	Moderate complex Baker's cyst containing multiple calcified bodies.

Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Imaging of the ACL without tear..

Small joint effusion with synovitis as well as subchondral marrow edema along both tibial plateau and femoral condyles and edema of the posterolateral corner. Findings are concerning for early inflammatory arthritis, for which aspiration should be considered.

report:
Uredan intenzitet signala svih koštanih struktura.
Fermorotibijalna hrskavica stanjena uz difuzne zone hondromalacija I° te fokalnu zonu II° u
lateralnom platou tibije. Sitni osteofiti zglobnih tijela u FT zglobu lateralno u smislu OA promjena.
Umjerena količina izljeva intraartikularno i suprapatelarno.
Prednji križni ligament se prati u kontinuitetu, izmijenjenog signala u smislu mukoidne
degeneracije umjerenog stupnja.
Stražnji meniskofemoralni ligament (Wrisberg) izraženo zadebljan uz dojam intrasusptancijske
separacije- vjerojatno stanje nakon ranije ozljede, kronične promjene.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
U posteriornom rogu medijalnog meniska nalazi se kompleksna horizontalna ruptura sa
vertikalnom komponenetom koja se proteže do donje artikulacijske plohe, zahvaća vanjsku
trećinu (crvenu zonu) meniska - primarno izgleda akutne/subakutne ozljede.
Gubitak vrha unutarnje trećine (bijele zone) stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska, moguće u
sklopu opisane rupture. Tijelo medijalnog meniska gotovo u cijelosti izmijenjenog signala,
umjerene do izražene deg. promjene, moguće uslijed ranije ozljede.
Ekstruzija u području tijela medijalnog meniska za 3mm.
Izražen edem hvatišta tetive m. semimembranosus uz promijenjen intenzitet signala
proksimalnije tetive te izljev u burzi, nalaz odgovara stanju po traumi, tendinopatiji.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova rupture, distenzija korijena stražnjeg roga.
U proksimalnoj polovini lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta nalazi se kraći segment koji odgovara
longitudinalnoj rupturi. Medijalni kolateralni ligament primjerenog je intenziteta signala i održanog
kontinuiteta.
Blaža tendinopatija tetive popliteusa uz okolni burzitis.
Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa, manja zona distenzija patelarnog
ligamenta u području hvatišta za patelu.
Bez znakova poplitealne ciste.
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba. Manje zone hondromalacije I°
patele.
translation:
Normal signal intensity of all bony structures.
Femorotibial cartilage thinned with diffuse zones of chondromalacia grade I and a focal zone of grade II in the lateral tibial plateau. Small osteophytes of the articular surfaces in the femorotibial joint laterally, consistent with OA changes.
Moderate amount of intra-articular and suprapatellar effusion.
The anterior cruciate ligament is visualized in continuity, with altered signal consistent with moderate mucoid degeneration.
The posterior meniscofemoral ligament (Wrisberg) is markedly thickened with the impression of intrasubstance separation – likely a post-injury state, chronic changes.
The posterior cruciate ligament has normal signal and is visualized in continuity.
In the posterior horn of the medial meniscus there is a complex horizontal tear with a vertical component extending to the inferior articular surface, involving the outer third (red zone) of the meniscus – primarily appears as an acute/subacute injury.
Loss of the tip of the inner third (white zone) of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, possibly as part of the described tear. The body of the medial meniscus is almost entirely of altered signal, moderate to marked degenerative changes, possibly due to prior injury.
Extrusion in the region of the body of the medial meniscus by 3 mm.
Marked edema at the insertion of the semimembranosus tendon with altered signal intensity of the more proximal tendon and effusion in the bursa, findings consistent with post-traumatic state, tendinopathy.
Lateral meniscus without signs of tear, distension of the root of the posterior horn.
In the proximal half of the lateral collateral ligament there is a short segment consistent with a longitudinal tear. The medial collateral ligament has appropriate signal intensity and maintained continuity.
Mild tendinopathy of the popliteus tendon with surrounding bursitis.
Normal signal intensity at the insertion of the quadriceps tendon, a small zone of distension of the patellar ligament in the region of its insertion on the patella.
No signs of a popliteal cyst.
Normal congruence of the articular surfaces of the patellofemoral joint. Minor zones of chondromalacia grade I of the patella.
