report:
COMPARISON:[Date].

CLINICAL HISTORY:Chronic left knee pain with ambulation.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The medial meniscus shows a tiny nondisplaced partial radial tear involving the posterior horn, without meniscal extrusion. The posterior root, body, and anterior horn of the medial meniscus are intact. This tear was not shown on the previous MRI from <[YEAR]>.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No patellofemoral subluxation. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 11 mm, within normal limits.

The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Mild chondrosis overlying the lateral patellar facet, also shown previously without imaging progression. There is subtle chondral fibrillation at the medial aspect of the patellofemoral compartment, progressed since <[YEAR]>. There is focal high-grade cartilage thinning involving the anterior peripheral aspect of the medial femoral condyle, new since previous study. Within the lateral compartment, there is fissuring of articular cartilage involving the central posterior weightbearing aspect lateral femoral condyle, new/progressed from <[YEAR]>.

Trace knee joint fluid. Baker's cyst, measuring 31 x 11 x 49 mm. No discrete 10 mm chondral fragment is seen within the cyst, which is increased in size compared to previous.

Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Interval development of tiny, partial nondisplaced radial tear involving the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. No meniscal extrusion.
2. Progressive mild to moderate tricompartment chondrosis, consistent with progressive mild tricompartment osteoarthritis of the left knee.
3. 31 x 11 x 49 mm Baker's cyst containing a 10 mm chondral fragment.

translation:
Clinical History:
Recent left patellar dislocation. Rule out meniscal injury.

Findings:
No significant bone marrow signal abnormalities.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Increased central signal of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus, which could represent a small peripheral tear.
Complex tear of the posterior meniscal root, posterior horn, and part of the body of the lateral meniscus with a segment partially displaced toward the posterior intercondylar region. This is associated with regional soft tissue edema and peripheral bone edema of the lateral femoral condyle with a small regional subcortical fracture. No signs of articular collapse. No other bone marrow signal abnormalities. No significant chondral lesions of the femorotibial compartments. Superficial chondral ulcers of the femoral trochlea. Full-thickness chondral ulcers with secondary bone changes of the medial facet and apex of the patella.
Mild joint effusion with diffuse synovitis. Small uncomplicated popliteal cyst.
Mild increased signal of the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon and the proximal insertion of the patellar tendon, without signs of tear. Soft tissue edema between the iliotibial band and the lateral femoral condyle, probably reactive.

Impression:
Complex tear of the lateral meniscus with a segment displaced toward the posterior intercondylar region. This is associated with mild regional soft tissue edema with peripheral bone edema of the lateral femoral condyle and a small regional subcortical fracture.
Signs of a medial meniscal tear, non-displaced.
Chondropathy grade 3 and 4 lesions of the patella. Superficial trochlear chondropathy.
Mild joint effusion. Small uncomplicated popliteal cyst.
Mild distal quadriceps and proximal patellar tendinosis.

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.

Lateral compartment cartilage: There is marked, diffuse cartilage loss with large marginal osteophytes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is moderate cartilage thinning and surface irregularity at the patella and trochlea diffusely. Moderate osteophytes.

Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Mild degenerative subchondral cystic changes are present at the anterior weightbearing aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and at the anterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. Mild, diffuse synovial proliferation. Moderate size Baker cyst. Small ganglion cyst also arises from the gastrocnemius origins bilaterally.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a complex tear involving the posterior horn extending to the meniscal body. Mild extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is moderate cartilage thinning and irregularity diffusely. Small marginal osteophytes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is a large, complex tear involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn, with maceration and moderate extrusion. A prominent radial tear is present at the junction of the body and posterior horn. A fragment is displaced centrally toward the intercondylar notch.
Lateral compartment cartilage: There is marked, diffuse cartilage loss with large marginal osteophytes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is moderate cartilage thinning and surface irregularity at the patella and trochlea diffusely. Moderate osteophytes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): The anterior cruciate ligament is diffusely degenerated. Both bundles are not well visualized, suggesting chronic partial tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Degenerated, intact.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
There is mild anterior soft tissue edema. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Medial and lateral meniscal tear. Maceration and extrusion of the lateral meniscus.
2. Tricompartmental osteoarthritis most prominent in the lateral tibiofemoral compartment.
3. Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament with evidence of chronic partial tear.
4. Moderate joint effusion with synovial proliferation. Moderate Baker cyst.

translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: The medial meniscus is extruded 3 mm medially from the knee joint, with volume loss in the meniscus, and grade II degeneration is observed in the posterior horn and body. Grade II degeneration is observed in the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus. Increased T2 signal and periligamentous edema are observed in the proximal portion of the medial collateral ligament. The anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament, and the lateral collateral ligament are normal. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Central-marginal osteophyte formation is observed in all three compartments of the knee joint. Joint space narrowing in the medial tibiofemoral joint, with significant thinning and focal destruction of the femoral and tibial cartilage adjacent to the joint, is observed. A subchondral osteochondral defect measuring 6.5x3 mm is observed in the anterior portion of the lateral femoral condyle. Mild fluid increase is observed in the suprapatellar bursa. Edema is observed in the prepatellar subcutaneous fat tissue.
CONCLUSION: Gonarthrosis. Mild medial extrusion, volume loss, and grade II meniscopathy in the medial meniscus. Grade II meniscopathy in the lateral meniscus. Osteochondral defect in the lateral femoral condyle. Grade II sprain of the medial collateral ligament. Mild suprapatellar bursitis.

translation:
Clinical History:
Follow-up of partial PCL tear. Previous study available for comparison from [DATE].

Findings:
On this follow-up, the PCL appears continuous, with low signal on T2 sequences, although persistent increased signal on DP fat-sat sequences.
ACL and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Persistent increased central signal of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus, somewhat more marked on the previous study, without contacting the articular surface, without features of a tear.
Lateral meniscus with preserved morphology.
Persistent partial-thickness chondral defects of the central region of the weight-bearing zone of the medial femoral condyle, unchanged. The remaining femorotibial cartilages without abnormalities. Signs of trochlear dysplasia. Trochlear cartilage without abnormalities. Partial-thickness defects of the patellar cartilage, unchanged.
No significant joint effusion or popliteal cysts.
Mild increased signal of the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon and the proximal insertion of the patellar tendon, without signs of tear.
Pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Small magnetic susceptibility artifacts in the subcutaneous soft tissue in the prepatellar region. Correlate with regional history.

Impression:
Advanced scarring changes of the PCL, correlate with clinical stability.
Chondropathy grade 2 lesions of the central region of the weight-bearing zone of the medial femoral condyle.
Chondropathy grade 2 and 3 lesions of the patella. Mild trochlear dysplasia.
Mild proximal patellar and distal quadriceps tendinosis.

report:

Manja zona edema u području interkondilarne eminencije tibije uz hvatište prednjeg križnog ligamenta i prednjeg korijena lateralnog meniska.
Vidljiva je hondromalacija IV. stupnja patelarne hrskavica uz zone erozije hrskavice u centralnom dijelu i prema lateralnoj faseti.
U lateralnom dijelu trohleje femura nalazi se zona denudacije zglobne hrskavice uz subhondralni edem - također hondromalacija IV.stupnja. Rubna osteofitoza zglobnih tijela u sklopu osteoartritičkih promjena.
Vidljive su i erozije zglobnih hrskavica femorotibijalnog zgloba, izraženije u medijalnom kompartmentu. Opisano odgovara hondromalaciji III. stupnja.
Prednji i stražnji križni ligament su održanog kontinuiteta, primjerenih intenziteta signala.
Degenerativno promijenjen lateralni menisk, moguća manja kosa ruptura stražnjeg roga meniska.
Degenerativno promijenjen medijalni menisk, bez evidentne rupture.
Ruptura anterolateralnog ligamenta koljena.
Medijalni kolateralni lateralni kolateralni ligamenti su održanog kontinuiteta. 
Održan kontinuitet iliotibijalnog trakta, tetive muskulusa biceps femoris i tetive muskulusa popliteusa.
Primjeren je prikaz tetiva pes anserinus.
Vidljiv je izljev u u burzi m. semimembranozusa, posteromedijalno kaudalno uz vidljivu manju poplitealnu cistu promjera 11 mm.
Distenzija medijalnog patelarnog retinakuluma.
Tendinopatija tetive m. kvadriceps femoris.
Održan je ligament patele, smanjene napetosti, moguće hiperekstenzijski položaj pri snimanju.
Ne nalazi se signifikantnog izljeva u koljenskom zglobu.
translation:

Minor zones of bone edema are visible in both femoral condyles below the insertions of the collateral ligaments.
Minor zone of edema in the area of the tibial intercondylar eminence at the insertion of the anterior cruciate ligament and the anterior root of the lateral meniscus.
Grade IV chondromalacia of the patellar cartilage is visible with zones of cartilage erosion in the central part and towards the lateral facet.
In the lateral part of the femoral trochlea there is a zone of articular cartilage denudation with subchondral edema – also grade IV chondromalacia. Marginal osteophytosis of the articular bodies as part of osteoarthritic changes.

The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are of intact continuity, with appropriate signal intensities.
Degeneratively changed lateral meniscus, possible minor oblique tear of the posterior horn of the meniscus.
Degeneratively changed medial meniscus, without evident tear.
Tear of the anterolateral ligament of the knee.
The medial collateral and lateral collateral ligaments are of intact continuity.
Intact continuity of the iliotibial tract, the tendon of the biceps femoris muscle, and the tendon of the popliteus muscle.
The pes anserinus tendons are adequately visualized.
An effusion is visible in the semimembranosus bursa, posteromedially and caudally, with a visible minor popliteal cyst measuring 11 mm in diameter.
Distension of the medial patellar retinaculum.
Tendinopathy of the quadriceps femoris tendon.

No significant effusion is found in the knee joint.

translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: Grade II degeneration is observed in the lateral meniscus. Maceration and a complex tear are present in the medial meniscus, with volume loss in the meniscus. The medial meniscus appears extruded medially. Marked signal increase is observed at the distal level of the anterior cruciate ligament (partial tear). Focal signal increases at various locations and irregularities in caliber are present at the proximal level of the posterior cruciate ligament (partial tear). The lateral collateral ligament is normal. Periligamentous edema is present around the medial collateral ligament (grade I sprain). The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Fluid increases are observed in the suprapatellar bursa and within the knee joint. Cartilage thinning at the medial and lateral facet levels of the patellar cartilage and loss of integrity laterally, with mild bone marrow edema in the adjacent bone structure, is observed (grade 3 chondromalacia at the medial facet, grade 4 chondromalacia at the lateral facet). Osteophytic changes in the bony structures forming the knee joint, narrowing of the tibiofemoral joint space especially laterally, and mild thinning in the adjacent cartilages are present (findings of degenerative arthritis).

Normal.

Normal.

None

Complex tear of the medial meniscus with a longitudinal horizontal component involving the posterior horn and body extending to the anterior horn and inferior articular surface and a radial component at the free edge of the meniscal body. Small joint effusion.

Other findings as detailed above.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST

Indication: 2 months of knee pain after slipping on stairs at work.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:

No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the posterior horn without extrusion. No flipped fragments. No parameniscal cyst.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Oblique tear of the posterior horn without extrusion. No flipped fragments. Parameniscal cyst adjacent to the body measuring 1.1 x 1.6 cm.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Increased signal in the proximal fibular collateral ligament, consistent with prior injury. No tear.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Globular T1 hyperintense and T2 hyperintense lesion within the superolateral Hoffa's fat pad measuring 1.2 x 2.1 x 2.5 cm. The lesion abuts the cartilage surface of the patella and lateral trochlea.
Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Globular T2 hyperintense lesion within the superolateral Hoffa's fat measuring 2.5 cm. Differential diagnosis includes fat pad impingement, localized nodular synovitis, amongst other etiologies. Biopsy is recommended.
2.	Osseous contusion of the anterior medial femoral condyle.
3.	Oblique tear of the lateral meniscus posterior horn without extrusion.
4.	Complex tear of the medial meniscus posterior horn without effusion.

report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Síndrome de fricción de la banda iliotibial.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que no contacta la
superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura. El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal
conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso y tendón poplíteo sin alteraciones.
Formación seudonodular hiperintensa en secuencias DP fat sat bien delimitada que mide
aproximadamente 9 x 9 x 5 mm en sus ejes mediolateral, anteroposterior y cefalocaudal
respectivamente en íntima relación a la unión miotendínea de la banda iliotibial, inespecífica. El
resto de la musculatura regional sin alteraciones. No se observa edema de las partes blandas
entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral de manera categórica en estas secuencias.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Imagen seudonodular bien delimitada en íntima relación a la unión miotendínea de la banda
iliotibial en su tercio distal, inespecífica. Si clínicamente sistema necesario estudiar de manera
dirigida con ecografía de alta resolución
translation:
Clinical History:
Iliotibial band friction syndrome.

Findings:
No significant bone marrow abnormalities.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Increased central signal in the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus that does not contact the articular surface, without features of a tear. The lateral meniscus is of preserved morphology and signal, without signs of tear.
Cartilage of the femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments without abnormalities.
No significant joint effusion or popliteal cysts.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserinus tendons, and popliteus tendon without abnormalities.
Well-defined pseudonodular formation hyperintense on DP fat-sat sequences measuring approximately 9 x 9 x 5 mm in its mediolateral, anteroposterior, and craniocaudal axes respectively, in close relation to the myotendinous junction of the iliotibial band, nonspecific. The remaining regional musculature without abnormalities. No soft tissue edema between the iliotibial band and the femoral condyle is categorically observed on these sequences.
No signal abnormalities of Hoffa's fat pad.

Impression:
Well-defined pseudonodular image in close relation to the myotendinous junction of the iliotibial band at its distal third, nonspecific. If clinically deemed necessary, further evaluation with targeted high-resolution ultrasound is recommended.

report: МР находка: МР данни за медиална гонартроза. Ставният хрущял на фемура и тибията от медиалната страна е изтънен. Наличие на ставна течност на мястото на лизирания хрущял. Дефекти в хрущяла на тибията се виждат и от латералната страна. Вижда се малка зона на субхондрален костно-мозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на фемура. Наличие на остеофитни наслоявания по кондилите на фемура и в по-лека степен на тибията. Остеофити се изобразяват и по интеркондиларните еминенции. Виждат се субхондрални кисти срединно в тибията. Наличие на малък ставен излив. Визуализира се голяма Бекерова киста с размер 74/24 мм. МР данни за изразени дегенеративни промени и руптура на медиалния менискус. Менискусът е увреден и се представя с повишен интензитет на сигнала и уголемен напречник, като същият е експулсиран встрани. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. Малки остеофити се виждат и по краищата на пателата. Хрущяла на пателата е лекостепенно изтънен, без видими дефекти и без костномозъчен едем в нея. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на м.квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата -нормално изобразяване. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за медиална гонартроза. Увреден, експулсиран встрани медиален менискус.
translation: MRI findings: MRI findings of medial gonarthrosis. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia on the medial side is thinned. Presence of joint fluid at the site of the lysed cartilage. Cartilage defects of the tibia are also seen on the lateral side. A small zone of subchondral bone marrow edema is seen in the medial femoral condyle. Presence of osteophytic deposits on the femoral condyles and to a lesser degree on the tibia. Osteophytes are also visualized along the intercondylar eminences. Subchondral cysts are seen centrally in the tibia. Presence of a small joint effusion. A large Baker's cyst is visualized measuring 74/24 mm. MRI findings of pronounced degenerative changes and rupture of the medial meniscus. The meniscus is damaged and presents with increased signal intensity and enlarged diameter, and it is extruded laterally. Normal appearance of the lateral meniscus. The cruciate ligaments are intact. Small osteophytes are also seen along the margins of the patella. The patellar cartilage is mildly thinned, without visible defects and without bone marrow edema within it. Retinacula – unremarkable. Quadriceps femoris tendon, patellar ligament – normal appearance. Collateral ligaments – unremarkable. Conclusion: MRI findings of medial gonarthrosis. Damaged, laterally extruded medial meniscus.

report:
FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Moderate joint effusion with synovitis. Baker's cyst, with further multiloculated ganglion cyst associated with the insertional fibers of semimembranosus.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Incomplete/moderate grade partial radial tear involving the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is meniscal extrusion of approximately 4 mm at the level of the body segment. Intrasubstance hyperintense signal in keeping with degenerative facet changes most pronounced at the body.

Some areas of high-grade and full-thickness chondral loss involving the weightbearing portions of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. Mild marginal osteophytosis, with subchondral cystic changes, sclerosis and reactive bone marrow signal edema in keeping with moderate osteoarthritis.

There is a focal approximately 1 x 1 cm area of subchondral sclerosis and cystlike changes, mild subchondral bone plate irregularity, and associated edema-like bone marrow reactive changes at the medial aspect of the medial tibial plateau, which raises the suspicion of sequela of a subchondral insufficiency fracture.

Mild edema deep to the medial collateral ligament suggesting reactive changes. There is some mass effect on the superficial medial collateral ligament by the extruded medial meniscus.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Longitudinal horizontal tear within the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus.

Mild diffuse chondral thinning. Heterogenous signal intensity of the cartilage in keeping with mild chondropathy.

Some increased signal intensity noted at the popliteus tendon suggesting mild tendinosis. Otherwise, normal lateral collateral ligamentous structures.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Mucoid degeneration of the ACL. Normal PCL.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Normal extensor mechanism.

Loose body versus nodular synovitis anterior to the trochlea groove (series 5, image 18), measuring 9 x 5 x 4 mm.
Mild diffuse chondral thinning.

Bones:
Mild bone marrow edema like signal at the proximal tibiofibular joint, likely degenerative.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
1.Severe medial compartment osteoarthritis with a moderate grade partial radial tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus and associated extrusion of the medial meniscal body.
2.There is a 1 cm area of subchondral sclerosis, cystlike changes, mild subchondral bone plate depression, and surrounding bone marrow edema at the medial tibial plateau, raising suspicion for sequelae of a subchondral insufficiency fracture.
3.Longitudinal horizontal tear within the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
4.Mild chondropathy at the medial and patellofemoral compartments.
5.A 9 mm structure is noted anterior to the trochlea, suggesting an intra-articular body.
6.Moderate joint effusion and synovitis. Small popliteal cyst and multiloculated ganglion cyst about the semimembranosus tendon insertion.

TECHNIQUE: The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat signal suppression, and T2 gradient echo sequences.

FINDINGS
- An adequate amount of intra-articular fluid collection is identified, particularly in the suprapatellar recess.
- Findings of extensive osteoarthritis are noted with large marginal osteophytes in both compartments, full-thickness articular cartilage erosions with accompanying subchondral changes in the medial compartment and correspondingly partial-thickness in the lateral compartment. There is coexisting loss of meniscal mass in the body of the medial meniscus and diffusely pathological signal in the dislocated posterior horn of the medial meniscus and overall in the lateral meniscus, in the setting of degeneration. Marginal osteophytes are also identified in the patellofemoral articulation, without articular cartilage erosions at the same level.
- Nodular loose bodies up to 7 mm are observed, intra-articularly at the posterior recess, in the setting of secondary osteochondromatosis.
- Confluent-multiloculated parameniscal cysts are identified in the medial aspect, with a total craniocaudal dimension of approximately 3 cm.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Complex tear of the anterior root, anterior horn, body, and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a dominant horizontal component and a para meniscal cyst abutting the meniscal body. There is mild meniscal extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Focal full-thickness cartilage fissuring along the posterior weightbearing lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Broad areas of full-thickness cartilage loss spanning the median ridge and lateral patellar facet with subchondral cystic change. Full-thickness cartilage loss at the periphery of the lateral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Mild soft tissue edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. There is patella alta Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Complex tearing of the lateral meniscus with dominant horizontal component, associated parameniscal cyst, and mild lateral compartment chondrosis.

2. Findings suggestive of lateral patellofemoral maltracking with grade 4 patellofemoral compartment chondrosis, mild Hoffa's fat pad impingement, mild distal quadriceps tendinosis, and patella alta configuration.

3. Small joint effusion and moderate Baker's cyst.

report:
Na seriji učinjenih MR presjeka kroz desno koljeno prikaže se kompletna radijalna ruptura
stražnjeg korijena medijalnog meniska s prema van zglobnog prostora ekstrudiranim preostalim
dijelom meniska i posljedično napetim prikazom medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Prisutne su osteoartrotske promjene femorotibijalno, izraženije medijalno s hondromalacijskim
lezijama 3.-4. stupnja oba femoralna kondila i platoa tibije.
Edem medijalnog femoralnog kondila i nešto manje medijalnog tibijalnog s aplaniranom nosivom
plohom medijalnog kondila femura i suphondralnom frakturom na arealu oko 8 mm (SIF).
Vidljivo je više slobodnih zglobnih tijela femorotibijalno, pojedini intenziteta kosti, a pojedini
hrskavice, a opisane su promjene u sklopu sekundarne sinovijalne osteohondromatoze.
Lateralni je menisk je bez znakova rupture.
Prednji i stražnji križni lateralni kolateralni ligament su održanog kontinuiteta, uredne debljine i
intenziteta signala, bez znakova lezije.
Mali intraartikularni izljev.
Izljev u bursi pes anserinusa aksijalnog promjera 3 cm, bez izljeva u Bakerovoj burzi.
Patela je asimetrična (Wiberg tip 3), a femoropatelarni zglob kongruentan s hondromalacijskim
lezijama 4. stupnja medijalne fasete i 2. stupnja grebena patele i femoralne trohlee.
Hipertrofična je medijalna patelarna plica, doseže zglobnu plohu medijalne fasete.
uredne debljine i intenziteta signala hrskavičnog pokrova patele i trohlee femura.
Uredan je prikaz tetive kvadricepsa, patelarnih retinakula i patelarne tetive, a TT-TG distanca
je u fiziološkim granicama.
Blagi edem mekog tkiva prepatelarno i medijalnog dijela supkutane masti koljena.
Na ostalim prikazanim koštanim, mekotkivnim i neurovaskularnim strukturama ne nalazim MR
znakova patomorfoloških promjena.
translation:
On the series of MR sections through the right knee, a complete radial tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus is demonstrated, with extrusion of the remaining meniscal portion beyond the joint space and consequent taut appearance of the medial collateral ligament.
Osteoarthritic changes are present in the femorotibial compartment, more pronounced medially, with grade 3–4 chondromalacia lesions of both femoral condyles and the tibial plateau.
Edema of the medial femoral condyle and, to a lesser extent, of the medial tibial plateau, with flattening of the weight-bearing surface of the medial femoral condyle and a subchondral insufficiency fracture (SIF) over an area of approximately 8 mm.
Multiple loose bodies are visible in the femorotibial compartment, some of bone signal intensity and some of cartilage signal intensity, consistent with secondary synovial osteochondromatosis.
The lateral meniscus shows no signs of tear.
The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments and the lateral collateral ligament are intact in continuity, of normal thickness and signal intensity, with no signs of lesion.
Small intra-articular effusion.
Effusion in the pes anserine bursa with an axial diameter of 3 cm, without effusion in the Baker's cyst.
The patella is asymmetric (Wiberg type 3), and the patellofemoral joint is congruent, with grade 4 chondromalacia lesions of the medial facet and grade 2 of the patellar ridge and femoral trochlea.
The medial patellar plica is hypertrophic, reaching the articular surface of the medial facet.
The cartilage covering of the patella and femoral trochlea is of normal thickness and signal intensity.
The quadriceps tendon, patellar retinacula, and patellar tendon appear normal, and the TT-TG distance is within physiological limits.
Mild soft tissue edema in the prepatellar region and the medial portion of the subcutaneous fat of the knee.
No MR signs of pathomorphological changes are found in the remaining visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures.

report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs anterior, posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade II dejenerasyon izlenmiştir.Medial menisküs diz ekleminde 5 mm mediale ekstrüdedir. Menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade III dejenerasyon ve serbest kenarda ilişkili horizontal yırtık izlenmiştir.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir. Medial kollateral ligamanda periligamantöz ödem izlenmektedir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Popliteal düzeyde femur medial kondil posterior superior kesim komşuluğunda ekstraartıküler yerleşimli 2x1 cm boyutlu ganglion kisti izlenmiştir.Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda incelme izlenmiştir.Posterior çapraz bağ posterior komşuluğunda 1 cm çaplı ganglion kisti izlenmiştir.Sonuç: Tibiofemoral eklem medialde, eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu kartilajlarda fokal incelme, medial menisküste medial ekstrüzyon, grade III meniskopati ve horizontal yırtık, lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati, medial kollateral ligamanda grade I sprain, popliteal fossada ekstraartıküler ganglion kisti, suprapatellar hafif bursit .
translation:
RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: Grade II degeneration is observed in the anterior horn, posterior horn, and body of the lateral meniscus. The medial meniscus is extruded 5 mm medially in the knee joint. Grade III degeneration and an associated horizontal tear at the free edge are observed in the posterior horn and body of the meniscus. The anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament, and the lateral collateral ligament are normal. Periligamentous edema is observed in the medial collateral ligament. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. A 2x1 cm extra-articular ganglion cyst is observed in the vicinity of the posterior superior aspect of the medial femoral condyle at the popliteal level. Joint space narrowing in the medial tibiofemoral joint, and thinning of the femoral and tibial cartilages adjacent to the joint are observed. A 1 cm diameter ganglion cyst is observed in the posterior vicinity of the posterior cruciate ligament.
Conclusion: Joint space narrowing in the medial tibiofemoral joint, focal thinning of the cartilages adjacent to the joint, medial extrusion of the medial meniscus, grade III meniscopathy and horizontal tear, grade II meniscopathy of the lateral meniscus, grade I sprain of the medial collateral ligament, extra-articular ganglion cyst in the popliteal fossa, mild suprapatellar bursitis.

translation:

High-grade complete tear of the ACL associated with bone edema and probable subcortical fracture of the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau.

Moderate joint effusion.

report: МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив.  Вижда се изразен костномозъчен едем в латерален фемурален кондил, разположен предимно епифизарно и в по-слаба степен метафизарно. В латералното плато на фемура сред описания едем, субхондрално се вижда хипоинтензна линия, следваща хода на ставния хрущял. Няма данни за депресия на костта. Хиалинният хрущял на тибията и фемура двустранно е съхранен. В задния рог на медиалния менискус се вижда хиперинтензна линеарна лезия с кос ход, която достига до края на менискуса и до ставния хрущял на тибията – grade 3. Не се изобразяват патологични лезии в останалите менискуси. Нормално изобразяване на предната и задната кръстна връзка. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. translation: MRI findings: MRI evidence of joint effusion. Quadriceps femoris tendon and patellar ligament – unremarkable. Soft tissue edema in the popliteal fossa. Patella – small subchondral cysts beneath the patellar cartilage. Lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 3.

Мастната тъкан на Хофа е с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Пателата се представя Wiberg II. Insall-Salvati- 1,3. Заключение:

Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et le tendon du poplité, le biceps femoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibial sont sans particularité.

translation:
Findings:

There is a small intra-articular effusion without a popliteal cyst.

There is mild thinning and superficial fibrillation of the cartilage involving all three compartments, more prominent in the medial compartment. There is no region of full-thickness cartilage loss.

There are mild intrasubstance degenerative changes involving the body to the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is no well-defined linear tear. The lateral meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise, the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the semimembranosus, the popliteus muscle and tendon, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament, and the iliotibial band are unremarkable.

Conclusion:

1- Mild degenerative changes more prominent in the medial compartment as described above.

2- Intrasubstance degenerative changes involving the medial meniscus without a well-defined linear tear.

3- Small intra-articular effusion without a popliteal cyst.

Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Complete, subacute tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

report:
Interprétation :

Il n’y a pas d’épanchement intra-articulaire ou kyste de Baker significatif. 

Le ménisque interne est intact sans déchirure. Le ménisque externe est de nature discoïde sans évidence de déchirure associée.

Le ligament collatéral interne de même que le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe sont intacts sans déchirure.

Il y a un léger œdème toutefois entre la bandelette ilio-tibiale et le reste du complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe qui pourrait suggérer un syndrome de friction. Pas de loculation liquidienne pour suggérer une bursite.

Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure.

L’alignement patellofémoral est dans les limites de la normale. Les tendons du quadriceps distal et patellaire sont intacts sans déchirure.

Les surfaces cartilagineuses sont préservées sans atteinte transfixiante ou changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés.

Conclusion :

Aspect discoïde du ménisque externe sans déchirure associée. Pas de dérangement interne au genou. Pas d’épanchement intra-articulaire. Signes d’un léger syndrôme de friction de la bandelette ilio-tibiale.
translation:
Interpretation:

There is no significant intra-articular effusion or Baker's cyst.

The medial meniscus is intact without tear. The lateral meniscus is discoid in nature without evidence of associated tear.

The medial collateral ligament as well as the lateral collateral ligament complex are intact without tear.

There is mild edema however between the iliotibial band and the remainder of the lateral collateral ligament complex which could suggest a friction syndrome. No fluid loculation to suggest bursitis.

The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact without tear.

Patellofemoral alignment is within normal limits. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact without tear.

The cartilage surfaces are preserved without full-thickness defect or associated reactive subchondral changes.

Conclusion:

Discoid appearance of the lateral meniscus without associated tear. No internal derangement of the knee. No intra-articular effusion. Signs of mild iliotibial band friction syndrome.

report: Gelenkspaltverschmälerung führend im medialen femoro-tibialen Kompartiment. Deutliche Osteophytenbildung führend medialseitig. Allenfalls gering ausgedünnter Knorpelbelag im lateralen  femoro-tibialen Gelenk ohne höhergradige fokale Läsionen. Zentrierte Stellung der Patella. Unauffälliger Knorpelbesatz an der retropatellaren Facette. Fokal bis vollschichtige Rissbildung des Knorpels an der Trochlea femoris medialseitig (4/16). Fabella. Geringe Ödemsignal subchondral lateral an der Eminentiae interkondylares (5/19). Extensionsstellung des Innenmeniskus bei Rissbildung des Vorderhornes (5/19) mit Beteiligung der Wurzel und deutlich ausgedünnter Pars intermedia bis zum Übergang in das Hinterhorn (5/22). Mukoide Degeneration des Meniskus. Mukoide Degeneration am Außenmeniskushinterhorn mit vertikaler Rissbildung bei Austritt an der tibialen Gelenkfläche (6/20). Am ehesten degenerative Signalanhebung im Verlauf des vorderen Kreuzbandes ohne Rissbildung. Intakte Darstellung des hinteren Kreuzbandes. Intakte Darstellung des lateralen Kollateralbandes, Reizzustand des medialen Kollateralbandes. Keine eindeutige freien Gelenkkörper. Geringer Erguss. translation: Joint space narrowing predominantly in the medial femorotibial compartment. Marked osteophyte formation predominantly on the medial side. At most mildly thinned cartilage covering in the lateral femorotibial joint without higher-grade focal lesions. Centered position of the patella. Unremarkable cartilage covering at the retropatellar facet. Focal to full-thickness cartilage tearing at the medial aspect of the femoral trochlea (4/16). Fabella. Mild subchondral edema signal laterally at the intercondylar eminence (5/19). Extrusion of the medial meniscus with tearing of the anterior horn (5/19) with involvement of the root and markedly thinned pars intermedia up to the transition into the posterior horn (5/22). Myxoid degeneration of the meniscus. Myxoid degeneration of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with vertical tearing at the exit at the tibial articular surface (6/20). Most likely degenerative signal increase in the course of the anterior cruciate ligament without tearing. Intact appearance of the posterior cruciate ligament. Intact appearance of the lateral collateral ligament, irritation of the medial collateral ligament. No definite loose bodies. Mild effusion. Intact appearance of the quadriceps and patellar tendons. Baker's cyst.

Indication: 2 months of right knee pain, hyperextension on fishing trip
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Diffuse cortical thickening and sclerosis with trabecular prominence. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Full-thickness radial tear of the posterior root with mild extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Areas of full thickness fissuring in the medial compartment.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness chondral fissuring the central trochlea. Maintenance of the patellar cartilage. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Edema surrounding the MCL consistent with g1 sprain
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.

Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Low grade strain of the vastus medialis muscle belly. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Full thickness radial tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with mild extrusion.
2. Moderate trochlear and medial compartment chondrosis. 
3. Diffuse cortical thickening and trabecular prominence which may be on the basis of Paget's disease or other metabolic bone etiology. Recommend correlation with radiography.

report: МР находка: Лява колянна става: МР данни за изразени дегенеративни изменения в лявата колянна става. Ставният хрущял от медиалната страна е изцяло лизиран. От латералната страна се виждат дефекти в ставния хрущял срединно.  Сравнително запазен е хрущяла на пателата. МР данни за масивни остеофити по кондилите на фемура и тибията. Сравително по-малки остеофити се изобразяват и в горния и долен край на пателата. Изострени са интеркондиларните еминенциии. Наличие на ставен излив с хетерогенно съдържимо, вероятно хемартроза.  МР данни за руптура на предната кръстна връзка с давност. Задната кръстна връзка е интактна. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Визуализират се тежки дегенеративни промени в двата менискуса –латералния менискус е с белези на парциална увреда и е експулсиран встряни, докато медиалният менискус е дегенерирал изцяло и не се визуализира. Изобразяват се част от фрагментиран заден рог на медиалния менискус. Наличие на субкортикални костни кисти – геоди в медиалния кондил на фемура  и на нивото на интеркондиларните еминенции. Визуализират се вкалцявания в меките тъкани дорзално от тибията. Заключение: МР данни за напреднала гонартроза, по-изразена от медиалната страна. Дегенеративна промяна в двата менискуса. Фрагментиран е задния рог на медиалния менискус, латералния е експулсиран встрани. Руптура на предната кръстна връзка с давност. Ставен излив с белези на хемартроза. В ДД плана по-малко вероятно е да се касае за първична синовиална хондроматоза.
translation: MR Findings: Left knee joint: MR evidence of pronounced degenerative changes in the left knee joint. The articular cartilage on the medial side is completely lysed. On the lateral side, defects in the articular cartilage are seen centrally. The cartilage of the patella is relatively preserved. MR evidence of massive osteophytes along the femoral and tibial condyles. Comparatively smaller osteophytes are also visualized at the superior and inferior poles of the patella. The intercondylar eminences are sharpened. Presence of joint effusion with heterogeneous content, probably hemarthrosis. MR evidence of chronic rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. Collateral ligaments – unremarkable. Severe degenerative changes are visualized in both menisci – the lateral meniscus shows signs of partial damage and is extruded laterally, while the medial meniscus is completely degenerated and is not visualized. Fragments of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus are visualized. Presence of subcortical bone cysts (geodes) in the medial femoral condyle and at the level of the intercondylar eminences. Calcifications in the soft tissues dorsal to the tibia are visualized. Conclusion: MR evidence of advanced gonarthrosis, more pronounced on the medial side. Degenerative changes in both menisci. The posterior horn of the medial meniscus is fragmented; the lateral meniscus is extruded laterally. Chronic rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament. Joint effusion with signs of hemarthrosis. In the differential diagnosis, primary synovial chondromatosis is less likely.

Единични малокалибрени субхондрални кисти под медиалната интеркондиларна еминенция. Мекотъканен едем в медиалната подкожна мастна тъкан. Едемни промени по хода на медиалния колатерален лигамент, като последният е със запазена цялост. Латерален  колатераелен лигамент- запазена цялост и сигнална характеристика. Хрущялът покриващ ставните повърхности на костите и пателата е със запазена цялост. Начални дегенеративни промени в задния рог на медиалния мениск, като последния е с нискостепенно повишен сигнален интензитет. Нормално изобразяване на преден рог на медиален менискус и на латерален менискус. Двете кръстни връзки се проследяват до залавните си места с правилна форма и сингален интензитет. МР данни за минимален ставен излив. Пателата се представя Wiberg II. Insall-Salvati- 1,18. Ретинакулуми – без особености. Заключение:  Увреда на медиален колатерален лигамент - grade I. Посттравматични промени в медиалната подкожна мастна тъкан. Начални дегенеративни промени в заден рог на медиален менискус.
translation: MRI findings: The bones forming the left knee joint are depicted with homogeneous structure and signal intensity. Single small-caliber subchondral cysts beneath the medial intercondylar eminence. Soft tissue edema in the medial subcutaneous fat. Edematous changes along the course of the medial collateral ligament, with the latter maintaining its integrity. Lateral collateral ligament – preserved integrity and signal characteristics. The cartilage covering the articular surfaces of the bones and the patella is intact. Early degenerative changes in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with the latter showing mildly increased signal intensity. Normal appearance of the anterior horn of the medial meniscus and of the lateral meniscus. Both cruciate ligaments are traced to their attachment sites with normal morphology and signal intensity. MRI evidence of minimal joint effusion. The patella is Wiberg type II. Insall-Salvati ratio: 1.18. Retinacula – unremarkable. Conclusion: Medial collateral ligament injury – grade I. Post-traumatic changes in the medial subcutaneous fat. Early degenerative changes in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.

translation: Mild bone marrow edema in the lateral tibial plateau. The lateral collateral ligament is mildly thickened with increased signal on edema-sensitive sequences, but structurally intact. Normal signal of the medial collateral ligament. Small focal chondropathy at the lateral femoral condyle (4/25). Thinned cartilage in the lateral compartment. Joint effusion with lateral and suprapatellar predominance. Baker's cyst with a craniocaudal measurement of 5 cm.

translation:
MAGNETIC RESONANCE IMAGING OF THE RIGHT KNEE

Technique: The examination was performed with T1, PD fs, and T2* pulse sequences.

Findings:
- Extensive bone marrow edema in the proximal metaphysis/epiphysis of the tibia, representing a bone contusion in the context of the reported injury.
- Edematous appearance of the anterior cruciate ligament with fiber discontinuity in the context of a subtotal (near-complete) tear.
- Edematous appearance and discontinuity at the proximal portion of the medial collateral ligament with surrounding edema in the context of a partial tear (grade 2).
- Significant amount of intra-articular fluid collection.
- Fluid collection prepatellarly in the context of prepatellar bursitis.
- Degeneration is observed in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
- Thinning and irregularity of the articular cartilage margin, particularly in the medial compartment and the medial articular cartilage of the patella, in the context of early osteoarthritis.
- No significant findings are observed on evaluation of the extensor mechanism and the remaining articular cartilage.

translation: Minimal increase in intra-articular fluid of the knee joint. Cruciate and collateral ligaments are normal. Bone island in the lateral femoral condyle measures 6 mm in diameter. Bone island in the medial femoral condyle measures 4 mm in diameter. Degeneration in the posterior horn-body of the medial meniscus is not accompanied by a tear. Free edge irregularity at the level of the lateral meniscus body is suspicious for a fraying-type tear at this level. Intraosseous ganglion cyst in the segment of the medial collateral ligament near the femoral insertion measures 1 cm in diameter. Patellofemoral joint degeneration is characterized by thinning reaching 50% of the cartilage thickness in the central trochlear cartilage around the patellar apex and millimeter-sized subchondral fibrovascular changes. Posterolateral and posteromedial corner structures are preserved. Articular cartilages and bones are otherwise normal. Extensor mechanism is preserved (quadriceps tendon and patellar tendon, patella and its position, femoral trochlear groove and patellofemoral ligaments are normal). Distal thigh and proximal leg muscles are atrophic, most prominently in the medial and lateral heads of the gastrocnemius muscle.

report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı normal. translation: Intra-articular fluid volume is normal. Edema in the quadriceps fat pad may be a cause of anterior knee pain. The patella is low-riding with an Insall-Salvati ratio of 0.7. The extensor mechanism is otherwise intact. The cruciate and collateral ligaments are otherwise normal. The popliteus tendon is normal. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal.

Συνυπάρχει αποπροσανατολισµός των ινών του οπίσθιου χιαστού συνδέσµου, καθώς επίσης απόκλιση της οπίσθιας επαλληλίας µηριαίου - κνηµιαίου οστού (σηµείο του συρταριού) κατά 1,8 cm. Τα ανωτέρω ευρήµατα προσανατολίζουν υπέρ ρήξης (ολικής - υφολικής) του πρόσθιου χιαστού συνδέσµου. Κλινική συνεκτίµηση. - Εντός του φυσιολογικού ελέγχονται οι πλάγιοι σύνδεσµοι. - Παρατηρείται παθολογικό σήµα και απώλεια µηνισκικής µάζας στο οπίσθιο κέρας του έσω µηνίσκου, µε συνοδό παρουσία µηνισκικού υλικού επί τα εντός του οπίσθιου χιαστού συνδέσµου, διαστάσεων 1.5 Χ 0.5 cm, στο πλάισιο ρήξης µε αναδίπλωση. - Αναγνωρίζεται ολικού πάχους απώλεια του αρθρικού χόνδρου κατά το έξω µεσάρθριο, που συνοδεύεται από αλλοιώσεις υποχόνδρινου οστού ισοϋψώς, στο πλαίσιο χονδροπάθειας (σταδίου IV). Μερικού πάχους απώλεια αρθρικού χόνδρου σηµειώνεται και στο έσω τµήµα της επιγονατίδας (σταδίου ΙΙ). - Συλλογή υγρού στο τενόντιο έλυτρο του ιγνυακού µυός, στο πλαίσιο τενοντοελυτρίτιδας.
translation:
TECHNIQUE: The examination was performed with T1, T2*, and PD fs sequences.

FINDINGS
- A large amount of intra-articular fluid is observed in the knee joint, predominantly in the suprapatellar region.
- The anterior cruciate ligament is not identified, except for a few fibers in its anterior portion. There is concurrent disorientation of the fibers of the posterior cruciate ligament, as well as deviation of the posterior femoral-tibial overlap (drawer sign) by 1.8 cm. The above findings are in favor of a (complete – subtotal) tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. Clinical correlation is recommended.
- The collateral ligaments are within normal limits.
- Abnormal signal and loss of meniscal substance are observed in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with accompanying presence of meniscal material displaced medially to the posterior cruciate ligament, measuring 1.5 x 0.5 cm, in the setting of a tear with flip.
- Full-thickness loss of articular cartilage is identified in the lateral compartment, accompanied by subchondral bone changes at the same level, in the setting of chondropathy (grade IV). Partial-thickness loss of articular cartilage is also noted in the medial facet of the patella (grade II).
- Fluid collection in the tendon sheath of the popliteus muscle, in the setting of tenosynovitis.

report: МР находка: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става са с нормален сигнален интензитет. Вижда се дегенеративна промяна и лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Задният рог на този менискус е с повишен сигнален интензитет, като в него се намира хиперинтензна линия с разиерен ход, съоветстваща на скъсване – 3-та степен. МР данни за лекостепенно изтъняване на ставния хрущял от медиалната страна на ставата и малки остеофити по ставните краища на медиалния феморален кондил. Наличие на ставна течност в медиалното ставно пространство. Ставният хрущял от латералната страна на ставата е с нормална дебелина. Патела – вижда се малък хондрален дефект  по латералната ставна повърхност на пателата – остомалация  2 степен. Кръстните връзки са интактни - с непроменена сигнална характеристика и дебелина. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Няма данни за свободен фрагмент.  Ретинакулуми – нормално изобразяване. Колатерални лигаменти двустранно – б.о. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за лезия задния рог на медиалния менискус  – 3-та степен.  Начална медиална гонартроза. Остеомалация на пателата – 2-ра степен.
translation: MRI findings: No MRI evidence of joint effusion. The bones forming the left knee joint have normal signal intensity. There is a degenerative change and lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. The posterior horn of this meniscus shows increased signal intensity, with a hyperintense line of radiating course within it, corresponding to a tear – grade 3. MRI evidence of mild thinning of the articular cartilage on the medial side of the joint and small osteophytes at the articular margins of the medial femoral condyle. Presence of joint fluid in the medial joint space. The articular cartilage on the lateral side of the joint is of normal thickness. Patella – a small chondral defect is seen on the lateral articular surface of the patella – chondromalacia grade 2. The cruciate ligaments are intact – with unchanged signal characteristics and thickness. Normal appearance of the lateral meniscus. No evidence of a loose body. Retinacula – normal appearance. Collateral ligaments bilaterally – unremarkable. Popliteal fossa – unremarkable. Conclusion: MRI evidence of a lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 3. Early medial gonarthrosis. Chondromalacia of the patella – grade 2.

report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Sağ diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda yaygın dejeneratif değişiklikler izlenmiştir.Femur medial kondilinde belirgin kemik iliği ödemi ve milimetrik osteokondral lezyon dikkati çekmiştir.Diz eklemini oluşturan eklem yüzeylerinde yaygın kıkırdak kaybı izlenmiştir.Diz eklem mesafesi medialde daralmıştır.Distal kuadriseps tendonlar normaldir. Patellar tendon bütünlüğü normal olmakla birlikte ondülan seyir dikkati çekmiştir.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Medial menisküs posterior hornunda kompleks yırtık izlenmiş olup medial menisküste eklem mesafesine yaklaşık 9 mm ekstrüzyon izlenmiştir. Anterior hornunda kompleks yırtık ve hacim kaybı dikakti çekmiştir.Lateral menisküs anterior hormnunda grade III yırtık izlenmiştir. Posterior hornunda grade II dejenerasyon dikkati çekmiştir. Anterior hornunda hacim kaybı izlenmiştir.Eklem mesafesinde ve suprapatellar bursada efüzyon izlenmiştir.Prepatellar yağ dokuda ödemli görünüm dikkati çekmiştir.
translation:
RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings:
Widespread degenerative changes are observed in the bony structures forming the right knee joint. Prominent bone marrow edema and a millimetric osteochondral lesion are noted in the medial femoral condyle. Widespread cartilage loss is observed on the articular surfaces forming the knee joint. The knee joint space is narrowed medially. The distal quadriceps tendons are normal. The patellar tendon integrity is normal; however, an undulating course is noted. The anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. A complex tear is observed in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, and approximately 9 mm extrusion of the medial meniscus into the joint space is noted. A complex tear and volume loss are noted in the anterior horn. A grade III tear is observed in the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus. Grade II degeneration is noted in the posterior horn. Volume loss is observed in the anterior horn. Effusion is observed in the joint space and suprapatellar bursa. An edematous appearance is noted in the prepatellar fat pad.

report:
МР находка: МР данни за варикоза на дясна бодбедрица. Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма. Визуализира се акцесорна осикула ретрофемурално- фабела. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. 
Установяват се две лезии на заден рог на медиален мениск, достигащи ставната повърхност. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Хондромалация grade I на пателата. Ставният хрущял на фемур и тибиа е съхранен. Пателата се представя Wiberg-II. Не се установява ставен излив. 
Колатерални лигаменти, ретинакулуми – със запазена цялост. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Заключение: MР данни за лезии лезии на заден рог на медиален мениск, достигащи ставната повърхност grade III. Хондромалация grade I на пателата. Фабела.
translation:
MRI findings: MRI data for varicose veins of the right thigh. The bones forming the knee joint are of normal shape. An accessory ossicle is visualized retrofemorally – fabella. The cruciate ligaments are intact.
Two lesions of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus are identified, reaching the articular surface. Normal appearance of the lateral meniscus. Chondromalacia grade I of the patella. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia is preserved. The patella is Wiberg type II. No joint effusion is identified.
Collateral ligaments, retinacula – intact. Patellar ligament, quadriceps femoris tendon – unremarkable.
Conclusion: MRI findings of lesions of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus reaching the articular surface, grade III. Chondromalacia grade I of the patella. Fabella.

report: МР находка: Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става са с нормална форма, структура и сигнален интензитет. Няма данни за ставен излив. Ставният хрущял на тибията и фемура е съхранен. Нормално изобразяване на медиалния и латералния менискус. Кръстни връзки – без патологични изменения. Колатерални лигаменти със запазена цялост. МР данни за висок стоеж на пателата – patella alta. Вижда се малка зона на повишен сигнален интензитет инфрапателарно в мастната подложка на Hoffa, съответстваща на едем. Възможно е да се касае за Hoffa fat pad импинджмънт синдром. Хрущял на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Ретинакулуми – б.о.  Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Не се намилат промени в поплитеалнта ямка. Заключение: МР данни за висок стоеж на пателата – patella alta. Малък мекотъканен едем в мастната подложка на Hoffa. Възможно е да се касае за Hoffa fat pad импинджмънт синдром.
translation: MRI findings: The bones forming the right knee joint are of normal shape, structure, and signal intensity. No evidence of joint effusion. The articular cartilage of the tibia and femur is preserved. Normal appearance of the medial and lateral meniscus. Cruciate ligaments – no pathological changes. Collateral ligaments with preserved integrity. MRI findings of high-riding patella – patella alta. A small area of increased signal intensity is seen infrapatellarly in Hoffa's fat pad, corresponding to edema. This may represent Hoffa fat pad impingement syndrome. Patellar cartilage – normal appearance. Retinacula – unremarkable. Patellar ligament, quadriceps femoris tendon – unremarkable. No changes are found in the popliteal fossa. Conclusion: MRI findings of high-riding patella – patella alta. Small soft tissue edema in Hoffa's fat pad. This may represent Hoffa fat pad impingement syndrome.

report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Lesión condral.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que impresiona
contactar la superficie articular inferior, sugiriendo una rotura, no desplazada.
El menisco lateral presenta una rotura compleja de su cuerno anterior y cuerpo con componente
radial completo en la unión de ambos componentes, con extrusión del cuerpo meniscal. Esto se
asocia a edema las partes blandas regionales.
Cartílagos los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones.
Aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
Mínimo derrame articular. Pequeño quiste poplíteo sin signos de complicación.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Rotura periférica del menisco medial, no desplazada.
Rotura compleja de la unión del cuerno anterior con el cuerpo del menisco lateral con componente
radial que impresiona completo y extrusión del cuerpo meniscal.
Signos de un síndrome de hiperpresión externa de la rótula.
Mínimo derrame articular. Pequeño quiste poplíteo no complicado
translation:
Clinical History:
Chondral lesion.

Findings:
No significant bone marrow signal abnormalities.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Increased central signal of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus appearing to contact the inferior articular surface, suggesting a non-displaced tear.
The lateral meniscus shows a complex tear of its anterior horn and body with a complete radial component at the junction of both components, with meniscal body extrusion. This is associated with regional soft tissue edema.
Cartilage of the femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments without abnormalities.
Increased signal of the superolateral aspect of Hoffa's fat pad.
Minimal joint effusion. Small popliteal cyst without signs of complication.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserinus tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.

Impression:
Peripheral tear of the medial meniscus, non-displaced.
Complex tear of the junction of the anterior horn with the body of the lateral meniscus with a radial component appearing complete and meniscal body extrusion.
Signs of lateral patellar hyperpressure syndrome.
Minimal joint effusion. Small uncomplicated popliteal cyst.

report:
Patella gering lateralisiert stehend, ansonsten regelrechte Stellungsverhältnisse im rechten Kniegelenk. Kein kontusionelle Knochenmarksödem. Kleine Fabella.

Vollständige transtendinöse Ruptur der Patellasehne ca. 2,5 cm kaudal des Patellapols. Das laterale Retinaculum nicht durchgehend abgrenzbar bei V. a. mit entsprechendem Tonusverlust und elongiert gewähltem Verlauf. Insall-Salvati Index von 1,1 somit kein, Patellahochstand. Läsion des selben (z. B. 9/12). Nur geringe in erster Linie chronische oberflächliche Chondropathie retropatellar ohne fokale tief greifende Läsionen. Kleine subkortikale Zyste an der lateralen Patellafacette (9/10). Moderate Chondropathie der Trochlea (z. B. 9/20). Zarte osteophytäre Anbauten lateralseitig (9/17).

Femorotibial lateralseitig am Tibiaplateau (6/27) sowie an der Femurkondyle (5/25) teilweise vollschichtige Chondropathie. Der Außenmeniskus im Vorderhorn und Pars intermedia deutlich substanzgemindert, im Hinterhorn aufgetrieben und massiv signalalteriert (6/25) mit Signalanhebungen bis in die hintere Wurzel. Deutliche osteophytäre Randanbauten.

Medialseitig vorwiegend oberflächliche Chondropathie mit einzelnen nativer greifenden Läsionen am medialen Femurkondylus (5/24). Der Innenmeniskus in Pars intermedia und Hinterhorn ebenfalls deutlich signalangehoben sowie etwas substanzgemindert (z. B. 5/24). Kleine osteophytäre Anbauten im Randbereich (5/22). Kreuzbänder intakt. Kollateralbänder ebenfalls intakt. Deutliche Einblutungen in den Hoffa'schen Fettkörper und die periartikulären Weichteile. Geringer Gelenkerguss. Baker-Zyste mit V. a. Ruptur bei auf dem gastrocnemicus auslaufender Flüssigkeit. Ansonsten unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Weichteile.
translation:
Patella slightly laterally displaced, otherwise normal alignment in the right knee joint. No contusion-type bone marrow edema. Small fabella.

Complete transtendinous rupture of the patellar tendon approximately 2.5 cm caudal to the inferior pole of the patella. The lateral retinaculum is not continuously delineable, with suspicion of corresponding loss of tone and elongated course. Insall-Salvati index of 1.1, thus no patella alta. Lesion of the same (e.g., 9/12). Only mild, primarily chronic superficial chondropathy retropatellar without focal deep lesions. Small subcortical cyst at the lateral patellar facet (9/10). Moderate chondropathy of the trochlea (e.g., 9/20). Delicate osteophytic formations laterally (9/17).

Femorotibial lateral compartment: partial full-thickness chondropathy at the tibial plateau (6/27) and at the femoral condyle (5/25). The lateral meniscus is markedly substance-reduced in the anterior horn and body, swollen and massively signal-altered in the posterior horn (6/25) with signal increases extending to the posterior root. Marked osteophytic marginal formations.

Medially, predominantly superficial chondropathy with individual deeper lesions at the medial femoral condyle (5/24). The medial meniscus in the body and posterior horn is also markedly signal-increased and somewhat substance-reduced (e.g., 5/24). Small osteophytic formations in the marginal area (5/22). Cruciate ligaments intact. Collateral ligaments also intact. Marked hemorrhage into Hoffa's fat pad and the periarticular soft tissues. Mild joint effusion. Baker's cyst with suspicion of rupture, with fluid tracking along the gastrocnemius. Otherwise unremarkable appearance of the surrounding soft tissues.

report: Stigmata der Pangonarthrose mit deutlichen osteophytären Anbauten aller Gelenkpartner, insbesondere lateral mit hier auch diskretem Knochenmarksödem. Weiteres Knochenmarksödem in der Eminentia intercondylaris sowie der dorsolateralen Femurkondyle bei fokaler vollschichtiger Chondropathie (4/24). In beiden Kompartimenten höhergradig geminderter Knorpelbesatz mit teils flächiger vollschichtige Chondropathie am lateralen Tibiaplateau sowie an der medialen Femurkondyle; medial führend. An der medialen Trochleafacette flächig vollschichtig geminderter Knorpelbesatz. Höhergradig geminderter Knorpelbesatz auch an der lateralen Trochleafacette sowie oberflächlich geminderter Knorpelbesatz an der Patellarückseite mit teils fokalen höhergradigen chondralen Läsionen (7/9 sowie 7/8). Lateral der Außenmeniskus extrudiert (4/22) sowie aufgefasert, Innenmeniskus ebenfalls aufgefasert. VKB und HKB intakt. Kräftiges Humphrey`sches Band ohne Kontinuitätsunterbrechung (5/11-13). Geringer medialer Reizzustand. LCL mit intakter Signalgebung. Mäßiger Kniegelenkserguss mit Reizsynovialitis. Ausgedehnte, lobulierte Baker-Zyste mit einer CC-Ausdehnung von 8,4 cm und einem einzelnen Chondrom (1014/45). Quadriceps- sowie Patellarsehne mit intakter Signalgebung. Die übrigen Weichteilanteile mit unauffälliger Signalgebung in den vorliegenden Sequenzen.
translation: Signs of pangonarthrosis with prominent osteophytic formations of all joint partners, especially laterally with discrete bone marrow edema here as well. Additional bone marrow edema in the intercondylar eminence and the dorsolateral femoral condyle with focal full-thickness chondropathy (4/24). In both compartments, high-grade reduced cartilage coverage with partly confluent full-thickness chondropathy at the lateral tibial plateau and at the medial femoral condyle; medial predominant. At the medial trochlear facet, confluent full-thickness reduced cartilage coverage. High-grade reduced cartilage coverage also at the lateral trochlear facet as well as superficially reduced cartilage coverage at the posterior patellar surface with partly focal high-grade chondral lesions (7/9 and 7/8). Laterally, the lateral meniscus is extruded (4/22) and frayed; the medial meniscus is also frayed. ACL and PCL intact. Prominent ligament of Humphrey without discontinuity (5/11-13). Mild medial reactive changes. LCL with intact signal. Moderate knee joint effusion with reactive synovitis. Extensive, lobulated Baker's cyst with a craniocaudal dimension of 8.4 cm and a single chondroma (1014/45). Quadriceps and patellar tendons with intact signal. The remaining soft tissue components with unremarkable signal on the available sequences.

report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ön çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon izleniyor. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Lateral menisküs normal. Medyal menisküsün arka kökünde tam kat yakın yırtık medyale 5 mm ekstrüzyon ve medyal menisküsün arka boynuz - gövdesindeki dejenerasyonla birlikte. Diz eklemindeki bikompartmantal osteoartrit patellofemoral ve medyal femoral tibyal eklemlerde izlenmekte olup fokal olarak tam kata ulaşan kıkırdak kaybının yanı sıra subkondral  medüller fibrovasküler - fibrokistik değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitlerle birlikte. Pateller tendonun patellaya insersiyonu düzeyinde kısa segment tendonozis izleniyor. Popliteus tendon kılıfında hafif sıvı artışı 2,5 cm çaplı gangliyon kisti ile birlikte. Popliteus tendonu normal. Diz ekleminin posteromedyal köşesi ödemli. Semimembranozus tendonozisi hafif derecede. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler bunların dışında normal. Ekstensör mekanizma bunların dışında korunmuş. translation: Mildly increased intra-articular fluid in the knee joint. Mucoid degeneration is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate and collateral ligaments are normal. The lateral meniscus is normal. Near full-thickness tear at the posterior root of the medial meniscus with 5 mm medial extrusion and degeneration in the posterior horn–body of the medial meniscus. Bicompartmental osteoarthritis of the knee joint is observed in the patellofemoral and medial femorotibial compartments, with focal full-thickness cartilage loss as well as subchondral medullary fibrovascular–fibrocystic changes and marginal osteophytes. Short-segment tendinosis is observed at the insertion of the patellar tendon to the patella. Mild fluid increase in the popliteus tendon sheath with a 2.5 cm diameter ganglion cyst. The popliteus tendon is normal. The posteromedial corner of the knee joint is edematous. Mild semimembranosus tendinosis. Articular cartilages and bones are otherwise normal. The extensor mechanism is otherwise preserved. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal.
