report: МР находка: Лява колянна става: МР данни за изразени дегенеративни изменения в лявата колянна става. Ставният хрущял от медиалната страна е лизиран рочти изцяло. От латералната страна се виждат дефекти в ставния хрущял в блисост с интеркондиларните еминенции. Сравнително запазен е хрущяла на пателата. МР данни за мадсивни остеофити по кондилите на фемура и тибията. Сравително по-малки остеофити се изобразяват и в горния и долен край на пателата. Изострени са интеркондиларните еминенциии. Наличие на ставен излив. МР данни за руптура на предната кръстна връзка с давност. Задната кръстна връзка е интактна. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Визуализират се дегенеративни промени в двата менискуса – при латералния менискус в областта на предния рог, докато медиалният менискус е дегенерирал изцяло. Задният рог на  медиалния менискус е фрагментиран. Наличие на слабо изразен субхондрален костномозъчен едем във фемура и тибията от медиалната страна. Поплитеална ямка – вижда се малка Бекерова киста с типична локализация. Заключение: МР данни за гонартроза, по-изразена от медиалната страна. Дегенеративна промяна в двата менискуса. Фрагментиран е  задния рог на медиалния менискус. Рутура на предната кръстна връзка. Ставен излив. Бекерова киста. Дясна колянна става:При дясната колянна става също се установяват напреднали дегенеративни промени, предимно от медиалната страна. Нарушена е конгруентността на ставата, като ставата е сублуксирана. Ставният хрущял от медиалната страна страна е лизиран изцяло. Фрагментирален и зедният рог на медиалния менискус, като част от менискуса липсва. Силно дегенерирал е предният рог на медиалния менискус. Предният рог на менискуса е уголемен и с повишен интензитет на сигнала. Вижда е се и киста, сквързана с предния рог на медиалния менискус. Лателарният менискус е сравнително запазен. Ставният хрущял от латералната страна е с неравности в контурните очертания, съответстващи на локални дефекти. МР днни за остеофити по ставните краища на фемура и тибията. Изострени са интеркондиларните еминенции. Кръстните връзки са интактни. Визуализира се изрезен субхондрален костно-мозъчен едем в тибията. Вижда се чуждо тяло /ставна мишка/ в ставата. Чуждото тяло е с кръгла форма и големина 7мм, локализирано е дорзално, до ставната капсула и медиално. Голям ставен излив. Заключение: МР данни за напреднала гонартроза, по-изразена от медиалната страна на дясната колянна става. Дегенеративна промяна и руптура на медиалния менискус. Сублуксация на дясната колянна става. Чуждо тяло /ставна мишка/ в дясната колянна става. Ставен излив.
translation:
MRI Findings:

Left knee joint: MRI findings of pronounced degenerative changes in the left knee joint. The articular cartilage on the medial side is lysed almost entirely. On the lateral side, defects in the articular cartilage are seen in proximity to the intercondylar eminences. The cartilage of the patella is relatively preserved. MRI findings of massive osteophytes on the femoral and tibial condyles. Relatively smaller osteophytes are also visualized at the superior and inferior poles of the patella. The intercondylar eminences are sharpened. Presence of joint effusion. MRI findings of rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament, chronic. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. Collateral ligaments – unremarkable. Degenerative changes are visualized in both menisci – in the lateral meniscus in the region of the anterior horn, while the medial meniscus is entirely degenerated. The posterior horn of the medial meniscus is fragmented. Presence of mild subchondral bone marrow edema in the femur and tibia on the medial side. Popliteal fossa – a small Baker's cyst is seen with typical location.

Conclusion: MRI findings of gonarthrosis, more pronounced on the medial side. Degenerative change in both menisci. The posterior horn of the medial meniscus is fragmented. Rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament. Joint effusion. Baker's cyst.

Right knee joint: Advanced degenerative changes are also established in the right knee joint, predominantly on the medial side. The congruence of the joint is disrupted, with the joint being subluxated. The articular cartilage on the medial side is entirely lysed. The posterior horn of the medial meniscus is fragmented, with part of the meniscus missing. The anterior horn of the medial meniscus is severely degenerated. The anterior horn of the meniscus is enlarged and with increased signal intensity. A cyst is also seen, associated with the anterior horn of the medial meniscus. The lateral meniscus is relatively preserved. The articular cartilage on the lateral side has irregularities in the contour outlines, corresponding to local defects. MRI findings of osteophytes on the articular ends of the femur and tibia. The intercondylar eminences are sharpened. The cruciate ligaments are intact. Pronounced subchondral bone marrow edema is visualized in the tibia. A loose body (joint mouse) is seen in the joint. The loose body is round in shape and 7 mm in size, located dorsally, adjacent to the joint capsule and medially. Large joint effusion.

Conclusion: MRI findings of advanced gonarthrosis, more pronounced on the medial side of the right knee joint. Degenerative change and rupture of the medial meniscus. Subluxation of the right knee joint. Loose body (joint mouse) in the right knee joint. Joint effusion.

МР данни за руптура на задния рог на медиалния мениск с наличие на коса хиперинтезна лезия достигаща ставната повърхност, както при руптура grade III. Свързана с увредения менискус се изобразява многокамерна киста с размери 14/22 мм, същата се разполага във фоса интеркондиларис, прилежаща към задна кръстна връзка.
Нормално изобразяване на преден рог на медиален менискус и на латерален менискус. Ставният хрущял е съхранен, с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет, включително и хрущялът покриващ ставните повърхности на пателата. Двете кръстни връзки се проследяват до залавните си места с правилна форма и сигнален интензитет. Двата колатерални лигамента са с правилна форма, хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет до залавните им места. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Няма данни за ставен излив. Normal visualization of the anterior horn of the medial meniscus and of the lateral meniscus. report:
MRI of Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, AX T2W FS, CO T2W FS



* There are linear signal intensity in the medial meniscus with extension into the surface, in favor of tear with medial displacement.
* Mild increased signal intensity in the anterior horn of lateral meniscus on F/S PD image, R/O grade 2 intrasubstance signal, maybe due to myxoid degeneration or contusion.
* Articular cartilage wearing and osteophytes formation of right knee (including distal femur, proximal tibia and patella) with subchondral bone marrow edema over medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau, reflecting osteoarthritis with bone contusion.
* Small amount of joint effusion in right knee with suprapatellar extension, R/O synovitis.
* High signal in the soft tissues medial to the medial collateral ligament and medial patellar retinaculum, in favor of grade 1 injury.
* Increased fat stranding and some fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus, R/O anserine bursitis.
> Some varicose veins in the medial aspect of right lower limb.
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> The lateral collateral ligament appears to be within normal.
> No significant muscle edema noted at distal thigh to proximal leg.

Impression:
1. C/W tear of medial meniscus with medial displacement.
2. R/O grade 2 intrasubstance signal in the anterior horn of lateral meniscus, maybe due to myxoid degeneration or contusion.
3. Osteoarthritis of right knee with osteophytes formation and subchondral bone marrow edema at the medial compartment and significant cartilage wearing/defect especially over medial side.
4. Few joint effusion and R/O synovitis and suprapatellar bursitis of right knee.
5. R/O pes anserine bursitis.
6. R/O grade 1 injury of medial collateral ligament and medial patellar retinaculum.

Suggest correlate with clinical manifestation.

translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat suppression, and STIR pulse sequences. A T2 gradient echo sequence was also acquired.

FINDINGS
On evaluation of the menisci, the cruciate and collateral ligaments, the articular cartilage, and the bone marrow, no significant findings are observed.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Trace joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is a 19 x 15 x 8 mm (transverse by anteroposterior by craniocaudad) osteochondral lesion along the lateral weightbearing aspect of the mediofemoral condyle. The nondisplaced osteochondral fragment is undercut by minimal fluid. There is mild edema and sclerosis in the adjacent bone marrow and mild subchondral sclerosis in the osteochondral fragment.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Nondisplaced 15 x 19 x 8 mm osteochondral lesion in the lateral portion of the medial femoral condyle.
2. No meniscal tear.

report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs diz ekleminden 6 mm mediale ekstrüdedir. Menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade III dejenerasyon ve serbest kenarda eşlik eden horizontal yırtık izlendi. Lateral menisküs anterior ve posterior hornu ve gövde kesimde grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Anterior çapraz bağda komplet rüptüre sekonder bütünlük kaybı izlendi. Lateral  kollateral ligaman normaldir.Posterior çapraz bağ T2 sinyalinde diffüz artıi izlenmekte olup grade II sprain izlendi.Medial kollateral ligamende periligamentöz ödem izlendi ( grade I sprain ).Femur lateral kondil posterior süperior kesim komşuluğunda 17x13 mm boyutlu ekstraartiküler ganglion kisti izlendi. Popliteal fossada 6,5 x1,5 cm boyutlu baker kisti izlendi. Femur interkondiler çentik ve tibia interkondiler eminenciada çapraz bağlar yapışma düzeyinde subkortikal dejeneratif milimetrik kistler izlendi. Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlendi.Diz eklemini oluşturan üç kompartmanda santral -marjinal osteofit formasyonları izlendi. Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma ekleme komşu femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda incelme ve destrüksiyon izlenmektedir. Tibia medial platoda subkondral alanda ödem izlendi. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlandı. SONUÇ: Gonartroz, medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon ve grade III meniskopati , lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati, anterior çapraz bağ rüptürü , femur interkondiler çentik ve tibia interkondiler eminenciada subkondral dejeneratif kistler, medial kollatera ligamende grade I sprain, popliteal fossada baker kisti , ekstraartiküler ganglion kisti, posterior çapraz bağda sprain .
translation: LEFT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: The medial meniscus is extruded 6 mm medially from the knee joint. Grade III degeneration and an accompanying horizontal tear at the free edge are observed in the posterior horn and body of the meniscus. Grade II degeneration is observed in the anterior and posterior horns and body of the lateral meniscus. Loss of integrity secondary to complete rupture is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. The lateral collateral ligament is normal. Diffuse increase in T2 signal is observed in the posterior cruciate ligament, and grade II sprain is noted. Periligamentous edema is observed in the medial collateral ligament (grade I sprain). A 17x13 mm extra-articular ganglion cyst is observed adjacent to the posterior superior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle. A 6.5 x 1.5 cm Baker's cyst is observed in the popliteal fossa. Subcortical degenerative millimetric cysts are observed at the attachment sites of the cruciate ligaments in the intercondylar notch of the femur and the intercondylar eminence of the tibia. Increased fluid is observed in the suprapatellar bursa and knee joint space. Central-marginal osteophyte formations are observed in all three compartments of the knee joint. Joint space narrowing, thinning and destruction of the femoral and tibial cartilages adjacent to the joint are observed in the medial tibiofemoral compartment. Edema is observed in the subchondral area of the medial tibial plateau. Findings are interpreted in favor of degenerative arthritis. CONCLUSION: Gonarthrosis, medial extrusion and grade III meniscopathy of the medial meniscus, grade II meniscopathy of the lateral meniscus, anterior cruciate ligament rupture, subchondral degenerative cysts in the intercondylar notch of the femur and intercondylar eminence of the tibia, grade I sprain of the medial collateral ligament, Baker's cyst in the popliteal fossa, extra-articular ganglion cyst, sprain of the posterior cruciate ligament.

translation:
Clinical History:
Post-sport knee pain.
Findings:
Full-thickness and full-width tear of the proximal third of the ACL associated with bone edema and subcortical fractures of the posterior aspect of the tibial plateaus. There is no significant anterior tibial translation.
PCL and collateral ligaments without significant alterations.
The medial meniscus is of preserved morphology and signal, without signs of tear.
Small peripheral vertical tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus at the insertion site of the meniscofemoral ligament of Wrisberg.
Cartilage of the femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments without alterations.
Moderate joint effusion with mild synovitis.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Impression:
Full-thickness and full-width tear of the proximal third of the ACL associated with bone edema and subcortical fractures of the posterior aspect of the tibial plateaus.
Small peripheral vertical tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus at the insertion site of the meniscofemoral ligament of Wrisberg.
Moderate joint effusion with mild diffuse synovitis.

translation:
Medial Compartment:
Marked thinning of the femorotibial cartilage, partly with full-thickness thinned cartilage (Series 5/ Image 24) and focal subchondral bone marrow edema (Series 5/ Image 20). Otherwise normal bone marrow signal. Complex tear of the medial meniscus with a horizontal component in the pars intermedia and a radial component in the posterior horn. Medial meniscus extrusion in the pars intermedia.

Lateral Compartment:
Normal bone marrow signal. Mild superficial irregularities of the femorotibial cartilage. Suspicion of a radial tear in the pars intermedia of the lateral meniscus. Partial lesion of the MCL with adjacent fluid and mild hyperintense signal alterations.

Patellofemoral Compartment and Trochlea:
Normal bone marrow signal. Focal deep defect at the inferior patellar ridge (Series 4/ Image 14). No subchondral bone marrow edema. Otherwise intact cartilage. Normal appearance of the patellar and quadriceps tendons. Normal Hoffa's fat pad.

Cruciate Ligaments:
Intact cruciate ligaments.

Musculature and Other Soft Tissues:
Moderate joint effusion with thickened synovium. Normal flow void in the visualized vessels.

report: МР находка: Наличие на минимален ставен излив. Визуализират се малки остеофитни наслоявания по кондилите на фемура и тибията, по-изразени от медиалната страна на фемура. Остеофитни наслоявания се изобразяват и по пателата. Наличие на малки субхондрални дегенеративни кисти в тибията в областта на интеркондиларните еминенции. Такава киста се изобразява и в латералния кондил на фемура. Артикулиращият хрущял на фемура и тибията е съхранен. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Колатерални лигаменти – със запазена цялост. Наличие на начални дегенеративни промени в предния и задния рог на латералния менискус. МР данни за увреда в задния рог на медиалния менискус. В него се визуализира хиперинтензна лезия с хоризонтален ход, която не достига ставните повърхности на фемура или тибията. Визуализира се малка киста, свързана с увредения менискус с р-р 7мм. Отчита се леко повишен интензитет на сигнала на залавното място на сухожилието на м. квадрицепс феморис към пателата. Лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за начални дегенеративни изменения в дясната колянна става, по-изразени от медиалната ѝ страна. Лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус – степен 2с. Наличие на малка киста, свързана с увредения менискус. Малък ставен излив.
translation:
MRI findings: Minimal joint effusion is present. Small osteophytic deposits are visualized along the femoral and tibial condyles, more pronounced on the medial side of the femur. Osteophytic deposits are also seen along the patella. Small subchondral degenerative cysts are present in the tibia in the region of the intercondylar eminences. Such a cyst is also visualized in the lateral femoral condyle. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia is preserved. Normal appearance of the cruciate ligaments. Collateral ligaments – intact. Early degenerative changes are present in the anterior and posterior horns of the lateral meniscus. MRI evidence of damage in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. A hyperintense lesion with horizontal course is visualized within it, which does not reach the articular surfaces of the femur or tibia. A small cyst associated with the damaged meniscus is visualized, measuring 7 mm. Slightly increased signal intensity is noted at the insertion of the quadriceps femoris tendon to the patella. Patellar ligament – normal appearance. Popliteal fossa – unremarkable.

Conclusion: MRI evidence of early degenerative changes in the right knee joint, more pronounced on its medial side. Lesion in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 2c. A small cyst associated with the damaged meniscus is present. Small joint effusion.

translation:
Clinical History:
Osteoarthritis. Pain.

Findings:
Diffuse bone marrow edema of the medial femoral condyle with a subcortical fracture line in the anterior weight-bearing zone of the medial femoral condyle, without signs suggesting articular collapse. This is associated with regional soft tissue edema.
No other bone marrow signal abnormalities.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Increased central signal of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus that does not appear to contact the articular surface, without features of a tear.
The lateral meniscus is of preserved morphology and signal, without signs of tear.
Thin superficial chondral ulcers of diffuse distribution in the lateral femorotibial compartment and in the central region of the weight-bearing zone of the medial femoral condyle. Trochlear cartilage without alterations. Partial-thickness chondral ulcers of the lateral facet and apex of the patella.
Mild joint effusion. No pathological popliteal cysts.
Increased signal at the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon with enthesopathic changes.
Thickening and increased signal of the proximal third of the patellar tendon with enthesopathic changes, small intrasubstance tear of the central fibers involving less than 20% of the thickness and width.
Increased signal of the superolateral aspect of Hoffa's fat pad.
Pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.

Impression:
Bone marrow edema associated with a subcortical fracture of the anterior region of the lateral femoral condyle, without signs of articular collapse. These findings could represent phenomena of an insufficiency fracture; correlate with clinical history.
Chondropathy grade 1 and 2 lesions of the lateral femorotibial compartment and of the central region of the weight-bearing zone of the medial femoral condyle.
Chondropathy grade 2 and 3 lesions of the patella. Signs of lateral patellar hyperpressure syndrome.
Distal quadriceps and proximal patellar enthesopathic changes with a small intrasubstance tear of the proximal and central fibers of the patellar tendon.

report: МР находка: Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става, са с нормална форма и интензитет на сигнала. Под интеркондиларните еминенции дорзално и субхондрално във фоса интеркондиларис феморис се виждат субхондрални дегенеративни кисти. Няма данни за ставен излив. Ставният хрущял на тибията и фемура е лекостепенно изтънен от медиалната страна на ставата и със запазена конгруентност. В задния рог на медиалния менискус се вижда хиперинтензна лезия, която не достига до края на менискуса или до ставния хрущял – grade 2c. Не се изобразяват патологични лезии в останалите менискуси. Нормално изобразяване на предната и задната кръстна връзка. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. Патела – б.о. Ретинакулуми на пателата и хрущял на пателата с нормален МР образ. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – б.о. Наличие на малка Бекерова киста. Не се виждат други промени в меките тъкани на лявото коляно. Заключение: МР данни за начални гонартрозни промени в лявата колянна става. Дегенеративна лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 2c. Малка Бекерова киста.

translation: Mildly increased intra-articular fluid in the knee joint. The posterior cruciate ligament and medial collateral ligament are normal. A partial tear is observed at the tibial insertion of the anterior cruciate ligament, involving approximately 50% of the fibers, accompanied by 2 mm retraction. The medial meniscus is normal. A tear in the body of the lateral meniscus has folded and displaced into the meniscofemoral interval. Edema around the lateral collateral ligament in this region suggests a sprain. A linear hypointense line (series 301, slice 28) accompanying subcortical bone marrow edema at the superior pole of the patella suggests an incomplete fracture at this location. Chondral degeneration in the posterior aspect of the weight-bearing region of the lateral femoral condyle is accompanied by subchondral millimetric fibrovascular changes. The articular cartilage and bones are otherwise normal. The extensor mechanism is intact.

smislu degenerativnih promjena uz manju horizontalnu rupturu u području crvene zone stražnjeg
roga te diskretnu ekstruziju meniska. Blaže distendiran medijalni kolateralni ligament uz manji
periligamentarni edem, održanog kontinuiteta.

FT zgloba su primjerenih intenziteta signala. Lateralni kolateralni ligament je primjerenih
intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Prednji križni ligament održanog kontinuiteta, u distalnom dijelu promijenjenih intenziteta signala
uz vidljivu ganglion cistu promjera 3 mm - nalaz može odgovarati degenerativnim promjenama ili
stanju nakon ranije parcijalne rupture.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog kontinuiteta.
Hondromalacija I° medijalne fasete patele.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Uredan prikaz tetive popliteusa, iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa i patelarni ligament su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Bez signifikantnog izljeva u zglob.

Posteriorno uz lateralni kondil femura, uz stražnji križni ligament, nalazi se ganglion cista

translation:

The visualized articular bodies are appropriately articulated.
Altered signal intensity of the articular cartilage of the medial facet of the femorotibial joint –
chondromalacia grade I/II. Increased signal intensity of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus consistent with degenerative changes with a minor horizontal tear in the red zone of the posterior horn and discrete meniscal extrusion. Mildly distended medial collateral ligament with minor periligamentous edema, with maintained continuity.
The lateral meniscus shows no signs of tear or degeneration. The articular cartilage of the lateral facet of the femorotibial joint shows appropriate signal intensity. The lateral collateral ligament shows appropriate signal intensity, with maintained continuity.

The posterior cruciate ligament shows appropriate signal intensity and maintained continuity.
Chondromalacia grade I of the medial facet of the patella.
The patellar retinacula are intact.
Normal appearance of the popliteus tendon, iliotibial tract, and pes anserinus.
The quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament show appropriate signal intensity, with maintained continuity.
No significant joint effusion.
No signs of a popliteal cyst are found.
Posteriorly along the lateral femoral condyle, adjacent to the posterior cruciate ligament, there is a ganglion cyst measuring 10 x 5 mm sagittally with a central hypointensity that may correspond to a calcification.

PCL and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Both menisci appear with preserved morphology and signal, without categorical criteria for tear.
Cartilage of the femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments without alterations.
Minimal joint effusion. No pathological popliteal cysts.
Main structures of the posterolateral corner within normal limits.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Impression:
Full-thickness and full-width tear at the junction of the middle and proximal thirds of the ACL, associated with bone edema and subcortical fractures of the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau as well as the weight-bearing zone of the lateral femoral condyle and peripherally of the medial femoral condyle.
Minimal joint effusion.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Progressive right knee pain in the region of the medial meniscus, suspected medial meniscal tear.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Result cleavage tear extends through the posterior horn of the medial meniscus into the body, without medial meniscal extrusion. Multilobulated meniscal cyst adjacent to the posterior horn, measuring 9 x 5 x 4 mm. The posterior root is intact. The anterior horn is intact.

The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments are intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 8 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Mild patellofemoral chondrosis. Mild to moderate medial femorotibial chondrosis. The lateral femorotibial articular cartilage is preserved.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. No erosions or periostitis. No synovitis or tenosynovitis.

IMPRESSION:
1. Horizontal cleavage tear posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus though medial meniscal extrusion. Parameniscal cyst formation adjacent to the posterior horn.
2. Nonspecific chondrosis medial and patellofemoral compartments, compatible with mild osteoarthritis most pronounced involving the medial femorotibial compartment. No specific imaging features of inflammatory arthritis.

report:
COMPARISON:Prior MRI scans from [Date] and [Date]. Plain films [Date].

CLINICAL HISTORY:Right knee pain, suspected meniscal pathology.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Slight peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body without evidence of discrete medial meniscal tear.

The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 8 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Scattered foci of mild chondrosis throughout the patellofemoral compartment. Preserved medial and lateral femorotibial articular cartilage.

Small knee joint effusion. Of note, there is an ovoid intramuscular lesion of low proton density/low T2 signal within the substance of the proximal fibers of the extensor digitorum muscle, measuring 33 mm craniocaudal, 15 mm anterior to posterior, 18 mm medial to lateral. The lesion shows a thin T2 hyperintense rim. This was not present on the recent prior MRI. The correlative plain films from [Date] show no evidence of focal mineralization in the region of the lesion.

Subcutaneous edema along the anterolateral aspect of the knee and proximal calf. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. Interval development of a 33 x 15 x 18 mm intramuscular lesion within the proximal musculature of the anterior compartment of the right calf. Correlation with gadolinium-enhanced MRI recommended for complete assessment.
2. Mild patellofemoral chondrosis.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee twisting injury, wrestler  
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla extremity system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Both bundles intact.  
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): High grade 2 sprain, most prominent proximally.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Scattered subcutaneous edema about the medial knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
High-grade 2 sprain of the medial collateral ligament.

Degenerativno stanjenje zglobne hrskavice posterolateralnog i posteromedijalnog dijela tibijalnih
platoa s manjim koštanim edemom i subhondralnim cistama. Koštani edem i u lateralnom kondilu
femura posteriorno te u području interkondilarne eminencije.
Trohlearna hrskavica izrazito stanjena.
Patelarna je hrskavica stanjena s fisurama i erozijama u lateralnoj faseti.
I dalje je prisutna veća količina izljeva suprapatelarno i u lateralnom recesusu. Manja količina
izljeva u medijalnom recesusu i intraartikularno u FT zglobnom prostoru. Edem Hoffine masti.
Prednji križni ligament zadebljan, difuzno povišenih intenziteta signala, inhomogenog prikaza
vlakana, s prekidom kontinuiteta u proksimalnoj trećini - kompletna ruptura.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga lateralnog meniska sa širenjem u trup. Povišen
intenzitet signala trupa i prednjeg roga u smislu degenerativne promjene.
Promijenjen intenzitet signala i inhomogeniji prikaz stražnjeg korijena meniska.
Ekstruzija lateralnog mensika lateralno do 6 mm, dorzalno do 5 mm.
Suspektna ruptura stražnjeg korijena medijalnog mensika uz povišenje intenziteta signala
stražnjeg roga i trupa u smislu intrasupstancijske rupture i degenerativnih promjena. Ekstruzija
prema medijalno do 5 mm.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti se prate u kontinuitetu, oba promijenjenih intenziteta
signala pri insercijama za femur uslijed degenerativnih promjena.
Tetiva m. popliteusa zadebljana, promijenjenih intenziteta signala, deg. promjene? distenzija?
Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa i patelarnog ligamenta.
Bez znakova poplitealne ciste. 
Početna lateralna subluksacija patele, uz moguću parcijalnu rupturu medijalnog retinakuluma. Početne OA promjene FPm zgloba.
translation:
Degenerative condition of the articular cartilage of the posterolateral and posteromedial portions of the tibial plateaus with minor bone edema and subchondral cysts. Bone edema also in the lateral femoral condyle posteriorly and in the area of the intercondylar eminence.
Trochlear cartilage markedly thinned.
Patellar cartilage is thinned with fissures and erosions in the lateral facet.
A larger amount of effusion is still present suprapatellarly and in the lateral recess. A smaller amount of effusion in the medial recess and intra-articularly in the femorotibial joint space. Edema of Hoffa's fat pad.
The anterior cruciate ligament is thickened, with diffusely increased signal intensity, inhomogeneous appearance of fibers, with discontinuity in the proximal third – complete rupture.
The posterior cruciate ligament has normal signal and is seen in continuity.
Complex tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with extension into the body. Increased signal intensity of the body and anterior horn consistent with degenerative change.
Altered signal intensity and more inhomogeneous appearance of the posterior meniscal root.
Extrusion of the lateral meniscus laterally up to 6 mm, dorsally up to 5 mm.
Suspected tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with increased signal intensity of the posterior horn and body consistent with intrasubstance tear and degenerative changes. Medial extrusion up to 5 mm.
The lateral and medial collateral ligaments are seen in continuity, both with altered signal intensity at the femoral insertions due to degenerative changes.
The popliteus tendon is thickened, with altered signal intensity, degenerative changes? distension?
Normal signal intensity of the insertions of the quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament.
No signs of a popliteal cyst.
Early lateral subluxation of the patella, with possible partial tear of the medial retinaculum. Early OA changes of the patellofemoral joint.

translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, T2, and proton density pulse sequences with fat signal suppression.

FINDINGS
On evaluation of the lateral meniscus, the cruciate and collateral ligaments, and the bone marrow, no significant findings are observed.
Simple degeneration is noted in the medial meniscus without evidence of tear.
A small intra-articular fluid collection is observed.
In the anterior compartment, thinning ICRS grade II is observed in the articular cartilage of the patella in the setting of early osteoarthritis.
Small ganglion cysts are observed in the posterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle.

Normal signal intensity of all bony structures.
Femoral and tibial cartilage markedly thinned, particularly in the medial compartment of the femorotibial joint, where near-complete bone denudation is visible, but without bone marrow edema - changes consistent with grade 3 chondromalacia.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Medial sided knee pain for 2 months, patient is a runner.
Comparison: Radiographs of the left knee 2/[DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Moderate osseous stress involving the patella. No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is otherwise normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects./

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with superimposed low-grade interstitial partial-thickness tearing of the anterior mid fibers. Superimposed osseous stress involving the patella..
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Mechanical stress across the extensor mechanism characterized by mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with low-grade interstitial tearing, as well as superimposed edema throughout the patella.

report: Transligamentäre VKB-Ruptur mit teils nach ventral umgeschlagenem distalen Bandstumpf sowie korrespondierenden bone bruise-Arealen im posterolateralen Tibiaplateau und im lateralen Femurcondylus auf Höhe des Sulcus terminalis. Keine menisciale Rissbildung bei geringen mukoiden Veränderungen der Hinterhörner (medial führend). Geringe proximale Partialläsion MCL. Teils geringe oberflächliche Knorpelirregularitäten retropatellar. Begleitend deutlicher Hämarthros. Kleine Plica mediopatellaris. Quadriceps- und Patellasehne intakt, unauffällig. NB: Fabella von ca. 5 mm.
translation: Transligamentous ACL rupture with the distal ligament stump partially flipped anteriorly, along with corresponding bone bruise areas in the posterolateral tibial plateau and in the lateral femoral condyle at the level of the sulcus terminalis. No meniscal tear, with mild mucoid changes of the posterior horns (medial predominant). Mild proximal partial lesion of the MCL. Partially mild superficial cartilage irregularities retropatellar. Accompanying significant hemarthrosis. Small mediopatellar plica. Quadriceps and patellar tendon intact, unremarkable. NB: Fabella of approximately 5 mm.

report: Regelrechte Artikulations- und Stellungsverhältnisse im Kniegelenk. Keine relevanten Degenerationen. Flächige Signalalterationen an der Patellabasis (8/8) mit partieller Assoziation zur Quadricepssehne als mögliches Schmerzkorrelat. MR-morphologisch kein eindeutiger Frakturnachweis. Ansonsten allseits regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Kein Hinweis auf eine Fraktur oder ein Bone-bruise. Allenfalls minimale Signalalterationen des retropatellaren Knorpels der medialen Facette (4/14). Keine höhergradige Chondropathie femoropatellar und femorotibial. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband sowie Kollateralbänder intakt. Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne intakt ohne Signalalteration. Regelrechte Konfiguration der Menisken ohne H.a. Rissbildung. Akzentuiert Gelenkflüssigkeit. Bakerzyste. Unauffällige Darstellung der Weichteile.
translation: Normal articulation and alignment of the knee joint. No relevant degenerative changes. Diffuse signal alterations at the base of the patella (8/8) with partial association to the quadriceps tendon as a possible pain correlate. No definitive fracture on MR morphology. Otherwise normal bone marrow signal throughout. No evidence of fracture or bone bruise. At most minimal signal alterations of the retropatellar cartilage of the medial facet (4/14). No higher-grade chondropathy in the patellofemoral or femorotibial compartments. Anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments as well as collateral ligaments intact. Quadriceps and patellar tendons intact without signal alteration. Normal configuration of the menisci without evidence of tear. Prominent joint effusion. Baker's cyst. Unremarkable appearance of the soft tissues.

report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ön çapraz bağın posterolateral demetinde tendon kalınlığının %50'sini aşmayan parsiyel yırtık izleniyor. Arka çapraz bağın posteromedyal demeti varyasyonel olarak beklenenden daha posteriyora insersiyon gösteriyor. Yan bağlar normal. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları korunmuş. Medyal menisküs ve lateral menisküs normal. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal).
translation: Mild increase in intra-articular fluid of the knee joint. A partial tear not exceeding 50% of the tendon thickness is observed in the posterolateral bundle of the anterior cruciate ligament. The posteromedial bundle of the posterior cruciate ligament shows a variationally more posterior insertion than expected. Collateral ligaments are normal. Posterolateral and posteromedial corner structures are preserved. Medial meniscus and lateral meniscus are normal. Articular cartilage and bones are normal. Extensor mechanism is preserved (quadriceps tendon and patellar tendon, patella and its position, femoral trochlear groove and patellofemoral ligaments are normal).

report:
Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala lateralnog
kolateralnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Kompleksna degenerativna ruptura medijalnog meniska u području stražnjeg roga i korpusa.
Korpus meniska periferno je potisnut s posljedičnim reaktivnim periligamentarnim edemom
medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta. U području stražnjeg roga nalazi se meniscealna kost 8 x 9 x
4 mm (LLx AP x CC).
Lateralni menisk degenerativno je promijenjen.
Mukoidna degeneracija prednjeg križnog ligamenta te manjim dijelom stražnjeg križnog
ligamenta.
Plitke fisure hrskavice lateralnog kondila femura i tibije (hondromalacija 2. stupnja prema ICRS
klasifikaciji).
Potpuni gubitak hrskavice medijalnog kondila femura i tibije sa subhondralnim koštanim edemom.
U patelofemoralnom zglobu nalaze se fisure do pune debljine hrsakvice s manjim fokalnim
zonama subhondralnog koštanog edema patele (hondromalacija 3. stupnja prema ICRS
klasifikaciji).
Opsežna rubna osteofitoza zglobnih tijela.
Opisano u sklopu uznapredovalih OA promjena.
Lamelarna tekuća kolekcija površno od iliotibijalnog traktusa. Sam iliotibijalni traktus urednih je
intenziteta signala.
Opsežan izljev u koljenu uz umjerenu proliferaciju sinovije, te lipoma arborescens u
suprapatelarnom recesusu. Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.
translation:
On the series of MR images of the left knee, there is normal morphology and signal intensity of the lateral collateral ligament, iliotibial tract, patellar ligament, and quadriceps tendon.
Complex degenerative tear of the medial meniscus in the region of the posterior horn and body.
The meniscal body is peripherally displaced with consequent reactive periligamentous edema of the medial collateral ligament. In the region of the posterior horn there is a meniscal ossicle measuring 8 x 9 x 4 mm (LL x AP x CC).
The lateral meniscus is degenerative in nature.
Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament and to a lesser extent of the posterior cruciate ligament.
Shallow fissures of the cartilage of the lateral femoral condyle and tibia (chondromalacia grade 2 according to ICRS classification).
Complete loss of cartilage of the medial femoral condyle and tibia with subchondral bone edema.
In the patellofemoral joint there are full-thickness cartilage fissures with small focal zones of subchondral bone edema of the patella (chondromalacia grade 3 according to ICRS classification).
Extensive marginal osteophytosis of the articular bodies.
Described in the context of advanced OA changes.
Lamellar fluid collection superficial to the iliotibial tract. The iliotibial tract itself has normal signal intensity.
Extensive knee effusion with moderate synovial proliferation, and lipoma arborescens in the suprapatellar recess. No popliteal (Baker's) cyst is present.
The other visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

FINDINGS:

POSTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:  There is partial and full-thickness cartilage loss involving the medial tibial plateau with mild degree of subchondral bone marrow edema. There is also mild thinning of the femoral cartilage. 

LATERAL MENISCUS:  Intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:  Within normal limits. 

MEDIAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT:  Proximal thickening of the medial collateral ligament, representing sequela of prior sprain. 

LATERAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT COMPLEX:  Intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: There is a focal full-thickness cartilage fissure of the lateral patellar facet, with mild full-thickness delamination. Moderate degree of associated subchondral bone marrow edema. Trochlear cartilage is intact. 

EXTENSOR APPARATUS:  Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. 

BONE MARROW:  No fracture. 
 
OTHER:  None. 


IMPRESSION:

1. Complete tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus, with moderate peripheral meniscal extrusion. There is also a horizontal undersurface tear of the posterior body.

2. Mild medial compartment osteoarthritis.

3. Full-thickness cartilage fissure of the lateral patellar facet.

4. Small popliteal cyst.

translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, T2, and proton density pulse sequences with fat signal suppression.

FINDINGS
- Complete chronic tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
- Vertical tear of the body of the medial meniscus with subluxation thereof, detachment of a portion, and displacement of the meniscal fragment of maximum diameter ~5 mm posteriorly between the medial tibial condyle and the medial collateral ligament.
- Moderate intra-articular effusion.
- Presence of small osteophytic marginal lesions on the femoral and tibial condyles as well as in the intercondylar notch, without narrowing of the joint space.
- The imaging of the lateral meniscus, the collateral ligaments, the posterior cruciate ligament, the tendons, the articular cartilage, and the bone marrow is normal.
- Presence of a bone island in the lateral femoral condyle without clinical significance.

report:
Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Geringe mukoide Degeneration des Innenmeniskushinterhorns. Kleine Ganglionzyste in der Tibia angrenzend an das Innenmeniskushinterhorn.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Geringe Ausdünnung des Knorpel an der medialen Femurcondyle in der Belastungszone. Kein tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt, kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Intakter Außenmeniskus.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Fokaler tiefgreifender Knorpeldefekt in der lateralen Patellafacette (Serie 7/ Image 12). Keinn vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt, kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder. Kleine Zyste an der Insertion des HKB.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit. 7 x 9 mm messende, umschriebene, rundliche Läsion mit in der PD TSE FS hyperintensem und der T2 eher hypointensem Signalverhalten mit feinen Septierungen mittig in der distalen Femurmetaphyse (Serie 4/ Image 17).
translation:
Medial compartment:
Normal bone marrow signal. Intact cartilage. Mild mucoid degeneration of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Small ganglion cyst in the tibia adjacent to the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.

Lateral compartment:
Normal bone marrow signal. Mild thinning of the cartilage at the medial femoral condyle in the weight-bearing zone. No deep or full-thickness cartilage defect, no subchondral bone edema. Intact lateral meniscus.

Patellofemoral compartment and trochlea:
Normal bone marrow signal. Focal deep cartilage defect in the lateral patellar facet (Series 7 / Image 12). No full-thickness cartilage defect, no subchondral bone edema. Normal appearance of the quadriceps and patellar tendons. Normal appearance of Hoffa's fat pad.

Cruciate ligaments:
Intact cruciate ligaments. Small cyst at the insertion of the PCL.

Musculature and remaining soft tissues:
Prominent joint fluid. A 7 x 9 mm well-defined, rounded lesion with hyperintense signal on PD TSE FS and relatively hypointense signal on T2, with fine septations, located centrally in the distal femoral metaphysis (Series 4 / Image 17).

translation:
RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings:
The lateral meniscus is normal. A horizontal tear related to the tibial articular surface is seen in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Diffuse signal increase is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament (mucoid degeneration). The posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. No joint effusion is detected. The signal intensities of the bony structures forming the knee joint are normal. A Baker's cyst measuring 3 cm in diameter is present in the popliteal region.
Conclusion: Medial meniscal tear, mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, Baker's cyst.

translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: Grade II degeneration is observed in the anterior and posterior horns and body of the lateral meniscus. The medial meniscus is extruded 5 mm medially from the knee joint. Grade III degeneration and a horizontal tear at the free edge are observed in the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus. The posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. Signal change secondary to myxoid degeneration is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. The distal quadriceps is normal. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Subchondral edema and significant cartilage thinning are observed at the medial facet of the patella. Increased fluid is observed in the suprapatellar bursa and knee joint space. A 10x6 mm subchondral osteochondral defect is observed at the lateral femoral condyle adjacent to the tibiofemoral joint. Joint space narrowing is observed in the medial tibiofemoral compartment. A subarticular fracture at the medial tibial plateau adjacent to the joint and edema in the adjacent bone marrow are observed. Destruction of the femoral and tibial cartilage is observed at this level. Millimetric osteophytic spurring is also observed at the corners of the bony structures. A 5x3 cm Baker's cyst is observed in the popliteal fossa. Multiple subcutaneous varicosities are observed at the level of the popliteal fossa.
CONCLUSION:
Gonarthrosis.
Subarticular fracture at the medial tibial plateau with adjacent bone marrow edema.
Osteochondral defect at the lateral femoral condyle.
Myxoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament.
Medial extrusion of the medial meniscus, grade III meniscopathy, and horizontal tear.
Grade II meniscopathy of the lateral meniscus.
Grade III chondromalacia at the medial facet of the patella.
Baker's cyst in the popliteal fossa.

report: МР находка: Костите, формиращи ставата са с нормален сигнален итензитет. Гонартрозни промени с формиране на периартикулерни остеофити и изтъняване на медиалния тибиален хрущял и изостряне на интеркондиларните еминенции. Ставният хрущял в останалите му части е съхранен. МР данни за дегенеративни промени и скъсване на медиалния менискус. Разкъсването се проследява по преден и заден рог, като в предният рог лезията достига ставната повърхност и се визуализира хоризонтално вгъване и фрагментация проследимо в интеркондиларната еминенция. Нормално изобразяване на латерален менискус. Няма ставен излив. Кръстните връзки са интактни. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Ретинакулуми – б.о.. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за комплексно разкъсване на медиалния меникус с наличие на вгъване („flap“) и фрагментация, проследими в интеркондиларната еминенция- grade III. Медиална гонартроза.
translation: MRI findings: The bones forming the joint have normal signal intensity. Gonarthrotic changes with formation of periarticular osteophytes, thinning of the medial tibial cartilage, and sharpening of the intercondylar eminences. The articular cartilage is preserved in its remaining parts. MRI findings of degenerative changes and tear of the medial meniscus. The tear extends along the anterior and posterior horns, with the lesion in the anterior horn reaching the articular surface and a horizontal flap and fragmentation visualized extending into the intercondylar eminence. Normal appearance of the lateral meniscus. No joint effusion. The cruciate ligaments are intact. Collateral ligaments – unremarkable. Retinacula – unremarkable. Popliteal fossa – unremarkable. Quadriceps femoris tendon and patellar ligament – unremarkable. Conclusion: MRI findings of complex tear of the medial meniscus with a flap and fragmentation extending into the intercondylar eminence – grade III. Medial gonarthrosis.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Approximately 2 weeks of right knee pain after fall while skiing.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
There are foci of bone marrow edema at the terminal sulcus of the lateral femoral condyle and posterior lateral tibial plateau consistent with a recent pivot shift type injury. No suspicious bone marrow signal abnormality is identified.

JOINT SPACE:
Alignment is anatomic. There is a small to moderate knee joint effusion. No calcified/ossified intra-articular bodies are identified. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Small focus of surfacing signal abnormality (seen best on series 4, image 21 and series 6, image 19), which may represent a small undersurface tear at the junction of the body/posterior horn of the medial meniscus. No extrusion, displaced fragment, or para meniscal cyst is identified.
Medial compartment cartilage: Slight cartilage heterogeneity and fraying along the central weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle without discrete high-grade defect. Medial tibial plateau cartilage appears intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Intact.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Focal, mild cartilage fraying along the posterior/central lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Markedly edematous and enlarged with near complete/complete mid substance disruption.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Intact.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Intact; minimal periligamentous edema could indicate a grade 1 sprain. A tiny amount of fluid interposed between the intermediate and deep layers could represents trace MCL bursitis.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex/posterolateral corner structures: Intact; periligamentous edema about the fibular collateral ligament and popliteofibular ligaments without significant fiber disruption compatible with grade 1 sprains.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Intact.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 11 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Small amount of intramuscular edema/fluid noted within the proximal muscle belly of the soleus compatible with a grade 2 strain. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Findings of a recent pivot shift injury including characteristic contusion pattern, near complete/complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, and low-grade sprains of the fibular collateral/popliteofibular ligaments. Possible grade 1 MCL sprain.

2. Suspected small undersurface tear at the junction of the body/posterior horn of the medial meniscus, as described.

3. Grade 2 strain of the proximal soleus muscle.

4. Minimal medial/lateral compartment chondrosis.

translation:
Clinical History:
Right knee pain.

Findings:
No significant bone marrow signal abnormalities.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Increased central signal of the posterior horn and part of the body of the medial meniscus, which does not appear to contact the articular surface, without definite tear characteristics.
Lateral meniscus with preserved morphology and signal, no signs of tear.
Superficial chondropathy of the weight-bearing zone of the medial femorotibial compartment.
Cartilage of the lateral femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments without abnormalities.
Increased signal of the superolateral aspect of Hoffa's fat pad.
No joint effusion and no popliteal cysts.
Mild thickening and increased signal of the proximal third of the patellar tendon and the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon, no signs of tear.
Pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Mild soft tissue edema between the iliotibial band and the lateral femoral condyle.
Preserved muscle bulk.

Impression:
Superficial chondropathy of the weight-bearing zone of the medial femorotibial compartment.
Signs of lateral patellar hyperpressure syndrome and iliotibial band friction syndrome.
Mild proximal patellar tendinosis and distal quadriceps tendinosis.

report:
MRI RIGHT KNEE

INDICATION: new extreme right knee pain. Out of keeping with exam/x ray findings. Rule out insufficiency fracture 

Routine MRI of the right knee shows no medial or lateral meniscal tear. The ACL is mildly thickened however this is chronic and could relate to an old low-grade partial tear. No acute tear. PCL intact. Collateral ligaments intact. Extensor mechanism intact.

Small simple effusion. No Baker's cyst. No cartilage defects in the medial and lateral compartments. There is focal severe chondrosis in the lateral patella with cartilage loss and 7 mm focus of bony edema. Trochlear cartilage is intact. No insufficiency fracture.

7 mm nonaggressive bone lesion in the proximal tibial diaphysis medially, possibly enchondroma. A tiny cyst is seen at the base of the medial and lateral tibial spines.

IMPRESSION:

Slight thickening of the ACL suggests old low-grade partial tear. It remains intact. Otherwise, no internal derangement. 

Focal severe chondromalacia patella at the lateral patella where there is a 7 mm degenerative cyst.

report:
In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
The lateral compartment, likewise, appears normal including meniscus and articular cartilage. 
The patellofemoral joint, there is focal low grade chondral defect (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the medial trochlea (about intact8*intact9 cm). Diffuse low grade chondrosis at medial trochlea. Small osteophytes are present. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact. 
The anterior cruciate ligament is present. There is high grade partial tear of the posterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance (mor than 50% ligamentous thickness). There is no tibial translation. 
The medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact. There is tendinopathy of the intra-articular portion, popliteus tendon. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. 
The extensor mechanism is normal. 
Some amount of left knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. 
IMPRESSION: 
-- Mild patellofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of left knee by evidence of chondrosis and osteophytes. 
-- High grade partial tear of the posterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. 
-- Tendinopathy of the intra-articular portion, popliteus tendon. 
-- Some amount of left knee effusion.

The patellofemoral joint, there is focal low grade chondral defect (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the medial trochlea (about intact8*intact9 cm). Diffuse low grade chondrosis at medial trochlea. Small osteophytes are present. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact. 
The anterior cruciate ligament is present. There is high grade partial tear of the posterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance (mor than 50% ligamentous thickness). There is no tibial translation. 
The medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact. There is tendinopathy of the intra-articular portion, popliteus tendon. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. 
The extensor mechanism is normal. 
Some amount of left knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. 
IMPRESSION: 
-- Mild patellofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of left knee by evidence of chondrosis and osteophytes. 
-- High grade partial tear of the posterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. 
-- Tendinopathy of the intra-articular portion, popliteus tendon. 
-- Some amount of left knee effusion.

report:
Interprétation: 

Dans l’intervalle, il y a eu progression d’un épanchement intra-articulaire d’allure modérée à large avec signes de synovite chronique. Il y a également augmentation en taille d’un kyste de Baker multi-lobulé, non-compliqué s’étendant sur 4.4cm de diamètre CC. 

Il y a une déchirure légèrement complexe du ménisque interne dans l’intervalle avec une composante probablement longitudinale oblique à la jonction de la corne postérieure et du corps méniscal avec flap méniscal déplacé au sein de la gouttière antérosupérieure à l’interligne articulaire fémoro-tibial interne. Il y a extrusion modérée du ménisque résiduel. 

Il y a progression d’une chondropathie maintenant sévère (grade 4) au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne avec dénudation transfixiante des surfaces cartilagineuses et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Ostéophytes marginaux modérés. 

Le ligament collatéral interne est intact sans déchirure. 

Léger émoussement du rebord libre de la corne postérieur du ménisque externe sans déchirure méniscale significative. Atténuation chondrale légère à modérée au compartiment fémoro-tibial externe avec fissures chondrales partielles en lien avec une chondropathie de grade 2. Il n’y a pas d’évidence d’atteinte transfixiante ou changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Ostéophytose modérée. Le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe est intact sans déchirure. Il y a multiples kystes ganglionnaires en lien avec la jonction myotendineuse et le récessus poplité au versant postéro-externe du genou. 

Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure. 

L’alignement fémoro-patellaire demeure dans les limites normales. Les tendons du quadriceps distal et patellaire sont intacts sans déchirure. Il y a une atténuation diffuse modérée des surfaces chondrales, avec foyer de chondropathie de grade 4 similaire le long de la facette patellaire interne avec fissure transfixiante et début de changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés et de grade 3 au niveau de l’échancrure inter-condylienne avec fissure chondrale transfixiante. Petits ostéophytes marginaux. 

Œdème sous-cutané pré-patellaire et infra-patellaire, non-spécifique. 

Conclusion: 

Il y a une nouvelle déchirure légèrement complexe dans l’intervalle impliquant le ménisque interne avec composante longitudinale oblique à la jonction de la corne postérieure et du corps méniscal et flap méniscal déplacé au sein de la gouttière antéro-supérieure à l’interligne articulaire fémoro-tibial interne tel que décrit ci-haut. 

Il y a progression d’une chondropathie fémoro-tibiale principalement interne, avec atteinte de grade 4. 

Progression d’un épanchement intra-articulaire maintenant modéré à large et d’un kyste de Baker non-compliqué avec signes de synovite associés. 

Il n’y a pas d’autre changement significatif dans l’intervalle incluant une chondropathie de grade 4 le long de la facette patellaire interne.
translation:
Interpretation:

In the interval, there has been progression of a moderate to large intra-articular effusion with signs of chronic synovitis. There is also increase in size of a multi-lobulated, uncomplicated Baker's cyst measuring 4.4 cm in CC diameter.

There is a slightly complex tear of the medial meniscus in the interval with a probably oblique longitudinal component at the junction of the posterior horn and meniscal body with a displaced meniscal flap within the anterosuperior recess of the medial femorotibial joint space. There is moderate extrusion of the residual meniscus.

There is progression of a now severe chondropathy (grade 4) in the medial femorotibial compartment with full-thickness cartilage surface denudation and associated reactive subchondral changes. Moderate marginal osteophytes.

The medial collateral ligament is intact without tear.

Mild blunting of the free edge of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus without significant meniscal tear. Mild to moderate chondral attenuation in the lateral femorotibial compartment with partial chondral fissures consistent with grade 2 chondropathy. There is no evidence of full-thickness involvement or associated reactive subchondral changes. Moderate osteophytosis. The lateral collateral ligament complex is intact without tear. There are multiple ganglion cysts related to the myotendinous junction and popliteal recess on the posterolateral aspect of the knee.

The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact without tear.

The femoropatellar alignment remains within normal limits. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact without tear. There is moderate diffuse attenuation of the chondral surfaces, with a similar focus of grade 4 chondropathy along the medial patellar facet with full-thickness fissure and early associated reactive subchondral changes, and grade 3 at the intercondylar notch with full-thickness chondral fissure. Small marginal osteophytes.

Prepatellar and infrapatellar subcutaneous edema, nonspecific.

Conclusion:

There is a new slightly complex interval tear involving the medial meniscus with an oblique longitudinal component at the junction of the posterior horn and meniscal body and a displaced meniscal flap within the anterosuperior recess of the medial femorotibial joint space as described above.

There is progression of femorotibial chondropathy, predominantly medial, with grade 4 involvement.

Progression of an intra-articular effusion now moderate to large and of an uncomplicated Baker's cyst with associated signs of synovitis.

There is no other significant interval change including grade 4 chondropathy along the medial patellar facet.

translation:
MRI OF THE LEFT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat signal suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

FINDINGS
On evaluation of the medial compartment, no significant findings are observed.
In the lateral compartment of the knee, no meniscal mass is observed, while thinning of the articular cartilage is noted, with the presence of marginal osteophytes, a small focus of subarticular osteomyelic edema in the tibial epiphysis, and joint effusion. The findings correspond to moderate-severity degenerative osteoarthritis.
On evaluation of the extensor mechanism, no significant findings are observed.
A Baker's cyst measuring 7.5 cm is observed in the medial popliteal fossa.
The ligamentous structures are intact.

report:
Trouvailles :

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.

Il y a légers à modérés changements dégénératifs plus proéminent au niveau du compartiment interne. Plus précisément, il y a amincissement modéré du cartilage impliquant la partie centrale du condyle fémoral interne et du plafond tibial avec léger changement réactif sous-chondral. Il y a un amincissement modéré du cartilage à la facette médiale de la rotule et à la partie médiale et centrale de la trochlée du fémur. Il y a léger amincissement et fibrillation superficielle du compartiment externe.

Il y a changements dégénératifs intra-substance impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure radiale complète de la jonction du corps et de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion du ménisque. Le ménisque externe démontre changements dégénératifs intra-substance sans déchirure linéaire bien définie.

Autrement le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion :

1. Changements dégénératifs légers à modérés plus proéminent au niveau du compartiment interne tel que détaillé ci-haut.

2. Changements dégénératifs intra-substance du ménisque interne avec déchirure radiale complète et extrusion du ménisque tel que détaillé ci-haut. Aucune déchirure linéaire du ménisque externe.

3. Épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.
translation:

Conclusion:

1. Mild to moderate degenerative changes, more prominent in the medial compartment as detailed above.

2. Intrasubstance degenerative changes of the medial meniscus with a complete radial tear and meniscal extrusion as detailed above. No linear tear of the lateral meniscus.

3. Intra-articular effusion without a popliteal cyst.

report: МР находка: МР данни за медиална гонартроза.  Ставният хрущял от медиалната страна е изтънен. Виждат се два дефекта в хрущяла и в костта на медиалния феморален кондил – остеохондрални лезии. Изобрзява се костно-мозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на фемора  във връзка с остеохондралните лезии. Виждат се малки остеофити по ставните краища на тибията от медиалната страна. Изострени са интрекондиларните еминенции. Наличие на малък ставен излив. МР данни за дегенеративна промяна и лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Задният рог на медиалния менискус е с висок интензитет на сигнала. В него се вижда хиперинтензна линия с кос ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Скъсването достига до края на менискуса. МР данни за тендинит и частични скъсвания на лигамента на пателата и сухожилието на м. квадрицепс феморис.  По отношение на напречника на споменатите сухожилие и лигамент, увредата е около 50% и се намира на залавните им към пателата места. Латерален менискус – без особености. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост и сигнална характеристика. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Едем на меките тъкани около коляното. Заключение: МР данни за остеохондрални лезии на медиалня феморален кондил. Медиална гонартроза. Лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус – 2а степен. Тендинит и частични скъсвания на лигамента на пателата и сухожилието на м. квадрицепс феморис. Малък ставен излив. Едеме на меките тъкани около коляното.

Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.

Diffuse bone marrow edema of the lateral femoral condyle with subcortical fracture in the weight-bearing zone and posteriorly, without collapse of the articular surface. Edema of the regional soft tissues.
Marginal fibrillation of the body of the lateral meniscus.
Complex tear of the medial meniscus with a partially displaced segment into the meniscotibial recess and edema of the adjacent soft tissues.
Chondropathy with grade 2 lesions of the lateral tibial plateau.
Minimal joint effusion. Small uncomplicated popliteal cyst.

MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small multilobulated Baker's cyst.

Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.

Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, T2 gradient echo, and proton density pulse sequences with fat signal suppression.

FINDINGS
Evaluation of the lateral compartment reveals small marginal osteophytes as well as mild degeneration of the meniscus without tear.

In the medial compartment, significant degenerative osteoarthritis is observed with complete erosion of the articular cartilage (ICRS grade 4), degenerative tear of the meniscus and extrusion of the remaining meniscal material, presence of marginal osteophytes and subarticular bone marrow lesions on both sides.

Evaluation of the anterior compartment reveals complete erosion of the articular cartilage at the inferomedial aspect of the articular surface of the patella.

Intra-articularly, multiple loose bodies are observed posterior to the posterior cruciate ligament, as well as the presence of foci of lipoma arborescens extending into the suprapatellar recess.

Evaluation of the bone marrow reveals a benign enchondroma in the proximal tibial epiphysis.

Incidentally, enthesophytes are noted at the intercondylar notch, the largest of which is in contact with the anterior cruciate ligament, which demonstrates mucoid degeneration. Small ganglion cysts are observed in the anterior articular compartment and larger ganglion cysts posterior to the distal femoral metaphysis.

COMPARISON:Prior imaging dating back to [Date].

CLINICAL HISTORY:Recent total hip arthroplasty. Right knee pain.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Intrasubstance degeneration posterior horn medial meniscus without tear. The anterior horn and body as well as posterior root are intact. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, and biceps femoris tendon insertion are intact. Mild popliteus tendinosis without tear. The iliotibial band is intact.

The TT-TG distance measures 6 mm, within normal limits. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. No patellofemoral subluxation. Mild quadriceps insertional tendinosis without tear. Mild proximal patellar tendinosis without tear.

Fissuring of articular cartilage at the patellar apex and along the lateral patellar facet with focal full thickness cartilage denuding at the periphery of the lateral patellar facet. Focal full thickness cartilage denuding lateral femoral trochlea near the central trochlea. There is a tiny focus of full-thickness cartilage denuding involving the posterior weightbearing aspect lateral tibial plateau. The remainder of the lateral femorotibial articular cartilage is relatively preserved. Preserved medial femorotibial articular cartilage. 

Small knee joint effusion. Trace fluid in the deep infrapatellar recess. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:

2. Quadriceps and popliteus tendinosis, without tears.
3. Moderate patellofemoral chondrosis consistent with moderate patellofemoral predominant osteoarthritis of the right knee.

INDICATION: Stepped into a pothole earlier this year, left knee supported the weight of the body in hyperflexion, has had deep knee pain since then,? Meniscal injury, refractory to initial management with physiotherapy, x-ray and ultrasound normal

Routine MRI of the left knee shows no medial or lateral meniscal tear. ACL and PCL are intact. MCL and all of the lateral collateral ligaments are intact. Extensor mechanism intact.

No joint effusion. No Baker's cyst. Pinpoint cartilage defect in the medial trochlea [9-84].

IMPRESSION:

No internal derangement. No joint effusion. 

Pinpoint cartilage defect medial trochlea involving the superficial cartilage, with no underlying bony edema.
