report: МР находка: Няма данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма и структура. Не се изобразява костномозъчен едем.   Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и тибията е интактен. Предна кръстна връзка се представя с непроменен сигнален интензитет, задната кръстна връзка също е интактна и със запазена цялост. МР данни за увреда на латерален менискус – в задния му рог се вижда хиперинтензна лезия с кос ход, достигащща до артикулиращия хрущял ан тибията – стадий 3. Частична руптура и на предния рог на минискус в съчетание с менискусови кисти . Частична увреда и на заден рог на медиален менискус – стадий 2а. Нормално изобразяване на колатералните лигаменти, като латералния е изместен встрани от подлежащите менискусови кисти. Хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м.квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Нормално изобрлазяване на меките тъкани в лявата колянна става.Заключение: МР данни за увреда на латерален менискус с формиране на менискусови кисти. Частична увреда на заден рог на медиален менискус.

Indication: Right knee pain

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Broad areas of full-thickness cartilage loss spanning the majority of the lateral patellar facet and at the lateral trochlea with osteophyte formation.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Mild soft tissue edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Elongated lateral patellar facet with shallow trochlear groove and mild lateral patellar translation. No patella alta.     Elevated tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 21 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

Findings of long-standing lateral patellofemoral maltracking with grade 4 patellofemoral compartment chondrosis, mild Hoffa's fat pad impingement, elongated lateral patellar facet and shallow trochlear groove, and elevated TT-TG distance of 21 mm.

Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales

Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.

representar lesión parcial regional.

PCL and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Increased signal of the meniscocapsular region of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
Lateral meniscus with preserved morphology and signal, no signs of tear.
Cartilage of the femorotibial compartments and femoral trochlea without alterations. Partial-thickness chondral ulcers of the patellar cartilage with diffuse distribution.
Mild joint effusion. No pathological popliteal cysts.
Mild increased signal of the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon and the proximal insertion of the patellar tendon, without signs of tear.
Pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Increased signal of the superolateral aspect of Hoffa's fat pad.
Impression:
Findings suggestive of a partial injury of the proximal aspect of the ACL, with partial horizontalization of its fibers, findings that could represent evolving cicatricial phenomena, correlate with clinical history.
Minimal bone edema of the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau.
Increased signal of the meniscocapsular region of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus that could represent a regional partial injury.
Chondropathy grade 2 lesions of the patella.
Mild joint effusion.
Mild distal quadriceps and proximal patellar tendinosis.
Probable lateral hyperpressure phenomena of the patella.

report:
Uredan intenzitet signala svih koštanih struktura.
Reducirana je debljina hrskavica femura i tibije, izraženije u medijalnoj feseti, diskretno
povišenog intenzitet signala u smislu hondromalacije I-II.stupnja.
Minimalni izljev u FT zglobu.
Prednji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Horizontalni hiperintenzivni tračak duž korpusa lateralnog meniska - susp. ruptura.
U stražnjem rogu medijalnog meniska vidi se vertikalni hiperintenzivni tračak cijelom debljinom
meniska u smislu radijalne rupture.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti urednog signala te se prate u kontinuitetu.
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba.
Izmijenjeni intenzitet signala patelarne hrskavice koja je mjestimično stanjena u medijalnom
dijelu sa sitnim arealom koštanog edema subhondralne kosti u smislu hondromalacije IV stupnja. Sitni rubni osteofiti.
Entezopatija medijalnog retinakula patele.
Umjereni izljev u suprapatelarnoj burzi (suprapatellar plicae type II).
Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa.
Blaže povišen signal patelarnog ligamenta na mjestu oba hvatišta.
Opsežniji edem subkutanog tkiva prepatelarno i prema lateralnoj strani koljena.
Manji edem Hoffine masti.
Dorzomedijalno u poplitealnoj jami vidi se septirana Baker cista 10x15x21 mm (apxllxcc).
translation:
Normal signal intensity of all bony structures.
Reduced thickness of the cartilage of the femur and tibia, more pronounced in the medial facet, with discretely increased signal intensity consistent with chondromalacia grade I-II.
Minimal effusion in the femorotibial joint.
The anterior cruciate ligament is of normal signal and is seen in continuity.
The posterior cruciate ligament is of normal signal and is seen in continuity.
Horizontal hyperintense band along the body of the lateral meniscus - suspected tear.
In the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, a vertical hyperintense band is seen extending through the full thickness of the meniscus, consistent with a radial tear.
The lateral and medial collateral ligaments are of normal signal and are seen in continuity.
Normal congruence of the articular surfaces of the patellofemoral joint.
Altered signal intensity of the patellar cartilage, which is focally thinned in the medial part, with a small area of bone edema of the subchondral bone consistent with chondromalacia grade IV. Small marginal osteophytes.
Enthesopathy of the medial patellar retinaculum.
Moderate effusion in the suprapatellar bursa (suprapatellar plicae type II).
Normal signal intensity of the insertion of the quadriceps tendon.
Mildly increased signal of the patellar ligament at both insertion sites.
More extensive edema of the subcutaneous tissue prepatellarly and towards the lateral side of the knee.
Minor edema of Hoffa's fat pad.
Dorsomedially in the popliteal fossa, a septated Baker's cyst is seen measuring 10x15x21 mm (AP x LL x CC).

translation:
Clinical History:
Left knee pain.
Findings:
No significant bone marrow signal abnormalities.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Medial meniscus with preserved morphology and signal, without categorical criteria for tear.
Complex tear of the anterior horn, body, and part of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a main oblique horizontal component associated with small parameniscal cysts of predominantly anterior location, polylobulated, measuring approximately 19 x 10 mm in their longest axes collectively.
Partial and near-full-thickness chondral ulcers of the weight-bearing zone of the lateral femorotibial compartment.
Cartilage of the medial femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments without abnormalities. No significant joint effusion. No popliteal cysts.
Mild increased signal at the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon and the proximal insertion of the patellar tendon, without signs of tear.
Pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Impression:
Complex tear of the anterior horn, body, and part of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with small regional parameniscal cysts.
Chondropathy with grade 2 and 3 lesions of the weight-bearing zone of the lateral femorotibial compartment.
Distal quadriceps tendinosis and proximal patellar tendinosis.

report: MRI ΔΕ ΓΟΝΑΤΟΣ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ Η εξέταση έγινε με ακολουθές παλμών 1, πυκνότητας πρωτονίων με καταστολή του σήματος του λίπους και Τ2 βαθμιδωτής ήχους. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ - Από τον έλεγχο των μηνίσκων παρατηρείται απλή εκφύλιση χωρίς ενδείξεις ρήξης. - Τα συνδεσμικά στοιχεία είναι ακέραια. - Από τον έλεγχο του αρθρικού χόνδρου δεν παρατηρούνται ευρήματα σε έσω και έξω διαμέρισμα. Εκφύλιση παρατηρείται στον αρθρικό χόνδρο κατά την έσω επιφάνεια της επιγονατίδας ( ICRS III). Συνυπάρχουν εκφυλιστικές αλλοιώσεις στην υποφλοιώδη μοίρα του οστικού μυελού στη μεσότητα της επιγονατίδας. - Μικρή συλλογή υγρού παρατηρείται ενδοαρθρικά με στοιχεία υμενίτιδας. - Μικρή συνοβιακή κύστη Baker παρατηρείται παρά την έσω κεφαλή του γαστροκνημίου μυός. - Μικρές γαγγλιακές κύστεις παρατηρούνται στην κνημοπερονιαία συμβολή. - Μικρά οστεόφυτα παρατηρούνται στην περιοχή της μεσοκονδύλιας εντομής με εξόρμηση από τον έσω μηριαίο κόνδυλο καθώς επίσης και στον κάτω πόλο της επιγονατίδος. - Υπερεπιγονατιδικά παρατηρείται οίδημα στο αντίστοιχο λιπώδες στρώμα το οποίο έχει κεφαλουραία διάμετρο 2,5 cm. -Συμπέρασμα: Ευρήματα εκφυλιστικής οστεοαρθρίτιδας στην επιγονατιδομηριαία συμβολή με ευρήματα ιδίως κατά την έσω αρθρική επιφάνεια της επιγονατίδας, με συνοδό ύδραρθρο και ήπια υμενίτιδα. Το οίδημα του υπερεπιγονατιδικού λιπώδους στρώματος θα μπορούσε να αποδωθεί σε πρόσκρουση του τετρακεφάλου τένοντα επί του μηριαίου οστού στα πλαίσια της προπεριγραφείσας οστεοαρθρίτιδας.
translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with pulse sequences: proton density with fat signal suppression and T2 gradient echo.

FINDINGS
- On evaluation of the menisci, simple degeneration is observed without evidence of tear.
- The ligamentous structures are intact.
- On evaluation of the articular cartilage, no findings are observed in the medial and lateral compartments. Degeneration is observed in the articular cartilage at the medial surface of the patella (ICRS III). Coexisting degenerative changes are present in the subcortical bone marrow at the mid-portion of the patella.
- A small fluid collection is observed intra-articularly with features of synovitis.
- A small Baker's synovial cyst is observed adjacent to the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle.
- Small ganglion cysts are observed at the tibiofibular junction.
- Small osteophytes are observed in the region of the intercondylar notch arising from the medial femoral condyle, as well as at the inferior pole of the patella.
- Suprapatellar edema is observed in the corresponding fat pad, which has a craniocaudal diameter of 2.5 cm.

CONCLUSION:
Findings of degenerative osteoarthritis at the patellofemoral joint, with findings particularly at the medial articular surface of the patella, with accompanying effusion and mild synovitis. The edema of the suprapatellar fat pad could be attributed to impingement of the quadriceps tendon against the femoral bone in the context of the aforementioned osteoarthritis.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 9 week history of right knee pain without known injury. [REDACTED].
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla extremity system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Large joint effusion with minimal synovial proliferation. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage defect weightbearing lateral femoral condyle. Full-thickness cartilage defect lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal chondrosis at the superior median patellar ridge and lateral patellar facet with subchondral bone marrow edema.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: There is edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. There is lateral patellar tilt and translation in part related to large joint effusion. Mild patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Mild prepatellar soft tissue edema.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Large joint effusion with minimal synovitis. Consider aspiration.
2.	Mild patellofemoral and moderate lateral compartment chondrosis.
3.	Findings of active lateral patellar maltracking.

translation:
Findings:

There is a significant intra-articular effusion with a small unruptured popliteal cyst. There are inflammatory soft tissue changes around the knee.

There is a complete tear of the midportion of the anterior cruciate ligament. There is a complete tear of the origin of the medial collateral ligament including the superficial component and the deep meniscofemoral component. The distal insertion of the medial collateral ligament remains intact.

There is a bone contusion of the lateral aspect of the knee compatible with a recent pivot mechanism. There is a small non-displaced subchondral fracture involving the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau.

Moderate chondropathy of the medial and patellofemoral compartments.

Otherwise, the medial meniscus, lateral meniscus, extensor mechanism, semimembranosus, popliteus muscle and tendon, distal biceps femoris, lateral collateral ligament, and iliotibial band are unremarkable.

Conclusion:

Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.

Grade 3 sprain of the medial collateral ligament as detailed above.

Significant intra-articular effusion with popliteal cyst.

report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve meniskal kök yırtığı izlendi.Medial menisküs mediale  ekstrude görünümdedir. Medial kollateral ligamen çevresinde periligamentöz ödem mevcuttur ( grade I sprain ).Lateral menisküste grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Ön çapraz bağ sinyali diffüz artmış, proksimalde ve distalde yer yer kalibrasyonda incelme ve düzensizlik mevcuttur ( komplet rüptür ). Arka çapraz bağ, lateral  kollateral ligaman normaldir.Patellar kıkardak medial faset düzeyinde kıkırdakta yer yer incelme ve komşu kemikte subkondrial milimetrik kist izlendi ( grade II kondromalazi ). Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda hafif osteofitik sivrileşmeler, tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma ve kartilajlarda belirgin incelmeler izlendi(dejeneratif artrit bulguları).Tibia medial plato düzeyinde subkondrial fokal ve femur medial kondil düzeyinde yaygın kemik iliği ödemi izlendi.Tibia interkondiler tüberkül düzeyinde ve lateral plato seviyesinde milimetrik kistler ve çevresinde hafif kemik iliği ödemi izlendi. Popliteal fossada 8x8 mm boyutlarında lobüle konturlu baker  kisti izlendi.Semitendinöz , gracilis ve semimemranöz  tendonları çevresinde peritendinoz kistler  izlendi. Tibia fibular eklem inferior posterior düzeyde 24x10 mm boyutlarında kistik lezyon izlendi ( ganglion kisti ). Popliteus kasında grade I-II strain ile uyumlu sinyal artışı ve bu düzeyde yaklaşık 1 cm çapta kist izlendi.
translation: RIGHT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: Grade III degeneration and a meniscal root tear were observed in the medial meniscus. The medial meniscus appears extruded medially. Periligamentous edema is present around the medial collateral ligament (grade I sprain). Grade II degeneration was observed in the lateral meniscus. The anterior cruciate ligament signal is diffusely increased, with focal thinning and irregularity in caliber proximally and distally (complete rupture). The posterior cruciate ligament and lateral collateral ligament are normal. Focal cartilage thinning at the medial facet level of the patellar cartilage and a subchondral millimetric cyst in the adjacent bone were observed (grade II chondromalacia). Mild osteophytic spurring in the bony structures forming the knee joint, joint space narrowing in the medial tibiofemoral compartment, and significant cartilage thinning were observed (findings of degenerative arthritis). Focal subchondral bone marrow edema at the level of the medial tibial plateau and diffuse bone marrow edema at the level of the medial femoral condyle were observed. Millimetric cysts at the level of the tibial intercondylar tubercle and lateral plateau with mild surrounding bone marrow edema were observed. A lobulated-contoured Baker's cyst measuring 8x8 mm was observed in the popliteal fossa. Peritendinous cysts were observed around the semitendinosus, gracilis, and semimembranosus tendons. A cystic lesion measuring 24x10 mm was observed at the inferior posterior level of the tibiofibular joint (ganglion cyst). Signal increase consistent with grade I-II strain in the popliteus muscle and a cyst approximately 1 cm in diameter at this level were observed.

Homogenes Knochenmarksignal, kein Knochenödem / Bone Bruise. Femorotibial keine tiefgreifende Chondropathie. Keine meniscale Rissbildung. translation: Normal femorotibial and femoropatellar articulation. Following a history of right patellar fracture, the patella is fully consolidated, as far as assessable by this method. FINDINGS:

There is a moderate knee joint effusion with synovitis. There is no popliteal cysts.

There are moderate degenerative changes most pronounced medially. More specifically there is moderate cartilage thinning in the medial compartment most pronounced at the central weightbearing portion of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau with mild subchondral reactive changes. There is also moderate cartilage thinning at the medial patellar facet and median ridge with subchondral reactive changes. There are mild changes in the lateral compartment.

There is intrasubstance degeneration involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is complete radial tear of the posterior root with meniscal extrusion. The lateral meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Moderate degenerative changes most pronounced medially.

2. Intrasubstance degeneration of the medial meniscus with complete radial tear of the posterior root and meniscal extrusion.

3. Knee joint effusion with synovitis without popliteal cyst. à

report:
Analiza TT-TG udaljenosti otežana zbog nemogućnosti širenja polja snimanja aksijalnih sekvenci
kaudalno, te koliko je dostupno iznosi oko 16 mm što ukazuje na graničnu patelofemoralnu
instabilnost.
Kut lateralne trohlearne inklinacije iznosi oko 7° što upućuje na displaziju trohleje.
Wiberg 3 tip patele te lateralna subluksacija patele.
Insall-Salvati omjer iznosi 1,67 što odgovara visoko položenoj pateli.
U femoropatelarnom zglobu vidi se lateralni osteofit trohleje koji je dio zglobnog tijela,
denudacija hrskavice i subhondralni koštani edem lateralne fasete patele i lateralnog dijela
trohleje. Unutar istog zgloba vidi se osteofit veličine 9 mm (CC) koji polazi sa centralnog dijela
proksimalne polovice trohleje femura. Osteofiti posteriornog dijela superiornog i kaudalnog pola
patele.
Također izražene gonartrotske promjene femorotibijalnog zgloba u vidu stanjenja hrskavice,
gubitka zglobnog prostora i lateralnih osteofita femura i tibije.
Mala subhondralna cista tibije uz hvatište stražnjeg križnog ligamenta.
Između iliotibijalnog trakta i kranijalnog dijela lateralnog kondila femura vidi se hondralno
slobodno tijelo veličine 13x5x16 mm (apxllxcc) uz manji okolni izljev.
Blagi hiperintenziteti stražnjih rogova oba meniska kao i prednjeg roga lateralnog meniska uslijed
degenerativnih promjena, bez znakova rupture.
Nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih ligamenata, prednjeg i stražnjeg
križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Minimalni izljev u koljenu. Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
translation:
Analysis of the TT-TG distance is limited due to the inability to extend the field of view of the axial sequences caudally; as far as available, it measures approximately 16 mm, indicating borderline patellofemoral instability.
The lateral trochlear inclination angle measures approximately 7°, suggesting trochlear dysplasia.
Wiberg type 3 patella and lateral patellar subluxation.
The Insall-Salvati ratio is 1.67, corresponding to patella alta.
In the patellofemoral joint, a lateral trochlear osteophyte is seen, which is part of a joint body, along with cartilage denudation and subchondral bone edema of the lateral patellar facet and the lateral portion of the trochlea. Within the same joint, an osteophyte measuring 9 mm (CC) is seen, arising from the central portion of the proximal half of the femoral trochlea. Osteophytes of the posterior aspect of the superior and caudal poles of the patella.
Also, pronounced gonarthrotic changes of the femorotibial joint in the form of cartilage thinning, joint space loss, and lateral osteophytes of the femur and tibia.
A small subchondral cyst of the tibia at the insertion of the posterior cruciate ligament.
Between the iliotibial tract and the cranial portion of the lateral femoral condyle, a chondral loose body measuring 13 x 5 x 16 mm (AP x LL x CC) is seen, with a minor surrounding effusion.
Mild hyperintensities of the posterior horns of both menisci as well as the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus due to degenerative changes, without signs of rupture.
Normal morphology and signal intensity of the collateral ligaments, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments, the iliotibial tract, the patellar ligament, and the quadriceps tendon.
Minimal knee effusion. No popliteal (Baker's) cyst is identified.

report:
МР находка: Състояние след травма на менискус с давност от една година.  Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма и структура. Тяхната сигнална характеристика е непроменена, няма МР данни за костномозъчен едем. Артикулиращият хрущял на фемура и тибията е запазен. Наличие на минимален ставен излив. Запазена цялост на предна кръстна връзка. Задната кръстна връзка е интактна, със запазен континуитет и сигнална характеристика. Задният рог на медиалния менискус не се изобразява на топичното си място. Същият е фрагментиран, като единият фрагмент е експулсиран встрани, а другия е изместен медиално в ставата и се разполага над медиалната интеркондиларна еминенция. Налице е белега на Double PCA sign – патогномоничен за Bucket-handle лезия на латералния менисус. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус и в двата си рога. Няма данни за травматични изменения на колатералните лигаменти. Медиалният колатерален лигамент е изместен от подлежащия менискален фрагмент. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – нормално изобразяване. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м.квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Не се намират патологични промени в поплитеалната ямка и фоса интеркондиларис. Липсва посттравматичен едем на меките тъкани. 
Заключение: Описаната лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус е по типа на Bucket-handle. Минимален ставен излив.
translation:
MRI findings: Status post meniscal trauma dating back one year. The bones forming the knee joint are of normal shape and structure. Their signal characteristics are unchanged, no MRI evidence of bone marrow edema. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia is preserved. Presence of a minimal joint effusion. Integrity of the anterior cruciate ligament is preserved. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact, with preserved continuity and signal characteristics. The posterior horn of the medial meniscus is not visualized in its anatomic position. It is fragmented, with one fragment displaced laterally and the other displaced medially into the joint, positioned over the medial intercondylar eminence. The Double PCL sign is present – pathognomonic for a bucket-handle tear of the lateral meniscus. Normal visualization of the lateral meniscus in both its horns. No evidence of traumatic changes of the collateral ligaments. The medial collateral ligament is displaced by the underlying meniscal fragment. Patella, patellar cartilage, retinacula – normal visualization. Patellar ligament, quadriceps femoris tendon – unremarkable. No pathological changes are found in the popliteal fossa and intercondylar fossa. No post-traumatic edema of the soft tissues.
Conclusion: The described lesion in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus is of the bucket-handle type. Minimal joint effusion.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 2 months of knee pain. Hit knee on metal bar.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small multiloculated Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal. Mild extrusion. No flipped fragments. No parameniscal cyst.
Medial compartment cartilage: Full thickness cartilage fissuring at the weightbearing medial femoral condyle with subchondral edema.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade fissuring at the lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal high-grade fissuring at the medial facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. 
2.	Low-grade tricompartmental chondrosis.

translation:
MRI KNEES

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, T2 gradient echo and proton density pulse sequences with fat signal suppression.

RIGHT KNEE
On evaluation of the medial compartment, findings of degenerative osteoarthritis are observed with degenerative tear and subluxation of the meniscus, subchondral bone marrow edema, presence of marginal osteophytes and erosion of the articular cartilage up to ICRS 4.
On evaluation of the lateral compartment, the only finding noted is the presence of marginal osteophytes.
On evaluation of the patellofemoral compartment, significant degenerative osteoarthritis is observed with erosion of the articular cartilage in the patella and femoral trochlea up to ICRS 4, while the patella also demonstrates lateral subluxation.
Intra-articularly, a significant joint effusion is observed communicating with a large Baker's cyst adjacent to the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle with a craniocaudal diameter of 6 cm.
Within the joint effusion, multiple osteochondral loose bodies are observed.
It is also noted that the fabella presents a longitudinal diameter of 22 mm, most likely secondary to degenerative osteoarthritis.

LEFT KNEE
On evaluation of the medial compartment, degenerative osteoarthritis is observed with erosion of the articular cartilage up to ICRS 4, presence of subchondral bone marrow edema, presence of marginal osteophytes and degeneration and subluxation of the medial meniscus.
In the lateral joint space, marginal osteophytes are observed on the femoral and tibial condyle.
On evaluation of the patellofemoral compartment, findings of articular cartilage erosion in the patella and femoral trochlea up to ICRS 4 are observed with presence of subchondral bone marrow edema in the patella.
Intra-articularly, a moderate joint effusion is observed with the presence of a few loose bodies within it.
A small Baker's cyst is observed in the medial popliteal fossa.
The fabella presents increased dimensions (1.5 cm).

report:
There is proximal non avulsive disruption of the anterior cruciate ligament, with some anteriorly displaced fragments being best appreciated in the sagittal plane.  
Marrow contusional changes are noted at the central portion of the lateral femoral condyle, also affecting the posteromedial and posterolateral tibial plateaux - the overall pattern being compatible with a pivot shift mechanism of injury.  
There is a significant resultant suprapatellar effusion with associated synovitis.  There are no convincing medial or lateral meniscal tears. A grade 1 proximal MCL injury is noted. There is furthermore a posteromedial meniscocapsular sprain. 
No posterolateral corner injury is identified, nor is there any injury to the anterolateral ligament. 
Normal PCL, lateral collateral ligament, popliteus musculotendinous unit and PTFL, distal iliotibial band and extensor tendons. Well-preserved tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage surfaces.  
The extent of fluid signal intensity within the deep posterior soft tissues following injury suggests prior posterior capsular disruption.

Marrow contusional changes are noted at the central portion of the lateral femoral condyle, also affecting the posteromedial and posterolateral tibial plateaux - the overall pattern being compatible with a pivot shift mechanism of injury.  
There is a significant resultant suprapatellar effusion with associated synovitis.  There are no convincing medial or lateral meniscal tears. A grade 1 proximal MCL injury is noted. There is furthermore a posteromedial meniscocapsular sprain. 
No posterolateral corner injury is identified, nor is there any injury to the anterolateral ligament. 
Normal PCL, lateral collateral ligament, popliteus musculotendinous unit and PTFL, distal iliotibial band and extensor tendons. Well-preserved tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage surfaces.  
The extent of fluid signal intensity within the deep posterior soft tissues following injury suggests prior posterior capsular disruption.

4. Anserine bursitis with perifocal soft tissue edema; subcutaneous edema over left knee.
5. Grade 1 injury of ACL.
6. Tendinosis of quadriceps tendon and patellar tendon.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

report:
МР находка: МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Задният рог на медиалния менискус е с повишен интензитет на сигнала. В него се вижда хиперинтензна линия с радиерен ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Скъсването достига до задния край на менискуса и до ставния хрущял на тибията. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на медиалния менискус и на латералния менискус. Ставният хрущял на фемура, тибията и пателата е интактен. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки.
Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става, са с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. Патела, ретинакулуми на пателата – б.о. Сухожилие на m. quadriceps femoris, лигамент на patella – нормално изобразяване. Наличие на малък ставен излив. Не се изобразяват промени в меките тъкани на дясното коляно. Поплитеалната вена е сравнително по-широка, като е с диаметър на лумена 13-14 мм. Заключение: МР данни за скъсване в задния рог на медиалния менискус –grade 2b. Малък ставен излив.

report: МР находка: Няма ставен излив. Костите формиращи лявата колянна става са с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. МР данни за дегенеративни изменения в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Задният рог на медиалния менискус е с повишен сигнален интензитет и е уголемен. Не се визуализира фрагмент при менискуса. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Ставният хрущял на медиалния феморален кондил е изтънен и е с неравности в контурните очертания. Ставният хрущял от латералната страна на ставата е интактен. МР данни за хондромалация на пателата. Изобразява се ерозия по хрущяла на пателата по медиалната пателарна повърхност. Нормално изобразяване на предната и задната кръстни връзки. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Вижда се малка киста с данни за хеморагично съдържимо, разположена пред залавнто място на предната кръстна връзка към тибията. Кистата е с размер 8мм, като в нея е формирано ниво течност/седимент. Втора малка киста с големина 4мм се открива и дорзално в коляното, до ставната капсула и задната кръстна връзка. МР данни за руптурирала Бекерова киста. Руптурирала Бекерова киста.

Ruptured Baker's cyst.

translation:
Clinical History:
Osteoarthritis.

Findings:
No significant bone marrow alterations.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Increased central signal of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus that does not appear to contact the articular surface, without features of a tear.
Tear of the anterior horn, body and part of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with perimeniscal soft tissue edema, parameniscal cysts and moderate meniscal extrusion.
Partial and near-full thickness chondral ulcers of the weight-bearing zone of the lateral femorotibial compartment. Cartilage of the medial femorotibial compartment and femoral trochlea without alterations. Superficial patellar chondropathy of the lateral facet.
Mild joint effusion with minimal synovitis.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon and iliotibial band within normal limits.

Impression:
Complex tear of the lateral meniscus with associated extrusion and parameniscal cysts.
Chondropathy grade 2 and 3 lesions of the weight-bearing zone of the lateral femorotibial compartment.
Superficial patellar chondropathy.
Mild joint effusion with minimal synovitis.

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain for 4 months after dance injury.

MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness chondrosis at the medial femoral condyle without full-thickness defect.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 15 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Low-grade chondrosis at the medial femoral condyle. Otherwise, MRI within normal limits.

Blagi izljev u koljenu.
U sklopu izraženih osteoartrotskih promjena medijalnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba
vidi se denudacija hrskavica femoralnog kondila i tibijalnog platoa, blagi koštani edem u predjelu
rubnih osteofita te gubitak zglobnog prostora.
U predjelu tijela degenerativno promijenjenog medijalnog meniskusa vidi se kompleksna ruptura
uz ekstruziju te se vidi mala kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga.
Vidi se vijugav tijek meniskofemoralnog ligamenta uslijed rupture te distenzija površinskih
vlakana.
Blago lobulirana oštroograničena tekuća kolekcija veličine oko 4,4x1,1 cm (ccxll) između dubokih
i površinskih vlakana medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta što odgovara većoj parameniscealnoj
cisti ili burzitisu medijalnog kolateralnog ligamneta.
Osteofit medijalnog ruba trohleje femura.
Hondromalacija I. stupnja hrskavice lateralnog tibijalnog platoa i II. stupnja obje fasete patele.
Minimalni edem supkutani u razini patele i patelarnog ligamenta.
Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
Znakovi blage rekonverzije koštane srži distalne dijafize femura.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala
translation:
Mild knee effusion.
In the setting of pronounced osteoarthritic changes of the medial compartment of the femorotibial joint, there is denudation of the cartilage of the femoral condyle and tibial plateau, mild bone edema in the region of marginal osteophytes, and loss of joint space.
In the region of the body of the degeneratively changed medial meniscus, there is a complex tear with extrusion, and a small complex tear of the posterior horn is seen.
A tortuous course of the meniscofemoral ligament is seen due to rupture, and distension of the superficial fibers.
A mildly lobulated, sharply demarcated fluid collection measuring approximately 4.4 x 1.1 cm (cc x ll) between the deep and superficial fibers of the medial collateral ligament, corresponding to a larger parameniscal cyst or bursitis of the medial collateral ligament.
Osteophyte of the medial margin of the femoral trochlea.
Grade I chondromalacia of the cartilage of the lateral tibial plateau and grade II of both patellar facets.
Minimal subcutaneous edema at the level of the patella and patellar ligament.
No popliteal (Baker's) cyst is found.
Signs of mild bone marrow reconversion of the distal femoral diaphysis.
The other visualized bony, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

report:
COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Progressive lateral joint line pain right knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The medial meniscus is intact. Lateral meniscus shows intrasubstance degeneration without evidence of surfacing tear.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No patellofemoral subluxation. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 15 mm, at the upper limit of normal. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

There is fissuring of articular cartilage along the medial patellar facet scattered foci of mild chondrosis throughout the remainder of the patellofemoral compartment. There is mild to moderate chondrosis overlying the medial patellar facet.

There is mild to moderate medial femorotibial chondrosis. Preserved lateral femorotibial articular cartilage.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. Tiny Baker's cyst. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. No evidence of discrete meniscal, ligament, or tendon tear.
2. Borderline lateralization of the tibial tubercle, which may predispose to patellofemoral maltracking/instability. No patellofemoral subluxation.
3. Mild to moderate medial femorotibial and patellofemoral chondrosis, suggesting evolving mild osteoarthritis of the right knee.

translation: LEFT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: Grade II degeneration is observed in the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus. report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs diz ekleminden 2.5 mm mediale ekstrudedir. Menisküs posterior horn ve gövde kesiminde grade III dejenerasyon izlendi.Lateral menisküs posterior horn ve gövde kesimde grade III dejenerasyon izlenmektedir.Anterior çapraz bağda diffüz incelme ve miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlendi. Posterior çapraz bağda kronik zorlanmaya bağlı proksimal kesimde T2 sinyal artışı izlendi. Medial kollateral ligamende periligamentöz ödem izlendi. Patellofemoral eklem lateralde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu kemik yüzlerde subkondrial skleroz, ödem ve dejeneratif kistler izlendi. Bu düzeylerde kartilajlarda bütünlük kayıpları izlenmektedir. Diz eklemi posteriorunda 1.5 cm çaplı ganglion kisti izlendi. Diz eklemi posterior superiorunda ekstraartiküler mesafede büyüğü 2.5x2 cm boyutlu ganglion kistleri izlendi. Diz eklemini oluşturan her 3 kompartmanda santral-marjinal osteofit formasyonu izlendi. Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlenmektedir. Popliteal fossada 3x1 cm boyutlu baker kisti izlenmektedir. Diz eklemi posteriorunda 5 mm çaplı loose bodye ait ossifiye nodüler lezyon izlendi. Gastrocnemius medial krus proksimal insersio düzeyinde tendinozis ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlendi. SONUÇ  :  Gonartroz.  Medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon ve grade III meniskopati, lateral menisküste grade III meniskopati.Anterior çapraz bağda diffüz incelme ve miksoid dejenerasyon. Posterior çapraz bağda kronik zorlanmaya sekonder sinyal değişikliği.Medial kollateral ligamende grade I sprain. Diz eklemi posteriorunda ganglion kistleri.Popliteal fossada baker kisti.Patellofemoral eklemde artroz ve kondromalazi. Medial kollateral ligamende grade I sprain.
translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings:
The medial meniscus is extruded 2.5 mm medially from the knee joint. Grade III degeneration is observed in the posterior horn and body of the meniscus. Grade III degeneration is observed in the posterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus. Diffuse thinning and signal change secondary to myxoid degeneration are observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. T2 signal increase is observed in the proximal segment of the posterior cruciate ligament due to chronic strain. Periligamentous edema is observed in the medial collateral ligament. Joint space narrowing laterally in the patellofemoral joint, subchondral sclerosis, edema, and degenerative cysts on the bone surfaces adjacent to the joint are observed. Loss of cartilage integrity is observed at these levels. A ganglion cyst measuring 1.5 cm in diameter is observed posterior to the knee joint. Ganglion cysts, the largest measuring 2.5x2 cm, are observed in the extra-articular space posterosuperior to the knee joint. Central-marginal osteophyte formation is observed in all three compartments of the knee joint. Joint space narrowing medially in the tibiofemoral joint, with destruction of the femoral and tibial cartilages adjacent to the joint, is observed. A Baker's cyst measuring 3x1 cm is observed in the popliteal fossa. An ossified nodular lesion measuring 5 mm in diameter, consistent with a loose body, is observed posterior to the knee joint. Signal change consistent with tendinosis is observed at the proximal insertion level of the medial head of the gastrocnemius.
CONCLUSION:
Gonarthrosis. Medial extrusion and grade III meniscopathy of the medial meniscus, grade III meniscopathy of the lateral meniscus. Diffuse thinning and myxoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament. Signal change secondary to chronic strain in the posterior cruciate ligament. Grade I sprain of the medial collateral ligament. Ganglion cysts posterior to the knee joint. Baker's cyst in the popliteal fossa. Arthrosis and chondromalacia in the patellofemoral joint. Grade I sprain of the medial collateral ligament.

Bevindingen: Zeer gelokaliseerd gevorderd kraakbeenlijden femoropatellaire femoropatellair, met transfixerende fissuur longitudinale fissuur op de trochleaire groeve, met minimale subchondrale veranderingen. translation: [DATE]: MRI Right Knee 15ch AA: Clinical information: knee surgery last year; pain when getting out of a truck, limited joint effusion, mild peripatellar pressure tenderness, meniscal tests not clear. Diagnostic question: cartilage damage? Meniscal injury? Findings: Very localized advanced cartilage damage in the femoropatellar compartment, with a transfixing longitudinal fissure on the trochlear groove, with minimal subchondral changes. Moderate joint effusion. Recent rupture of a popliteal cyst, with extensive fluid collection deep and superficial to the medial gastrocnemius muscle. Normal appearing menisci. Cruciate ligaments and lateral ligaments intact. Normal appearing tendons. Conclusion: - Very localized advanced cartilage damage with a longitudinal transfixing fissure on the trochlear groove of the femur in the femoropatellar compartment. - Moderate joint effusion. - Recent rupture of a popliteal cyst with extensive fluid collection in the right calf.

translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings:
Grade II degeneration is observed in the anterior horn, posterior horn, and body of the lateral meniscus.
The medial meniscus is extruded 7.5 mm medially from the knee joint space. Maceration, volume loss, and accompanying complex tears in the posterior horn are observed in the meniscus.
The posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal.
Thickening and increased T2 signal secondary to mucoid degeneration are observed in the anterior cruciate ligament.
The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal.
There is no retinacular discontinuity.
Edema in the subchondral area and cartilage thinning are observed in the medial facet of the patella.
No joint effusion is detected.
In the medial tibiofemoral joint, joint space narrowing, subchondral millimetric cysts, and subchondral edema are observed on the bone surfaces adjacent to the joint. Destruction of the femoral and tibial cartilages is observed at this level. The findings are interpreted in favor of degenerative arthritis.
A subcortical degenerative cyst is observed at the anterior intercondylar eminence of the tibia, at the insertion level of the anterior cruciate ligament.
Central-marginal osteophyte formation is observed in all three compartments of the knee joint.
Conclusion: Gonarthrosis, volume loss, maceration, and complex tear in the medial meniscus, grade II meniscopathy in the lateral meniscus, mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, grade III chondromalacia of the medial facet of the patella, mild suprapatellar bursitis.

report:
Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena u području distalne dijametafize/medijalnog kondila femura
vidi se T1 hipo, T2 hiperintenzivna lobulirana lezija dimenzija 13x13x16 mm (APxLLxCC) koja
prvenstveno odgovara enhondromu.
nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih ligamenata, stražnjeg križnog
ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta.
Prednji križni ligament je zadebljan, difuzno povišenih intenziteta signala - ddg. mukoidna
degeneracija.
Sitna ganglion cista je vidljiva pri femoralnom hvatištu ACL.
Diskretno povišenje intenziteta signala pri hvatištu tetive m. kvadricepsa - početne
entezopatske promjene.
Medijalni i lateralni menisk uredne su morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Patela je medioponirana, Wiberg 2. Heterogen je intenzitet signala artikulacijske hrskavice
lateralne fasete patele (hondromalacija II. stupnja).
Gotovo je potpuno reducirana debljina artikulacijske hrskavice medijalne i lateralen trohleje
femura.
Heterogen je intenzitet signala medijalnog i lateralnog kondila femura i platoa tibije -
hondromalacija I. stupnja.
Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
Varikoziteti sliva VSM i VSP.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.
translation:
On a series of MR images of the left knee, in the region of the distal diametaphysis/medial femoral condyle, there is a T1 hypointense, T2 hyperintense lobulated lesion measuring 13x13x16 mm (APxLLxCC), which primarily corresponds to an enchondroma.
Normal morphology and signal intensity of the collateral ligaments, posterior cruciate ligament, iliotibial tract, and patellar ligament.
The anterior cruciate ligament is thickened, with diffusely increased signal intensity - differential diagnosis: mucoid degeneration.
A small ganglion cyst is visible at the femoral attachment of the ACL.
Discrete increase in signal intensity at the insertion of the quadriceps tendon - early enthesopathic changes.
The medial and lateral menisci are of normal morphology and signal intensity.
The patella is medially positioned, Wiberg type 2. Heterogeneous signal intensity of the articular cartilage of the lateral patellar facet (grade II chondromalacia).
The thickness of the articular cartilage of the medial and lateral femoral trochlea is almost completely reduced.
Heterogeneous signal intensity of the medial and lateral femoral condyles and tibial plateau - grade I chondromalacia.
No popliteal (Baker's) cyst is found.
Varicosities of the great saphenous vein and small saphenous vein territories.
The other visualized bony, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

translation:

report: МР находка: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. Наличе на енхондром в тибията. МР данни за костномозъчен едем в медиалните конидили на фемура и тибията и ръбови остеофити на тези кондили. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и на тибията е изтънен до липсващ от страната на медиалното тибиално плато – промени, съотвеетстващи на медиален остеоартрит. Предна кръстна връзка е проследима по цялото си протежение, лекостепенно задебелена и с повишен сигнален интензитет, както при частична мукоидна дегенерация в средна и горна трета на връзката. Задната кръстна връзка се проследява до залавните си места с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. Състояние след менискектомия на медиален менискус – задният му рог е частично отстранен, с останалата част от менискуса е експулсирана встрани. Нормално изобразяване на предния му рог. Латерален менискус – с нормален МР образ. Нормално изобразяване на колатералните лигаменти. Ретинакулуми – без особености. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на меките тъкани на лявото коляно. Заключение: МР данни за медиален остеоартрит на дясната колянна става. Суспектни данни за частична мукоидна дегенерация на предната кръстна връзка, като последната е със запазена цялост. Енхондром. Увреда на заден рог на медиален менискус – частично отстранен и експулсиран встрани. Костномозъчен едем.
translation: MRI findings: No MRI evidence of joint effusion. Presence of an enchondroma in the tibia. MRI evidence of bone marrow edema in the medial condyles of the femur and tibia and marginal osteophytes of these condyles. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia is thinned to absent on the side of the medial tibial plateau – changes corresponding to medial osteoarthritis. The anterior cruciate ligament is traceable along its entire length, mildly thickened and with increased signal intensity, as in partial mucoid degeneration in the middle and upper third of the ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament is traced to its attachment sites with normal shape and signal intensity. Status post meniscectomy of the medial meniscus – its posterior horn is partially removed, with the remaining part of the meniscus extruded laterally. Normal appearance of its anterior horn. Lateral meniscus – with normal MRI appearance. Normal appearance of the collateral ligaments. Retinacula – unremarkable. Patellar ligament and quadriceps femoris tendon – unremarkable. Normal appearance of the soft tissues of the left knee. Conclusion: MRI evidence of medial osteoarthritis of the right knee joint. Suspicious findings for partial mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, with the latter maintaining its integrity. Enchondroma. Damage to the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – partially removed and extruded laterally. Bone marrow edema.

translation:
Clinical History:
Medial pain. Rule out meniscal syndrome.
Findings:
Mild peripheral bone marrow edema of the medial femoral condyle with an image suggestive of a small regional subcortical fracture. No other bone marrow signal abnormalities.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Both menisci with preserved morphology and signal, without signs of tear.
Nearly full-thickness chondral ulcers in the central region of the weight-bearing area of the medial femoral condyle. Superficial chondropathy of the medial tibial plateau. The remaining femorotibial and patellofemoral cartilages without abnormalities.
No significant joint effusion or popliteal cysts.
Mild increased signal at the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon and at the proximal insertion of the patellar tendon, without signs of tear.
Pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within preserved limits.
Soft tissue edema between the iliotibial band and the lateral femoral condyle.
No signal abnormality of Hoffa's fat pad.
Impression:
Mild peripheral bone marrow edema of the medial femoral condyle with an image suggestive of a small subcortical fracture.
Focal grade 2-3 chondropathy of the central region of the weight-bearing area of the medial femoral condyle.
Mild proximal patellar and distal quadriceps tendinosis.

report:
FINDINGS:

There is a large knee joint effusion with synovitis. There is a nonruptured popliteal cyst.

There are severe degenerative changes in the medial and patellofemoral compartments with full-thickness cartilage loss and subchondral reactive changes. There is lateral subluxation and lateral tilt of the patella. There is moderate cartilage thinning involving the lateral compartment with a large cartilage defect of the central aspect of the lateral tibial plateau.

There is diffuse intrasubstance degeneration, maceration and degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus with meniscal extrusion. The lateral meniscus demonstrates intrasubstance degeneration of the body without a well-defined linear tear.

There is intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL. There is no evidence of acute ligament injury.

Otherwise the PCL, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Severe degenerative changes in the medial and patellofemoral compartments with full-thickness cartilage loss.

2. Diffuse degenerative tearing with maceration and extrusion of the medial meniscus.

3. Intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL without evidence of acute ligament injury.

4. Knee joint effusion with synovitis with a nonruptured popliteal cyst.

report: Lateralisiert stehende Patella. Ansonsten regelrechte Artikulationsverhältnisse. Tiefgreifender, bis an den knochenreichender Knorpeldefekt an der lateralen Patellafacette großflächig mit bis zu 1,7 cm und chondralen Fibrillationen (4/8). Angrenzend teils geringes Knochenmarködem (5/8). Femorotibial regelrechte Stellung. V. a. horizontale Rissbildung des Innenmeniskus in der Pars intermedia am Übergang zum Hinterhorn (5/26, 8/9 oder 3/125). Keine dislozierten Anteile. Kein Korbhenkelriss. Keine relevante Chondropathie femorotibial. Geringes subkortikales Ödem im medialen Tibiaplateau. Kreuzbänder intakt. Außenmeniskus intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Geringe Flüssigkeit um das MCL, DD bei Reizzustand. Signalanhebungen am Ansatz der Quadrizepssehne und am Ursprung der Patellasehne (8/28), in erster Linie bei Reizzustand. Flüssigkeitseinlagerungen in die umgebende Subcutis. Deutlicher Gelenkerguss mit im medialen und lateralen Recessus gelegenen kleinen länglichen Strukturen (3/25). Umgebende Muskulatur und Subkutis unauffällig.
translation: Laterally positioned patella. Otherwise normal articulation. Deep, full-thickness cartilage defect extending to the bone on the lateral patellar facet, large in area, measuring up to 1.7 cm, with chondral fibrillations (4/8). Adjacent mild bone marrow edema in part (5/8). Normal femorotibial alignment. Suspicion of horizontal tear of the medial meniscus in the pars intermedia at the transition to the posterior horn (5/26, 8/9 or 3/125). No displaced fragments. No bucket-handle tear. No relevant femorotibial chondropathy. Mild subcortical edema in the medial tibial plateau. Cruciate ligaments intact. Lateral meniscus intact. Collateral ligaments intact. Mild fluid around the MCL, differential diagnosis of reactive condition. Signal increases at the insertion of the quadriceps tendon and at the origin of the patellar tendon (8/28), primarily due to reactive condition. Fluid accumulation in the surrounding subcutaneous tissue. Marked joint effusion with small elongated structures located in the medial and lateral recesses (3/25). Surrounding musculature and subcutaneous tissue unremarkable.

Bone contusions in the posterior aspect of the bilateral tibial plateau.

As above.

None

report:
Trouvailles: 
Il y a une apparence hétérogène de la moelle osseuse plus proéminent impliquant le fémur distalement. Il n'y a pas de composante tissulaire extra-osseuse. Il y a changements similaires mais moins marqués impliquant le tibia et le péroné proximalement. 
Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité. Il y a un kyste ganglionnaire multi-loculé de 2cm AP x 1.8cm transverse x 1cm cranio-caudal au niveau de la région intercondylienne antérieure. Aucune évidence de déchirure méniscale associée. Le kyste semble être en provenance des fibres distales du ligament croisé antérieur. 
Il y a proéminence et fragmentation de la tubérosité tibiale sans oedème osseux compatible avec une ancienne maladie de Osgood-Schlatter. 
Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité. 
Conclusion: 
1. Il n'y a aucune déchirure méniscale ou blessure du croisé antérieur. 
2. Kyste ganglionnaire au niveau de la région inter-condylienne antérieure qui semble être en provenance du croisé antérieur. Ceci pourrait causer des douleurs surtout en extension complète du genou. À corréler cliniquement. 
3. Séquelles d'ancienne maladie d'Osgood-Schlatter. 
4. Découverte fortuite d'une apparence hétérogène de la moelle osseuse. Ceci est non-spécifique et pourrait représenter une reconversion en moelle rouge. Un processus infiltratif est moins probable mais demeure dans le diagnostic différentiel. Une investigation hématologique est recommandée.
translation:
Findings:
There is a heterogeneous appearance of the bone marrow, more prominently involving the distal femur. There is no extra-osseous soft tissue component. There are similar but less marked changes involving the proximal tibia and fibula.
There is a small intra-articular effusion without a popliteal cyst. There is a multi-loculated ganglion cyst measuring 2 cm AP x 1.8 cm transverse x 1 cm craniocaudal at the level of the anterior intercondylar region. No evidence of an associated meniscal tear. The cyst appears to originate from the distal fibers of the anterior cruciate ligament.
There is prominence and fragmentation of the tibial tuberosity without bone edema, compatible with old Osgood-Schlatter disease.
Otherwise, the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the semimembranosus, the popliteus muscle and tendon, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament, and the iliotibial band are unremarkable.
Conclusion:
1. There is no meniscal tear or anterior cruciate ligament injury.
2. Ganglion cyst at the level of the anterior intercondylar region that appears to originate from the anterior cruciate ligament. This could cause pain especially in full knee extension. Clinical correlation is recommended.
3. Sequelae of old Osgood-Schlatter disease.
4. Incidental finding of a heterogeneous bone marrow appearance. This is nonspecific and could represent red marrow reconversion. An infiltrative process is less likely but remains in the differential diagnosis. Hematological investigation is recommended.

report:
MRI LEFT KNEE  (plain)

Clinical information:
Left knee pain and stiffness. Ultrasound shows a large complex collection at the posterior joint, MRI suggested. 

Technique: 
Multiplanar MR of the knee according to protocol.

Comparison: 
Ultrasound report dated [Date]

Findings: 

Menisci

Lateral meniscus: intact

Medial meniscus: Several tears of the medial meniscus noted. Radial tear close to the posterior root of the medial meniscus and another inferior surfacing horizontal tear is seen at the posterior horn. Radial tear with truncation also seen at the body of meniscus, which is attenuated in size. Most of the medial meniscus is extruded from the jointline, approximately 0.4cm medial to joint line. 

Ligaments

Anterior cruciate ligament: intact

Posterior cruciate ligament: intact 

Medial collateral ligament: Superficial and deep components intact. Thickening of the superificial component of the medial collateral ligament with moderate periligamentous edema is suggestive of moderate sprain. 

Lateral collateral ligament: The iliotibial band, biceps femoris tendon, fibular collateral ligament and popliteus muscle and tendon intact. 

Posterolateral corner structures: Intact

Extensor Mechanism

The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. The patella is normally positioned within the femoral groove. There is no retinacular disruption.

Fluid

Moderate knee effusion noted with evidence of synovitis. Thinned wall Baker's cyst with thin septations measuring 4.1cm x 3.4cm x 6.1cm (TSxAPxCC) is seen, consistent with a complex Bakers cyst. No fluid fluid level is seen..Small amount of fluid at the posterior knee is probably secondary to previous rupture.

Mild prepatellar bursitis observed. 

Osseous and Articular Structures

Bones: Mild oedema is seen at the anterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau. Moderate degenerative changes with osteophytosis of all three compartments noted. No fracture, stress reaction, or osseous lesion is seen.

Patellofemoral compartment: Full thickness chondral loss and fissures most observable at the patella apex and medial patella facet, associated with subchondral oedema. 

Medial compartment: Minimal chondrosis. 

Lateral compartment: Minimal chondrosis. 

Others:

Hoffas fat pad: clear

Muscles: Severe atrophy and fatty infiltration of the semimembranosus muscle. 

Neurovascular bundle: Normal 


COMMENT

1.	Multiloculated Bakers cyst with prior rupture. No evidence of haemorrhage or active inflammatory changes. 
2.	Several tears of the medial meniscus, including a radial tear of the posterior root, horizontal tear of the posterior horn and truncation of the inner free edge of the body of medial meniscus. Medial meniscal extrusion noted. 
3.	Moderate sprain of the superficial component of the medial collateral ligament. It is intact with no tear. 
4.	Severe patellofemoral chondral loss and fissures with subchondral oedema. Otherwise only minimal chondrosis at the tibiofemoral joint. Osteophytes in all three compartments.
5.	Mild prepatellar bursitis.

MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Minimal focal increased T2 signal peripheral lateral femoral condyle may reflect resolving low grade osseous contusion. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Focal partial-thickness cartilage loss along the central weightbearing medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Heterogeneity at the median ridge compatible with low grade cartilage loss. No focal high grade cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Moderate distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with superimposed edema of the retroquadriceps fat and low-grade interstitial tearing of the posterior lateral insertional fibers. Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

2.	Minimal bone marrow edema peripheral lateral femoral condyle, may reflect resolving low grade osseous contusion.

translation:

Medial knee pain.

Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
The lateral meniscus appears of preserved morphology and signal, without categorical criteria for tear.
Complex tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with mild meniscal extrusion and a segment that extends toward the posterior intercondylar region.
Partial and full-thickness chondral ulcers of the weight-bearing zone of the medial femoral condyle.

Partial-thickness chondral ulcers of the remaining femorotibial compartments.

Complex tear of the medial meniscus with mild extrusion and partially displaced segment.
Chondropathy with grade two and three lesions of the medial femoral condyle. Partial-thickness chondral ulcers of the remaining femorotibial cartilages. Probable subcortical fracture in the weight-bearing zone of the medial tibial plateau, without depression.

report: Patellofemoral kompartmandaki dejeneratif eklem hastalığı tam kat eklem kıkırdağı kaybı, subkondral-subkortikal medüller fibrovasküler-fibrokistik değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Diz eklemi içerisindeki sıvı miktarı orta derecede artmış. Lateral menisküste dejenerasyon. Dejenere medyal menisküsün arka boynuzundan gövdesine uzanan, üst-alt eklem yüzeyleri ve serbest kenar ile ilişkilendirilen kompleks yırtık gözleniyor. Ön çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon izleniyor. İç yan bağı çevreleyen ödem grade 1 yaralanma ile uyumlu. Arka çapraz ve dış yan bağlar normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal. Popliteus kas liflerindeki ödem ve kas lifleri arasındaki 8x3 mm boyutlu sıvı lokülasyonu düşük dereceli yaralanma ile uyumlu. Ayrıca bu kasın çevresinde parafasyal ödem de gözleniyor. Prepatellar-infrapatellar cilt altı bağ dokusu ödemli ve cilt altında variköz venler izleniyor.
translation: Degenerative joint disease in the patellofemoral compartment is characterized by full-thickness articular cartilage loss, subchondral-subcortical medullary fibrovascular-fibrocystic changes, and marginal osteophytes. The amount of fluid within the knee joint is moderately increased. Degeneration in the lateral meniscus. A complex tear extending from the posterior horn to the body of the degenerated medial meniscus, involving the superior and inferior articular surfaces and the free edge, is observed. Mucoid degeneration is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. Edema surrounding the medial collateral ligament is consistent with a grade 1 injury. The posterior cruciate and lateral collateral ligaments are normal. The extensor mechanism is intact. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal. Edema in the popliteus muscle fibers and an 8x3 mm fluid loculation between the muscle fibers are consistent with a low-grade injury. Additionally, perifascial edema is also observed around this muscle. The prepatellar-infrapatellar subcutaneous connective tissue is edematous, and varicose veins are observed in the subcutaneous tissue.

report:
МР находка: Дясна колянна става: Минимален ставен излив.  Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става са с нормална форма, структура и сигнален интензитет. Начални остеофити по ставните ръбове на кондилите. Малка ограничена зона на костномозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на тибията. Ставният хрущял на фемура и тибията е силно изтънен и с нарушена конгруентност от медиалната страна на ставата. Няма данни за субхондрални лезии. Малка лезия 2а в заден рог на медиален менискус. Нормално изобразяване на предния му рог. Не се виждат патологични лезии в латералния менискус. Малка лезия – 2а стадии с кос ход в заден рог на медиалния менискус. Кръстни връзки – със запазена цялост. В проксималната трета на задната кръстна връзка, в близост до залавното място към фемура се изобразява кистична лезия в структурата на връзката с характеристика на интралигаментарна ганглион киста. Същата е със размери 10/7мм. Колатерални лигаменти със запазена цялост. Ретинакулуми на пателата, патела  и пателарен хрущял – б.о. Бекерова киста със сагитални размери 36мм в дм.  Не се изобразяват други промени в меките тъкани на дясното коляно.
Заключение: МР данни хондропатия от медиалната срана на ставата с малък ставен излив и костномозъчен едем. Ганглион киста на задна кръстна връзка. Частична увреда на заден рог на медиален менискус. Бекерова киста.
translation:
MRI Findings: Right knee joint: Minimal joint effusion. The bones forming the right knee joint are of normal shape, structure, and signal intensity. Early osteophytes along the articular margins of the condyles. Small focal area of bone marrow edema in the medial tibial condyle. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia is significantly thinned with impaired congruence on the medial side of the joint. No evidence of subchondral lesions. Small grade 2a lesion in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Normal appearance of its anterior horn. No pathological lesions are seen in the lateral meniscus. Small grade 2a lesion with oblique course in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Cruciate ligaments – intact. In the proximal third of the posterior cruciate ligament, near the femoral insertion, a cystic lesion is seen within the ligament substance with characteristics of an intraligamentous ganglion cyst. It measures 10/7 mm. Collateral ligaments are intact. Patellar retinacula, patella, and patellar cartilage – unremarkable. Baker's cyst with sagittal dimensions of 36 mm in diameter. No other changes are seen in the soft tissues of the right knee.
Conclusion: MRI findings of chondropathy on the medial side of the joint with small joint effusion and bone marrow edema. Ganglion cyst of the posterior cruciate ligament. Partial injury of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Baker's cyst.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Diminutive horn of the lateral meniscus consistent with complex tear. The lateral meniscal body and posterior horn show intrasubstance degeneration without additional tear. No lateral meniscal extrusion. The medial meniscus shows intrasubstance degeneration and slight peripheral extrusion of the body, without tear.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament. Small insertional cysts at the anterior cruciate ligament foot plate.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Mild popliteus tendinosis without tear. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

Attenuated appearance of the medial patellofemoral ligament suggestive of prior tear. Slight lateral patellar subluxation. The lateral patellar retinaculum is intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 12 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Foci of full-thickness cartilage denuding patellar apex, lateral patellar facet, as well as central to lateral femoral trochlea. There is fissuring of articular cartilage throughout the lateral femorotibial compartment. There is mild to moderate medial femorotibial chondrosis.

Trace knee joint fluid. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Diminutive horn of the lateral meniscus consistent with complex tear. The lateral meniscal body and posterior horn show intrasubstance degeneration without additional tear. No lateral meniscal extrusion. The medial meniscus shows intrasubstance degeneration and slight peripheral extrusion of the body, without tear.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament. Small insertional cysts at the anterior cruciate ligament foot plate.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Mild popliteus tendinosis without tear. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

Foci of full-thickness cartilage denuding patellar apex, lateral patellar facet, as well as central to lateral femoral trochlea. There is fissuring of articular cartilage throughout the lateral femorotibial compartment. There is mild to moderate medial femorotibial chondrosis.

Trace knee joint fluid. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

1. Complex tear anterior horn lateral meniscus without lateral meniscal extrusion.
