report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı orta derecede artmış. Medyal femorotibyal eklemdeki hafif dereceli osteoartrit femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki kondral kalınlığın %50'sini  aşmayan incelme ve milimetrik fokal tam kat kondral fissürler ile karakterize. Femoral kondil medyali ve tibyal platoda lateralde kemik iliği ödemi izleniyor. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzu - gövdesindeki  dejenerasyonu arka kökü düzeyindeki tam kata ulaşmayan vertikal yırtık eşlik ediyor. İç yan bağın çevresi ödemli. Medyal menisküs medyale 3.5 mm ekstrüzyon gösteriyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Gastroknemyus-semimembranozus bursasındaki 4.7 cm maksimum boyutlu içerisinde debriyi telkin eden düşük intensiteli alanlar gözlenen sıvı lokülasyonunun çevresindeki yumuşak  doku ödemi sızdırdığını telkin ediyor. Diz ekleminin anteriyorunda prepateller - yüzeyel infrapateller cilt altı bağ dokusu ödemli. Çapraz ve yan bağlar bunların dışında normal. Medyal patellar sinovyal plika kalınlığı normal olup eklem aralığına interpoze değil. Hoffa'nın yağ yastıkçığı ödemli. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.
translation: The amount of intra-articular fluid in the knee joint is moderately increased. Mild osteoarthritis in the medial femorotibial joint is characterized by thinning not exceeding 50% of the cartilage thickness on the weight-bearing surface of the femoral condyle and millimetric focal full-thickness chondral fissures. Bone marrow edema is observed in the medial femoral condyle and laterally in the tibial plateau. Degeneration in the posterior horn – body of the medial meniscus is accompanied by a vertical tear not reaching full thickness at the level of the posterior root. The surrounding area of the medial collateral ligament is edematous. The medial meniscus shows 3.5 mm medial extrusion. The lateral meniscus is normal. The soft tissue edema surrounding the fluid loculation in the gastrocnemius-semimembranosus bursa, measuring up to 4.7 cm in maximum dimension with low-intensity areas suggesting debris within, suggests leakage. The prepatellar – superficial infrapatellar subcutaneous connective tissue is edematous in the anterior aspect of the knee joint. The cruciate and collateral ligaments are otherwise normal. The medial patellar synovial plica thickness is normal and is not interposed into the joint space. Hoffa's fat pad is edematous. The extensor mechanism is intact. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal.

Degenerative changes of the femoropatellar joint with chondromalacic changes grade III of the cartilage of the medial patellar facet.
Bone marrow reconversion zones in the distal diametaphysis of the femur and, less pronounced, in the proximal diametaphysis of the tibia.
The anterior cruciate ligament is moderately degenerated, without signs of rupture, with a larger intraosseous ganglion cyst (dimensions approximately 8 mm) at the proximal attachment.

Enthesopathic changes of the proximal attachment of the lateral collateral ligament.
Enthesopathic changes and minimal bursitis of the popliteus tendon.

Enthesopathic changes of the quadriceps tendon and both attachments of the patellar ligament.

Baker's cyst measuring approximately 47x25x77 mm.

suprapatelarnog masnog jastučića, vjerojatno reaktivno.

translation:
On the performed non-contrast MR images of the left knee, a small zone of subchondral edema is visible in the area of the posterior part of the lateral femoral condyle. The finding may correspond to a minor osteochondral IIa lesion. Osteoarthritic changes of the patellofemoral joint are visible with calcifications of the patellar cartilage and fissures of chondromalacia type grade III to IV.
The anterior cruciate ligament is mildly degenerative, with irregular appearance of the lateral part of the insertion at the intercondylar eminence, which may correspond to a minimal partial tear. The posterior cruciate ligament is of normal appearance.
Mild degenerative changes of the medial meniscus are present, without signs of tear. The lateral meniscus is of normal appearance.
The collateral ligaments of the knee are intact.
Mild enthesitis of the quadriceps tendon at its insertion on the patella is present. Edema of the suprapatellar fat pad, likely reactive.
Normal appearance of the patellar ligament.
No significant effusion in the knee joint.
No popliteal cyst is identified.
The other visualized structures are of normal appearance.

Cartílago fémoro-tibial y patelo-femoral de espesor e intensidad de señal conservadas.

Rotura radial marginal que compromete cuerno anterior y región corporal del menisco medial con

platillo tibial.
translation:
Clinical History:
Obs. Medial meniscal lesion.
Findings:
Bone marrow of normal signal intensity.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments continuous, without lesions.
Signal alteration of the anterior horn and part of the body of the medial meniscus suggestive of marginal radial tear, with mild meniscal extrusion, which is associated with reactive bone edema of the articular surfaces. Discrete meniscal extrusion of 2.5 mm at the level of the body.
Lateral meniscus of normal morphology, without signs of tears.
Femorotibial and patellofemoral cartilage of preserved thickness and signal intensity.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserinus tendons, biceps femoris tendon and iliotibial band of normal thickness and signal intensity.
No joint effusion or popliteal cyst is observed.
Impression:
Marginal radial tear involving the anterior horn and body region of the medial meniscus with mild meniscal extrusion and reactive bone edema of the articular surfaces of the femoral condyle and tibial plateau.

report: МР находка: МР данни за малък ставен излив. Виждат се артрозни промени във фемуро-пателарната става - хрущялът на фемура е изтънен. Сред изтънения фемурален хрущял се виждат дефекти с липсващи участъци от него. Изобразява се свободен хрущялен фрагмент сред ретропателарния ставен излив. Той е с размер 11/2мм. Хрущялът на тибията и фемура от медиалната страна на ставата е също лекостепенно изтънен. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Дегенеративни промени в заден рог на медиалния менискус. Дорзално от него и дорзално от задната кръстна връзка се изобразява многокамерна ганглион киста с размер в сагитална равнина 30/8мм. Нормално изобразяване на костите, формиращи лявата колянна става. Няма данни за костномозъчен едем. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилието на м. квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Колатерални връзки – запазена цялост. Заключение:  МР данни за хондропатия. Наличие на свободен хондрален фрагмент ретропателарно вътреставно – за артроскопия. Ганглион киста.

There is an undisplaced horizontal oblique tear through the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, along with a small bilobed posteriorly located meniscal cyst. A small joint effusion is present, no loose bodies have been demonstrated.  The lateral meniscus is normal.  The ACL, PCL, medial and lateral collateral ligaments are intact.  The medial and lateral tibiofemoral articular cartilage is well preserved.  
A well-defined ring of sclerosis with internal marrow signal characteristics is noted along the central portion of the lateral femoral condyle, with no surrounding marrow edema like signal change. Such appearances are deemed incidental and completely non aggressive in nature, not requiring any further assessment.  Marrow signal characteristics are otherwise reasonably well-maintained.  
Mild distal femoral trochlear dysplasia with a tiny focus of high-grade cartilage loss and associated subchondral marrow change being noted along the inferior aspect of the lateral retropatellar facet. Incidental note is made of a patella alta morphology as per modified Insall Salvati index. No other finding of note.

The medial and lateral tibiofemoral articular cartilage is well preserved.

Such appearances are deemed incidental and completely non aggressive in nature, not requiring any further assessment.  Marrow signal characteristics are otherwise reasonably well-maintained.  
Mild distal femoral trochlear dysplasia with a tiny focus of high-grade cartilage loss and associated subchondral marrow change being noted along the inferior aspect of the lateral retropatellar facet. Incidental note is made of a patella alta morphology as per modified Insall Salvati index. No other finding of note.

translation: Normal articulation in the left knee joint. Mild subchondral edema at the medial femoral condyle (5/18). Otherwise unremarkable bone marrow signal. Small fabella (7/23). Chondropathy retropatellar, focally partly also deeper-reaching (e.g., 6/20), otherwise largely preserved cartilage covering, otherwise largely preserved cartilage covering femoropatellar. Femorotibial, particularly medially in the weight-bearing zone, diffusely thinned cartilage covering of the joint partners without full-thickness deep-reaching lesion. Lateral meniscus intact. At the medial meniscus, demonstration of a flap tear at the transition from the pars intermedia to the posterior horn with a paratibially displaced component (5/21). translation:
Clinical History:
Right knee pain.

Findings:
No significant bone marrow signal abnormalities.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Predominantly marginal tear of the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus with minimal meniscal extrusion.
Oblique horizontal tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with a segment extending toward the posterior intercondylar region in a laminar fashion.
Partial and full-thickness chondral ulcers of the weight-bearing zone of the lateral tibial plateau, without secondary bone changes. Superficial chondropathy of the central region of the medial femoral condyle. The remaining femorotibial cartilages without abnormalities. Patellofemoral cartilages without abnormalities.
Minimal joint effusion. No pathological popliteal cysts.
Mild increased signal at the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon and at the proximal insertion of the patellar tendon, without signs of tear. Pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Mild soft tissue edema between the iliotibial band and the lateral femoral condyle.

Impression:
Marginal tear of the lateral meniscus with minimal meniscal extrusion.
Tear of the medial meniscus with a segment extending toward the posterior intercondylar region in a laminar fashion.
Chondropathy: grade 3 lesions of the lateral tibial plateau and grade 2 of the central region of the medial femoral condyle.
Minimal joint effusion.
Mild proximal patellar tendinosis and distal quadriceps tendinosis.
Probable iliotibial band friction phenomena.

translation:
MRI LEFT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat signal suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

FINDINGS
In the medial compartment, a degenerative tear of the meniscus is observed, extensive bone marrow edema at the medial femoral condyle and epicondyle, as well as a subarticular area of linear morphology with low signal on all pulse sequences.
In the lateral compartment, no pathological findings are observed.
On evaluation of the anterior compartment, no significant lesions are observed.
A small joint effusion is observed intra-articularly with mild synovitis, while the ligamentous structures do not show pathological findings.

CONCLUSION:
Findings of microtrabecular insufficiency fracture (synonymous with "spontaneous osteonecrosis") at the medial femoral condyle and epicondyle without collapse of the articular surface, with accompanying degenerative tear of the medial meniscus.

translation:

Chondromalacia grade I–II of the cartilage of the lateral tibial plateau.
Mild osteoarthritic changes of the patellofemoral joint with visible grade II chondromalacia of the cartilage of the femoral trochlea.
The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are of preserved continuity, without signs of rupture.
Between the cruciate ligaments, adjacent to the tibial intercondylar eminence, there is a free osteochondral body measuring 9 mm.
Advanced degenerative changes of the medial meniscus with a complex tear of the posterior horn and visible extrusion beneath an osteophyte of the medial femoral condyle. Consequently, the medial collateral ligament is distended, with a small amount of effusion, without signs of rupture.
The lateral meniscus is of normal signal intensity, without signs of rupture.
Enthesopathic changes of the lateral collateral ligament, without signs of rupture.
Enthesopathic changes at the insertion of the popliteus tendon with popliteus tendon bursitis.
The iliotibial tract is without signs of rupture.
The patellar retinacula are intact.
Moderate effusion in the knee joint with mild synovial hypertrophy suprapatellarly and posteriorly along the tibia, and lipoma arborescens in the suprapatellar recess laterally.
No Baker's cyst is found.

translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1 and proton density pulse sequences with fat signal suppression.

FINDINGS
From the evaluation of the posterior cruciate and collateral ligaments, the articular cartilage, and the extensor mechanism, no significant findings are observed.
The anterior cruciate ligament shows discontinuity at the proximal portion.
The medial meniscus shows pathological signal without extension to the articular surface.
The lateral meniscus shows larger dimensions than expected with a minimum diameter in the coronal plane of 18 mm.
The bone marrow does not show pathological findings.
Moderate joint effusion is observed intra-articularly.

CONCLUSION:
1. Chronic complete tear of the femoral insertion of the anterior cruciate ligament.
2. Degeneration of the medial meniscus at the posterior horn without tear.
3. Discoid morphology of the lateral meniscus.

report:
In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, there is bucket-handle tear of the lateral meniscus, at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn. There is displaced meniscal fragment into the intercondylar notch. There is focal osteochondral fracture at posterior weight-baring lateral femoral condyle (about 1.5* 1 cm).

report: ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ: Η εξέταση έγινε µε ακολουθίες παλµών Τ1, πυκνότητας πρωτονίων µε καταστολή του σήµατος του λίπους και Τ2 βαθµιδωτής ηχούς. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Παρατηρείται παθολογικό σήµα στο σώµα και στο οπίσθιο κέρας του έσω µηνίσκου µε επέκταση στην κάτω αρθρική επιφάνεια. Ο πρόσθιος χιαστός παρουσιάζει οριζόντιο προσανατολισµό και τµηµατική ασυνέχεια των ινών του στο επίπεδο της πρόσφυσής του στο µηριαίο. Παρατηρείται οστικό οίδηµα στο οπίσθιο έξω τµήµα της κνήµης. Φυσιολογικοί απεικονίζονται οι πλάγιοι και ο οπίσθιος χιαστος σύνδεσµος καθώς και ο έξω µηνίσκος. Από τον έλεγχο του εκτατικού µηχανισµού παρατηρείται µορφολογία της επιγονατίδας Wiberg II καθώς και συγγενώς αβαθής τροχιλία. Μετρία συλλογή υγρού παρατηρείται ενδοαρθρικά. Εντός του φυσιολογικού ελέγχεται ο αρθρικός χόνδρος. Καλόηθες υπερπλασία παρατηρείται στον οστικό µυελό µε παρουσία υπερβάλλοντος ερυθρού στοιχείου στην άπω µεταδιάφυση του µηριαίου, της περόνης και της κνήµης. ΣΥΜΠΕΡΑΣΜΑ: 1. Ολική ρήξη του πρόσθιου χιαστού συνδέσµου µε συνοδό οστεοµυλικό οίδηµα (bone bruise) στο οπίσθιο και έξω τµήµα της κνήµης και αίµαρθρο σε φάση απορρόφησης. 2. Τραυµατική ρήξη του σώµατος και οπίσθιου κέρατος του έσω µηνίσκου (ramp lesion). 3. Ευρήµατα που συνηγορούντα υπέρ δυσλειτουργίας κύλισης της επιγονατίδας (patella maltracking).
translation:
TECHNIQUE: The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

FINDINGS:
Abnormal signal is observed in the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with extension to the inferior articular surface. The anterior cruciate ligament presents with horizontal orientation and partial discontinuity of its fibers at the level of its femoral attachment. Bone edema is observed in the posterior lateral aspect of the tibia. The collateral ligaments and the posterior cruciate ligament as well as the lateral meniscus appear normal. On evaluation of the extensor mechanism, a Wiberg type II patellar morphology is observed as well as a congenitally shallow trochlea. A moderate joint effusion is observed intra-articularly. The articular cartilage is within normal limits. Benign hyperplasia is observed in the bone marrow with presence of excess red marrow element in the distal metadiaphysis of the femur, fibula, and tibia.

IMPRESSION:
1. Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament with associated bone marrow edema (bone bruise) in the posterior and lateral aspect of the tibia and hemarthrosis in the resorption phase.
2. Traumatic tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus (ramp lesion).
3. Findings consistent with patellar maltracking.

translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: Grade II degeneration and a horizontal tear are observed in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. The lateral meniscus is normal. The signal of the anterior cruciate ligament is diffusely increased with focal irregularities in places (myxoid degeneration). The posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. A focal subchondral millimetric cyst and bone marrow edema in the patellar bone, and cartilage thinning in the medial facet are observed. Minimal fluid increase is observed at the patellofemoral joint level. Subchondral bone marrow edema and a cyst are observed in the posterior aspect of the lateral condyle.

tetive m. kvadricepsa.

Kompleksna ruptura medijalnog meniska - horizontalna ruptura stražnjeg roga koja prelazi
tibijalnu zglobnu plohu te manja longitudinalna komponenta rupture tijela meniska.
Inhomogen je prikaz lateralne fasete patele - hondromalacija II. stupnja.
Reducirana je debljina artikulacijske trohleje femura.
Manji izljev u koljenu, dominantno u lateralnom dijelu suprapatelarnog recessusa. Multilokulirana
Bakerova cista dimenzija 16x12x43 mm (APxLLxCC).
Manja zona koštanog edema medijalnog platoa tibije
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i

translation:
On the series of MR images of the right knee, there is normal morphology and signal intensity of the collateral ligaments, anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments, iliotibial tract, patellar ligament, and quadriceps tendon.
The lateral meniscus is of normal morphology and signal intensity.
Complex tear of the medial meniscus – horizontal tear of the posterior horn extending to the tibial articular surface and a smaller longitudinal component of the tear in the body of the meniscus.
Inhomogeneous appearance of the lateral patellar facet – grade II chondromalacia.
Reduced thickness of the articular cartilage of the femoral trochlea.
Small knee effusion, predominantly in the lateral part of the suprapatellar recess. Multiloculated Baker's cyst measuring 16x12x43 mm (APxLLxCC).
Small zone of bone marrow edema of the medial tibial plateau.
The other visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

report: Bei Z. n. Patellaluxation die Patella aktuell noch etwas inkongruent gering lateralisiert stehend. Flache Trochlea (4/72). Unauffällige Patella-Form. Ansonsten regelrechte Stellungsverhältnisse am linken Knie. Am ehesten postkontusionelles Bone Bruise an der Außenseite der lateralen Femurkondyle (4/79) sowie dezent auch anterior am lateralen Tibia-Plateau (5/19). Kein eindeutiges Bone Bruise an der Patella. Der retropatellare Knorpelbelag mit einzelnen tief greifenden bis auf Knochenniveau reichenden fissuralen Läsionen, exemplarisch an der medialen Facette (8/11) sowie auch an der lateralen Facette (8/10). Ansonsten überwiegend oberflächliche Fibrillationen, betont an der medialen Facette. Das MPFL am Ursprung an der medialen Femurkondyle verdickt (8/12) und deutlich signalalteriert bei höhergradiger Partialläsion. Femoropatellar regelrechte Stellung und unauffälliger Knorpelbelag. Unauffällige Darstellung der Menisken. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Das LCL am Ursprung gering aufgetrieben und signalangehoben (5/25), DD bei kleiner Partialläsion. Deutlicher Hämarthros. Diffuse Einblutungen in die umgebende Subcutis. Unauffällige Darstellung der miterfassten Muskulatur.
translation: Status post patellar dislocation with the patella currently still slightly incongruent and mildly lateralized. Shallow trochlea (4/72). Normal patellar morphology. Otherwise normal alignment of the left knee. Most likely post-contusion bone bruise on the lateral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle (4/79) as well as subtly also anteriorly at the lateral tibial plateau (5/19). No definite bone bruise of the patella. The retropatellar cartilage with individual deep fissural lesions reaching down to bone level, exemplarily at the medial facet (8/11) as well as at the lateral facet (8/10). Otherwise predominantly superficial fibrillations, emphasized at the medial facet. The MPFL thickened at its origin at the medial femoral condyle (8/12) and markedly signal-altered with high-grade partial tear. Normal femoropatellar alignment and unremarkable cartilage. Normal appearance of the menisci. Anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments intact. Collateral ligaments intact. The LCL slightly thickened and signal-elevated at its origin (5/25), DD small partial tear. Marked hemarthrosis. Diffuse hemorrhages in the surrounding subcutaneous tissue. Normal appearance of the included musculature.

translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE: The examination was performed with T1, Pd fs, T2 me2d sequences.

FINDINGS
- A significant amount of intra-articular fluid collection is identified. There is a coexisting Baker's cyst at the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle measuring 4.4 x 1.4 cm.
- A small marginal irregularity of the lateral patellar cartilage.
- The menisci, the collateral and cruciate ligaments, as well as the remaining articular cartilage appear normal.
- No other pathological findings from the extensor mechanism, while normal extensor mechanism alignment measurements are noted.
- The bone marrow shows normal signal.
- No other degenerative changes.

CONCLUSION
Grade II chondropathy of the lateral facet of the patella. Significant intra-articular fluid collection.

ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Από τον έλεγχο του έξω µηνίσκου και των πλαγίων συνδέσµων δεν παρατηρούνται παθολογικά ευρήµατα. Ο πρόσθιος χιαστός σύνδεσµος παρουσιάζει ολική ρήξη στην µηριαία πρόσφυση αυτού. Στο οπίσθιο κέρας του έσω µηνίσκου παρατηρείται κάθετη ρήξη (Ramp tear). Ο αρθρικός χόνδρος παρουσιάζει παθολογικό σήµα και εστιακή διόγκωση (blistering) στην έσω αρθρική επιφάνεια. Tο εύρηµα αποδίδεται σε εστιακή χονδροµαλάκυνση (grade II modified Outerbridge). Πολλαπλές εστίες οστικού µώλωπα παρατηρούνται στον έξω µηριαίο κόνδυλο, στον οπίσθιο έξω κνηµιαίο κόνδυλο αλλά και στην οπίσθια έσω κνηµιαία επίφυση. Από τον έλεγχο του εκτατικού µηχανισµού παρατηρείται υποδόριο οίδηµα προεπιγονατιδικά.
translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

FINDINGS
No pathological findings are observed on evaluation of the lateral meniscus and collateral ligaments.
The anterior cruciate ligament shows a complete tear at its femoral attachment.
A vertical tear (Ramp tear) is observed in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
The articular cartilage shows abnormal signal and focal bulging (blistering) on the medial articular surface. This finding is attributed to focal chondromalacia (grade II modified Outerbridge).
Multiple foci of bone bruise are observed in the lateral femoral condyle, the posterior lateral tibial condyle, and the posterior medial tibial epiphysis.
On evaluation of the extensor mechanism, subcutaneous edema is observed prepatellarly.

report:
Trouvailles :

Il y a un épanchement articulaire petit à modéré. Il y a un kyste poplité qui mesure jusqu’à 4.7 x 3.1 x 2.6cm de diamètre.

L’alignement fémoro-rotulien est normal. Légère tendinopathie du tendon rotulien. Il n’y a pas de bursite. Les rétinaculas rotuliens sont sans particularité. Le signal de la graisse de Hoffa est normal. Le signal de la graisse supra-rotulienne est également normal.

Le cartilage fémoro-rotulien est normal. Il n’y a pas de chondrose significative.

Le ménisque interne démontre des signes de dégénérescence mixoïde. Il n’y a pas de déchirure.

Le ménisque externe parait normal.

Le ligament croisé antérieur est normal.

Le ligament croisé postérieur démontre une déchirure longitudinale et partielle paraissant ancienne.

Le complexe ligamentaire externe est normal.

Le ligament collatéral interne est épaissi à la sa partie supérieure avec irrégularité de contour suggestif d’une ancienne blessure grade 1-2. Il n’y a pas de déchirure significative.

Il n’y a pas de contusion osseuse d’œdème de la moelle osseuse ou de fracture. Il n’y a pas de blessure ostéochondrale.

Il n’y a pas de chondrose ou d’arthrose significative au niveau des compartiments tibio-fémoral interne ou externe.

Le reste de l’examen est sans particularité.

Conclusion :

Déchirure partielle ancienne du ligament croisé postérieur. Une corrélation clinique est recommandée quant à sa stabilité.

Ancienne blessure grade 1-2 du ligament collatéral interne. Pas d’évidence de déchirure significative.

Épanchement articulaire petit à modéré avec présence d’un kyste poplité tel que décrit plus.

Autres observations faites, voir rapport plus haut.
translation:
Findings:

There is a small to moderate joint effusion. There is a popliteal cyst measuring up to 4.7 x 3.1 x 2.6 cm in diameter.

The patellofemoral alignment is normal. Mild tendinopathy of the patellar tendon. There is no bursitis. The patellar retinacula are unremarkable. The signal of Hoffa's fat pad is normal. The signal of the suprapatellar fat pad is also normal.

The patellofemoral cartilage is normal. There is no significant chondrosis.

The medial meniscus demonstrates signs of myxoid degeneration. There is no tear.

The lateral meniscus appears normal.

The anterior cruciate ligament is normal.

The posterior cruciate ligament demonstrates a longitudinal partial tear appearing chronic.

The lateral ligamentous complex is normal.

The medial collateral ligament is thickened at its superior portion with contour irregularity suggestive of an old grade 1-2 injury. There is no significant tear.

There is no bone contusion, bone marrow edema, or fracture. There is no osteochondral injury.

There is no significant chondrosis or arthrosis at the medial or lateral tibiofemoral compartments.

The remainder of the examination is unremarkable.

Conclusion:

Chronic partial tear of the posterior cruciate ligament. Clinical correlation is recommended regarding its stability.

Old grade 1-2 injury of the medial collateral ligament. No evidence of significant tear.

Small to moderate joint effusion with presence of a popliteal cyst as described above.

Other observations made, see report above.

report:
Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala lateralnog
kolateralnog kompleksa, prednjeg i stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa,
patelarnog ligamenta i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Lezija I. stupnja MCL prvenstveno u sklopu degenerativnih promjena.
Veći unutarnji i vanjski osteofiti kondila femura, unutarnji se parcijalno utiksuju u križne sveze.
Difuzno je povišen intenzitet signala intrasupstancijski u medijalnom i lateralnom menisku
prvenstveno uslijed degenerativnih promjena, bez jasnih znakova rupture uz ekstruziju
medijalnog meniska.
Reducirana je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice femorotibijalnog zgloba, naglašenije medijalnog
kompartmenta uz vidljivu hondromalaciju IV. stupnja te manji subhondralni koštani edem.
Hondromalacija II./III. stupnja lateralnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba.
Patela je medioponirana, Wiberg 1 uz hondromalaciju II. stupnja medijalne i lateralne fasete
patele.
Bakerova cista dimenzija 18 x 16 x 44 mm (APxLLxCC).
Supkutani edem prepatelarno i infrapatelarno.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.
translation:
On the series of MR images of the right knee, there is normal morphology and signal intensity of the lateral collateral complex, anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments, iliotibial tract, patellar ligament, and quadriceps tendon.
Grade I lesion of the MCL, primarily in the context of degenerative changes.
Large medial and lateral osteophytes of the femoral condyles; the medial ones partially impinge on the cruciate ligaments.
There is diffusely increased intrasubstance signal intensity in the medial and lateral menisci, primarily due to degenerative changes, without clear signs of tear, with extrusion of the medial meniscus.
Reduced thickness of the articular cartilage of the femorotibial joint, more pronounced in the medial compartment with visible grade IV chondromalacia and minor subchondral bone edema.
Grade II/III chondromalacia of the lateral compartment of the femorotibial joint.
The patella is medially positioned, Wiberg type 1, with grade II chondromalacia of the medial and lateral patellar facets.
Baker's cyst measuring 18 x 16 x 44 mm (AP x LL x CC).
Subcutaneous edema prepatellarly and infrapatellarly.
The other visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1 and proton density pulse sequences with fat signal suppression.

FINDINGS
On evaluation of the lateral meniscus, the anterior cruciate ligament, and the collateral ligaments, no significant findings are observed.
Simple degeneration without tear at the anterior and posterior horns of the medial meniscus.
Myxoid degeneration is observed in the proximal half of the posterior cruciate ligament.
On evaluation of the extensor mechanism and the anterior compartment, an osteochondral lesion of degenerative origin is observed at the mid articular surface of the patella with significant cartilage thinning and subarticular bone marrow lesions in the patella, while at the lateral aspect of the patella, fissural erosions (fraying) are observed.
A moderate fluid collection is observed intra-articularly.
In the lateral aspect of the joint cavity, suprapatellarly, a synovial fold is observed along with the presence of small foci of fatty metaplasia of the synovium, which raises suspicion of an early "frond-like" lipoma (lipoma arborescens).
Prominent varicose venous dilatations are observed in the subcutaneous tissue of the medial aspect of the knee.

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The medial meniscus is intact. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

1. No evidence of discrete meniscal, ligament, or tendon tear.
2. Subtle patellofemoral and lateral femorotibial chondrosis as detailed above.
3. Partially leaking 31 x 22 x 50 mm Baker's cyst.

MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla extremity system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. There is a 11 x 8 x 11 mm lobulated T2 hyperintense low-grade chondroid lesion within the distal femur without aggressive features.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion with mild synovial proliferation. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Full thickness fissuring of the medial tibial plateau with associated subchondral cystic change/edema. Medial femoral condyle cartilage is intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Partial thickness fissuring along the lateral patellar facet. The trochlear cartilage is intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Moderate joint effusion out of proportion to intra-articular findings. Consider fluid sampling if there is concern for inflammatory arthropathy or infection.
2.	MIld medial and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları korunmuş. Diz eklemindeki hafif dereceli trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı patellofemoral eklemde en belirgin ve patella apeksi ve çevresindeki kondral kalınlığın %50'sini aşmayan yüzeyel düzensizlik-kayıp ve buna eşlik eden milimetrik subkondral fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve milimetrik marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Medyal menisküs arka boynuz-gövdesi bileşkesindeki dejeneratif yapı içi intensite artışına yırtık eşlik etmiyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Kuadriseps yağ yastığındaki minimal ödem ön diz ağrısı nedeni olabilir. Femoral troklea hafif dereceli displastik (De Jour tip A). Patella hafifçe laterale translasyon gösteriyor. Patellanın yüksekliği normal. TT-TO mesafesi normal. Ekstensör mekanizma bunların dışında korunmuş.
translation: The amount of intra-articular fluid in the knee joint is mildly increased. The cruciate and collateral ligaments are normal. The posterolateral and posteromedial corner structures are preserved. Mild tricompartmental degenerative joint disease of the knee is most prominent in the patellofemoral joint and is characterized by superficial irregularity and loss not exceeding 50% of the cartilage thickness at the apex of the patella and its surroundings, accompanied by millimetric subchondral fibrovascular changes and millimetric marginal osteophytes. The degenerative intrasubstance signal intensity increase at the posterior horn–body junction of the medial meniscus is not accompanied by a tear. The lateral meniscus is normal. Minimal edema in the quadriceps fat pad may be a cause of anterior knee pain. The femoral trochlea is mildly dysplastic (Dejour type A). The patella shows slight lateral translation. Patellar height is normal. The TT-TG distance is normal. The extensor mechanism is otherwise preserved.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:

SOFT TISSUES:

IMPRESSION:

report: МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив в ретропателарната бурса. Костите, формиращи двете коленни стави са с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. МР данни за костномозъчен едем в латералния кондил на тибията и в по-малка площ в медиалния кондил на фемура.  Ставният хрущял е запазен и със запазена конгруентност. Вижда се руптура на предна кръстна връзка в областта на средна трета. На това ниво връзката е задебелена и с повишен сигнален интензитен и дезорганизирани влакна. Задната кръстна връзка е интактна и с непроменена сигнална характеристика по цялото си протежение. В задния рог на медилния менискус се вижда хиперинтензна лезия с кос ход - руптура 2а стадий.  МР данни за дегенеративни промени на преден рог на латерален менискус. Пред него се изобразява многокамерна кистична лезия с овална форма и размери 14/6мм, съответстваща на вътреставна гнаглион киста, в ДД- по-малко вероятно е да се касае за менискусова киста. Нормално изобразяване на пателата, хрущяла на пателата и ретинакулумите. Медиалният колатерален лигамент се изобразява със запазена цялост  и повишена сигнална характеристика. Лигаментът е частично задебелен, с едемни промени в средната си трета. Латерален колатерален лигамент– б.о. Наличие на слабо изразен едем на меките тъкани. Вижда се и малка Бекерова киста на нивото на медиалната глава на м. гастрокнемиус. Заключение: МР данни за руптура на предна кръстна връзка. Вътреставен излив. Частична руптура 2а стадий на заден рог на медиален менискус. Вътреставни ганглион кисти пред преден рог на лтерален менискус. Едемни промени на медиален колатерален лигамент. Бекерова киста.

report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Kuadriseps yağ yastığındaki ödem ön diz ağrısı nedeni olabilir. Ön çapraz bağda hafif mukoid dejenerasyon izleniyor. Arka çapraz bağ korunmuş. İç yan bağın çevresi ödemli. Dış yan bağ dejenerasyon dışında normal. Lateral menisküs arka boynuzu-gövdesi bileşkesindeki dejeneratif yapı içi intensite artışı yüksek olasılıkla yırtık biçiminde eklem yüzeylerine uzanmıyor. Medyal menisküs medyale 4 mm ekstrüde ve arka boynuzu-gövdesinde yaygın dejeneratif kompleks yırtık eşlik ediyor. Distal femur anteromedyalindeki metafizyel subkortikal 1.4 cm boyutlu lobüle konturlu milimetrik hipointens odaklar barındıran lezyonun kıkırdak matriks içerikli bir tümörü temsil etme olasılığı yüksek. Arka çapraz bağın tibyal insersiyonuna komşu 1.4 cm boyutunda intraoseöz gangliyon kisti mevcut. Trikompartmantal osteoartrit patellofemoral ve medyal femoral tibyal eklemlerde en belirgin ve fokal olarak tam kat eklem kıkırdağı kaybı, eşlik eden subkondral medüller fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitler ile karakterize. Semimembranozus tendonozisi orta derecede ve milimetrik kalınlıkta yapı içi yırtıklar eşlik ediyor. Diz ekleminin posteromedyal köşesi ödemli. Diz çevresindeki kaslarda sarkopeni ile uyumlu hacim kaybı gözleniyor. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.
translation: The amount of intra-articular fluid in the knee joint is mildly increased. Edema in the quadriceps fat pad may be a cause of anterior knee pain. Mild mucoid degeneration is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. The surrounding area of the medial collateral ligament is edematous. The lateral collateral ligament is normal apart from degeneration. The degenerative intrasubstance signal intensity increase at the posterior horn–body junction of the lateral meniscus most likely does not extend to the articular surfaces in the form of a tear. The medial meniscus is extruded 4 mm medially, accompanied by a diffuse degenerative complex tear in its posterior horn–body. The 1.4 cm lobulated-contoured metaphyseal subcortical lesion in the anteromedial distal femur, containing millimetric hypointense foci, most likely represents a cartilage matrix-containing tumor. A 1.4 cm intraosseous ganglion cyst is present adjacent to the tibial insertion of the posterior cruciate ligament. Tricompartmental osteoarthritis, most pronounced in the patellofemoral and medial femorotibial compartments, characterized by focal full-thickness articular cartilage loss, accompanying subchondral medullary fibrovascular changes, and marginal osteophytes. Moderate semimembranosus tendinosis, accompanied by millimetric-thickness intrasubstance tears. The posteromedial corner of the knee joint is edematous. Volume loss consistent with sarcopenia is observed in the muscles around the knee. The extensor mechanism is intact. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal.

report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular:Medial menisküs diz ekleminde 4,5mm mediale ekstrüdedir. Menisküste maserasyon , volüm kaybı ve kompleks yırtıklar izlendi. Lateral menisküs anterior -posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade II dejenerasyon izlendi.Anterior çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyona sekonder kalınlaşma ve sinyal artışı izlendi.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral  kollateral ligaman normaldir.Medial kollateral ligamende periligamentöz ödem izlendi ( grade I sprain ).Patella medial fasette kartilaj bütünlüğünde kayıp izlendi. Lateral fasette kartilajda incelme, subkondral kemik iliği ödemi izlendi.Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlendi.Femur medial kondil postero-süperior kesim komşuluğunda ekstraartiküler yerleşimli 2,5x1,5 cm boyutlu ganglion kisti izlendi.Diz eklemi kapsülü posteriorunda yırtık ve yırtık ile ilişkili 2x1,5cm boyutlu ganglion kisti izlendi.Tibia interkondiler eminenc anteriorunda anterior çapraz bağ yapışma yeri düzeyinde 1cm çaplı subkortikal kist izlendi.Peripatellar cilt altı yağ dokuda ödem izlendi.Tibia femoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma , ekleme komşu kemik yüzlerde subkondral skleroz ödem ve dejeneratif kistler izlendi. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlendi. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlandır.Femur lateral kondilde subkondral alanda 6x4mm boyutlu osteokondral defekt izlendi. Diz eklemini oluşturan her üç kompartmanda santral -marjinal osteofit formasyonu izlendi. Sonuç: Gonartroz, medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon, maserasyon , volüm kaybı ve kompleks yırtıklar , lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati, anterior çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon, medial kollateral ligamende grade I sprain , suprapatellar bursit, diz ekleminde sinovit,  ekstraartiküler ganglion kisti, tibia interkondiler eminencde subkortikal kist, prepatellar cilt altı ödem, diz eklem kapsülü posteriorunda yırtık ve yırtık ile ilişkili ganglion kisti, patella medial fasette grade III lateral fasette grade II kondromalazi.
translation:
RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings:
The medial meniscus is extruded 4.5 mm medially in the knee joint. Maceration, volume loss, and complex tears are observed in the meniscus. Grade II degeneration is observed in the anterior and posterior horns and body of the lateral meniscus. Thickening and increased signal secondary to mucoid degeneration are observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament and lateral collateral ligament are normal. Periligamentous edema is observed in the medial collateral ligament (grade I sprain). Loss of cartilage integrity is observed on the medial facet of the patella. Cartilage thinning and subchondral bone marrow edema are observed on the lateral facet. Increased fluid is observed in the suprapatellar bursa and knee joint space. An extra-articular ganglion cyst measuring 2.5x1.5 cm is observed adjacent to the postero-superior aspect of the medial femoral condyle. A tear in the posterior knee joint capsule and a 2x1.5 cm ganglion cyst associated with the tear are observed. A subcortical cyst measuring 1 cm in diameter is observed at the anterior tibial intercondylar eminence at the level of the anterior cruciate ligament insertion. Edema is observed in the peripatellar subcutaneous fat tissue. Joint space narrowing in the medial tibiofemoral compartment, subchondral sclerosis, edema, and degenerative cysts on the bone surfaces adjacent to the joint are observed. Cartilage destruction in the femoral and tibial cartilage at this level is observed. Findings are interpreted in favor of degenerative arthritis. An osteochondral defect measuring 6x4 mm is observed in the subchondral area of the lateral femoral condyle. Central-marginal osteophyte formation is observed in all three compartments of the knee joint.
Conclusion: Gonarthrosis, medial extrusion, maceration, volume loss, and complex tears of the medial meniscus, grade II meniscopathy of the lateral meniscus, mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, grade I sprain of the medial collateral ligament, suprapatellar bursitis, synovitis of the knee joint, extra-articular ganglion cyst, subcortical cyst at the tibial intercondylar eminence, prepatellar subcutaneous edema, tear of the posterior knee joint capsule and ganglion cyst associated with the tear, grade III chondromalacia of the medial facet and grade II chondromalacia of the lateral facet of the patella.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain for 2 years. No known injury. No history of knee surgery.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion. Marginal osteophytosis at the patellofemoral compartment. Button osteophyte at the medial femoral condyle.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. Small multiloculated Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Diminutive medial meniscus with blunting of the free edge of the meniscal body. Displaced meniscal fragment to the posterior joint recess. Moderate meniscal extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage irregularity with low-grade cartilage loss at the weightbearing medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade articular cartilage loss throughout the medial patellar facet with regions of full-thickness chondral fissuring at the median ridge. Full-thickness chondral fissuring at the medial and central trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis. Retro-quadriceps fat pad edema. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Mild lateral patellar tilt. No lateral patellar translation. No patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 14 mm, normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Complex degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus with displaced meniscal fragment at the posterior joint recess.
2.	Moderate patellofemoral compartment and mild medial tibiofemoral compartment chondrosis. 
3.	Small multiloculated Baker's cyst.
4.	Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis.

translation:
TECHNIQUE: The examination was performed with PD sequences with fat signal suppression, T1 and T2*.

FINDINGS:
- A large amount of fluid is identified within the joint with extension into the suprapatellar recess and the lateral recesses.
- On evaluation of the menisci, pathological signal and margin irregularity are identified in the medial meniscus, at the posterior horn and partly at the body. Meniscal material is observed anterior to the insertion of the transverse ligament at the anterior horn.
- The lateral meniscus appears normal.
- On evaluation of the ligamentous structures, the anterior cruciate ligament demonstrates diffusely pathological signal, consistent with mild myxoid degeneration, without disruption of fiber continuity. The posterior cruciate ligament and the collateral ligaments appear normal.
- On evaluation of the articular cartilage, a full-thickness defect measuring 7 mm in length is observed at the weight-bearing portion of the medial femoral condyle with accompanying bone marrow edema (ICRS 4).
- On evaluation of the extensor mechanism, a shallow femoral trochlea is identified (sulcus angle 159°). Additionally, a small focal degeneration is identified at the distal portion of the patellar tendon and at its medial aspect.
- Bone marrow edema is observed at the medial tibial epiphysis, with the articular surface intact.

CONCLUSION:
1. Microtrabecular insufficiency fracture of the medial tibial epiphysis (synonymous with "spontaneous osteonecrosis"), without collapse of the articular surface.
2. Moderate osteoarthritis of the medial compartment with degenerative tear of the medial meniscus, full-thickness cartilage defect at the medial femoral condyle, subarticular bone marrow edema, and joint effusion.

Intact cruciate ligaments.

Extensive joint effusion with thickened synovium.

report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Lateral menisküs dejenerasyonuna yırtık eşlik etmiyor. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzu-gövdesindeki dejenerasyon üst ve alt eklem yüzeyleri ile ilişkilenen ve serbest kenarda doku defektinin eşlik ettiği kompleks yırtık ile birlikte. Posterior oblik bağ ve çevresi hafif ödemli. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları bunların dışında korunmuş. Medyal femoral tibyal eklem osteoartriti eklem kıkırdağındaki kondral kalınlığın %50'sini aşmayan incelme, subkondral milimetrik çaplı fibrovaskuler değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler bunun dışında korunmuş. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal).
translation: Mild increase in intra-articular fluid. Cruciate and collateral ligaments are normal. Lateral meniscus degeneration is not accompanied by a tear. Degeneration in the posterior horn–body of the medial meniscus is accompanied by a complex tear that communicates with both the superior and inferior articular surfaces and is associated with a tissue defect at the free edge. The posterior oblique ligament and its surroundings are mildly edematous. The posterolateral and posteromedial corner structures are otherwise preserved. Medial femorotibial joint osteoarthritis is characterized by thinning of the articular cartilage not exceeding 50% of the cartilage thickness, subchondral millimeter-sized fibrovascular changes, and marginal osteophytes. The articular cartilages and bones are otherwise preserved. The extensor mechanism is preserved (quadriceps tendon and patellar tendon, patella and its position, femoral trochlear groove and patellofemoral ligaments are normal).

Il y a amincissement du cartilage avec fibrillation superficielle impliquant les trois compartiments plus proéminents impliquant le compartiment interne. Il n’y a pas de région de perte de cartilage complet. 

Il y a changements dégénératifs intra-substance impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure radiale complète de la corne postérieure avec extrusion du ménisque. Autrement le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Léger à modérés changements dégénératifs plus proéminents impliquant le compartiment interne. 

Changements dégénératifs intra-substance des ménisques avec une déchirure radiale complète de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion.

There is cartilage thinning with superficial fibrillation involving all three compartments, more prominent involving the medial compartment. There is no region of full-thickness cartilage loss.

There are intrasubstance degenerative changes involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is a complete radial tear of the posterior horn with meniscal extrusion. The lateral meniscus demonstrates intrasubstance degenerative changes without a well-defined linear tear.

Otherwise, the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the semimembranosus, the popliteus muscle and tendon, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament, and the iliotibial band are unremarkable.

Conclusion:

Mild to moderate degenerative changes, more prominent involving the medial compartment.

Intrasubstance degenerative changes of the menisci with a complete radial tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus with extrusion.

Significant intra-articular effusion with synovitis with a partially ruptured popliteal cyst.

translation:
Technique: The examination was performed with T1 and PD fs sequences. History of a motorcycle fall 3 months ago.

Findings:
- Edema and thickening are observed at the femoral attachment of the posterior cruciate ligament, a finding consistent with partial tear of this ligament. The anterior cruciate ligament is intact.
- An oblique horizontal tear is seen at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. The lateral meniscus is intact.
- Injury of the medial collateral ligament (grade II) is observed, with thickening of the ligament and presence of edema along its course.
- Bone marrow edema is recognized at the posterior and lateral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle, with a low signal intensity line at the most peripheral portion of the condyle, corresponding to a small fissure fracture. A wedge-shaped area of impaction is present at the articular surface, medial to the fracture line, with associated loss of the overlying cartilage, consistent with grade IV chondropathy.
- Posterior to the posterior cruciate ligament in the intercondylar notch, a foreign body measuring 6 mm in diameter is seen, most likely of cartilaginous origin. The above findings are consistent with an osteochondral injury.
- A moderate joint effusion is recognized. Projecting synovial folds (plicae) at the superior part of the patellofemoral joint, possibly without clinical significance. Clinical correlation is recommended.
- Incidentally, a bony exostosis without edema at the present phase is seen at the region of insertion of the adductor magnus muscle at the superior part of the femoral condyle, possibly corresponding to an old injury.

No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

report:
Interprétation : 
Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire. Pas de kyste de Baker significatif avec un liséré de liquide au sein du récessus poplité. 
En corrélation avec les radiographies du genou droit, suspicion d’un ossicule méniscal au sein de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne mesurant 7-8mm de diamètre avec déchirure radiaire transfixiante à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure de même qu’au niveau de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion significative du corps méniscal de façon associée. Ceci est nouveau dans l’intervalle. Stabilité d’une déchirure longitudinale horizontale centrée au corps du ménisque interne s’étendant légèrement aux cornes postérieures et antérieures et à la surface articulaire inférieure. 
Également dans l’intervalle, il y a progression significative des changements dégénératifs au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne avec perte transfixiante des surfaces chondrales, principalement aux surfaces portantes et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Ostéophytes marginaux modérés. 
Le ligament collatéral interne est intact sans déchirure. 
Légers changements de signal au sein de la corne antérieure du ménisque externe suggérant des changements de nature mucoïde dégénératifs. Pas de franche déchirure notée. 
Changements dégénératifs légers à modérés au compartiment fémoro-tibial externe avec atténuation/fissure chondrale partielle à la surface portante et petits ostéophytes marginaux associés. 
Le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe est intact sans déchirure. 
Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure. Petit kyste intra-osseux réactionnel sous l’insertion distale du ligament croisé postérieur. 
L’alignement patellofémoral est préservé. Changements dégénératifs modérés à sévères au compartiment patellofémoral, plus marqués le long de la facette patellaire externe et apex patellaire avec fissures chondrales transfixiantes et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Ceci a minimalement progressé dans l’intervalle. Petits ostéophytes marginaux. 
Légère tendinose à l’insertion distale du tendon du quadriceps et de façon plus diffuse au niveau du tendon patellaire. Pas de franche déchirure notée. 
Conclusion : 
Nouvelle déchirure radiale transfixiante à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure de même qu’au niveau de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion secondaire marquée du corps méniscal tel que détaillé ci-haut. Suspicion d’un ossicule méniscal à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure du ménisque interne, en corrélation avec une radiographie du genou droit. 
Progression dans l’intervalle des changements dégénératifs/chondropathie tricompartimentaux, sévères au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne et modérés à sévères au compartiment patellofémoral plus marqués le long de la facette patellaire externe de l’apex patellaire. 
Petit épanchement intra-articulaire.
translation:
Interpretation:
There is a small intra-articular effusion. No significant Baker's cyst, with a rim of fluid within the popliteal recess.
In correlation with right knee radiographs, suspicion of a meniscal ossicle within the posterior horn of the medial meniscus measuring 7–8 mm in diameter, with a full-thickness radial tear at the junction of the posterior horn and the posterior root as well as at the level of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with associated significant extrusion of the meniscal body. This is new in the interval. Stability of a horizontal longitudinal tear centered on the body of the medial meniscus, extending slightly to the posterior and anterior horns and to the inferior articular surface.
Also in the interval, there is significant progression of degenerative changes in the medial femorotibial compartment with full-thickness loss of the chondral surfaces, predominantly at the weight-bearing surfaces, and associated reactive subchondral changes. Moderate marginal osteophytes.
The medial collateral ligament is intact without tear.
Mild signal changes within the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus suggesting degenerative mucoid changes. No definite tear noted.
Mild to moderate degenerative changes in the lateral femorotibial compartment with partial chondral attenuation/fissuring at the weight-bearing surface and associated small marginal osteophytes.
The lateral collateral ligament complex is intact without tear.
The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact without tear. Small reactive intraosseous cyst beneath the distal insertion of the posterior cruciate ligament.
Patellofemoral alignment is preserved. Moderate to severe degenerative changes in the patellofemoral compartment, more marked along the lateral patellar facet and patellar apex, with full-thickness chondral fissures and associated reactive subchondral changes. This has minimally progressed in the interval. Small marginal osteophytes.
Mild tendinosis at the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon and more diffusely at the level of the patellar tendon. No definite tear noted.
Conclusion:
New full-thickness radial tear at the junction of the posterior horn and the posterior root as well as at the level of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with secondary marked extrusion of the meniscal body as detailed above. Suspicion of a meniscal ossicle at the junction of the posterior horn and the posterior root of the medial meniscus, in correlation with a right knee radiograph.
Interval progression of tricompartmental degenerative changes/chondropathy, severe in the medial femorotibial compartment and moderate to severe in the patellofemoral compartment, more marked along the lateral patellar facet and the patellar apex.
Small intra-articular effusion.

report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs bütünlüğü ve sinyal intensitesi doğaldır.Medial menüsküs posterior hornunda grade II dejenerasyon izlenmiştir. Arka çapraz bağ, medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Lateral kollateral ligamanda grade II sprain görünümü mevcuttur.Anterior çapraz bağ seyri normal olmakla birlikte sinyal artışı mevcuttur (strain). Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Diz ekleminde medial ve lateral reseste, suprapatellar bursada artmış efüzyon izlenmiştir. Femur lateral kondilinde, tibialateral platosunda belirgin kemik iliği ödemi izlenmiş olup tibia lateral platosunda mikro fraktürler açısından şüpheli lineer hipointens çizgilenmeler dikkati çekmiştir. Tetkike dahil diğer kemik yapıların korteks bütünlükleri doğaldır.
translation: RIGHT KNEE MRI. Findings: The integrity and signal intensity of the lateral meniscus are normal. Grade II degeneration is observed in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. The posterior cruciate ligament and medial collateral ligament are normal. A grade II sprain appearance is present in the lateral collateral ligament. The course of the anterior cruciate ligament is normal; however, there is increased signal (strain). The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Increased effusion is observed in the medial and lateral recesses of the knee joint and in the suprapatellar bursa. Significant bone marrow edema is observed in the lateral femoral condyle and the lateral tibial plateau, and suspicious linear hypointense striations have been noted in the lateral tibial plateau regarding microfractures. The cortical integrity of the other bony structures included in the examination is normal.

report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve posterior hornunda horizontal yırtık ile uyumlu görünüm izlendi. Lateral menisküs normaldir. Medial kollateral ligamen çevresinde periligamentöz ödem izlendi ( grade I sprain ). Ön çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal artışı mevcuttur. Ön çapraz bağ tibia yapışma düzeyinde subkondrial milimetrik kistler izlendi.Arka çapraz bağ ve lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursada ve infrapatellar bursada diz eklemi içerisinde sıvı artışı izlendi.Tibiofemoral eklem medial düzeyde femoral yüzde 6x3.5 mm ve 5x3 mm boyutlarında, tibial yüzde 6x2 mm boyutlarında osteokondrial defektler ve komşuluklarında kemik iliği ödemleri izlendi. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda osteofitik sivrileşmeler, tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem mesafesinde daralma ve komşu kartilajlarda özellikle tibial kartilajda belirgin incelmeler izlenmiştir ( dejeneratif artrit bulguları ). Diz eklemi posteriorda medialde büyüğü yaklaşık 8 mm çapta 2 adet eklem içi cisim izlendi(loose body).
translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: Grade III degeneration in the medial meniscus with an appearance consistent with a horizontal tear in its posterior horn was observed. The lateral meniscus is normal. Periligamentous edema was observed around the medial collateral ligament (grade I sprain). There is signal increase consistent with mucoid degeneration in the anterior cruciate ligament. Subchondral millimetric cysts were observed at the tibial insertion level of the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament and lateral collateral ligament are normal. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Increased fluid was observed in the suprapatellar bursa and infrapatellar bursa within the knee joint. Osteochondral defects measuring 6x3.5 mm and 5x3 mm on the femoral surface and 6x2 mm on the tibial surface at the medial level of the tibiofemoral joint, with bone marrow edema in their vicinity, were observed. Osteophytic spurs in the bony structures forming the knee joint, narrowing of the joint space at the medial tibiofemoral joint, and marked thinning in the adjacent cartilages, particularly in the tibial cartilage, were observed (findings of degenerative arthritis). Two intra-articular bodies (loose bodies) were observed posteriorly and medially in the knee joint, the larger one approximately 8 mm in diameter.

translation:
On the series of MR images of the left knee, there is normal morphology and signal intensity of the collateral ligaments, posterior cruciate ligament, iliotibial tract, patellar ligament, and quadriceps tendon.
Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, more pronounced at the tibial attachment, with preserved fiber continuity. A small cyst at the tibial attachment of the ACL, immediately adjacent to the anterior root of the lateral meniscus.
The lateral meniscus is of normal morphology and signal intensity.
Intrasubstance increased signal intensity of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – differential diagnosis: degenerative changes.
Shallow fissures <50% of the lateral patellar facet (grade II chondromalacia). Near-complete loss of articular cartilage of the medial patellar facet.
Centrally between the medial and lateral patellar facets, a small zone of bone edema is seen – grade IV chondromalacia.
Grade I chondromalacia of the articular cartilage of the femorotibial joint.
No popliteal (Baker's) cyst is found. A small multiloculated ganglion cyst at the femoral attachment of the posterior cruciate ligament.
Discreet subcutaneous edema prepatellarly and infrapatellarly.
Edema of Hoffa's fat pad infrapatellarly – differential diagnosis: impingement.
The other visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

report: МР находка: МР данни за малък ставен излив. МР данни за лезия в средна трета и задния рог на латералния менискус – grade 2a. В него се изобразява хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход, която достига до края на менискуса. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на латералния менискус и на предния и задния рог на медиалния менискус. Костите, формиращи колянната става, са с нормална форма и сигнална характеристика. Не се намират изменения в хрущяла от медиалната и латералната страна на ставата. Кръстни връзки – интактни. Колатерални лигаменти, ретинакулуми на пателата – нормално изобразяване. МР данни за тендинит сухожилието на мускулус квадрицепс феморис в областта на залавното място за пателата. Нормално изобразяване на лигамента на пателата. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Поплитеална ямка - б.о Изобразява се едем в меките тъкани от латералната страна на ставата, както и в подкожието на предната повърхност на подбедрицата. Заключение: МР данни за малък ставен излив. Лезия в средна трета и задния рог на латералния менискус – grade 2a. Инсерционит на сухожилието на мускулус квадрицепс феморис.
translation: MRI findings: MRI findings of a small joint effusion. MRI findings of a lesion in the middle third and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus – grade 2a. A hyperintense line with a horizontal course is visualized within it, reaching the edge of the meniscus. Normal appearance of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus and of the anterior and posterior horns of the medial meniscus. The bones forming the knee joint are of normal shape and signal characteristics. No changes are found in the cartilage on the medial and lateral side of the joint. Cruciate ligaments – intact. Collateral ligaments, patellar retinacula – normal appearance. MRI findings of tendinitis of the quadriceps femoris tendon at the insertion site on the patella. Normal appearance of the patellar ligament. Patella, patellar cartilage – unremarkable. Popliteal fossa – unremarkable. Edema is visualized in the soft tissues on the lateral side of the joint, as well as in the subcutaneous tissue of the anterior surface of the lower leg. Conclusion: MRI findings of a small joint effusion. Lesion in the middle third and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus – grade 2a. Insertional tendinitis of the quadriceps femoris tendon.

translation: RIGHT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: Millimetric cysts and bone marrow edema are observed in the lateral femoral condyle. Cortical integrity and signal intensities of the other bony structures forming the knee joint are normal. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The anterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. Signal changes suggestive of mucoid degeneration are present in the anterior cruciate ligament. Signal intensity and integrity of the lateral meniscus are normal. A complex tear, extrusion beyond the joint space, and volume loss are present in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Narrowing of the joint space is noted at this level. Thinning of the cartilage tissue is observed on the posterior aspect of the patella (patellar chondromalacia). No space-occupying lesion was detected in the popliteal fossa.

No focal cartilage defects.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.

Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

Complex predominantly oblique undersurface tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with subchondral marrow edema about the peripheral tibial joint line.

report:
Zu [DATE] größenprogrediente Baker-Zyste mit einer cc-Ausdehnung von knapp 11 cm in lobulierter Morphologie (12/8), im kranialen Abschnitt diskontinuierlich DD rupturiert. Überwiegend diffus auslaufende Flüssigkeit im s.c. Gewebe popliteal sowie um die Unterschenkelmuskulatur. Gering Ödemsignal in den Flexoren bds. (11/32). 
Medial betonte Gonarthrose mit bekannt in der Belastungszone höhergradig gemindertem Knorpelbesatz; im Vergleich zu [DATE] dabei an der hinteren Femurkondyle Progredienz mit nun vollschichtiger Chondropathie fokal (4/23, 5/10). Zunehmende subchondrale Ödemzone des medialen Tibiaplateaus sowie der medialen Femurkondyle. Mucoide Degeneration des Innenmeniskus führend am Hinterhorn mit komplexer Rissbildung (5/9) am Übergang in die Pars intermedia aus der Voruntersuchung bekannt; der Meniskus extrudiert bei Beteiligung der Hinterwurzel. Mucoide Degeneration auch des Außenmeniskus mit möglicher, bereits vorbeschriebener Rissbildung am freien Rand. 
Fokal höhergradige Chondropathie auch lateral an der dorsolateralen Femurkondyle über 7 x 6 mm (5/26). Fokal tiefergreifende Chondropathie retropatellar sowie flächig hochgradige Chondropathie in der Trochlea mit vollschichtiger Läsion am Übergang zu den Kondylenwangen und subchondraler Reaktion/Ödembildung am Übergang zum lateralen Kompartiment (4/17). MCL-Reizzustand. Geringer Gelenkerguss mit Reizsynovialitis. Fabella. 
Kleine Baker-Zyste rechts miterfasst. Intakte Darstellung der Sehnenverläufe am Unterschenkel.
translation:
As of [DATE], size-progressive Baker's cyst with a craniocaudal extent of just under 11 cm in lobulated morphology (12/8), discontinuous in the cranial portion, DD ruptured. Predominantly diffuse tracking fluid in the subcutaneous tissue popliteally and around the lower leg musculature. Mild edema signal in the flexors bilaterally (11/32).
Medially predominant gonarthrosis with known higher-grade reduced cartilage coverage in the weight-bearing zone; compared to [DATE], progression at the posterior femoral condyle with now full-thickness chondropathy focally (4/23, 5/10). Increasing subchondral edema zone of the medial tibial plateau and the medial femoral condyle. Mucoid degeneration of the medial meniscus, predominantly at the posterior horn with complex tear formation (5/9) at the transition to the pars intermedia, known from the prior examination; the meniscus is extruded with involvement of the posterior root. Mucoid degeneration also of the lateral meniscus with possible, previously described tear formation at the free edge.
Focal higher-grade chondropathy also laterally at the dorsolateral femoral condyle measuring 7 x 6 mm (5/26). Focal deep chondropathy retropatellarly as well as diffuse high-grade chondropathy in the trochlea with full-thickness lesion at the transition to the condylar facets and subchondral reaction/edema formation at the transition to the lateral compartment (4/17). MCL irritation. Mild joint effusion with reactive synovitis. Fabella.
Small Baker's cyst on the right also captured. Intact depiction of the tendon courses at the lower leg.

report:
MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    Rule out meniscal tear.

PRIOR IMAGING: Plain film radiographs from [Date]
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact and unremarkable. The patellofemoral ligaments are intact and unremarkable.

Articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is well-maintained.

T-TG distance is normal.

Lateral meniscus is intact. There is focal anterior and lateral femoral sulcus indentation with minor loss of cartilage of the lateral femoral condyle in the region of the sulcal depression. Overall articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

There is an oblique inferiorly surfacing tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus associated with a small posterior parameniscal cyst measuring about 4 to 5 mm in short axis tracking about 3 cm along the posterior margin of the meniscus and extending posterior to the base of the posterior cruciate ligament. Articular cartilage in the medial joint compartment is well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including the IT band, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus tendon and biceps femoris tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is significant edema and soft tissue stranding extending from the space between the medial head of gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscle proximally into the popliteal fossa behind the distal femur and distally into the medial soft tissues of the calf deep to the pes anserine tendons. The finding is consistent with a ruptured Baker's cyst.

There is no significant knee effusion.

INTERPRETATION: 

Oblique inferiorly surfacing tear of the medial meniscus involving body and posterior horn with associated para meniscal cyst posteriorly.

Nonacute osteochondral impaction injury involving lateral femoral sulcus with some mild focal cartilage loss overlying the region of cortical depression. No associated anterior cruciate ligament injury.

Soft tissue edema compatible with ruptured Baker's cyst.

- Confluent multiloculated cystic formations are identified, located both at the superior lateral aspect of the infrapatellar fat pad and intratendinously within the superficial fibers of the patellar tendon, likely representing ganglion cysts, with approximate dimensions AP ~3.7 cm and transverse ~3.5 cm. Clinical correlation for possible extensor mechanism dysfunction is recommended.
- Numerous nodular formations of increased signal intensity on T2 sequences are observed in the deep subcutaneous adipose tissue at the medial aspect of the knee at the level of the distal femoral diaphysis and in contact with the medial border of the vastus medialis muscle, with overall dimensions of 3.1 cm AP x 1.6 cm transverse x 3 cm craniocaudal, within which small foci of low signal intensity are demonstrated in places, possibly representing foci of calcifications (phleboliths). Mild edema of the adjacent fat is present. The above findings are primarily suggestive of a soft tissue hemangioma. Focused ultrasound examination is recommended.
- No intra-articular fluid collection.
- The menisci appear normal, as well as the cruciate and collateral ligaments. Small longitudinal ganglion cysts are observed within the anterior cruciate ligament.
- The articular cartilage is within normal limits.
- The bone marrow signal is within normal limits.

report: [DATE]: MR rechterknie Klinische inlichtingen/radiologische vraagstelling: Pijn bij flexie. Chondromalacia patellae? Daarnaast ook meniscaal letsel? Zie gescande aanvraag Procedure: Sagittale, coronale en axiale intermediaire meting met vetsaturatie, sagittale intermediaire meting en zonder vetsaturatie, coronale T1 gewogen opnamen. Bevindingen: Normaal voorkomen van quadricepspees en patellapees. Normale aflijning van het patellaire kraakbeen met beperkte zone van kraakbeenverdunning/beperkte fissuratie in het mediale patellafacet. Geloculeerde cysten uitpuilend in het vetplan van Hoffa, vanaf de tibiale insertie van de voorste kruisband, verder verlopend naar mediaal en caudaal, rondom het mediaal tibiaal plateau, op en diep ten opzichte van de distale patellapees aan laterale zijde. Intact voorkomen van voorste en achterste kruisband. De signaalintensiteiten van de menisci lijken binnen normale grenzen. Normaal voorkomen van het mediaal en het lateraal collateraal ligament en de tractus iliotibialis. Normaal voorkomen van de pes anserinus.
