report: In den vorliegenden Sequenzen unauffällige Signalgebung der ossären Strukturen, kein Knochenmarksödem, kein bone bruise. Grenzwertige Patella alta bei einem Canton-Deschamps-Index von 1,3. Patellaform Typ III nach Wiberg. Bei einem Sulcuswinkel von 152° abgeflachte Trochlea im Sinne einer Dysplasie Typ A nach Dejour. TTTG-Abstand mit 8 mm nicht vergrößert. Keine chondrale Läsion. Innen- sowie Außenmeniskus mit intakter Signalgebung ohne Hinweis auf eine Rissbildung. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband intakt. Innen- sowie Außenband intakt. MPFL intakt. Kein Kniegelenkserguss. Stigmata eines patellaren Maltrackings bei Ödem im superolateralen Hoffa'schen Fettkörper. Quadriceps- sowie Patellarsehne mit intakter Signalgebung. Ansonsten unauffällige Signalgebung der miterfassten Weichteile in den vorliegenden Sequenzen.
translation: Normal signal intensity of the osseous structures on the available sequences, no bone marrow edema, no bone bruise. Borderline patella alta with a Canton-Deschamps index of 1.3. Patella morphology type III according to Wiberg. Flattened trochlea with a sulcus angle of 152°, consistent with trochlear dysplasia type A according to Dejour. TT-TG distance not increased at 8 mm. No chondral lesion. Medial and lateral menisci with intact signal intensity, no evidence of a tear. Anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments intact. Medial and lateral collateral ligaments intact. MPFL intact. No knee joint effusion. Signs of patellar maltracking with edema in the superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Quadriceps and patellar tendons with intact signal intensity. Otherwise unremarkable signal intensity of the included soft tissues on the available sequences.

report:
Uredan intenzitet signala koštanih struktura tibije i femura.
Femoralna i tibijalna hrskavica su blago stanjene u smislu hondromalacije II stupnja.
Izljev intraartikularno te posteriorno uz kondile femura i tibije.
Prednji križni ligament je povišenog intenziteta signala u području distalnog dijela posterolateralnog
snopa pri inserciji za tibiju - u smislu distenzije/parcijalne rupture.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog intenziteta signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska s "flap"-om uz stražnji korijen meniska,
prema interkondilarnim eminencijama.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova degeneracije ili rupture.
Distenzija lateralnog i medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Izljev uz tetivu m. popliteusa - burzitis.
Povišen je intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa i patelarnog ligamenta za patelu u smislu
entezopatije.
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba. Patelarna hrskavca je potpuno
stanjena u području dorzalnog grebena patele s koštanim edemom i cističnim formacijama priležeće
subhondralne kosti - hondromalacija IV stupnja . Stanjenja patelarna hrskavica medijalne fasete s
fisurama - hondromalacija III stupnja. Hondromalacija II stupnja patelarne hrskavice lateralne fasete.
Opsežan izljev suprapatelarno te u medijalnom i lateralnom recesusu.
Prepatelarni edem potkožnog masnog tkiva.
Manja bisagasta poplitealna cista.
translation:
Normal signal intensity of the bony structures of the tibia and femur.
Femoral and tibial cartilage are mildly thinned, consistent with grade II chondromalacia.
Intra-articular effusion as well as posteriorly along the femoral and tibial condyles.
The anterior cruciate ligament shows increased signal intensity in the region of the distal portion of the posterolateral bundle at the tibial insertion – consistent with distension/partial tear.
The posterior cruciate ligament is of normal signal intensity and is seen in continuity.
Complex tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus with a flap at the posterior meniscal root, towards the intercondylar eminences.
The lateral meniscus shows no signs of degeneration or tear.
Distension of the lateral and medial collateral ligaments.
Effusion along the popliteus tendon – bursitis.
Increased signal intensity at the insertion of the quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament to the patella, consistent with enthesopathy.
Normal congruence of the articular surfaces of the patellofemoral joint. The patellar cartilage is completely thinned in the region of the dorsal ridge of the patella with bone edema and cystic formations of the adjacent subchondral bone – grade IV chondromalacia. Thinning of the patellar cartilage of the medial facet with fissures – grade III chondromalacia. Grade II chondromalacia of the patellar cartilage of the lateral facet.
Extensive effusion suprapatellarly and in the medial and lateral recesses.
Prepatellar edema of the subcutaneous fat tissue.
Small Baker's popliteal cyst.

report:
Erhaltene Artikulation im rechten Kniegelenk. Patella zentriert stehend. Unauffälliger Knorpelbelag femoropatellar.

Unauffällige Darstellung des lateralen femorotibialen Kompartimentes mit unauffälligem Außenmeniskus und erhaltenem Knorpelbelag.

Vollständiger Riss der Innenmeniskus Hinterwurzel (5/25 oder 4/17) mit geringer Extrusion der Pars intermedia und T2 Signalanhebungen des verbliebenen Hinterhornes (5/25). Der Knorpelbelag im medialen femorotibialen Kompartiment ist noch erhalten es zeigt sich jedoch ein deutliches Knochenmarksödem im medialen Tibiaplateau (5/19). Die Kreuzbänder sind intakt. Reizzustand des MCL bei umgebenden Flüssigkeitssignal (5/20). LCL intakt. Kleine Baker-Zyste. Geringer Gelenkerguss.
translation:
Preserved articulation in the right knee joint. Patella centered in standing position. Unremarkable cartilage covering in the patellofemoral compartment.

Unremarkable appearance of the lateral femorotibial compartment with unremarkable lateral meniscus and preserved cartilage covering.

Complete tear of the medial meniscus posterior root (5/25 or 4/17) with mild extrusion of the pars intermedia and T2 signal elevation of the remaining posterior horn (5/25). The cartilage covering in the medial femorotibial compartment is still preserved, however there is marked bone marrow edema in the medial tibial plateau (5/19). The cruciate ligaments are intact. Irritation of the MCL with surrounding fluid signal (5/20). LCL intact. Small Baker's cyst. Mild joint effusion.

report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Síndrome de banda iliotibial.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de una rotura en estas
secuencias.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras
condrales de espesor parcial de la faceta medial de la rótula.
No hay derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Discreto aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Tendón
cuadricipital, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales. Mínimo edema las partes blandas entre la banda de tibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de la faceta medial de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
Mínimos fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial.
translation:
Clinical History:
Iliotibial band syndrome.
Findings:
No significant bone marrow signal abnormalities.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Menisci with preserved morphology and signal, without categorical criteria for a tear on these sequences.
Cartilage of the femorotibial compartments and femoral trochlea without abnormalities. Partial-thickness chondral ulcers of the medial facet of the patella.
No joint effusion or popliteal cysts.
Mild increased signal of the proximal third of the patellar tendon, without signs of tear. Quadriceps tendon, pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris and iliotibial band within normal limits. Minimal soft tissue edema between the iliotibial band and the lateral femoral condyle.
No significant signal abnormalities of Hoffa's fat pad.
Impression:
Grade 2 chondropathy of the medial facet of the patella.
Mild proximal patellar tendinosis.

translation:
RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings:
Grade II degeneration is observed in the medial and lateral meniscus. The medial meniscus appears extruded medially. Periligamentous edema and increased signal are observed around the medial collateral ligament (grade I-II sprain). The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments and the lateral collateral ligament are normal. Increased fluid in the suprapatellar bursa and within the knee joint, and synovial thickening are observed (bursitis-synovitis). The patellar tendon appears normal. The patella is normally positioned. The retinacula are normal. Loss of cartilage integrity on the lateral facet of the patellar cartilage and subchondral bone marrow edema in the adjacent bone are present (grade IV chondromalacia). Mild osteophytic spurring in the bony structures forming the knee joint, narrowing in the medial tibiofemoral joint space, and thinning of the adjacent cartilages are observed (findings of degenerative arthritis). A Baker's cyst measuring 55x18 mm is observed in the popliteal fossa.

report: МР находка: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи колянната става, са със запазена форма и сигнална характеристика. Визуализира се вариант в анатомията – трипартидна патела. Артикулиращият ставен хрущял на фемура и тибията е съхранен. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Нормално представени са предните и задните рога на двата менискуса. Колатерални лигаменти – нормално изобразяване. Визуализира се зона на повишен сигнален интензитет в лигамента на пателата (от латералната му страна). По съседство на нея се изобразяват едемни промени в инфрапателарната мастна подложка на Hoffa. Едемни изменени се изобразяват и около латералния пателарен ретинакулум, като в последния се визуализира дефект в близост със залавното му място към пателата. Свързани с него се визуализират малки ганглион кисти. По-голямата от тях пропагира към подкожието и е с р-р 11/3мм. Медиален пателарен ретинакулум – б.о. Малка киста е налице и зад задната кръстна връзка с р-р 7мм. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за пателарна тендиноза (“Jumper’s knee”). Увреда на латералния пателарен ретинакулум. Наличие на малки ганглион кисти, свързани с ретинакулума.  Трипартидна патела.
translation: MRI findings: No MRI evidence of joint effusion. The bones forming the knee joint have preserved shape and signal characteristics. An anatomical variant is visualized – tripartite patella. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia is preserved. Normal appearance of the cruciate ligaments. The anterior and posterior horns of both menisci are normally represented. Collateral ligaments – normal appearance. A zone of increased signal intensity is visualized in the patellar ligament (on its lateral side). Adjacent to it, edematous changes are seen in the infrapatellar fat pad of Hoffa. Edematous changes are also visualized around the lateral patellar retinaculum, with a defect visualized in the latter near its insertion to the patella. Small ganglion cysts are visualized in association with it. The larger of them propagates toward the subcutaneous tissue and measures 11/3 mm. Medial patellar retinaculum – unremarkable. A small cyst is also present behind the posterior cruciate ligament, measuring 7 mm. Popliteal fossa – unremarkable. Conclusion: MRI findings of patellar tendinosis ("Jumper's knee"). Damage to the lateral patellar retinaculum. Presence of small ganglion cysts associated with the retinaculum. Tripartite patella.

translation:
MRI LEFT KNEE

TECHNIQUE: The examination was performed with T1 pulse sequences, proton density with fat signal suppression, and T2 gradient echo.

FINDINGS:
- The menisci, cruciate ligaments, and collateral ligaments do not show pathological findings.
- From the evaluation of the extensor mechanism, a congenitally high position of the patella (patella alta) is recognized with an Insall-Salvati ratio of 1.5 and Wiberg II-III morphology, as well as a congenitally shallow trochlea (sulcus angle 180°). An area of edema within the prefemoral fat pad is noted.
- A small subchondral lesion, 2 mm in diameter, is barely noted in the lateral part of the lateral femoral condyle, without significant edema of the underlying bone marrow, most likely without clinical significance.
- The bone marrow is evaluated with normal signal.

CONCLUSION: The findings from the evaluation of the extensor mechanism support patellar maltracking with predisposition for lateral dislocation and indications of impingement syndrome with edema of the prefemoral fat pad.

report: МР находка: Минимален за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става се изобразяват с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Вижда се малка зона на костномозъчен едем в предния ръб на медиалния кондил на фемура. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и в по-голяма степен на тибията е изтънен от страната на медиалното тибиално плато. Двете кръстни връзки се проследяват до залавните си места с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. Менискусите са с нормална сигнална характеристика и запазена цялост, без данни за руптура. Нормално изобразяване на колатералните лигаменти. Ретинакулуми – без особености. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на меките тъкани на лявото коляно.  Заключение: МР данни за хондропатия от медиалната страна на колянната става. report:
ACL tear
MRI of right knee without contrast. 
Pulse sequences: sagittal T1, axial, coronal, sagittal T2 FS, sagittal PD

Findings: 
1. Suggestive of complete tear or ACL. 
The PCL appears intact.
2. Oblique tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
The lateral meniscus shows no obvious tear.
3. Moderate knee joint effusion. Synovial thickening with multiple projections. Cannot rule out pigmented villonodular synovitis. Suggest correlate with arthrographic findings. 
4. The medial & lateral collateral ligaments, quadriceps & patellar tendons show intact appearance.
5. No obvious bone marrow edema or periarticular soft tissue edema, probably as a result of chronic injury.
6. Intact patellar cartilage.

IMP: 
(1) (Chronic ) complete ACL tear.
(2) Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
(3) Moderate knee joint effusion. 
Synovial thickening with multiple projections. PVNS cannot be ruled out. 
Suggest arthrographic correlation.

translation:
RIGHT KNEE

Technique
The examination was performed on a 1.5T magnetic field strength MRI scanner, using a multi-channel coil, with image acquisition using T1-weighted and proton density sequences with fat signal suppression.

Findings
A small fluid collection is identified in the knee joint. The medial meniscus, the cruciate and collateral ligaments, have normal signal intensity and morphology. Abnormal signal is observed in the body of the lateral meniscus. The bone marrow has normal signal intensity in the distal femur and proximal tibia and fibula. The articular cartilage in the medial and lateral compartments does not show findings of injury or degeneration. On evaluation of the anterior compartment and the extensor mechanism, the quadriceps and patellar tendons appear normal, and the patella has normal morphology and position relative to the femoral trochlea. The articular cartilage along the medial facet of the inferior pole of the patella shows significant thinning (ICRS stage IV) with a small subarticular osteomyelitic lesion. A cystic lesion with a craniocaudal diameter of 3.5 cm is observed adjacent to the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle.

Conclusion
Early degenerative osteoarthritis of the anterior compartment with joint effusion and Baker's synovial cyst. Degeneration, without tear, of the lateral meniscus.

report:
MRI of Left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, CO T2W FS, SG T1W, AX T2W FS

* The contour of PCL is not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, R/O tear.
   In favor of avulsion fracture of PCL insertion site of posterior intercondylar eminence.
* Interstitial intermediate signal in ACL on T1WI, R/O grade 1 injury.
* Hyperintensity signal is noted in distal quadriceps femoris tendon, especially at patellar insertion site, reflecting patella enthesophytes and tendinosis of distal quadriceps tendon.
* Focal hyperintensity area is noted in tibial tuberosity, intercondylar area, and posterior of medial condyle on F/S T2WI,  reflecting bone contusion.
* Spur formation of knee joint with mild subchondral edema in medial aspect of knee joint and irregular thin articular cartilage, reflecting osteoarthritis.
    Wearing of articular cartilage of patella, reflecting grade 3-4 patellar chondromalacia. 
* Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
* Subcutaneous edema around knee, more prominent at lateral side.
* Muscle and intermuscular infiltration over left popliteal fossa, in favor of muscle and intermusclar edema.
* Deep infrapatellar bursitis.
* Thickening of iliotibial band and quadriceps tendon, in favor of tendinosis.

Impression:

report:
Trouvailles:

Il y a un signal normal de la moelle osseuse. Il n'y a pas de fracture ou de contusion. Il y a un léger amincissement du cartilage impliquant les trois compartiments sans région de perte de cartilage complet.

Il y a des changements dégénératifs intrasubstances impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure longitudinale d'orientation horizontale s'étendant de la corne postérieure, jusqu'au niveau du corps du ménisque interne. La déchirure s'étend à la surface articulaire inférieure du ménisque. Il y a un petit kyste paraméniscal millimétrique adjacent à la corne postérieure et au corps. Il n'y a pas de fragment déplacé. Le ménisque externe est sans particularité.

Autrement, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et le tendon du poplité, le biceps femoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion:

1- Rotule sans particularité sans fracture ou contusion. Légers changements dégénératifs des trois compartiments.

2- Changements dégénératifs intrasubstances du ménisque interne avec une déchirure horizontale telle que détaillée ci-haut.

3- Aucune évidence de blessure ligamentaire.
translation:
Findings:

There is normal bone marrow signal. There is no fracture or contusion. There is mild cartilage thinning involving all three compartments without any region of full-thickness cartilage loss.

There are intrasubstance degenerative changes involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is a longitudinal tear with horizontal orientation extending from the posterior horn to the body of the medial meniscus. The tear extends to the inferior articular surface of the meniscus. There is a small millimetric parameniscal cyst adjacent to the posterior horn and body. There is no displaced fragment. The lateral meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise, the extensor mechanism, the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the medial collateral ligament, the semimembranosus, the popliteus muscle and tendon, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament, and the iliotibial band are unremarkable.

Conclusion:

1- Patella unremarkable, no fracture or contusion. Mild degenerative changes of all three compartments.

2- Intrasubstance degenerative changes of the medial meniscus with a horizontal tear as detailed above.

3- No evidence of ligamentous injury.

Meniscopathy in the medial and lateral menisci, mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, suprapatellar bursitis, synovitis of the knee joint, grade I sprain of the medial collateral ligament.

Prednji križni ligament blago je povišenog intenziteta signala u smislu mukoidne degeneracije,
prati se u kontinuitetu.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Parcijalna radijalna ruptura u području stražnjeg korijena medijalnog meniska.
Radijalna ruptura stražnjeg roga lateralnog meniska s manjim ekstraartikularnim pomakom tijela
meniska u posteriornom dijelu za oko 4 mm.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti urednog signala te se prate u kontinuitetu. Oko
navedenih ligamenata u području femoralnih kondila vidi se manja količina izljeva uz edem
okolnih mekih tkiva.
Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa i patelarnog ligamenta.
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba.
Manja poplitealna cista.
translation:
A larger zone of bone edema with an irregular, lobulated, cystic, marginal zone of increased signal of the medial tibial plateau. The described changes are primarily in the context of degenerative changes with a possible necrotizing lesion of the medial femoral condyle.
Degenerative changes of the femoral and tibial cartilage - chondromalacia grade III, more pronounced in the area of the medial femoral condyle - chondromalacia grade IV.
A small amount of effusion in the suprapatellar recess.
The anterior cruciate ligament shows mildly increased signal intensity consistent with mucoid degeneration, it is seen in continuity.
The posterior cruciate ligament shows normal signal and is seen in continuity.
Partial radial tear in the area of the posterior root of the medial meniscus.
Radial tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a minor extrusion of the meniscal body in the posterior part of approximately 4 mm.
The lateral and medial collateral ligaments show normal signal and are seen in continuity. Around the aforementioned ligaments in the area of the femoral condyles, a small amount of effusion is seen with edema of the surrounding soft tissues.
Normal signal intensity of the insertions of the quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament.
The congruence of the articular surfaces of the patellofemoral joint is normal.
A small popliteal cyst.

In the medial femorotibial compartment, primarily contusional bone bruise in the medial femoral condyle (5/20). Furthermore, tear of the medial meniscus in the pars intermedia with horizontal and oblique tear component (e.g., 6/8 or 5/23) with corresponding substance loss at the free edge. Discrete signal increase of the deep portions of the MCL, DD partial lesion (5/21). Unremarkable cartilage covering in the medial compartment.

Unremarkable appearance of the lateral femorotibial compartment. The lateral meniscus intact. Unremarkable cartilage covering. LCL unremarkable. Anterior and posterior cruciate ligament intact. Fabella. Marked joint effusion. Unremarkable appearance of the surrounding musculature and subcutaneous tissue.

translation:
MRI findings: MRI evidence of joint effusion. MRI evidence of bone marrow edema in the medial femoral condyle. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia is of normal morphology. The anterior cruciate ligament is ruptured and cannot be traced to its attachment sites. Medial and lateral meniscus – normal MRI appearance. Normal appearance of the collateral ligaments.
Retinacula – unremarkable. Patellar ligament and quadriceps femoris tendon – unremarkable. Normal appearance of the soft tissues of the left knee. MRI evidence of a Baker's cyst. Conclusion: MRI evidence of anterior cruciate ligament rupture. Joint effusion. Bone marrow edema.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain for one year with worsening in the last 3 months.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Mild myxoid degeneration without tear.
Medial compartment cartilage: Intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Discoid meniscus with complex tearing involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn with dominant horizontal component. Hypoplastic posterior root.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Articular cartilage irregularity at the weightbearing aspect of the joint without focal chondral defect.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness chondral loss at the inferior aspect of the trochlea with associated subchondral signal changes. Low-grade articular cartilage loss at the patellar median ridge.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Periligamentous edema, likely related to adjacent meniscal pathology.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. Patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 10 mm, normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Discoid lateral meniscus with extensive complex tearing at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn.
2.	Moderate patellofemoral and mild lateral tibiofemoral compartment chondrosis.
3.	Small knee joint effusion.

translation:
MRI: LEFT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed on a 3 Tesla scanner with T1 and proton density pulse sequences with fat signal suppression.

FINDINGS:
On evaluation of the menisci, the cruciate and collateral ligaments, the articular cartilage, and the bone marrow, no significant findings are observed.

On evaluation of the extensor mechanism, a congenitally shallow trochlea is observed (sulcus angle 180°). This finding predisposes to patellar tracking dysfunction.

A small fluid collection is observed intra-articularly in communication with a small Baker's synovial cyst in the medial popliteal fossa, where small ganglion cysts are also noted adjacent to the insertion of the posterior cruciate ligament, without clinical significance.

report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular:Lateral menisküste grade I dejenerasyon izlenmiştir. Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve posterior hornunda gövdeye doğru ulaşan kompleks yırtık izlenmiştir. Medial menisküs mediale doğru ekstrüde görünümdedir.Arka çapraz bağ ,Lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir. Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde belirgin sıvı artışı izlenmiştir ( grade I sprain).Ön çapraz bağ sinyali diffüz hafif artmıştır. Patellar tendon normal. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinakulumlar normaldir. Patella süperior lateral kesimi düzeyinde bipartial patella ile uyumlu olabilecek görünüm izlendi. Ayrıca patellar kıkırdak medial fasette kıkırdakta fokal incelme izlenmiştir (tip II kondromalazi).Arka çapraz bağ posterior komşuluğunda 32x15 mm boyutlarında lobüle konturlu kist izlenmiştir (ganglion kisti).Femur interkondiler düzeyde anteriorda subkondral milimetrik kistler izlenmiştir. Suprapatellar burada ve diz eklemi içerisinde hafif sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.
translation: LEFT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: Grade I degeneration is observed in the lateral meniscus. Grade III degeneration and a complex tear extending towards the body in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus are observed. The medial meniscus appears extruded medially. The posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. Significant fluid increase is observed around the medial collateral ligament (grade I sprain). The signal of the anterior cruciate ligament is diffusely mildly increased. The patellar tendon is normal. The patella is normally positioned. The retinacula are normal. An appearance compatible with bipartite patella is observed at the level of the superior lateral segment of the patella. Additionally, focal thinning of the cartilage is observed on the medial facet of the patellar cartilage (type II chondromalacia). A lobulated contour cyst measuring 32x15 mm is observed in the posterior vicinity of the posterior cruciate ligament (ganglion cyst). Subchondral millimetric cysts are observed anteriorly at the intercondylar level of the femur. Mild fluid increase is observed in the suprapatellar bursa and within the knee joint.

translation: [DATE]: MRI Knee Left 15ch AA: Clinical information: follow-up Diagnostic question: lateral knee pain Findings: Locally advanced femoropatellar cartilage disease grade 4 accompanied by deep fissures and subchondral geodes on the upper third of the patellar ridge as well as on the lateral facet of the patella. Moderate distension of the suprapatellar recess. T2 punctiform elements in the menisci, highly suggestive of chondrocalcinosis, possibly to be supplemented with radiography of the knee for confirmation. Strong suspicion of horizontal degenerative tear at the body of the lateral meniscus, with small reservation due to present calcifications. Intraosseous lesion of the proximal fibular head, T2-hyperintense and polylobulated, popcorn aspect, with maximal diameter 9~mm: enchondroma. Moderate Baker's cyst. Conclusion: - Locally advanced femoropatellar cartilage disease grade 4, currently with moderate hydrops. - Strong suspicion of calcifications at the level of the menisci in the context of chondrocalcinosis, possibly to be confirmed with radiography of the knee. - Strong suspicion of horizontal tear of the body of the medial meniscus, with small reservation due to presence of punctiform calcifications in the context of chondrocalcinosis.

translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1 and proton density pulse sequences with fat signal suppression.

FINDINGS

From the evaluation of the medial compartment, findings of extensive degenerative osteoarthritis are observed with total erosion of the articular cartilage (ICRS stage 4), degenerative tear and extrusion of the medial meniscus, presence of marginal osteophytes and subarticular bone marrow edema on both sides of the joint.

From the evaluation of the lateral compartment, simple degeneration without tear of the lateral meniscus is observed, with presence of marginal osteophytes without significant erosion of the articular cartilage.

From the evaluation of the anterior compartment, presence of large osteophytes in the region of the anterior femur is noted, without however substantial erosion of the articular cartilage of the patella.

Intra-articularly, joint effusion is observed with presence of a loose body in the anterior part of the joint with a transverse diameter of 11 mm.

The bone marrow presents benign hypertrophy.

In the intercondylar notch, new bone formation is observed, particularly prominent in the medial part of the lateral femoral condyle, with accompanying total tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, most likely due to chronic impingement.

In the posterior part of the medial femoral condyle, the large osteophyte projecting laterally presents bone marrow edema, most likely due to impingement on the surrounding muscles and tendons.

translation:

Non-displaced and questionable subchondral fracture at the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau.

Normal.

Grade 2 cartilage fissure at the medial patellar facet.

Bone contusions with bone edema at the posterior aspect of the medial and lateral tibial plateaus, as well as at the medial corner of the medial tibial plateau.

Patellar retinacula: Normal.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [PROFESSION]. Right medial knee pain. 
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
There is a moderate, focal bone contusion/subchondral bone marrow edema at the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau at the medial joint line at the site of the medial meniscus tear. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a complex, predominantly radial tear involving the inner margin of the body of the medial meniscus near the anterior horn/body junction (se 2, img 20 and se 5, img 11) with a superiorly flipped thin fragment extending into the anteromedial meniscofemoral recess (se 5, img 12 to 16 and se 4, img 7). Underlying reactive bone marrow edema at the medial femoral condyle and to a lesser degree at the medial tibial plateau. The tear of the meniscal body slightly extends into the posterior horn. No significant meniscal extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There are small 3 mm areas of focal full thickness cartilage fissuring (grade 4 chondral fissuring) at the medial patellar facet and at the groove of the femoral trochlea. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 3 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Complex, predominantly radial tear involving the inner margin of the body of the medial meniscus with a superiorly flipped meniscal fragment extending into the meniscofemoral recess. 
2.	Moderate, focal bone contusion/subchondral bone marrow edema at the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau at the medial joint line at the site of the medial meniscus tear. 
3.	Patellofemoral compartment: Small 3 mm areas of focal full thickness cartilage fissuring (grade 4 chondral fissuring) at the medial patellar facet and at the groove of the femoral trochlea. 
4.	Moderate knee joint effusion.

report: МР находка: Наличие на ставен излив. Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и тибията е запазен. Вижда се малка зона на костномозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на фемура. МР данни за увреда и на медиалния менискус тип „bucket-handle”. Вижда се, че част от менискуса не е на топичното си място, а се проектира под задната кръстна връзка – т.нар „double PCL sign”. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. Нормално изобразяване на колатералните лигаменти. Пателата е лекостепенно дислоцирана в латерално направление. Хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Оток на меките тъкани около колянната става.  Заключение: МР данни за увреда на медиалния менискус тип „bucket-handle”. Малък травматичен костномозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на тибията. Ставен излив. Лекостепенна дислокация на пателата.
translation:
MRI findings: Presence of joint effusion. The bones forming the knee joint are of normal shape. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia is intact. A small zone of bone marrow edema is seen in the medial femoral condyle. MRI findings of a bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus. Part of the meniscus is not in its normal anatomical position and projects beneath the posterior cruciate ligament – the so-called "double PCL sign". Normal appearance of the lateral meniscus. The cruciate ligaments are intact. Normal appearance of the collateral ligaments. The patella is mildly laterally dislocated. Patellar cartilage, retinacula – unremarkable. Patellar ligament and quadriceps femoris tendon – unremarkable. Soft tissue edema around the knee joint.
Conclusion: MRI findings of a bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus. Small traumatic bone marrow edema in the medial tibial condyle. Joint effusion. Mild dislocation of the patella.

report: Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femoral tibyal kompartmanda en belirgin ve tam kata ulaşan eklem kıkırdağı kaybı ve dejenerasyonu, subkondral medüller fibrokistik ve fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve hipertrofik marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ön çapraz bağın femoral yapışma yeri düzeyinden tam kat-tam kata yırtık.. Dış yan bağın femoral insersiyonuna komşu subkondral fibrovasküler-fibrokistik değişiklikler mevcut. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Medyale 6 mm ekstrude medyal menisküsün arka boynuzu - kökündeki dejenerasyon üst ve alt eklem yüzeylerine ulaşan kompleks dejeneratif yırtık ile birlikte. Lateral menisküsün korpus kesiminde serbest kenardaki yırtık püsküllenme biçiminde olabilir. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş.
translation: Tricompartmental degenerative joint disease of the knee, most prominent in the medial femorotibial compartment, characterized by full-thickness articular cartilage loss and degeneration, subchondral medullary fibrocystic and fibrovascular changes, and hypertrophic marginal osteophytes. The intra-articular fluid volume is mildly increased. Full-thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament at the level of its femoral attachment. Subchondral fibrovascular-fibrocystic changes adjacent to the femoral insertion of the lateral collateral ligament. The posterior cruciate and collateral ligaments are normal. Medial meniscus extruded 6 mm medially, with degeneration at the posterior horn–root accompanied by a complex degenerative tear reaching the superior and inferior articular surfaces. Tear at the free edge in the body of the lateral meniscus, possibly in a frayed pattern. The extensor mechanism is intact.

translation:
On the series of MR images of the right knee, there is normal morphology and signal intensity of the collateral ligaments, posterior cruciate ligament, iliotibial tract, patellar ligament, and quadriceps tendon.
The anterior cruciate ligament shows mild mucoid degeneration.
Mild degenerative changes of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus with a visible horizontal tear of the posterior horn and part of the body extending to the tibial articular surface. Extrusion of the medial meniscus.
The lateral meniscus is of normal morphology and signal intensity.
The patella is medially positioned, Wiberg type 2, with visible fissures involving more than 70% of the articular cartilage of the medial and lateral femoral trochlea as well as the femoral sulcus (grade 3 chondromalacia).
Grade I/II chondromalacia of the lateral patellar facet.
Incipient bony appositions of the patella and femur are visible in the patellofemoral joint.
Heterogeneous signal intensity of the medial and lateral tibial plateau (grade I chondromalacia).
Marginal bony appositions of the medial and lateral tibial plateau and femoral condyles.
Small knee joint effusion. No popliteal (Baker's) cyst is found. The medial plica is thickened in the suprapatellar recess.

translation: LEFT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: Grade I degeneration was observed in the lateral meniscus and medial meniscus. The anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament appear normal. Signal increase and periligamentous edema were observed in the lateral and medial collateral ligaments (grade I sprain). The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Increased fluid was observed in the suprapatellar bursa and within the knee joint. Subchondral millimetric cysts on the surface facing the intercondylar surface at the medial aspect of the lateral femoral condyle, and subchondral bone marrow edema on the lateral-facing surface of the lateral femoral condyle were observed. A 4x2 mm osteochondral lesion on the surface facing the tibiofemoral joint surface of the medial femoral condyle and signal change consistent with bone marrow edema in its vicinity were observed. There is a diffuse edematous appearance in the subcutaneous fatty tissue at the prepatellar level.

report: МР находка: Наличие на малък ставен излив. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става са с нормална структура. Вижда се ограничена зона на контузионен костномозъчен едем дорзално в епифизата на медиалното тибиално плато. Сред мастната подложка на Hoffa, зад лигамента на пателата се изобразява овална структура с р-р 10/3,5мм. Находката е с костна структура и съответства на вътреставно свободно тяло. Втора лезия със сходна макроморфология се изобразява и пред медиалния кондил на фемура. Визуализира се остеохондрален дефект по предната повърхност на медиалния кондил на фемура. Дефектът в хрущяла съответства по форма на описаното свободно тяло пред медиалния кондил на фемура. Наличие на начални, минимални остеофити по ставните повърхности на медиалните кондили на фемура и тибията. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. МР данни за руптура на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Свързани с менискуса се изобразяват множество перименискални малки кисти. Дегенеративно променен латерален менискус. Наличие на малък ставен излив. Колатералните лигаменти са със запазена цялост. Наличие на остеофити по горната и долната повърхност на пателата на залавните места на лигамента на пателата и на сухожилието на м. квадрицепс феморис. Хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – без особености. Изобразяват се дискретни дефекти в хрущяла по предната повърхност на фемура (ретропателарно). Поплитеална ямка – без особености. Заключение: МР данни за малък ставен излив. Остеохондрален дефект във фемура с описаната локализация. Свободни вътреставни тела. Лезия на заден рог на медиалния менискус – 3 степен.
translation: MRI findings: Small joint effusion present. The bones forming the right knee joint have normal structure. A limited zone of contusion-type bone marrow edema is seen dorsally in the epiphysis of the medial tibial plateau. Within Hoffa's fat pad, behind the patellar ligament, an oval structure measuring 10/3.5 mm is visualized. The finding has bony structure and corresponds to an intra-articular loose body. A second lesion with similar macromorphology is also visualized anterior to the medial femoral condyle. An osteochondral defect is visualized on the anterior surface of the medial femoral condyle. The cartilage defect corresponds in shape to the described loose body anterior to the medial femoral condyle. Initial, minimal osteophytes are present on the articular surfaces of the medial femoral and tibial condyles. The cruciate ligaments are intact. MRI evidence of tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Multiple small perimeniscal cysts are visualized in association with the meniscus. Degeneratively changed lateral meniscus. Small joint effusion present. The collateral ligaments are intact. Osteophytes are present on the superior and inferior surfaces of the patella at the insertion sites of the patellar ligament and the quadriceps femoris tendon. Patellar cartilage, retinacula – unremarkable. Discrete cartilage defects are visualized on the anterior surface of the femur (retropatellar). Popliteal fossa – unremarkable. Conclusion: MRI evidence of small joint effusion. Osteochondral defect of the femur at the described location. Intra-articular loose bodies. Lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 3.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Mild left knee joint effusion. Tiny uncomplicated popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Note some thinning and irregularity involving the cartilage of the weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle as is identified on the previous MRI. No subchondral bone marrow reactive changes.

The medial meniscus and medial collateral ligament are unremarkable.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Redemonstration of tearing of the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus with associated extrusion of the attenuated body of the meniscus. Appearances are again compatible with an unstable meniscal tear.

There is some marked thinning and irregularity of the articular cartilage involving the weightbearing surfaces of the lateral femoral and tibial condyles with associated mild focal subchondral bone marrow reactive signal intensity changes and some marginal osteophyte.

The fibular collateral ligament complex appears intact.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Normal.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Redemonstration of marked the fissuring involving both the medial and lateral patellar facet, not significantly changed since the previous MRI, with some very minimal subchondral bone marrow reactive signal intensity change.

Morphology of the trochlear articular cartilage is unremarkable.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
Suspected multiple small osteochondral bodies projected within the posterior joint space medial to the posterior cruciate ligament.

CONCLUSION:
1.Redemonstration of an unstable tear involving the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus, as described.
2.Tricompartmental articular cartilage thinning and fissuring most prominently affecting the patellofemoral and lateral femorotibial compartments.
3.Some associated small multiple osteochondral bodies within the posterior joint space surrounded by synovial fluid.
4.Mild left knee joint effusion.

report:
Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena prikazuju se uznapredovale OA promjene femorotibijalnog i
femoropatelarnog zgloba.
Denudacija tibijalne i kondilarne hrskavice medijalnog kompartmenta FT zgloba.
Patela je lateralno subluksirana (Wiberg 1) uz vidljivu gotovo potpuno reduciranu debljinu
artikulacijske hrskavice femoropatelarnog zgloba, osobito lateralne fasete patele i kondila
femura gdje je vidljiva hondromalacija IV. stupnja uz manji areal subhondralnog koštanog
edema. Vidljivi su rubni osteofiti femoropatelarnog zgloba.
Sitna osteohondralna lezija posteriornog dijela lateralnog kondila femura.
Više degenerativnih subhondralnih cističnih promjena zglobnih tijela FP zgloba te medijalnog
platoa tibije, najveća posteriorno dimenzija 8 x 12 mm.
Prednji križni ligament je mukoidno degeneriran.
Stražnji križni ligament je zadebljan s vidljivim intrasupstancijskim povišenjem intenziteta signala
fokalna mukoidna degeneracija.
Sitna ganglion cista neposredno uz hvatište stražnjeg križnog ligamenta za tibiju promjera oko 5
mm.
Lezija I. stupnja MCL prvenstveno posljedično degenerativnim promjenama.
Prati se stanje po kompleksnoj ruptutri stražnjeg roga i trupa medijalnog meniska na
degenerativnoj podlozi uz ekstruziju meniska. Uz medijalni plato tibije vidi se okrugla lezija
promjera do 6 mm intenziteta meniska - flap rupturiranog meniska?
Distenzija posteriornog segmenta zglobne čahure medijalno.
Uz ventralni korijen lateralnog meniska vidi se slobodno zglobno tijelo niskih intenziteta signala
dimenzija 7 x 4 mm - kalcifikat?
Bakerova cista aksijalno dimenzija oko 21 x 20 mm. Umjereni izljev u zglobu.
Nešto tekućine uz hvatište tetive m. sartoriusa za femur (tenosinovitis).
Supkutani edem infrapatelarno i edem Hoffine masti.
Manja subhondralna cista glavice fibule promjera 6 mm.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.
translation:
On the series of MR images of the left knee, advanced OA changes of the femorotibial and femoropatellar joint are demonstrated.
Denudation of the tibial and condylar cartilage of the medial compartment of the FT joint.
The patella is laterally subluxated (Wiberg 1) with visible almost completely reduced thickness of the articular cartilage of the femoropatellar joint, particularly of the lateral facet of the patella and the femoral condyle where grade IV chondromalacia is visible with a small area of subchondral bone edema. Marginal osteophytes of the femoropatellar joint are visible.
Small osteochondral lesion of the posterior part of the lateral femoral condyle.
Multiple degenerative subchondral cystic changes of the articular bodies of the FP joint and the medial tibial plateau, the largest posteriorly measuring 8 x 12 mm.
The anterior cruciate ligament is mucoid degenerated.
The posterior cruciate ligament is thickened with visible intrasubstance increased signal intensity – focal mucoid degeneration.
Small ganglion cyst immediately adjacent to the tibial insertion of the posterior cruciate ligament, measuring approximately 5 mm in diameter.
Grade I lesion of the MCL, primarily secondary to degenerative changes.
Follow-up of the condition after complex tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus on a degenerative basis with meniscal extrusion. Adjacent to the medial tibial plateau, a round lesion measuring up to 6 mm in diameter with meniscal signal intensity is seen – flap of the torn meniscus?
Distension of the posterior segment of the joint capsule medially.
Adjacent to the anterior root of the lateral meniscus, a loose body with low signal intensity measuring 7 x 4 mm is seen – calcification?
Baker's cyst measuring approximately 21 x 20 mm axially. Moderate joint effusion.
Some fluid adjacent to the femoral insertion of the sartorius tendon (tenosynovitis).
Subcutaneous edema infrapatellarly and edema of Hoffa's fat pad.
Small subchondral cyst of the fibular head measuring 6 mm in diameter.
The other demonstrated osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

translation:

report:
FINDINGS:

There is a moderate knee joint effusion with no popliteal cysts.

There is a complex multidirectional tear involving the lateral meniscus. Specifically there is a longitudinal horizontal tear extending from the posterior horn to the anterior horn. There is also an intersecting partial radial tear at the junction of the posterior horn and body. There is no displaced meniscal fragment or para meniscal cyst. The medial meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise the ACL, the PCL, the extensor mechanism, the MCL, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Complex multidirectional tear involving the lateral meniscus as detailed above.
2. Moderate knee joint effusion with no popliteal cysts.

3. Increased amount of fluid in the knee joint with presence of a Baker's cyst.

report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ön çapraz bağ tam kat-tam kata yakın yırtık. Arka çapraz bağ ve yan bağlar korunmuş. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzundaki dejenerasyona yırtık eşlik etmiyor. Lateral menisküs gövdesindeki vertikal oblik yırtık üst eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkileniyor. Patellofemoral eklem dejenerasyonu hafif derecede ve troklear oluğun medyalindeki ve lateral patellar fsetteki yüzeyel kondral düzensizlikler ile karekterize. Medyal ve lateral femoral tibyal eklem dejenerasyonu femoral kondillerin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki yüzeyel kondral düzensizlikler fokal tam kat kıkırdak kaybı ile birlikte. Semimembranozus tendonu insersiyon düzeyinde tendon içerisinde ve çevresinde 2,4 cm maksimum boyutlu gangliyon kistleri mevcut. Troklea displastik (Dejour tip A) ve patella laterale 5 mm translasyon gösteriyor. Patellanın yüksekliği normal. Ekstensör mekanizma bunların dışında korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.
translation: Mild increase in intra-articular fluid. Full-thickness to near full-thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament and collateral ligaments are intact. Degeneration in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus is not accompanied by a tear. Vertical oblique tear in the body of the lateral meniscus communicates with the superior articular surface. Patellofemoral joint degeneration is mild and characterized by superficial chondral irregularities in the medial trochlear groove and the lateral patellar facet. Medial and lateral femorotibial joint degeneration with superficial chondral irregularities on the weight-bearing surfaces of the femoral condyles along with focal full-thickness cartilage loss. Ganglion cysts measuring up to 2.4 cm in maximum dimension are present within and around the semimembranosus tendon at its insertion level. The trochlea is dysplastic (Dejour type A) and the patella shows 5 mm lateral translation. Patellar height is normal. The extensor mechanism is otherwise intact. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal.

Left knee pain. Obs. Meniscopathy. Pes anserine bursitis.

report:

Sospecha esguince de rodilla.

Foco de edema óseo del aspecto posterior del platillo tibial medial.
Signos de rotura completa del tercio proximal / medio del LCA. Se acompaña de traslación tibial
anterior de aproximadamente 9 mm.
Ligamentos cruzado posterior y colaterales continuos. Engrosamiento con alteración de señal del
tercio proximal del componente superficial del ligamento colateral medial.
Rotura del menisco medial de rasgo vertical en la periferia del cuerno posterior, en la interfase
meniscocapsular, asociado otro rasgo vertical oblicuo a nivel de la unión de cuerpo - cuerno
posterior.
Rotura vertical periférica en la inserción del ligamento menisco femoral posterior en cuerno
posterior del menisco lateral.
Cartílago femorotibial y patelofemoral de grosor y señal normal, sin defectos condrales profundos.
Tendones regionales de grosor y señal normal.
Moderado / acentuado derrame articular. No se observa quiste poplíteo.
Planos musculares de trofismo y señal conservados. Edema de los planos intermusculares.
Impresión:
Rotura completa del LCA. Foco de edema óseo en el aspecto posterior del platillo tibial medial.
Rotura vertical periférica en la interfase meniscocapsular del cuerno posterior del menisco medial
con componente vertical oblicuo en cuerpo-cuerno posterior.
Rotura vertical periférica en cuerno posterior del menisco lateral en sitio inserción del ligamento
menisco femoral posterior.
Moderado / acentuado derrame articular.
translation:
Clinical History:
Suspected knee sprain.
Findings:
Focus of bone edema in the posterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau.
Signs of complete tear of the proximal/middle third of the ACL. Associated with anterior tibial translation of approximately 9 mm.
Posterior cruciate ligament and collateral ligaments are intact. Thickening with signal alteration of the proximal third of the superficial component of the medial collateral ligament.
Vertical tear of the medial meniscus at the periphery of the posterior horn, at the meniscocapsular interface, associated with another oblique vertical tear at the body–posterior horn junction.
Peripheral vertical tear at the insertion of the posterior meniscofemoral ligament in the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
Femorotibial and patellofemoral cartilage of normal thickness and signal, without deep chondral defects.
Regional tendons of normal thickness and signal.
Moderate/marked joint effusion. No popliteal cyst is observed.
Muscle planes with preserved trophism and signal. Edema of the intermuscular planes.
Impression:
Complete ACL tear. Focus of bone edema in the posterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau.
Peripheral vertical tear at the meniscocapsular interface of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus with an oblique vertical component at the body–posterior horn junction.
Peripheral vertical tear in the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus at the insertion site of the posterior meniscofemoral ligament.
Moderate/marked joint effusion.

Alignement articulaire normal.

Le signal osseux est normal.

Signe de coincement du paquet graisseux supra-patellaire.

Il n'y a pas d'autre anomalie.

Signs of impingement of the suprapatellar fat pad.

No other abnormality.

translation: The amount of intra-articular fluid in the knee joint is normal. The cruciate and collateral ligaments are normal. The medial and lateral menisci are normal. Degenerative signal intensity changes are observed in the medial facet of the trochlear groove, with cartilage loss involving less than 50% of the cartilage thickness. Bones and cartilaginous structures are otherwise normal. The extensor mechanism is intact. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal.

report:
Prikazane koštane strukture primjerene su morfologije. Povišeni su intenziteti signala u području
medijalnog kondila femura, medijalnog platoa tibije te dijela tibije u području interkondilarnih
eminencija u smislu koštanog edema. Prikazana zglobna tijela primjereno su uzglobljena.
Potpuni gubitak hrskavice u području medijalnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba
(hondromalacija IV°), a u lateralnom dijelu su vidljivi izmijenjeni intenziteti signala te redukcija
debljine u smislu hondromalacije III°. Formirani veći rubni osteofiti FT zgloba - uznapredovale OA promjene. Hondormalacija patele II° uz formirane rubne osterofite zglobnih tijela - OA promjene.
Prednji križni ligament je održanog kontinuiteta, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala u smislu
mukoidne degeneracije. Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog
kontinuiteta. Ganglion ciste uz dorzalne dijelove oba križna ligamenta.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova rupture, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala u smislu degenerativnih
promjena.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga i tijela medijalnog meniska s ekstruzijom cijelog meniska.
Lateralni kolateralni ligamenti je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Medijalni kolateralni ligament je održanog kontinuiteta, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala te
distendiran.
Uredan prikaz tetive popliteusa, iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa i patelarni ligament su izmijenjenih intenziteta signala u području insercije na
pateli u smislu degenerativnih promjena, održanog kontinuiteta.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.Manja količina izljeva u suprapateralnoj burzi te u dorzalnom dijelu
koljenskog zgloba. Bakerova cista CC promjera do 32 mm.
translation:
The visualized bony structures are of normal morphology. Increased signal intensity is present in the region of the medial femoral condyle, the medial tibial plateau, and the portion of the tibia in the region of the intercondylar eminences, consistent with bone marrow edema. The visualized articular bodies are normally congruent.
Complete loss of cartilage in the medial compartment of the femorotibial joint (chondromalacia grade IV), while in the lateral compartment altered signal intensity and reduced thickness are seen, consistent with chondromalacia grade III. Large marginal osteophytes of the femorotibial joint have formed – advanced OA changes. Chondromalacia of the patella grade II with formed marginal osteophytes of the articular bodies – OA changes.
The anterior cruciate ligament is intact in continuity, with altered signal intensity consistent with mucoid degeneration. The posterior cruciate ligament is of normal signal intensity and intact in continuity. Ganglion cysts adjacent to the dorsal portions of both cruciate ligaments.
The lateral meniscus shows no signs of tear, with altered signal intensity consistent with degenerative changes.
Complex tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with extrusion of the entire meniscus.
The lateral collateral ligament is of normal signal intensity, intact in continuity.
The medial collateral ligament is intact in continuity, with altered signal intensity and distended.
Normal appearance of the popliteus tendon, iliotibial tract, and pes anserinus.
The quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament show altered signal intensity at the region of insertion on the patella, consistent with degenerative changes, intact in continuity.
The patellar retinacula are intact. A small amount of effusion in the suprapatellar bursa and in the dorsal portion of the knee joint. Baker's cyst with a craniocaudal diameter of up to 32 mm.

Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial, correlacionar con clínica
translation:
Clinical History:
Rule out meniscal injury. Effusion.
Findings:
No significant bone marrow alterations.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments without alterations.
Incomplete radial tear of the posterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus, without categorical displacement of segments.
The medial meniscus is of preserved morphology and signal, without signs of tear.
Cartilage of the femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments without alterations.
Mild joint effusion with mild synovitis. No pathological popliteal cysts.
Mild increased signal of the proximal aspect of the patellar tendon, without signs of tear. Mild edema of the suprapatellar retroquadriceps fat pad. Quadriceps tendon, pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Mild edema of the soft tissues between the iliotibial band and the lateral femoral condyle.
Impression:
Incomplete radial tear of the lateral meniscus, without displacement of segments.
Mild joint effusion with mild synovitis.
Mild proximal patellar tendinosis. Mild signs of lateral patellar hyperpressure syndrome.
Probable iliotibial band friction phenomena, correlate clinically.

report:

translation:
Clinical History:
Right anterior knee pain.
Findings:
No significant bone marrow signal abnormalities.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
Increased central signal of the posterior horn and part of the body of the medial meniscus that does not appear to contact the articular surface, without features of a tear. The lateral meniscus is of preserved morphology and signal, without signs of tear.
Cartilage of the femorotibial compartments with diffuse superficial chondropathy.
Trochlear cartilage without alterations. Full-thickness chondral ulcers with secondary bone changes at the lateral facet and apex of the patella.
Mild increased signal of the superolateral aspect of Hoffa's fat pad.
Minimal joint effusion. No pathological popliteal cysts.
Pes anserinus tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Mild increased signal of the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon and the proximal insertion of the patellar tendon, without signs of tear.
Impression:
Chondropathy with grade 4 lesions of the patella. Superficial chondropathy of the weight-bearing zone of the femorotibial compartments.
Discrete signs of lateral patellar hyperpressure syndrome.
Minimal joint effusion.
Mild proximal patellar and distal quadriceps tendinosis.

report:
Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala lateralnog
kolateralnog ligmanta, prednjeg i stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog
ligamenta. Diskretno je povišen intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive m. kvadricepsa što dif. dg.
odgovara početnim entezopatskim promjenama.
Lezija I. stupnja MCL prvenstveno u sklopu degenerativnih promjena.
Sitna cistična degenerativna promjena na mjestu insercije prednjeg križnog ligamenta za tibiju.
Medijalni i lateralni menisk uredne su morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Patela je medioponirana (Wiberg 2). Reducirana je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice
femoropatelarnog zgloba uz vidljivu fissuru lateralne trohleje femura (hondromalacija II./III.
stupnja).
Heterogen je intenzitet signala lateralne fasete patele (hondromalacija II. stupnja).
Reducirana je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice femorotibijalnog zgloba, naglašenije medijalnog
kompartmenta gdje je vidljiva hondromalacija II. stupnja medijalnog platoa tibije i kondila
femura.
Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
Supkutani edem prepatelarno i opsežnije infrapatelarno.
Cistična lezija posteromedijalnog dijela proksimalne metafize tibije aksijalno dimenzija oko 6 x 3
mm.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.
translation:
On the series of MR images of the right knee, normal morphology and signal intensity are noted of the lateral collateral ligament, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments, the iliotibial tract, and the patellar ligament. There is discretely increased signal intensity at the insertion of the quadriceps tendon, which in the differential diagnosis corresponds to early enthesopathic changes.
Grade I lesion of the MCL, primarily in the context of degenerative changes.
Small cystic degenerative change at the tibial insertion of the anterior cruciate ligament.
The medial and lateral menisci are of normal morphology and signal intensity.
The patella is medially positioned (Wiberg type 2). There is reduced thickness of the articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint with a visible fissure of the lateral femoral trochlea (chondromalacia grade II/III).
Heterogeneous signal intensity of the lateral patellar facet (chondromalacia grade II).
There is reduced thickness of the articular cartilage of the femorotibial joint, more pronounced in the medial compartment where chondromalacia grade II is visible of the medial tibial plateau and femoral condyle.
No popliteal (Baker's) cyst is found.
Subcutaneous edema prepatellarly and more extensively infrapatellarly.
Cystic lesion of the posteromedial part of the proximal tibial metaphysis, axially measuring approximately 6 x 3 mm.
Other visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

report: Kuadriseps yağ yastıkçığındaki hafif dereceli ödem ön diz ağrısı ile birliktelik gösterebilir. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı normal. Medyal ve lateral menisküs normal. Patella medyal fasetindeki kondral fissür ve fokal olarak %50'ye ulaşan kondral incelmeye subkortikal medüller fibrovasküler değişiklikler eşlik ediyor. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.
translation: Mild edema in the quadriceps fat pad may be associated with anterior knee pain. The amount of intra-articular fluid in the knee joint is normal. The medial and lateral menisci are normal. Chondral fissure and focal chondral thinning reaching up to 50% on the medial facet of the patella are accompanied by subcortical medullary fibrovascular changes. Bones and cartilage structures are otherwise normal. Mucoid degeneration in the anterior cruciate ligament is mild. The cruciate and collateral ligaments are otherwise normal. The extensor mechanism is intact. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal.

report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normal  izlendi.  Medial menisküste grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Ön ve arka çapraz bağ  lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.
translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: The lateral meniscus appears normal. Grade II degeneration is observed in the medial meniscus. The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. No joint effusion is detected. The signal intensities of the bony structures forming the knee joint are normal.

report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs  normaldir. Medial menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade II dejenerasyon izlenmiştir.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir. Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursada hafif sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Sonuç: Medial menisküste grade II meniksopati, anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon.
translation: LEFT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: The lateral meniscus is normal. Grade II degeneration is observed in the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus. The posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. Signal change secondary to myxoid degeneration is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Mild fluid increase is observed in the suprapatellar bursa. Signal intensities of the bony structures forming the knee joint are normal. Conclusion: Grade II meniscopathy in the medial meniscus, myxoid degeneration in the anterior cruciate ligament.

report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı normal. Ön çapraz bağdaki mukoid dejenerasyon femoral ve tibyal yapışma yerleri komşuluğundaki intraoseöz milimetrik boyuttaki kistik uzanımlarla birlikte. Arka çapraz ve dış yan bağ normal. Lateral menisküs arka boynuz-gövdesi bileşkesindeki dejeneratif yapı içi intensite artışına yırtık eşlik etmiyor. Medyal menisküs arka kök-boynuzundan gövdesine kadar uzanan yaygın dejenerasyon üst ve alt eklem yüzeylerindeki düzensizlik ve üst eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkilenen vertikal oblik yırtıkla birlikte (kompleks yırtığı ile uyumlu). Medyal menisküs medyale 7 mm ekstrüde olup iç yan bağı basılıyor. İç yan bağın çevresi, meniskofemoral ve meniskotibyal bağlar ödemli. Troklear sulkus hipoplazik olup sulkus açısı 154 derece. Patella laterale 4 mm translasyon gösteriyor. Patellanın yüksekliği normal. Hoffanın yağ yastıkçığı ödemli. Ekstansör mekanizma bunun dışında korunmuş. Dizin anteriorunda, derin cilt altı bağ dokusu ödemli. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler bunların dışında normal. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.
translation: Intra-articular fluid volume is normal. Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament with millimeter-sized intraosseous cystic extensions adjacent to the femoral and tibial attachment sites. The posterior cruciate and lateral collateral ligaments are normal. Degenerative intrasubstance signal increase at the posterior horn–body junction of the lateral meniscus is not accompanied by a tear. Diffuse degeneration extending from the posterior root–horn to the body of the medial meniscus, with irregularity of the superior and inferior articular surfaces and a vertical oblique tear communicating with the superior articular surface (consistent with a complex tear). The medial meniscus is extruded medially by 7 mm, compressing the medial collateral ligament. The periphery of the medial collateral ligament, the meniscofemoral and meniscotibial ligaments are edematous. The trochlear sulcus is hypoplastic with a sulcus angle of 154 degrees. The patella shows 4 mm lateral translation. Patellar height is normal. Hoffa's fat pad is edematous. The extensor mechanism is otherwise preserved. In the anterior aspect of the knee, the deep subcutaneous connective tissue is edematous. The articular cartilages and bones are otherwise normal. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Anterior right knee pain. 
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.  

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES: 
Bone marrow edema identified in the patella which appears related to full-thickness chondrosis. There are tricompartment marginal osteophytes. 
Alignment is anatomic.  No aggressive osseous lesions.  

JOINT SPACE: 
Intra-articular body deep to the posterior root of the medial meniscus. Small joint effusion. No Baker's cyst. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Extensive complex tear of the meniscus with partial tearing of the posterior root, maceration of the posterior horn, and undersurface tearing body. 
Medial compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss posterior weightbearing portion of the femoral condyle. Button osteophyte/articular spur of the femoral condyle. 

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Diffuse intrasubstance degeneration with no tear. 
Lateral compartment cartilage: Small areas of full-thickness cartilage loss on both sides of the joint. Button osteophyte/articular spur of the femoral condyle. 

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: 
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Denudation of cartilage of the lateral patellar facet and median ridge. Full thickness cartilage loss of the lateral trochlea. Heterogeneity of the medial patellar facet and medial trochlea cartilage. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.  
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.  

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal. 
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.  
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal. 

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.  
Patellofemoral tracking: Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 23 mm. Mild edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. 
No lateral patellar tilt or translation.  No patella alta.  Normal patellar and trochlear morphology.  

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy.  Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact. 

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. 

IMPRESSION:
1.	Tricompartment osteoarthritis including marginal osteophytes, chondrosis and bone marrow edema in the patella.
2.	Extensive complex medial meniscus tear with full-thickness cartilage loss in the medial tibiofemoral compartment.
3.	Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG).

report: МР находка: Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма и сигнална характеристика. Няма данни за ставен излив. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и тибията е съхранен. МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Визуализира се хиперинтензна линия с радиерен ход в менискуса, която достига ставната повърхност на тибията. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. Нормално изобразяване на колатералните лигаменти. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Виждат се лекостепенни едематозни изменения в мастната подложна на Hoffa непосредствено под пателата от латералната ѝ страна. Сухожилието на пателата се представя с повишен интензитет на сигнала в близост до залавното му място към пателата. Нормално изобразяване на скенираните мускулни групи. Заключение: МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3. translation: MRI findings: The bones forming the knee joint are of normal shape and signal characteristics. No evidence of joint effusion. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia is preserved. MRI evidence of a lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. A hyperintense line with radial course is visualized within the meniscus, reaching the articular surface of the tibia. Normal appearance of the lateral meniscus. The cruciate ligaments are intact. Normal appearance of the collateral ligaments. Patella, patellar cartilage, retinacula – unremarkable. Mild edematous changes are seen in Hoffa's fat pad immediately inferior to the patella on its lateral side. The patellar tendon shows increased signal intensity near its insertion to the patella. Normal appearance of the scanned muscle groups. Conclusion: MRI evidence of a lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 3. Mild edematous changes in Hoffa's fat pad in the setting of increased signal intensity in the patellar tendon, as seen in patellar tendinitis – so-called "Jumper's knee".

report: МР находка: Костите формиращи лявата колянна става се изобразяват с правилна форма, структура и нехомогенен сигнален интензитет. Установява се костно-мозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на фемура. В съшата зона е налице дефект в покриващият хрущял. Хрущяла покриващ oстаналите ставни повърхности и пателата е с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Дискретни начални дегенеративни промени в медиалния мениск. Хомогенно анинтенсен латерален мениск.  Двата кръстни лигамента се проследяват до залавните си места с правилна форма и сингален интензитет. Двата колатерални лигамента са с правилна форма, хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет до залавните им места. Ретинакулуми- без патологични промени. Малък ставен излив. Мастната тъкан на Хофа е с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Пателата се представя Wiberg III. Insall-Salvati- 1. Заключение:  МР данни за остеохондрален дефект на медиалния кондил на фемура- grade II.

Homogeneously hypointense lateral meniscus. Both cruciate ligaments are traced to their attachment sites with normal shape and signal intensity. Both collateral ligaments are of normal shape, homogeneous structure, and signal intensity to their attachment sites. Retinacula – no pathological changes. Small joint effusion. Hoffa's fat pad is of homogeneous structure and signal intensity. The patella is Wiberg type III. Insall-Salvati ratio: 1. Conclusion: MRI findings of osteochondral defect of the medial femoral condyle – grade II.
