translation:
TECHNIQUE: The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

FINDINGS
- On evaluation of the medial compartment, small marginal osteophytes are observed, significant thinning and erosions of the articular cartilage of the femoral and tibial condyle (ICRS Grade III-IV), as well as subchondral sclerosis and bone marrow edema of the medial femoral and tibial condyle. The medial meniscus shows extrusion and abnormal signal.
- On evaluation of the lateral compartment, no significant pathological findings are observed, apart from small marginal osteophytes.
- On evaluation of the anterior (patellofemoral) compartment, a small fissural erosion of the articular cartilage measuring 1.5 mm in width is noted at the lateral pole of the patella.
- The anterior cruciate ligament shows focally increased signal in the context of myxoid degeneration, without tear.
- The posterior cruciate ligament and the lateral collateral ligament appear normal. Small bursitis is observed at the medial collateral ligament (MCL bursa).
- Intra-articularly, a small fluid collection is observed with the presence of cartilaginous loose bodies up to 3 mm in diameter. The intra-articular effusion communicates with a Baker's cyst measuring 7 cm in craniocaudal diameter.

CONCLUSION:
1) Findings indicative of degenerative osteoarthritis of the medial compartment with degenerative tear of the medial meniscus.
2) Myxoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament.
3) Small intra-articular fluid collection with osteochondral loose bodies.

Mildly mucoid degenerated but intact ACL. Intact PCL.

Moderate suprapatellar joint effusion with thickened synovium and synovial proliferations. Mediopatellar plica (Type B according to Sakakibara). Fabella.

report:
МР находка: Дясна колянна става: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи колянната става са със запазена форма. Виждат се остеофитни наслоявания на пателата – супратрохлеарно вляво, като същата е сублуксирана в латерално направление. Ставният хрущял на фемуропателарната става е изтънен с наличие на ерозии на хрущяла на пателата и малки субхондрални костни кисти по задния и ръб с перифокален едем по съседство. Дефект с кос ход, на късо протежение в хрущяла на медиалния кондил на десния фемур в зоната на максимално натоварване, без подлежаща субхондрална костна лезия. Субхондрални костни кисти „геоди“ се изобразяват под интеркондиларните еминенции, които са изострени. Подобни малки кисти се виждат и на нивото на тибиофибуларната става.  Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Визуализират се дегенеративни промени в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Колатерални лигаменти – нормално изобразяване. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Лява колянна става: Състояние след парциална менискектомия и остеохондропластика [DATE]г. 
МР данни за начални дегенеративни промени в лявата колянна става. Визуализират се малки остеофити по ставните краища на фемура и тибията, предимно на медиалните кондили.  Интеркондиларните еминенции са изострени. Наличие на остеохондрален дефект в предната половина на медиалния кондил на фемура с обширен костномозъчен едем, извън зоната на максимално натоварване. Вижда се дефект в подлежащия ставен хрущял на това ниво. В останалите си отдели артикулиращият ставен хрущял на на тибията и фемура е със запазена конгруентност, лекостепенно изтънен.  Предната кръстна връзка е със запазена цялост. Задна кръстна връзка – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус при начални дегенеративни промени в задния му рог. Визуализира се руптура с хоризонтален към кос ход в задния рог на медиалния менискус – степен 2b. Колатерални лигаменти - нормално изобразяване на медиалния колатерален лигамент. Дегенеративни промени в залавните места на латералния колатерален лигамент, който е със запазена цялост.  Пателата е с белези на хондрмалация. Вижда се малък дефект срединно в хрущяла на ставния хрущял в областта на горния полюс в съчетание с едемни субхондрални промени в прилежащата задна стена на пателата. Находката съответства на ходромалация – IV степен по Outerbridge grading system. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на меките тъкани. Заключение: Дясна колянна става: МР данни за трохлеарна дисплазия – тип В по Dejour. Латерална сублуксация на пателата. Начални гонартрозни промени с хондромалация на пателата.

Лява колянна става: МР данни за гонартроза. Остеохондрален дефект в медиален кондил на фемура. Хондромалация на пателата -  IV степен по Outerbridge. Лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус – 2b степен.
translation:
MRI findings: Right knee joint: No MRI evidence of joint effusion. The bones forming the knee joint have preserved shape. Osteophytic deposits are seen on the patella – supratrochlear on the left, with lateral subluxation of the patella. The articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is thinned with erosions of the patellar cartilage and small subchondral bone cysts along its posterior margin with adjacent perifocal edema. An oblique defect of short extent in the cartilage of the medial condyle of the right femur in the zone of maximum loading, without underlying subchondral bone lesion. Subchondral bone cysts (geodes) are seen beneath the intercondylar eminences, which are sharpened. Similar small cysts are also seen at the level of the tibiofibular joint. Normal appearance of the cruciate ligaments. Degenerative changes are visualized in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Normal appearance of the lateral meniscus. Collateral ligaments – normal appearance. Patellar ligament, quadriceps femoris tendon – unremarkable. Popliteal fossa – unremarkable. Left knee joint: Status post partial meniscectomy and osteochondroplasty [DATE]. MRI evidence of early degenerative changes in the left knee joint. Small osteophytes are visualized along the articular margins of the femur and tibia, predominantly on the medial condyles. The intercondylar eminences are sharpened. Presence of an osteochondral defect in the anterior half of the medial femoral condyle with extensive bone marrow edema, outside the zone of maximum loading. A defect is seen in the overlying articular cartilage at this level. In the remaining areas, the articular cartilage of the tibia and femur has preserved congruence, mildly thinned. The anterior cruciate ligament is intact. Posterior cruciate ligament – unremarkable. Normal appearance of the lateral meniscus with early degenerative changes in its posterior horn. A rupture with horizontal to oblique course is visualized in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 2b. Collateral ligaments – normal appearance of the medial collateral ligament. Degenerative changes at the insertions of the lateral collateral ligament, which is intact. The patella shows signs of chondromalacia. A small midline defect is seen in the articular cartilage in the region of the superior pole in combination with edematous subchondral changes in the adjacent posterior surface of the patella. The finding corresponds to chondromalacia – grade IV by Outerbridge grading system. Retinacula – unremarkable. Normal appearance of the soft tissues. Conclusion: Right knee joint: MRI evidence of trochlear dysplasia – type B by Dejour. Lateral subluxation of the patella. Early gonarthrotic changes with chondromalacia of the patella.

Left knee joint: MRI evidence of gonarthrosis. Osteochondral defect in the medial femoral condyle. Chondromalacia of the patella – grade IV by Outerbridge. Lesion in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 2b.

MRI LEFT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

FINDINGS
From the examination of the medial compartment, a degenerative tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus is observed. A small focus of bone bruise is observed in the anterior portion of the tibial epiphysis. In the lateral compartment, no pathological findings are observed. From the examination of the anterior compartment, a full-thickness fissural erosion of the articular cartilage is observed at the midline of the articular surface of the patella, as well as prepatellar edema. A moderate joint effusion is observed intra-articularly in communication with a small Baker's synovial cyst adjacent to the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle. Incidentally, varicose venous dilatations are identified in the subcutaneous tissue of the medial aspect of the knee joint.

translation:
MRI LEFT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat signal suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

FINDINGS
On evaluation of the lateral compartment, no pathological findings are observed.

On evaluation of the medial compartment, findings of degenerative tear of the meniscus, erosion of the articular cartilage ICRS grade III maximum at the medial femoral condyle, and presence of marginal and chondrogenic small osteophytes are observed. The findings are in favor of moderate severity degenerative osteoarthritis.

On evaluation of the extensor mechanism, edema is observed in the suprapatellar fat pad with a transverse diameter of 5 cm. The finding is attributed to impingement of the quadriceps tendon, which appears degenerated, against the anterior femur.

Intra-articular fluid collection is observed.

A Baker's synovial cyst with a craniocaudal diameter of 6 cm is observed in the medial popliteal fossa.

Incidentally, edema and presence of small cysts of overall small extent are identified at the mid-portion of the proximal metadiaphysis of the tibia, of degenerative origin.

report:
MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    [Age] with chronic left knee pain, ultrasound unable to visualize medial collateral ligament. Please note that at the time of the exam the patient insisted that the symptoms were on the right knee not the left and for this reason the right knee was scanned.   .

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact and unremarkable. Patellofemoral ligaments are intact and unremarkable. There is prepatellar edema demonstrated anterior to the patella with some fluid in the prepatellar bursa and pretibial bursa consistent with pretibial bursitis.

The articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is reasonably well-maintained.

The TT-TG distance measures about 1 cm, within normal limits.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is reasonably well-maintained. There is very early degenerative osteophytic spurring seen along the lateral joint margin.

The medial meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is reasonably well-maintained. Mild medial compartment degenerative osteophyte formation is seen particularly at the condylar notch.

The anterior cruciate ligament is intact and unremarkable.

The posterior cruciate ligament is intact and unremarkable.

The medial collateral ligament is intact and appears unremarkable.

The lateral collateral ligament complex including the IT band, fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon and popliteus tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is a small to moderate Baker's cyst demonstrated.

There is no evidence of a significant knee effusion. There is a small parameniscal cyst unassociated with a definite meniscal tear situated near the posterior root attachment of the medial meniscus measuring about 1.1 x 0.4 x 1.3 cm.

Marrow signal is within normal limits.

INTERPRETATION: 

There is no evidence of internal derangement.

There is edema in the pretibial and prepatellar soft tissues consistent with prepatellar bursitis.

There is a Baker's cyst.

There are early degenerative changes seen to the lateral and medial joint compartments.

Right knee pain.

The cruciate and collateral ligaments are within normal limits.

Complex tear of the posterior meniscal root of the medial meniscus with mild meniscal extrusion.

Partial and near-full-thickness chondral ulcers of diffuse distribution in the weight-bearing zone of the femorotibial compartments.
Full-thickness chondral ulcers of diffuse distribution in the patellofemoral joint with secondary bone changes and peripheral bone proliferations.
Moderate joint effusion with diffuse synovitis. Small intra-articular body adjacent to the lateral recess of the knee in the meniscotibial region measuring 5 x 7 mm.
Increased signal with enthesopathic changes at the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon.
The patellar tendon, pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band are within normal limits.

Impression:
Tear of the posterior meniscal root of the medial meniscus with secondary bone changes.
Chondropathy grade 2 and 3 lesions in the weight-bearing zone of the femorotibial compartments.
Diffuse grade 4 chondropathy of the patellofemoral joint.
Moderate joint effusion with diffuse synovitis. Small intra-articular body in the lateral recess.
Tendinosis with distal quadriceps enthesopathic changes.

report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normaldir.Medial menisküs diz ekleminden 5 mm mediale ekstrüdedir. Menisküs posterior horn ve gövde kesimde grade III dejenerasyona serbest kenarda horizontal yırtık izlendi.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir. Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlendi. Medial kollateral ligamande periligamantöz ödem izlendi.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma ekleme komşu femur medial kondilde subkondral fokal kemik iliği ödemi izlendi. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlendi. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlandı.Suprapateller bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlendi.Sonuç: Gonartroz. Medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon ve grade III meniskopati. Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon. Medial kollateral ligamande grade I sprain. Suprapatellar bursit.
translation: RIGHT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: The lateral meniscus is normal. The medial meniscus is extruded 5 mm medially from the knee joint. Grade III degeneration is seen in the posterior horn and body of the meniscus with a horizontal tear at the free edge. The posterior cruciate ligament and lateral collateral ligament are normal. Signal change secondary to myxoid degeneration is seen in the anterior cruciate ligament. Periligamentous edema is seen in the medial collateral ligament. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Joint space narrowing is seen in the medial tibiofemoral joint with subchondral focal bone marrow edema in the medial femoral condyle adjacent to the joint. Cartilage destruction is seen in the femoral and tibial cartilages at this level. The findings are interpreted in favor of degenerative arthritis. Increased fluid is seen in the suprapatellar bursa and knee joint space. Conclusion: Gonarthrosis. Medial extrusion and grade III meniscopathy of the medial meniscus. Myxoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament. Grade I sprain of the medial collateral ligament. Suprapatellar bursitis.

report:
Patella zentriert stehend. Am oberen Patellapol vom First ausgehend bis in die laterale Facette zum Knochen ziehende fissurale T2 Signalanhebung im retropatellaren Knorpel (4/11). Im angrenzenden Knochen kleinzystische Veränderungen (3/39 oder 5/10). Ansonsten unauffälliger Knorpelbelag retropatellar. Auch an der Trochlea regelrechter Knorpelbelag.

Femorotibial medialseitig sowohl femoral- als auch tibialseitig hochgradige Chondropathie mit teils bis Knochenniveau reichenden chondralen Defekten, exemplarisch in der Hauptbelastungszone der Femurkondyle (5/19) mit angrenzendem intraossärem Ödem sowie im medialen Tibiaplateau (5/22 oder 6/9), dort teils mit angedeuteter chondraler Delaminierung. Auch weiter posterior am medialen Femurcondylus tief greifende Chondropathie mit angrenzendem Ödem (7/11 und 5/27). Der Innenmeniskus deutlich extrudiert und in Pars intermedia und Hinterhorn deutlich signalalteriert mit schräger Rissbildung im Hinterhorn am Übergang zur Hinterwurzel (3/89 oder 5/28). Das angrenzende MCL gering verdickt am ehesten bei Reizzustand.
Lateral femorotibial im lateralen Tibiaplateau fissurale bis zum Knochen reichender Knorpeldefekt (5/24 oder 7/25) sowie vorwiegend oberflächliche Chondropathie am lateralen Femurkondylus. Kreuzbänder intakt. Unauffällige Darstellung des LCL. Geringer Gelenkerguss. Baker-Zyste sowie auf dem Musculus gastrocnemicus nach distal ziehende Flüssigkeit (3/112). Geringe Flüssigkeitseinlagerungen in die Subcutis präpatellar. Ansonsten unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Weichteile.
translation:
Patella centered in position. At the upper patellar pole, fissural T2 signal increase in the retropatellar cartilage extending from the ridge into the lateral facet down to bone (4/11). Small cystic changes in the adjacent bone (3/39 or 5/10). Otherwise unremarkable retropatellar cartilage covering. Also regular cartilage covering at the trochlea.

Medial femorotibial compartment: high-grade chondropathy on both the femoral and tibial sides with chondral defects partly reaching down to bone level, exemplarily in the main weight-bearing zone of the femoral condyle (5/19) with adjacent intraosseous edema, and in the medial tibial plateau (5/22 or 6/9), there partly with suggested chondral delamination. Also further posteriorly at the medial femoral condyle, deep-reaching chondropathy with adjacent edema (7/11 and 5/27). The medial meniscus is markedly extruded and shows marked signal alteration in the pars intermedia and posterior horn with oblique tear formation in the posterior horn at the transition to the posterior root (3/89 or 5/28). The adjacent MCL is slightly thickened, most likely due to an irritative state.
Lateral femorotibial compartment: fissural cartilage defect reaching down to bone in the lateral tibial plateau (5/24 or 7/25), as well as predominantly superficial chondropathy at the lateral femoral condyle. Cruciate ligaments intact. Unremarkable appearance of the LCL. Small joint effusion. Baker's cyst and fluid extending distally over the gastrocnemius muscle (3/112). Small fluid deposits in the prepatellar subcutaneous tissue. Otherwise unremarkable appearance of the surrounding soft tissues.

report: МР находка: Наличие на малък ставен излив. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става, са с нормален сигнален интензитет. Виждат се малки остеофити по ставните краища на феумра и тибията. Изострени са интеркондиларните еминенции. Хрущялът на фемура, тибията и пателата е интактен. МР данни за лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Задният рог на медиалния менискус е с повишен интензитет на сигнала. В него се вижда хиперинтензна линия с радиерен ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Скъсването достига до края на менискуса и до хрущяла на тибията. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Кръстните връзки са интактни. Колатерални лигаменти - без особености. Сухожилие на m.quadriceps femoris - нормално изобразяване. МР данни за инсерционит на пателарния лигамент. В лигамента на залавното му към пателата място се изобразява зона на повишен интензитат на сигнала. Едемни промени в меките тъкани около инсерцията на лигамента.  Наличие на Бекерова киста с типична локализация и големина 53/25 мм. Заключение: МР данни за дегенеративна промяна и скъсване в задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3. Инсерционит на лигамента на пателата. Бекерова киста. Малък ставен излив.
translation: MRI findings: Small joint effusion is present. The bones forming the right knee joint show normal signal intensity. MRI findings of a lesion in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. The posterior horn of the medial meniscus shows increased signal intensity. A Baker's cyst is present with typical location and size 53/25 mm. Conclusion: MRI findings of degenerative change and tear in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 3. Insertionitis of the patellar ligament. Baker's cyst. Small joint effusion.

translation:
Clinical History:
Obs. Medial meniscal bucket-handle tear. [DATE].
Findings:
No diffuse bone marrow signal abnormality.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments are intact.
Signs of a vertical oblique tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus persist, which currently appears to contact both articular surfaces and is associated with another complex tear of the body of this meniscus with discrete meniscal extrusion, without displacement of segments, with edema of the parameniscal soft tissues.
Lateral meniscus with preserved morphology and signal, no criteria for tear.
Cartilage of the femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments with preserved thickness and signal, no deep chondral defects.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, biceps femoris tendon, pes anserinus tendons, and iliotibial band with preserved thickness and signal.
Discrete lateral paracondylar edema underlying the iliotibial band.
No joint effusion. No Baker's cyst is observed.
Muscular planes with preserved trophism and signal.
Impression:
Signs of a vertical oblique tear of the posterior horn and a complex tear of the body of the medial meniscus, with discrete meniscal extrusion without displacement of segments and edema of the parameniscal soft tissues.

report:

МР данни за начали дегенеративни изменения задния рог на медиалния менискус. Същият се представя с лекостепенно повишен сигнален интензитет. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на медиалния менискус и на латералния менискус. Кръстните връзки са интактни. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Мускулни групи, меки тъкани – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за начални дегенеративни промени в задния рог на медиалния менискус.
translation:
MRI findings: No MRI evidence of joint effusion. The bones forming the right knee joint are of normal shape and signal characteristics. The articular cartilage of the tibia and femur is with preserved thickness and congruence. Patella, patellar cartilage, patellar retinacula – unremarkable.
MRI evidence of early degenerative changes of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. It presents with mildly increased signal intensity. Normal appearance of the anterior horn of the medial meniscus and of the lateral meniscus. The cruciate ligaments are intact. Collateral ligaments – unremarkable. Patellar ligament and quadriceps femoris tendon – unremarkable. Popliteal fossa – unremarkable. Muscle groups, soft tissues – unremarkable. Conclusion: MRI evidence of early degenerative changes in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.

report: МР находка: МР данни за лезия в медиалния фемурален кондил. Не се визуализира промяна на формата на костта. Изобразява се малка субхондрална лезия с размери 5/4мм разположена в зоната на максимално натоварване. Около нея се визуализира изразен контузионен костномозъчен едем в медиалния фемурален кондил. Малка зона на субкортикален едем е налице и латерално в епифизата на тибията, субкортикално, без промяна в прилежащия хрущял. Не се визуализират други промени в костите, формиращи лявата колянна става. Нормално изобразяване на арнтикулиращия ставен хрущял, който е със запазена конгруентност. МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 2c. Задният рог на медиалния менискус е с повишен интензитет на сигнала. В него се изобразява задебелена хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход, която достига в близост до края на менискуса. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на медиалния менискус и на предния и задния рог на латералния менискус. Кръстни връзки – интактни. Колатерални лигаменти, патела и ретинакулуми на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Нормално изобразяване на сухожилието на мускулус квадрицепс феморис и на лигамента на пателата. Поплитеална ямка - б.о. Наличие на малък ставен излив. Заключение: МР находката субхондрално в медиалния фемурален кондил съответства в най-голяма степен на начален дисециращ остеохондрит. translation: MRI findings: MRI data for a lesion in the medial femoral condyle. No change in bone shape is visualized. A small subchondral lesion measuring 5/4 mm is depicted, located in the zone of maximum loading. Pronounced contusion-type bone marrow edema is visualized around it in the medial femoral condyle. A small zone of subcortical edema is also present laterally in the tibial epiphysis, subcortically, without change in the adjacent cartilage. No other changes are visualized in the bones forming the left knee joint. Normal depiction of the articular cartilage, which has preserved congruence. MRI data for a lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 2c. The posterior horn of the medial meniscus shows increased signal intensity. A thickened hyperintense line with horizontal course is depicted within it, reaching close to the edge of the meniscus. Normal depiction of the anterior horn of the medial meniscus and of the anterior and posterior horns of the lateral meniscus. Cruciate ligaments – intact. Collateral ligaments, patella and patellar retinacula – normal depiction. Normal depiction of the quadriceps femoris tendon and the patellar ligament. Popliteal fossa – unremarkable. Presence of a small joint effusion. Conclusion: The MRI finding subchondrally in the medial femoral condyle most likely corresponds to early osteochondritis dissecans. Post-traumatic bone marrow edema in the medial femoral condyle. Minimal joint effusion. Lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 2c.

> Fluid accumulation in the suprapatellar bursa and femorotibial joint cavity

report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular:Lateral menisküs ve medial menisküs normaldir. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Ön çapraz bağda diffüz hafif sinyal artışı izlenmiştir (minimal mukoid dejenerasyon?).Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Prepatellar bursada hafif ödem ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Cilt altı yağlı dokuda variköz venöz oluşumlar görülmüştür. Popliteal bölgede 1 cm çaplı Baker izlenmiştir. SONUÇ: Prepatellar bursit, cilt altı variköz venöz oluşumlar, ACL'de mukoid dejenerasyon.
translation: RIGHT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: The lateral meniscus and medial meniscus are normal. The posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. Diffuse mild signal increase is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament (minimal mucoid degeneration?). The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Signal change consistent with mild edema is observed in the prepatellar bursa. The signal intensities of the bony structures forming the knee joint are normal. Varicose venous formations are seen in the subcutaneous fatty tissue. A Baker's cyst measuring 1 cm in diameter is observed in the popliteal region. CONCLUSION: Prepatellar bursitis, subcutaneous varicose venous formations, mucoid degeneration of the ACL.

report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif artmış. İç yan bağı çevreleyen ödem zorlanma (düşük dereceli zedelenme) ile uyumlu. Posteromedyal kapsüler-parakapsüler ödem hafif derecede. Çapraz ve dış yan bağlar normal. Posterolateral köşe yapıları korunmuş. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Medyale 3 mm ekstrude medyal menisküsün arka boynuzundaki kompleks dejeneratif yırtık süperiyor ve inferiyor eklem yüzeylerine ulaşıyor. Lateral menisküsteki horizontal yapı içi klivaj serbest kenara ulaşmıyor. Tibyal platonun anteromedyalinde subkondral medüller fibrovasküler değişiklikler kıkırdak dejenerasyonu ile birlikte. Eklem kıkırdakları ve diğer kesimlerde kemikler normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal).
translation: Mild increase in intra-articular fluid. Edema surrounding the medial collateral ligament is consistent with a sprain (low-grade injury). Mild posteromedial capsular-paracapsular edema. Cruciate and lateral collateral ligaments are normal. Posterolateral corner structures are intact. Cruciate and collateral ligaments are normal. Complex degenerative tear in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus with 3 mm medial extrusion, extending to the superior and inferior articular surfaces. Horizontal intrasubstance cleavage in the lateral meniscus does not reach the free edge. Subchondral medullary fibrovascular changes in the anteromedial tibial plateau associated with cartilage degeneration. Articular cartilage and bones in other regions are normal. Extensor mechanism is intact (quadriceps tendon and patellar tendon, patella and its position, femoral trochlear groove and patellofemoral ligaments are normal).

Moderate joint effusion. No Baker's cyst

Complete rupture of the ACL with large kissing bone contusions in the lateral femoral condyle and posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau.

Additional large bone bruise in the posterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau and small bone bruise in the medial femoral condyle.

MCL sprain.

No meniscal tear.

report: МР находка: Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става, са с нормална форма и структура. МР данни за костномозъчен едем в областта на латералното тибиално плато. При Т1 серии на скениране се набелязва хипоинтензна линия, успоредна на латералното тибиално плато, която е суспектна за остеохондрална лезия. В ставния хрущял на тибията от латералната страна се визуализира малък дефект под формата на  хиперинтензна зона при Т2 изобразяване с прекъсване на хрущяла. Нормално изобразяване на артикулиращия хрущял на фибулата, пателата и латералната част на тибията. Наличие на малко количество свободна течност в ретропателарното пространство, както и около кръстните връзки. Нормален МР образ на предната и задната кръстна връзка. МР данни за лезия с радиерен ход в задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 2b. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на медиалния менискус, както и на латералния менискус. Колатерални лигаменти - б.о. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. МР данни за минимален мекотъканен оток в областта на пателата. Заключение: МР находката може да съответства на субхондрална инсуфициентна фрактура (SIF) с прилежащ дефект в артикулиращия хрущял. Лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 2b. Наличие на малък вътреставен излив.
translation: MRI findings: The bones forming the left knee joint are of normal shape and structure. MRI evidence of bone marrow edema in the region of the lateral tibial plateau. On T1-weighted sequences, a hypointense line is noted, parallel to the lateral tibial plateau, which is suspicious for an osteochondral lesion. In the articular cartilage of the tibia on the lateral side, a small defect is visualized in the form of a hyperintense zone on T2-weighted imaging with disruption of the cartilage. Normal appearance of the articular cartilage of the fibula, the patella, and the lateral part of the tibia. Presence of a small amount of free fluid in the retropatellar space, as well as around the cruciate ligaments. Normal MRI appearance of the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments. MRI evidence of a lesion with a radial course in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 2b. Normal appearance of the anterior horn of the medial meniscus, as well as of the lateral meniscus. Collateral ligaments – unremarkable. Retinacula – unremarkable. Patella, cartilage of the patella – unremarkable. MRI evidence of minimal soft tissue edema in the region of the patella. Conclusion: The MRI findings may correspond to a subchondral insufficiency fracture (SIF) with an adjacent defect in the articular cartilage. Lesion in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 2b. Presence of a small intra-articular effusion.

translation: [DATE]: MRI Right Knee 15ch AA: Clinical information: persistent pain right knee, meniscal tests positive. Diagnostic question: osteoarthritis? Tear? Findings: Small horizontal degenerative tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus without displaced fragment. Early medial femorotibial cartilage damage, grade 2, with minimally thinned and irregular appearing cartilage. Advanced femoropatellar cartilage damage, with complete loss of cartilage of the lateral facet of the patella, with minimal subchondral changes and fissures at the trochlear notch. Moderate joint effusion. Normal appearance of tendons. Cruciate ligaments and lateral ligaments intact. No bone edema. Conclusion: Early gonarthrosis, currently with moderate joint effusion.

report:
МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив. Изобразява се остеохондрална фрактура в областта на медиалния кондил на бедрената кост. Фрактурата се представя като хипоинтензна линия с дъговидна форма. Налице е костно-мозъчен едем в костта, както и депресия на медиалното плато. В този участък се изобразява и изтъняване на артикулиращия хрущял на кондила на протежение от около 9 мм. Костно-мозъчен едем е налице в медиалното тибиално плато, както и в отграничен участък от латералния кондил на фемура. Ставният хрущял, покриващ тибията и латералния кондил на бедрената кост, е със запазена дебелина и конгруентност.
МР данни за руптура на задния рог на медиалния менискус. В задния рог на медиалния менискус се изобразява хиперинтензна линия с кос ход, достигаща до края на менискуса и до артикулиращата повърхност на тибията. МР данни за дегенеративни промени в задния рог на латералния менискус. В него се вижда къса хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход, не достигаща до ставните повърхности. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на медиалния менискус и на 
предния рог на латералния менискус. Латералният менискус е лекостепенно експулсиран встрани. МР данни за пълна руптура на предната кръстна връзка в залавното ѝ място за фемура. Връзката е с разширен напречник и е с дифузно повишен сигнален интензитет. Задна кръстна връзка – интактна. Двата колатерални лигамента са с правилна форма, хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет до залавните им места. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на m. quadriceps femoris, lig. patellae – нормален образ. Изобразени мускулни групи и останали меки тъкани – нормален образ. Наличие на малка еднокамерна Бекерова киста в поплитеалната ямка с размер 17/12 мм. Заключение: МР данни за остеохондрална фрактура в медиалното плато на бедрената кост. Скъсване в заден рог на медиален менискус - grade 3. Лезия в задния рог на латералния менискус – grade 2a. Пълна руптура на предна кръстна връзка. Ставен излив. Травматичен костно-мозъчен едем. Малка Бекерова киста.
translation:
MRI findings: MRI evidence of joint effusion. An osteochondral fracture is visualized in the region of the medial femoral condyle. The fracture presents as a hypointense arcuate-shaped line. Bone marrow edema is present in the bone, as well as depression of the medial plateau. In this area, thinning of the articular cartilage of the condyle is also visualized over a length of approximately 9 mm. Bone marrow edema is present in the medial tibial plateau, as well as in a circumscribed area of the lateral femoral condyle. The articular cartilage covering the tibia and the lateral femoral condyle is of preserved thickness and congruence.
MRI evidence of rupture of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. In the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, a hyperintense line with an oblique course is visualized, reaching the edge of the meniscus and the articular surface of the tibia. MRI evidence of degenerative changes in the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. A short hyperintense line with a horizontal course is seen within it, not reaching the articular surfaces. Normal appearance of the anterior horn of the medial meniscus and of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus. The lateral meniscus is mildly extruded laterally. MRI evidence of complete rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament at its femoral attachment. The ligament is of increased diameter and shows diffusely increased signal intensity. Posterior cruciate ligament – intact. Both collateral ligaments are of normal shape, homogeneous structure, and signal intensity up to their attachments. Patella, patellar cartilage, retinacula – unremarkable. Quadriceps femoris tendon, patellar ligament – normal appearance. Visualized muscle groups and remaining soft tissues – normal appearance. A small unilocular Baker's cyst is present in the popliteal fossa measuring 17/12 mm.
Conclusion: MRI evidence of osteochondral fracture in the medial femoral plateau. Tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 3. Lesion in the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus – grade 2a. Complete rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament. Joint effusion. Traumatic bone marrow edema. Small Baker's cyst.

translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: Grade II degeneration is observed in the anterior and posterior horns and body of the lateral meniscus. The medial meniscus is extruded 5.5 mm medially from the knee joint space. Volume loss, maceration, and complex tear are observed in the meniscus. The posterior cruciate ligament and lateral collateral ligament are normal. Signal change secondary to myxoid degeneration is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. Grade I sprain is observed in the medial collateral ligament. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Increased fluid is observed in the suprapatellar bursa and knee joint space. Central-marginal osteophyte formation is observed in all three compartments of the knee joint. Joint space narrowing in the medial tibiofemoral joint, mild sclerosis and edema in the subchondral area of the bone surfaces adjacent to the joint are observed. Destruction of the femoral and tibial cartilages is observed at this level. Findings are interpreted in favor of degenerative arthritis. A 2 cm diameter ossified lesion is observed in the posterosuperior vicinity of the supracondylar level of the femur in the popliteal fossa. Increased fluid and ossified nodular lesions, the largest being 1 cm in diameter, are also observed in the vicinity of the popliteus tendon.
CONCLUSION:
Gonarthrosis.
Medial extrusion, maceration, and complex tear of the medial meniscus.
Grade II meniscopathy of the lateral meniscus.
Myxoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament.
Grade I sprain of the medial collateral ligament.
Suprapatellar bursitis, synovitis of the knee joint.
Synovial chondromatosis in the vicinity of the popliteus.
The ossified lesion in the popliteal fossa is interpreted in favor of chondromatosis.

The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat signal suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

A radial tear is observed at the junction of the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus.
On evaluation of the medial meniscus, the cruciate and collateral ligaments, and the articular cartilage, no pathological findings are observed.

Knochen: Ödemsignal führend am posterolateralen Tibiaplateau (4/21), geringer am posteromedialen Tibiaplateau. Gering subchondrales Ödemsignal an der anterolateralen Femurkondyle. Kein Ödemsignal der Patella. Lateral führende Gelenkspaltverschmälerung femorotibial. Zentrierte Stellung der Patella. Kein Tibialer Shift nach ventral. 
Knorpel: Fokal oberflächliche Chondropathie an der medialen patellaren Facette bei geringer Signalanhebung ohne wesentliche Ausdünnung (7/11). Keine wesentliche Chondropathie im medialen und lateralen femorotibialen Kompartiment. 
Menisci: Minimale Signalanhebung ohne Rissbildung im Außenmeniskushinterhorn (5/25), a.e. bei mucoider Degeneration. Gering mucoide Degeneration des Innenmeniskushinterhornes. 
Bänder/Sehnen/Kapsel: 
Ruptur des Vorderen Kreuzbandes transligamentär ca. 1,5 cm distal des femoralen Ansatzes bei interponiertem Flüssigkeitssignal, Faserdiskontinuität und Auftreibung (6/19). Hinteres Kreuzband intakt, unauffällige Signalgebung und Verlauf. 
Intakte Darstellung des medialen Kollateralbandes bei Reizzustand. 
Partialruptur bei Auffaserung des LCL (8/26) und V.a. Partialläsion des M. popliteus am myotendinösen Übergang (7/24), wohl Ausriss des meniscopolitealen Faszikels (5/28) bei intakter meniscokapsulärer Aufhängung sowie Gelenkkapsel. Kein eindeutiger Nachweis einer Läsion des Lig. arcuatum, Fibulaspitze intakt. 
Intakte Darstellung der Quadriceps- und Patellarsehne. Mäßig wohl blutig tingierter Gelenkerguss. Keine synovialen Proliferationen.
Fettkörper: Unauffällig, kein raumfordernder Prozess.
Weichgewebe: Gering subkutane popliteale Flüssigkeitseinlagerungen, keine typische Baker-Zyste.
translation:
Bone: Edema signal predominantly at the posterolateral tibial plateau (4/21), lesser at the posteromedial tibial plateau. Mild subchondral edema signal at the anterolateral femoral condyle. No edema signal of the patella. Laterally predominant femorotibial joint space narrowing. Centered position of the patella. No anterior tibial shift.
Cartilage: Focal superficial chondropathy at the medial patellar facet with mild signal increase without significant thinning (7/11). No significant chondropathy in the medial and lateral femorotibial compartments.
Menisci: Minimal signal increase without tear in the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus (5/25), most likely due to mucoid degeneration. Mild mucoid degeneration of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
Ligaments/Tendons/Capsule:
Rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament, transligamentous approximately 1.5 cm distal to the femoral attachment with interposed fluid signal, fiber discontinuity and swelling (6/19). Posterior cruciate ligament intact, unremarkable signal and course.
Intact appearance of the medial collateral ligament with signs of irritation.
Partial rupture with fraying of the LCL (8/26) and suspicion of partial lesion of the popliteus muscle at the myotendinous junction (7/24), likely avulsion of the meniscopopliteal fascicle (5/28) with intact meniscocapsular attachment and joint capsule. No definite evidence of a lesion of the arcuate ligament, fibular head intact.
Intact appearance of the quadriceps and patellar tendons. Moderate likely hemorrhagic joint effusion. No synovial proliferations.
Fat pad: Unremarkable, no space-occupying process.
Soft tissue: Mild subcutaneous popliteal fluid collections, no typical Baker's cyst.

Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalaze se uznapredovale OA promjene medijalnog
kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba s denudacijom artikulacijskih hrskavica i zonama
subhondralnog edema zglobnih tijela.
Vidi se radijalna ruptura kroz stražnji rog medijalnog meniska uz stražnji korijen, a kroz dio
prednjeg roga, trup i ostatak stražnjeg roga pruža se horizontalna ruptura - opisano vj. na
degenerativnoj podlozi uz ekstruziju meniska.
Povišen je intenzitet signala prednjeg roga i trupa lateralnog meniska u smislu uznapredovalih
degenerativnih promjena, uz moguću parcijalnu vertikalnu rupturu donje plohe trupa.
Distenzija MCL. LCL održan uz entezopatske promjene hvatišta za femur.
Degenerativne promjene ACL blažeg stupnja, uz održan kontinuitet. PCL primjerenog prikaza.
Patela je medioponirana, Wiberg 1, uz reduciranu debljinu artikulacijske hrskavice
femoropatelarnog zgloba i hondromalaciju II. stupnja. Osteofiti kranijalnog i kaudalnog pola
patele.
Hondromalacija II./III. stupnja lateralnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba.
Entezopatske promjene hvatišta m. kvadricepsa.
Parcijalna ruptura mišićno-tetivnog prijelaza m. popliteusa.
Parcijalna ruptura m. semimembranosus na hvatištu za tibiju.
Masna atrofija prikazane natkoljenične muskulature GC 2.
Izljev u koljenu. Bakerova cista, aksijalno dimenzija 23 x 9 mm.
Supkutani edem prepatelarno i infrapatelarno.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala
translation:
On the series of MR images of the right knee, there are advanced OA changes of the medial compartment of the femorotibial joint with denudation of the articular cartilage and zones of subchondral edema of the articular bodies.
A radial tear is seen through the posterior horn of the medial meniscus at the posterior root, and a horizontal tear extends through part of the anterior horn, the body, and the remainder of the posterior horn – described as likely on a degenerative basis with meniscal extrusion.
Increased signal intensity of the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus consistent with advanced degenerative changes, with a possible partial vertical tear of the inferior surface of the body.
Distension of the MCL. The LCL is intact with enthesopathic changes at the femoral attachment.
Mild degenerative changes of the ACL, with maintained continuity. The PCL is of normal appearance.
The patella is medially positioned, Wiberg type 1, with reduced thickness of the articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint and grade II chondromalacia. Osteophytes of the cranial and caudal poles of the patella.
Grade II/III chondromalacia of the lateral compartment of the femorotibial joint.
Enthesopathic changes at the insertion of the quadriceps muscle.
Partial tear of the musculotendinous junction of the popliteus muscle.
Partial tear of the semimembranosus muscle at its tibial insertion.
Fatty atrophy of the visualized thigh musculature, Goutallier grade 2.
Knee joint effusion. Baker's cyst, measuring 23 x 9 mm axially.
Subcutaneous edema in the prepatellar and infrapatellar regions.
The other visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

translation:
Technique: The examination was performed with T1 pulse sequences, proton density with fat signal suppression, and high-resolution T2 gradient echo.

Findings:
- There is narrowing of the joint space in the lateral compartment of the patellofemoral space, with full-thickness loss of articular cartilage, as well as mild bone marrow edema on the opposing surfaces of the patella and the lateral femoral condyle (grade IV).
- In the medial and lateral tibiofemoral compartments, there is narrowing of the joint space and formation of small osteophytes in the context of degenerative osteoarthritis.
- Posterior to the insertion of the posterior cruciate ligament on the tibial plateau, as well as above the medial femoral condyle, there are large osteophytes measuring 1 cm in extent.
- On examination of the remaining extensor mechanism, there is mild degenerative tear-tendinopathy at the insertion of the quadriceps tendon at its medial portion.
- There is myxoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament. No pathological findings are observed on examination of the posterior cruciate ligament, the collateral ligaments, and the menisci.
- A small amount of free fluid is noted intra-articularly.
- The remaining bone marrow is examined with normal signal.

report: МР находка: МР  данни за ставен излив – наличие на течност в ретропателарната бурса. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става са с нормална форма и структура. Ставният хрущял на тибията и фемура е със запазена конгруентност. Дорзално в медиалния кондил на тибията и в по- слаба степен от вътрешната страна на медиалния кондил на фемура се изобразяват зони а костномозъчен едем с повишен сигнален интензитет. МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Същата е задебелена, с кос ход и с хиперинтензитет на сигнала, като достига до артикулиращия хрущял на тибията. Увредата съответства на руптура 3-та степен.  Нормално изобразяване на двата рога на латералния менискус. Кръстни връзки – б.о.  Колатерални лигаменти - б.о. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Малка предходно руптурирала Бекерова киста от медиалната страната на коляното. Нормално изобразяване на скенирните мускулни групи и меки тъкани. Заключение: Наличие на ставен излив. МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3. Предходно руптурирала малка Бекерова киста.

EXAM DATE AND TIME: [DATE] [TIME]
INDICATION: [IDENTIFIER]
COMPARISON: None

Impression:  

1. Fracture involving the posterior and anterior horns of the medial meniscus.

2. Microtrabecular insufficiency fracture involving the weightbearing aspect of the medial femoral condyle and probably the medial tibial plateau, with surrounding marrow edema as well as medial compartment osteoarthritis.

3. Marrow contusions involving the anterior aspect of the medial and lateral tibial plateau.


Technique:  Magnetic Resonance Imaging of the right knee was performed utilizing sagittal T2 weighted and fat suppressed proton density, coronal T1 weighted and fat suppressed proton density, and axial fat suppressed T2 weighted sequences.


Comment:

Menisci: The lateral meniscus is intact. There is a complex fracture involving the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with extrusion of the meniscal body. There is also a horizontal fracture involving the anterior horn of the medial meniscus.

Cruciate ligaments: Intact

Collateral ligaments: Intact

Extensor mechanism: Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Joint fluid/Baker's cyst: There is a small to moderate joint effusion. There is also a moderate complex Baker's cyst which appears partially ruptured.

Bone marrow: A small crescentic focus of signal abnormality is noted in the subchondral weightbearing aspect of the medial femoral condyle, compatible with a microtrabecular insufficiency fracture with surrounding marrow edema. There is slight flattening of the articular surface at the site of the fracture. An additional small microtrabecular insufficiency fracture is suspected in the medial tibial plateau. There is also marrow edema along the anterior aspect of the medial and lateral tibial plateau suggesting marrow contusions.

Femorotibial joints: There is cartilage thinning involving the weightbearing aspect of the medial compartment, with joint space narrowing and osteophyte formation compatible with osteoarthritis. Mild cartilage thinning and heterogeneity are noted in the weightbearing aspect of the lateral compartment.

Patellofemoral joint: There is mild cartilage heterogeneity along the posterior patella.

report:
FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Mild to moderate joint effusion with a small popliteal cyst measuring 1.3 x 1.0 x 4.3 mm. There are no signs of leakage.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
The medial meniscus and the cartilage surfaces are unremarkable.
Mild edema of the meniscocapsular junction without fluid cleft.
High grade, almost complete tear of the superficial and anterior deep fibers of the femoral insertion of the medial collateral ligament with faint possible remaining attachment of the posterior deep fibers and the distal insertion.
There is periligamentous and pericapsular edema.
Medial suprapatellar plica as a variant.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
The lateral meniscus and the lateral cartilage surfaces are unremarkable.
High-grade partial tear of the mid fibers of the lateral collateral ligament without retraction or complete discontinuity, although distal fibers are not clearly seen.
The remaining components of the lateral collateral complex are preserved.
Mild tendinopathy of the popliteus tendon and edema of the myotendinous junction a small synovial cyst.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Complete discontinuity of the proximal fibers of the anterior cruciate ligament with reactive synovitis of the intercondylar notch. Mild associated anterior tibial translation.
The posterior cruciate ligament has a buckled appearance without tear.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
The extensor mechanism is unremarkable.
The patellofemoral cartilage is preserved.
Superficial soft tissue swelling a laminar fluid collection.

Bones:
Posterior lateral bone contusion without fracture line..

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Subcutaneous soft tissue swelling and myotendinous junction tear of the fibers of the distal vastus lateralis.
Neurovascular bundles are unremarkable.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
1.Full-thickness tear of the proximal fibers of the anterior cruciate ligament
2.High-grade / almost complete tear of the superficial and deep components of the medial collateral ligament as detailed above.
3.High grade tear of the lateral collateral ligament.
4.Joint effusion and popliteal cyst.

For further findings, please see the body of the report.

report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküste diz eklem mesafesinden 4 mm mediale ekstrüdedir. Menisküs hacminde azalma, posterior horn ve gövde kesiminde grade III dejenerasyon izlenmiştir. Lateral ve medial kollateral ligamanda grade I sprain izlenmiştir. Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir. Tibia interkondiler eminens posteriorunda posterior çapraz bağ yapışma düzeyinde 1 cm çaplı subkondral kist izlenmiştir .Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Tibiofemoral eklem medialinde, eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu kemik yüzlerde subkondral hafif kemik iliği ödemi izlendi. Femur medial kondilde ise 7x4 mm boyutlu fokal osteokondral defekt izlenmektedir. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda incelme izlenmiştir. SONUÇ: gonartroz, medial menisküste hafif mediale ekstrüzyon ve grade III meniskopati, lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati, anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon, tibia interkondiler eminenste subkondral kist, suprpatellar bursit, diz ekleminde sinovit, medial kollateral ligamanda grade I sprain.
translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: The medial meniscus is extruded 4 mm medially from the knee joint space. Decrease in meniscal volume, grade III degeneration observed in the posterior horn and body. Grade I sprain observed in the lateral and medial collateral ligaments. Signal change secondary to myxoid degeneration observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. A subchondral cyst measuring 1 cm in diameter is observed at the posterior aspect of the tibial intercondylar eminence at the insertion level of the posterior cruciate ligament. Increased fluid observed in the suprapatellar bursa and knee joint space. In the medial tibiofemoral joint, narrowing of the joint space and mild subchondral bone marrow edema on the bone surfaces adjacent to the joint were observed. A focal osteochondral defect measuring 7x4 mm is observed in the medial femoral condyle. Thinning of the femoral and tibial cartilages is observed at this level.
CONCLUSION: Gonarthrosis, mild medial extrusion and grade III meniscopathy of the medial meniscus, grade II meniscopathy of the lateral meniscus, myxoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, subchondral cyst of the tibial intercondylar eminence, suprapatellar bursitis, synovitis of the knee joint, grade I sprain of the medial collateral ligament.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Prior right knee meniscal and medial collateral ligament injury with prior arthroscopy. Recurrent right knee pain, limping, swelling.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Inferiorly surfacing oblique tear posterior horn medial meniscus extending to the body, which is peripherally extruded. There is irregular contour of the posterior horn and body of the meniscus, consistent with superimposed complex tear. There is apical truncation of the medial meniscal body consistent with a superimposed partial radial tear. The anterior horn and posterior root are intact. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. Fibular collateral ligament is intact. Moderate popliteus tendinosis without tear. Fibular collateral ligament is intact. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. The iliotibial band is intact.

There is slight medial patellar subluxation. The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 14 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Full-thickness cartilage denuding at the periphery of the medial patellar facet and fissuring of articular cartilage throughout the central to lateral femoral trochlea. Focal full thickness cartilage denuding medial femoral trochlea. There is fissuring and thinning of medial femorotibial articular cartilage along the inferior aspect. There is mild lateral femorotibial chondrosis.

Small knee joint effusion. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. Complex tearing of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with medial meniscal extrusion, as described.
2. Intact medial collateral ligament.
3. Popliteus tendinosis without tear.
4. Mild to moderate tricompartment chondrosis most pronounced involving the patellofemoral and medial femorotibial compartments consistent with mild to moderate osteoarthritis of the right knee.

report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Tibiyal plato medyalinde ve medyal femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki milimetrik subkondral kırıkları kemik iliği ödemi çevreliyor. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzu-gövdesindeki dejenerasyona yırtık eşlik etmiyor. Medyal menisküs arka kökü ödemli/mukoid dejenerasyon gösteriyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Çapraz ve dış yan bağlar korunmuş. İç yan bağ ve çevresi ödemli olup, bu düzeydeki zorlanmayı telkin ediyor. Posterior oblik bağ ödemli. Medyal patellar sinovyal plika eklem aralığına uzanıyor ve kalınlığı hafifçe artmış (medyal patellar sinovyal plika sendromu ile uyumlu). Medyal femoral tibyal ve patellofemoral eklem osteoartritleri femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan kesimindeki geniş tam kat kıkırdak kaybı ve eşlik eden subkortikal meduller fibrovasküler-fibrokistik değişiklikler ile karakterize. Diz ekleminin anteriorunda cilt altı bağ dokusu ödemli. Gastroknemyus-semimembranozus bursasındaki 5.8 cm maksimum boyutlu sıvı lokülasyonu olasılıkla sızdırıyor. Diz eklemi çevresindeki kaslarda hacim kaybı ve yağlı atrofi sarkopeni ile uyumlu.
translation: The amount of intra-articular fluid in the knee joint is mildly increased. Bone marrow edema surrounds millimetric subchondral fractures in the medial tibial plateau and the weight-bearing surface of the medial femoral condyle. Degeneration in the posterior horn-body of the medial meniscus is not accompanied by a tear. The posterior root of the medial meniscus shows edema/mucoid degeneration. The lateral meniscus is normal. The cruciate and lateral collateral ligaments are intact. The medial collateral ligament and its surroundings are edematous, suggesting strain at this level. The posterior oblique ligament is edematous. The medial patellar synovial plica extends into the joint space and its thickness is slightly increased (consistent with medial patellar synovial plica syndrome). Medial femorotibial and patellofemoral joint osteoarthritis is characterized by extensive full-thickness cartilage loss in the weight-bearing portion of the femoral condyle and accompanying subcortical medullary fibrovascular-fibrocystic changes. The subcutaneous connective tissue anterior to the knee joint is edematous. The fluid loculation in the gastrocnemius-semimembranosus bursa, measuring up to 5.8 cm in maximum dimension, is likely leaking. Volume loss and fatty atrophy in the muscles around the knee joint are consistent with sarcopenia.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Four-month anterior knee pain. Landing injury during sports.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Moderate tendinosis with low-grade interstitial tearing of the proximal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. Mild patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Moderate proximal patellar tendinosis with low-grade interstitial tearing.
2.	Lateral patellofemoral maltracking.

report:
Interprétation :

Minime épanchement intra-articulaire qui pourrait être de nature physiologique. Large kyste de Baker qui a progressé de façon significative dans l’intervalle, mesurant 2.8 x 2.6 x 7.1 cm, avec extension significative inférieurement le long du muscle gastrocnémien interne avec multiples loculations liquidiennes et œdème, suggérant une rupture partielle associée. 

Dans l’intervalle, il y a une déchirure légèrement complexe du ménisque interne avec macération/composante radiaire à la jonction de la corne postérieure et du corps méniscal de même qu’une composante potentiellement longitudinale horizontale s’étendant de la jonction de la corne postérieure avec le corps méniscal jusqu’à la corne antérieure et la surface articulaire supérieure. Extrusion méniscale significative avec possiblement un petit flap méniscal déplacé au sein de la gouttière supérieure à l’interligne articulaire fémoro-tibiale interne, en contact avec la composante profonde ménisco-fémorale du ligament collatéral interne. Légère œdème au pourtour du ligament collatéral interne réactionnel ou en lien avec une entorse de grade 1.

Il y a une progression de changements dégénératifs/chondropathie au compartiment fémoro-tibial, maintenant modérée à sévère, avec fissures chondrales transfixiantes aux  surfaces portante et non-portante (versant postérieur du condyle fémoral interne). Minime/début de changements sous-chondraux réactionnels au versant interne de la surface portante. Ostéophytes marginaux modérés. 

Le ménisque externe est grossièrement inchangé sans déchirure significative. Le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe est intact sans déchirure. Légers changements dégénératifs/chondropathie au compartiment fémoro-tibial externe avec atténuation diffuse des surfaces articulaires.

Légère atténuation du ligament croisé antérieur avec légère anomalie de signal sans déchirure significative. Ceci pourrait être en lien avec une ancienne entorse de bas grade. Pas de déchirure transfixiante. Le ligament croisé postérieur est intact sans déchirure. Petits kystes ganglionnaires intra-osseux sous son insertion distale au versant postérieur du tibia, augmentés dans l’intervalle.

La rotule est hautement située. Les tendons du quadriceps distal et patellaire sont intacts sans déchirure. À nouveau, changements dégénératifs/chondropathie sévère au versant interne du compartiment patellofémoral, légèrement plus marqué qu’à l’étude précédente, avec atténuation transfixiante des surfaces cartilagineuses et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Petits ostéophytes marginaux.

Conclusion :

Dans l’intervalle, déchirure légèrement complexe du ménisque interne tel que détaillé ci-haut.

Progression de changements dégénératifs/chondropathie tricompartimentale, modérée à sévère au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne et sévère au versant interne du compartiment patellofémoral tel détaillé ci-haut.

Progression d'un kyste de Baker (large) avec signes de rupture partielle.

Autres trouvailles tel que décrit ci-haut.
translation:
Interpretation:

Minimal intra-articular effusion that could be physiological in nature. Large Baker's cyst that has progressed significantly in the interval, measuring 2.8 x 2.6 x 7.1 cm, with significant inferior extension along the medial gastrocnemius muscle with multiple fluid loculations and edema, suggesting an associated partial rupture.

In the interval, there is a slightly complex tear of the medial meniscus with maceration/radial component at the junction of the posterior horn and meniscal body as well as a potentially horizontal longitudinal component extending from the junction of the posterior horn with the meniscal body to the anterior horn and the superior articular surface. Significant meniscal extrusion with possibly a small displaced meniscal flap within the superior gutter of the medial femorotibial joint space, in contact with the deep meniscofemoral component of the medial collateral ligament. Mild edema at the periphery of the medial collateral ligament, reactive or related to a grade 1 sprain.

There is progression of degenerative changes/chondropathy in the femorotibial compartment, now moderate to severe, with full-thickness chondral fissures at the weight-bearing and non-weight-bearing surfaces (posterior aspect of the medial femoral condyle). Minimal/early reactive subchondral changes at the medial aspect of the weight-bearing surface. Moderate marginal osteophytes.

The lateral meniscus is grossly unchanged without significant tear. The lateral collateral ligament complex is intact without tear. Mild degenerative changes/chondropathy in the lateral femorotibial compartment with diffuse attenuation of the articular surfaces.

Mild attenuation of the anterior cruciate ligament with mild signal abnormality without significant tear. This could be related to a prior low-grade sprain. No full-thickness tear. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact without tear. Small intraosseous ganglion cysts beneath its distal insertion at the posterior aspect of the tibia, increased in the interval.

The patella is high-riding. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact without tear. Again, severe degenerative changes/chondropathy at the medial aspect of the patellofemoral compartment, slightly more marked than on the previous study, with full-thickness attenuation of the cartilage surfaces and associated reactive subchondral changes. Small marginal osteophytes.

Conclusion:

In the interval, slightly complex tear of the medial meniscus as detailed above.

Progression of tricompartmental degenerative changes/chondropathy, moderate to severe in the medial femorotibial compartment and severe at the medial aspect of the patellofemoral compartment as detailed above.

Progression of a (large) Baker's cyst with signs of partial rupture.

Other findings as described above.

translation:
Clinical History:
Internal derangement of the knee.
Findings:
No significant bone marrow signal abnormalities.
PCL without abnormalities. Non-visualization of the ACL, suggesting a full-thickness tear with resorption of its fibers.
Collateral ligaments without abnormalities.
Extensive complex tear with maceration and extrusion of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with a segment partially displaced into the meniscofemoral recess at the level of the body and toward the posterior intercondylar region.
The lateral meniscus appears of preserved morphology and signal, without categorical criteria for a significant tear.
Full-thickness chondral ulcers with secondary bone changes of the weight-bearing zone of the medial femorotibial compartment and peripheral bone proliferations. Focal full-thickness chondral ulcers of the lateral femoral condyle. No peripheral bone proliferations are observed predominantly toward the intercondylar region at the level of the medial femoral condyle.
Partial and full-thickness chondral ulcers of diffuse distribution of the patellofemoral joint.
Moderate joint effusion with diffuse synovitis. Intra-articular bodies in the posterior recesses, especially at the level of the posterolateral recess of the knee, up to 20 mm.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserinus tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Impression:
Signs of a complete ACL tear, not recent, with resorption of its fibers.
Extensive complex tear with maceration and extrusion of the medial meniscus.
Chondropathy with grade 4 lesions of the medial femorotibial compartment.
Chondropathy with grade 3 lesions of the patellofemoral compartment and the medial femoral condyle.
Moderate joint effusion with diffuse synovitis. Intra-articular bodies in the posterior recesses.

report: МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става са с нормалнен интензитет на сигнала. Визуализират се малки остеофитни наслагвания по латералния кондил на фемура и тибията. Ставният хрущял на фемура и тибията е съхранен. Вижда се малък дефект в средната трета на хрущяла на пателата както при начална хондропатия. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. В задния рог на медиалния менискус се вижда хиперинтензна лезия с неправилен ход, достигаща до артикулиращия хрущял на фемура - grade 3. В задния рог на латерален менискус също е налице увреда в по-малка степен – grade 2a. Нормално изобразяване на предните рога на двата мениска. Изобразява се Бекерова киста на нивото на медиалната глава на мускулус гастрокнемиус с размери 36/15мм, без белези за руптуриране. Колатералните лигаменти са със запазена цялост. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на м квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Заключение:  МР данни за увреда на задните рога на двата менискуса. Начална хондропатия на пателата. Бекерова киста. Малък ставен излив.
translation: MRI findings: MRI evidence of joint effusion. The bones forming the left knee joint have normal signal intensity. Small osteophytic deposits are visualized along the lateral condyle of the femur and tibia. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia is preserved. A small defect is seen in the middle third of the patellar cartilage, consistent with early chondropathy. Normal appearance of the cruciate ligaments. In the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, a hyperintense lesion with an irregular course is seen, reaching the articular cartilage of the femur – grade 3. In the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus, there is also damage to a lesser degree – grade 2a. Normal appearance of the anterior horns of both menisci. A Baker's cyst is visualized at the level of the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle, measuring 36/15 mm, without signs of rupture. The collateral ligaments are intact. Retinacula – unremarkable. Quadriceps femoris tendon and patellar ligament – normal appearance. Conclusion: MRI evidence of damage to the posterior horns of both menisci. Early chondropathy of the patella. Baker's cyst. Small joint effusion.

denudacije hrskavice femoralnog kondila i tibijalnog platoa, rubne osteofite uz vidljiv minimalni
koštani edem u predjelu istih te gubitak intraartikularnog prostora.

kaudalnom migracijom istog u oba parameniskalna recesusa za oko 6 mm.
Hiperintenzitet vlakana medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta uslijed distenzije.
Umjerene do teške degenerativne promjene prednjeg križnog ligamenta uz mukoidne inkluzije
između vlakana te koštani edem i sitne intraosalne ganglion ciste u području hvatišta za tibiju.
Ganglion cista 4 mm prednjeg korijena lateralnog meniska uz hvatište za tibiju, moguće u sklopu
deg. promjena.
Rubni osteofiti lateralnog kompartmenta FT zgloba.
Hondromalacija III. stupnja hrskavice lateralnog kondila femura.
Hondromalacija II. stupnja hrskavice lateralnog platoa tibije.
Degenerativne promjene prednjeg roga lateralnog meniska.
Vidi se stanjenje hrskavice lateralne fasete patele uz početnu formaciju subhondralne ciste.
Hondromalacija I. stupnja medijalne fasete i IV. stupnja centralnog dijela patele.

translation:
Pronounced osteoarthritic changes of the medial compartment of the femorotibial joint in the form of cartilage denudation of the femoral condyle and tibial plateau, marginal osteophytes with visible minimal bone edema in the region of the same, and loss of intra-articular space.
A complex tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus is seen, with extrusion and cranial and caudal migration into both parameniscal recesses by approximately 6 mm.
Hyperintensity of the fibers of the medial collateral ligament due to distension.
Moderate to severe degenerative changes of the anterior cruciate ligament with mucoid inclusions between the fibers and bone edema and small intraosseous ganglion cysts in the region of the tibial attachment.
Ganglion cyst 4 mm of the anterior root of the lateral meniscus at the tibial attachment, possibly as part of degenerative changes.
Marginal osteophytes of the lateral compartment of the femorotibial joint.
Grade III chondromalacia of the cartilage of the lateral femoral condyle.
Grade II chondromalacia of the cartilage of the lateral tibial plateau.
Degenerative changes of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
Thinning of the cartilage of the lateral patellar facet with initial formation of a subchondral cyst is seen.
Grade I chondromalacia of the medial facet and grade IV of the central part of the patella.
Baker's cyst with a sagittal height of 6.7 cm.
Anterior subcutaneous edema adjacent to the patella and patellar ligament.
All other visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

report: Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femoral tibyal kompartmanda en belirgin ve tam kata ulaşan eklem kıkırdağı kaybı ve dejenerasyonu, subkondral medüller fibrokistik ve fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Tibyal plato posterolateralindeki subkondral kırığı kemik iliği ödemi çevreliyor. Ön çapraz bağ tam kat yırtık olup tibya anteriyora 26 mm translasyon gösteriyor. Arka çapraz bağın femoral insersiyon kesimindeki yapı içi sinyal artışı ve milimetrik sıvı intensitesi bu kesimdeki parsiyel yırtığı telkin ediyor. İç yan bağ korunmuş Dış yan bağ parsiyel yırtık . Biseps femoris tendonu korunmuş. Popliteus tendonozisi izleniyor. Lateral menisküsün gövdesi ve ön boynuzunda üst eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkilenen horizontal oblik yırtık ve serbest kenarında püsküllenme izleniyor. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzunda ait eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkilenen horizontal oblik yırtık mevcut. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibiofibuler eklem dejenere. Gastrokinemiyus medyal ve lateral başının femoral origoları çevresinde eklem  kapsülü komşuluğunda büyüğü 9 mm boyutunda gangliyon kistleri izleniyor.
translation: Tricompartmental degenerative joint disease of the knee, most prominent in the medial femorotibial compartment, characterized by full-thickness articular cartilage loss and degeneration, subchondral medullary fibrocystic and fibrovascular changes, and marginal osteophytes. Bone marrow edema surrounds a subchondral fracture of the posterolateral tibial plateau. The anterior cruciate ligament has a full-thickness tear with 26 mm anterior tibial translation. Increased intrasubstance signal and millimetric fluid intensity at the femoral insertion of the posterior cruciate ligament suggest a partial tear at this segment. The medial collateral ligament is intact. The lateral collateral ligament has a partial tear. The biceps femoris tendon is intact. Popliteus tendinosis is observed. A horizontal oblique tear communicating with the superior articular surface is seen in the body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus, with fraying at the free edge. A horizontal oblique tear communicating with the inferior articular surface is present in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is a mild increase in intra-articular fluid of the knee joint. The extensor mechanism is intact. The proximal tibiofibular joint is degenerated. Ganglion cysts, the largest measuring 9 mm, are seen adjacent to the joint capsule around the femoral origins of the medial and lateral heads of the gastrocnemius.
