translation:
MRI LEFT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1 and proton density pulse sequences with fat signal suppression. [DATE].

FINDINGS
In the area of the medial compartment where degeneration of the meniscus had been previously observed, a degenerative tear of the body is noted on the current examination. Also observed is a helical course of the meniscofemoral ligament, a finding that suggests an old partial tear of it. The lateral meniscus shows degeneration without tear. On evaluation of the cruciate and collateral ligaments as well as the quadriceps and patellar tendons, no pathological findings are observed. On evaluation of the bone marrow, a subcortical-subarticular lesion of 6 mm is observed at the mid articular surface of the patella, which was not present on the previous examination. The finding is attributed to an old osteochondral injury. At the midline of the patella, a fissure-like erosion of the articular cartilage is observed through its full thickness. A moderate fluid collection is observed intra-articularly in communication with a Baker's synovial cyst.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT W WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain; severe knee pain and decreased range of motion; history of negative cultures; symptoms for one week with difficulty walking and bearing weight
Comparison: Radiograph of the right knee dated [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 3.0 system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), without and with intravenous contrast.

Contrast: 4 mL of Gadavist

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Multiple areas of curvilinear serpiginous high T2 and low T1 signal intensity are noted in the distal femoral metadiaphysis as well as in the medial femoral condyle and proximal medial tibia with central areas of fat, characteristic for osteonecrosis. The largest in the femur measures up to 4.8 cm mediolateral by 2.5 cm anterior posterior by 7.1 cm craniocaudal dimension, with a thick peripheral rim of enhancement and central areas of fat signal intensity. These findings are age-indeterminate with a probable chronic component given the central fat and absence of surrounding geographic marrow edema. Very subtle periarticular edema is noted along the anteromedial aspect anterolateral aspect of the femoral condyles. There is mild nonspecific marrow edema and a patella. Mild marrow edema is noted at the anterior patella and deep to the popliteus tendon. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Minimal joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

report:
Trouvailles :

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire avec petit kyste poplité non-rupturé.

Il y a léger amincissement et fibrillation superficielle du cartilage incluant les trois compartiments plus proéminent au niveau du compartiment interne avec changement réactif sous-chondral. Il n’y a pas de région de perte de cartilage complet.

Il y a changements dégénératifs intrasubstance impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure longitudinale d’orientation oblique au niveau de la corne postérieure. La déchirure s’étend à la surface articulaire inférieure du ménisque. Il n’y a pas de fragment déplacé ou de kyste para-méniscal. Le ménisque externe est sans particularité.

Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion :

1. Légers changements dégénératifs impliquant les trois compartiments sans région de perte de cartilage complet.

2. Changements dégénératifs intrasubstances du ménisque interne associés à une déchirure oblique de la corne postérieure.

3. Épanchement intra-articulaire avec petit kyste poplité non-rupturé.
translation:
Findings:

There is a small intra-articular effusion with a small unruptured popliteal cyst.

There is mild thinning and superficial fibrillation of the cartilage involving all three compartments, more prominent in the medial compartment with subchondral reactive change. There is no region of full-thickness cartilage loss.

There are intrasubstance degenerative changes involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is an obliquely oriented longitudinal tear at the posterior horn. The tear extends to the inferior articular surface of the meniscus. There is no displaced fragment or parameniscal cyst. The lateral meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise, the anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, extensor mechanism, medial collateral ligament, semimembranosus, popliteus muscle and tendon, distal biceps femoris, lateral collateral ligament, and iliotibial band are unremarkable.

Conclusion:

1. Mild degenerative changes involving all three compartments without region of full-thickness cartilage loss.

2. Intrasubstance degenerative changes of the medial meniscus associated with an oblique tear of the posterior horn.

3. Intra-articular effusion with a small unruptured popliteal cyst.

report:
MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    Knee pain. Exam consistent with? Meniscal injury 3. Ultrasound shows? Lateral meniscal tear. Please note this scan was ordered for the left knee but the patient insisted that the right knee was symptomatic and at the patient's insistence the right knee was scanned, not the left.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact.

There is increased T2 signal and mild thickening of the proximal fibers of the patellar tendon consistent with mild patellar tendinosis.

The patellofemoral ligaments are intact.

Articular cartilage of the patella demonstrates chondral fraying and signal change to the lateral facet with some fissuring and very faint subcortical edema seen within the bone of the lateral facet of patella. There is associated trochlear cartilage fraying and fissuring seen involving the trochlear apex and medial facet. Findings are consistent with severe chondrosis of the patellofemoral joint.

The TT-TG distance measures about 9 mm, within normal limits.

The lateral meniscus appears intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is reasonably well-maintained.

The medial meniscus is intact. There is some linear nonsurfacing signal seen in the posterior horn extending into the posterior body of medial meniscus but a definite surfacing meniscal tear is not identified.

There is moderate chondrosis of the medial joint compartment with some regions of focal fraying and thinning and one focus of mild subcortical edema seen to the weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex appear intact.

There is a small to moderate sized Baker's cyst present.

There is no evidence of a significant knee effusion.

Marrow signal is otherwise normal. 

INTERPRETATION: 

Mild patellar tendinosis.

Severe chondrosis involving patellofemoral joint.

Moderate medial compartment chondrosis.

Baker's cyst.

No evidence of internal derangement or lateral meniscal tear.

Le ligament croisé antérieur démontre de légers changements dégénératifs. Le ligament croisé postérieur est sans particularité.

Léger amincissement du cartilage diffus. Il y a une fissure de grade modéré à la facette latérale de la rotule. Le tendon du quadriceps et le ligament patellaire sont sans particularité. Minime œdème au gras supra-patellaire. 
Compartiment interne : 
Il y a un amincissement du cartilage diffus modéré. De plus, il y a un foyer focal de 1cm x 1cm de perte de cartilage de pleine épaisseur à l’aspect postérieur du condyle fémoral interne avec de très minimes changements œdémateux à la moelle osseuse sous-chondrale. Il y a émoussement du rebord interne au corps du ménisque interne avec des changements dégénératifs. Il y a un foyer oval de 4mm de signal liquidien antérieur à la corne antérieure du ménisque interne qui pourrait suggérer un petit kyste para-méniscal ou possiblement un kyste ganglionnaire. Une déchirure méniscale n’est pas définitivement identifiée à ce niveau. Le ligament collatéral interne est intact. 
Compartiment externe : 
Amincissement du cartilage diffus léger à modéré. Il n’y a pas de déchirure significative au ménisque externe. Le complexe ligamentaire latéral est maintenu. 
Minime ostéophyte marginaux au compartiment interne et externe. 

Conclusion : 
Amincissement du cartilage diffus léger à modéré tricompartimental plus prononcé au compartiment interne où il y a aussi un foyer de 1cm de perte de cartilage de pleine épaisseur à l’aspect postérieur du condyle fémoral interne. 
Changements dégénératifs et émoussement du rebord interne du corps du ménisque interne. 
Kyste poplité de taille modérée avec rupture partielle récente. 
Petit épanchement intra-articulaire au genou. 
Distension liquidienne de la gaine tendineuse du poplité. Il y a un foyer d’environ 1cm dans la gaine tendineuse du poplité qui suggère une possible souris intra-articulaire, peut-être reflétant le morceau de cartilage manquant à l’aspect postérieur du condyle fémoral interne.
translation:
Findings:
There is a mild intra-articular effusion. There is a popliteal cyst with a few internal septations and possible debris measuring up to 5.7 x 2.6 x 1.2 cm (craniocaudal x transverse x anteroposterior). There is a small amount of free fluid surrounding the popliteal cyst suggesting a recent partial rupture.
There is mild fluid distension of the popliteus tendon sheath. There is a focus of intermediate signal measuring up to 10 mm within the tendon sheath that may suggest a small migrated intra-articular loose body, possibly related to the area of cartilage loss described below.
The anterior cruciate ligament demonstrates mild degenerative changes. The posterior cruciate ligament is unremarkable.
Anterior compartment:
Mild diffuse cartilage thinning. There is a moderate-grade fissure at the lateral facet of the patella. The quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament are unremarkable. Minimal edema in the suprapatellar fat pad.
Medial compartment:
There is moderate diffuse cartilage thinning. Additionally, there is a 1 cm x 1 cm focal area of full-thickness cartilage loss at the posterior aspect of the medial femoral condyle with very minimal subchondral bone marrow edematous changes. There is blunting of the medial edge of the body of the medial meniscus with degenerative changes. There is a 4 mm ovoid focus of fluid signal anterior to the anterior horn of the medial meniscus that could suggest a small parameniscal cyst or possibly a ganglion cyst. A meniscal tear is not definitively identified at this level. The medial collateral ligament is intact.
Lateral compartment:
Mild to moderate diffuse cartilage thinning. There is no significant tear of the lateral meniscus. The lateral ligamentous complex is maintained.
Minimal marginal osteophytes at the medial and lateral compartments.

Conclusion:
Mild to moderate diffuse tricompartmental cartilage thinning, more pronounced at the medial compartment where there is also a 1 cm focus of full-thickness cartilage loss at the posterior aspect of the medial femoral condyle.
Degenerative changes and blunting of the medial edge of the body of the medial meniscus.
Moderate-sized popliteal cyst with recent partial rupture.
Small intra-articular knee effusion.
Fluid distension of the popliteus tendon sheath. There is an approximately 1 cm focus within the popliteus tendon sheath suggesting a possible intra-articular loose body, perhaps reflecting the missing piece of cartilage at the posterior aspect of the medial femoral condyle.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 49-year-old female with right knee pain for months, pain at the anterior aspect of the knee. No surgical history.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No suspicious osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. Lobulated T2 hyperintense T1 isointense mass centered in the anterior joint recess/Hoffa's fat measuring 3.4 cm transverse by 2.2 cm anteroposterior by 3.8 cm craniocaudal. There maybe a few small foci of hypointense signal, suggestive of hemosiderin. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness chondrosis along the median ridge with full-thickness fissuring a small cartilage flap extending to the lateral patellar facet. Subchondral cystic change at the median ridge. Trochlear cartilage is intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS AND POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 18 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Lobulated mass centered at the anterior joint recess/Hoffa's fat measuring 3.4 x 2.2 x 3.8 cm, favored to represent localized pigmented villonodular synovitis (PVNS).

2. Patellofemoral compartmental chondrosis.

3. Moderate knee joint effusion.

translation: LEFT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: The integrity and signal intensities of the bony structures forming the knee joint are normal. Signal increase consistent with degeneration is noted in the anterior cruciate ligament. The integrity and signal intensity of the anterior and posterior horns of the lateral meniscus are normal. A complex tear and volume loss are observed in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. A tear involving the inferior articular surface is noted in the anterior horn. No space-occupying lesion is detected in the popliteal fossa. Increased effusion is observed in the joint space and suprapatellar bursa.

report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküste  meniskal kök yırtığı ve hafif ekstrüsyon izlendi. Medial menisküste ekstrüsyon , maserasyon ve komplet yırtık izlenmiş olup volüm kaybı mevcuttur.Ön çapraz bağda komplet yırtık ile uyumlu bütünlük kaybı mevcuttur.  Arka çapraz bağ normaldir.Lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir. Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde sıvı artışı mevcuttur(grade I sprain).Distal kuadriseps tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patellar kıkırdakta yer yer ince fissür hatları ve sinyal değişiklikleri mevcuttur (grade II kondromalazi ).Suprapatellar bursada, diz eklem mesafesinde, lateral ve medial reseslerde sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda osteofitik sivrileşmeler ve medial tibiofemoral eklem mesafesinde daralma ve subkondral skleroz , kistler ve kemik iliği ödemi mevcuttur.Eklem kapsülünde posterior süperiorunda fokal yırtık izlenmiş olup ve komşuluğunda ganglion kistleri mevcuttur.Pes anserinus bursada 4 x2x1 cm loküle sıvı izlendi(bursit).
translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: A meniscal root tear and mild extrusion are observed in the lateral meniscus. Extrusion, maceration, and a complete tear are observed in the medial meniscus, with volume loss present. Loss of integrity consistent with a complete tear is present in the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament is normal. The lateral collateral ligament is normal. Increased fluid is present around the medial collateral ligament (grade I sprain). The distal quadriceps tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Thin fissure lines and signal changes are present in places in the patellar cartilage (grade II chondromalacia). Increased fluid is observed in the suprapatellar bursa, the knee joint space, and the lateral and medial recesses. Osteophytic spurs are present in the bony structures forming the knee joint, with narrowing of the medial tibiofemoral joint space, subchondral sclerosis, cysts, and bone marrow edema. A focal tear is observed in the posterosuperior aspect of the joint capsule, with ganglion cysts in the vicinity. Loculated fluid measuring 4 x 2 x 1 cm is observed in the pes anserinus bursa (bursitis).

translation:
RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: A lesion with a narrow transition zone, well-defined margins, approximately 15x11 mm in size, located in the distal diaphysis of the femur within the imaged section, hypointense on T1-weighted sequences and heterogeneous in intensity on T2-weighted sequences was observed. Enchondroma was primarily considered in the differential diagnosis of the lesion. Osteophytic spurring was noted in the bony structures forming the knee joint. Bone marrow edema was noted in the medial tibial plateau. The knee joint space is narrowed medially. Grade I chondromalacia was noted in the patellofemoral cartilage, particularly in the medial aspect. The integrity and signal intensity of the quadriceps and patellar tendons, lateral collateral ligaments, and posterior cruciate ligaments are normal. Decreased caliber of the anterior cruciate ligament was observed. Signal increase consistent with grade I sprain was noted in the medial collateral ligament. A complex tear in the anterior horn of the medial meniscus and meniscal extrusion beyond the joint were noted. Grade II degeneration was observed in the posterior horn. Grade II degeneration was observed in the anterior and posterior horns of the lateral meniscus. Increased effusion was observed in the joint space and suprapatellar bursa. An edematous appearance is present in the prepatellar soft tissue.

report:
Na učinjenim nativnim MR presjecima kroz desno koljeno nalazi se blaži (vj. rezidualni) koštani
edem medijalnog platoa tibije u posteriornom dijelu.
Defekt dijela vlakana prednje križne sveze na lateralnom tuberkulu interkondilarne eminencije
tibije - nalaz upućuje na parcijalnu rupturu posterolateralnog snopa.
Vidljiv je hiperintenzitet stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska koji upućuje na horizontalnu rupturu,
vjerojatno starijeg datuma.
Nalazi se distenzija medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Edem mekih tkiva uz iliotibijalni trakt može odgovarati distenziji istog.
Burzitis tetive popliteusa.
Hondromalacija drugog stupnja tibijalne i kondilarne hrskavice.
Distenzija medijalnog patelarnog retinakuluma.
Manja subhondralna cista tibije u proksimalnom tibiofibularnom zglobu.
Blaža tendinopatija tetive kvadricepsa.
Ne nalazi se signifikantnog izljeva u koljenski zglob. Ne nalazi se poplitealne ciste.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.
translation:
On native MR images of the right knee, there is mild (likely residual) bone marrow edema of the medial tibial plateau in the posterior portion.
Defect of part of the fibers of the anterior cruciate ligament at the lateral tubercle of the intercondylar eminence of the tibia – the finding suggests a partial tear of the posterolateral bundle.
Hyperintensity is visible in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus suggesting a horizontal tear, likely of older date.
There is distension of the medial collateral ligament.
Soft tissue edema along the iliotibial tract may correspond to a sprain of the same.
Bursitis of the popliteus tendon.
Grade 2 chondromalacia of the tibial and condylar cartilage.
Distension of the medial patellar retinaculum.
Small subchondral cyst of the tibia at the proximal tibiofibular joint.
Mild tendinopathy of the quadriceps tendon.
No significant effusion in the knee joint. No popliteal cyst.
The other visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

translation:
Clinical History:
Synovitis of the right knee.

Findings:
Cruciate and collateral ligaments without alterations.
Extensive degenerative tear of the anterior horn, body, posterior horn, and part of the meniscal root of the lateral meniscus with significant associated extrusion.
Marginal tear of the body of the medial meniscus with minimal extrusion.
Full-thickness chondral ulcers with secondary bone changes and peripheral bone proliferations of the lateral femorotibial compartment. Partial-thickness and near full-thickness chondral ulcers of the weight-bearing zone of the medial femorotibial compartment.
Advanced degenerative changes of the patellofemoral joint with secondary bone changes and peripheral bone proliferations.
Moderate joint effusion with moderate diffuse synovitis associated with small diffuse intra-articular bodies. Multilobulated popliteal cyst, without signs of rupture.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.

Impression:
Extensive degenerative tear of the lateral meniscus with associated extrusion.
Marginal tear of the medial meniscus with minimal extrusion.
Chondropathy with advanced degenerative changes of the lateral femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments.
Chondropathy grade two and three lesions of the medial femorotibial compartment.
Moderate joint effusion with moderate diffuse synovitis. Small diffuse intra-articular bodies. Uncomplicated popliteal cyst.

Normal appearance of the quadriceps tendon and patellar tendon.
Normal delineation of the patellar cartilage.
Normal signal intensities of the osseous structures.
Septated cystic structure posterior to the posterior cruciate ligament.
Intact appearance of the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments.
Normal signal intensities of the lateral meniscus.
Linear hyperintense signal in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, in contact with the tibial articular surface.
Normal appearance of the medial and lateral collateral ligaments and the iliotibial tract.
Possibly small [finding] in the posterolateral aspect of the proximal tibial meta-diaphysis.
Normal appearance of the pes anserinus.
Normal signal intensities of the tibial nerve and the common peroneal nerve.
Conclusion:
- Small tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
- Septated cystic structure posteriorly in the joint, against the posterior cruciate ligament: most likely a ganglion cyst.

report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs gövde ve arka boynuzda kompleks yırtık izlenmekte olup menisküste hafif ekstrüzyon izlenmektedir. Medial menisküs gövde kesiminde tibial eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkili horizontal yırtık vardır.Ön çapraz bağda diffüz sinyal artışı mevcuttur (mukoid dejenerasyon). Arka çapraz bağ, medial kollateral ligaman normaldir. Lateral eklem aralığında komşu femur ve tibiada tam kat kıkırdak kaybı mevcuttur. Patella femoral eklem aralığında marjinal osteofitler görüldü. Tibia eminencia posteriorda milimetrik subkondral dejeneratif kistik oluşumlar izlendi.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Diz ekleminde hafif mayii artışı izlendi.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Sonuç: Lateral menisküs ve medial menisküste yırtıklar, lateral eklem aralığında Grade 4 kondromalazi, patellofemoral hafif osteoartrit bulguları, ön çapraz bağda diffüz sinyal artışı (mukoid dejenerasyon).
translation: LEFT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: A complex tear is observed in the body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus, with mild meniscal extrusion. There is a horizontal tear in the body of the medial meniscus communicating with the tibial articular surface. Diffuse signal increase is present in the anterior cruciate ligament (mucoid degeneration). The posterior cruciate ligament and medial collateral ligament are normal. Full-thickness cartilage loss is present in the adjacent femur and tibia in the lateral compartment. Marginal osteophytes were seen in the patellofemoral joint space. Millimetric subchondral degenerative cystic formations were observed in the posterior tibial eminence. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Mild joint effusion was observed in the knee joint. Signal intensities of the bony structures forming the knee joint are normal. Conclusion: Tears in the lateral meniscus and medial meniscus, Grade 4 chondromalacia in the lateral compartment, mild patellofemoral osteoarthritis findings, diffuse signal increase in the anterior cruciate ligament (mucoid degeneration).

Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih
ligamenata, stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta.
Prednji križni ligament je mukoidno degeneriran uz moguću manju parcijalnu rupturu
anteromedijalnih vlakana za tibiju.
Ganglion cista promjera oko 7 mm na hvatištu LCL za femur u sklopu kronične entezopatije ili
ranije parcijalne rupture.
Lokulirani izljev uz iliotibijalni trakt moguće u sklopu sindroma iliotibijalnog trakta.
Entezopatske promjene hvatišta tetive m. kvadricepsa uz vidljiv veći entezofit kranijalng pola
patele.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga lateralnog meniska na degenerativnoj podlozi. Ekstruzija
trupa lateralnog meniska. Uznapredovale degenerativne promjene i gotovo poptpuna destrukcija
prednjeg roga lateralnog meniska.
Horizontalno intrasupstancijsko povišenje intenziteta signala medijalnog meniska, na
degenerativnoj bazi, bez jasnih znakova rupture.
Lobulirane ganglion ciste uz stražnji korijen oba meniska.

Blago je reducirana debljina femoropatelranog zgloba uz vidljivu fisuru lateralne trohleje femura
(hondromalacija III. stupnja).
Gotovo je potpuno reducirana debljina artikulacijske hrskavice lateralnog kompartmenta
femorotibijalnog zgloba uz vidljiv opsežan subhondralni edem lateralnog platoa tibije koji je
deniveliran u sklopu OA promjena (hondromalacija IV. stupnja). OA promjene FP zgloba.
Hondromalacija III. stupnja zglobne plohe medijalnog kondila femura.
Lamelarno tekućine infrapatelarno. Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
Tendinopatske promjene hvatišta tetive m. popliteusa.
Nešto tekućine oko tetive medijalne glave m. gastrocnemiusa.
Ganglion cista promjera 10 mm uz anteriorni rub medijalne glave m. gastrocnemiusa.
Masna degeneracija muskulature GC2 u sklopu atrofičkih promjena.

translation:
On the series of MR images of the right knee, there is normal morphology and signal intensity of the collateral ligaments, posterior cruciate ligament, iliotibial band, and patellar ligament.
The anterior cruciate ligament is mucoid degenerated with a possible minor partial tear of the anteromedial fibers at the tibial attachment.
Ganglion cyst measuring approximately 7 mm in diameter at the femoral attachment of the LCL in the setting of chronic enthesopathy or prior partial tear.
Loculated effusion along the iliotibial band, possibly in the setting of iliotibial band syndrome.
Enthesopathic changes at the insertion of the quadriceps tendon with a visible larger enthesophyte at the cranial pole of the patella.
Complex tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus on a degenerative basis. Extrusion of the body of the lateral meniscus. Advanced degenerative changes and near-complete destruction of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
Horizontal intrasubstance increased signal intensity of the medial meniscus, on a degenerative basis, without clear signs of tear.
Lobulated ganglion cysts at the posterior root of both menisci.
The patella is medially positioned, Wiberg type 1.
Mildly reduced thickness of the femoropatellar joint cartilage with a visible fissure of the lateral femoral trochlea (chondromalacia grade III).
Near-complete loss of articular cartilage thickness in the lateral compartment of the femorotibial joint with visible extensive subchondral edema of the lateral tibial plateau, which is irregular in the setting of OA changes (chondromalacia grade IV). OA changes of the patellofemoral joint. Chondromalacia grade III of the articular surface of the medial femoral condyle.
Lamellar fluid infrapatellarly. No popliteal (Baker's) cyst is found.
Tendinopathic changes at the insertion of the popliteus tendon.
Some fluid around the tendon of the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle.
Ganglion cyst measuring 10 mm in diameter along the anterior margin of the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle.
Fatty degeneration of the GC2 musculature in the setting of atrophic changes.
The remaining visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

report:
Knochen: Gering intraossäres Ödemsignal anterioren der medialen Femurkondyle (5/15). Des Weiteren keine Ödemsignal der knöchernen Strukturen. Unauffällige Signalgebung des Knochenmarkes. Zentrierte Stellung femoropatellar und femorotibial. Im medialen und lateralen femorotibialen Kompartiment keine wesentlichen osteophytären Ausziehungen. Fabella.
Knorpel: Fokal bis tiefer greifende Chondropathie an der Trochlea (4/22). Keine wesentliche Chondropathie des Gelenkknorpels an der retropatellaren Gelenkfläche. Langstreckig an der lateralen Femurkondyle ausgedünnter Knorpelbelag im lateralen femorotibialen Kompartiment (6/25 und 5/21). Medialseitig unauffälliger Knorpelbesatz ohne höhergradige Chondropathie.
Bänder/Sehnen/Kapsel: Mediales und laterales Kollateralband intakt. Reizzustand des MCL. Flüssigkeit um den Tr. iliotibialis, a.e. ebenfalls Reizzustand. Intakte Darstellung des vorderen und hinteren Kreuzbandes. Quadrizepssehne und Patellasehne intakt. Kein wesentlicher Gelenkerguss, keine Eindeutig freien intraartikulären Gelenkkörper.
Menisci: Unauffällige Form und Signalgebung. Keine eindeutige Rissbildung.
Fettkörper: Unauffällig, kein raumfordernder Prozess.
Weichteile: Kleine Baker-Zyste. Des Weiteren unauffällig.
translation:
Bone: Mild intraosseous edema signal anteriorly of the medial femoral condyle (5/15). Otherwise no edema signal of the bony structures. Unremarkable bone marrow signal. Centered alignment femoropatellar and femorotibial. No significant osteophytic spurs in the medial and lateral femorotibial compartment. Fabella.
Cartilage: Focal deep-reaching chondropathy at the trochlea (4/22). No significant chondropathy of the articular cartilage at the retropatellar articular surface. Long-segment thinning of the cartilage covering at the lateral femoral condyle in the lateral femorotibial compartment (6/25 and 5/21). Medially unremarkable cartilage covering without higher-grade chondropathy.
Ligaments/Tendons/Capsule: Medial and lateral collateral ligament intact. Irritation state of the MCL. Fluid around the iliotibial tract, most likely also irritation state. Intact depiction of the anterior and posterior cruciate ligament. Quadriceps tendon and patellar tendon intact. No significant joint effusion, no definite free intra-articular bodies.
Menisci: Unremarkable morphology and signal. No definite tear.
Fat pad: Unremarkable, no space-occupying process.
Soft tissues: Small Baker's cyst. Otherwise unremarkable.

report: МР находка: МР данни за минимален ставен излив. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става, са с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет, с изключение на пателата, по горния ръб на която се виждат остеофитни наслагвания. Ставният хрущял на тибията и фемура от медиалната страна е изтънен. В задния рог на медиалния менискус се изобразява хиперинтензна лезия, съответстваща на дегенеративна промяна. Тя е с линеарен кос ход, достигаща до ставния хрущял на тибията. В латералния менискус също се вижда патологична лезия. Тя се представя като плътна висосигнална линеарна лезия с хоризонтален ход в средния дял на латералния менискус, между двата му рога. Кръстни връзки – б.о. Хрущял на пателата – б.о. Фоса поплитеа – нормално изобразяване. Колатерални лигаменти, ретинакулуми – със запазена цялост. Заключение: МР данни за левостранна гонартроза. Дегенеративни промени в двата менискуса със скъсване на латералния менискус. Минимален ставен излив.
translation: MRI findings: MRI data for minimal joint effusion. In the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, a hyperintense lesion is visualized, corresponding to a degenerative change. It has a linear oblique course, reaching the articular cartilage of the tibia. In the lateral meniscus, a pathological lesion is also seen. Patellar cartilage – unremarkable. Popliteal fossa – normal appearance. Collateral ligaments, retinacula – with preserved integrity. Conclusion: MRI findings of left-sided gonarthrosis. Degenerative changes in both menisci with a tear of the lateral meniscus. Minimal joint effusion.

MRI of the left knee was performed in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Subarticular cysts and erosions are seen involving the medial tibial plateau. Tricompartmental arthritic changes in the form of reduced medial tibiofemoral joint space with subjacent marrow edema, thinning of the cartilage and marginal osteophytes.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. A fluid-filled distended synovial-lined lesion is seen arising in the popliteal fossa between the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus tendons measuring approximately 3 x 1.5 x 3 cm in maximum dimensions. Findings indicate Baker's cyst. No signs of infection or rupture is visualized.
MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Reduced patellofemoral joint space with subchondral erosions and thinning of the cartilage. 
Insall Salvati ratio is 1.3 indicating mild patella alta.
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Baker's cyst as described above.
2.	Tricompartmental arthritic changes in the form of reduced medial tibiofemoral joint space with subjacent marrow edema, thinning of the cartilage and marginal osteophytes.
3.	Mild patella alta.
4.	No meniscal tears could be visualized.

Zglobna tijela PF zgloba su kongruentna.
PF artrotske promjene s reduciranim zglobnim prostorom, manjim izljevom i hondromalacijom IV
stupnja hrskavice interfasetarno.

Minimalni izljev.
Prednji križni ligament u području distalnog hvatišta pokazuje trokutasti hiperintenzitet koji
može odgovarati manjoj intrasupstancijskoj rupturi.
Vertikalna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska koja seže i zahvaća donju artikulacijsku
plohu uz promijenjen intenzitet signala posteromedijalnog dijela zglobne čahure i meniskotibijalne
sveze - ramp lezija .
Uz stražnju konturu meniska vidi se nekoliko milimetarskih ganglion cista.
Početno degenerativno promijenjen intenizet signala preostalog dijela medijalnog meniska.
Manja ekstruzija dijela diska u meniskotibijalni recesus.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova degeneracije ili rupture.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti urednog signala te se prate u kontinuitetu.
Blage tendinopatske promjene hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa.
Uredan izgled patelarnog ligamenta.
Bez znakova poplitealne ciste.
translation:
The articular bodies of the PF joint are congruent.
PF arthrotic changes with reduced joint space, minor effusion and grade IV chondromalacia of the interfacet cartilage.
Grade II chondromalacia of the lateral tibial plateau and the cartilage of the medial femoral condyle. OA changes bilaterally, more pronounced laterally with osteophytes.
The tibial plateau intercondylar posteriorly shows multiple small subchondral cysts.
Minimal effusion.
The anterior cruciate ligament in the region of the distal insertion shows triangular hyperintensity that may correspond to a minor intrasubstance tear.
Vertical tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus extending to and involving the inferior articular surface with altered signal intensity of the posteromedial portion of the joint capsule and the meniscotibial ligament - ramp lesion.
Along the posterior contour of the meniscus, several millimeter-sized ganglion cysts are seen.
Early degenerative altered signal intensity of the remaining portion of the medial meniscus.
Minor extrusion of part of the disc into the meniscotibial recess.
The lateral meniscus shows no signs of degeneration or tear.
The posterior cruciate ligament shows normal signal and is intact in continuity.
The lateral and medial collateral ligaments show normal signal and are intact in continuity.
Mild tendinopathic changes at the insertion of the quadriceps tendon.
Normal appearance of the patellar ligament.
No signs of a popliteal cyst.

Knee pain (gonalgia).

Medial femorotibial chondropathy grade 1-2.
Mild distal quadriceps and proximal patellar tendinosis.
Probable posteromedial knee friction phenomena.

translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1 pulse sequences, proton density with fat signal suppression, and T2 gradient echo.

FINDINGS
From the examination of the anterior compartment, a single superficial erosion of the articular cartilage of the medial surface of the patella is observed, without other lesions.
In the medial compartment, subarticular bone marrow edema and accompanying undulating erosions of the articular cartilage are identified, located on the surface of the medial femoral condyle and to a greater degree on the surface of the medial tibial condyle (ICRS grade 3), and presence of small marginal osteophytes on the medial tibial plateau.
The medial meniscus shows degeneration and subluxation.
A significant amount of joint effusion and synovitis is noted.
From the examination of the lateral compartment and the lateral collateral and cruciate ligaments, no significant pathological findings are noted.

CONCLUSION
Degenerative osteoarthritis of the medial compartment of the right knee with degenerative tear of the medial meniscus and joint effusion.

report: МР находка: МР данни за дегенеративна промяна и скъсване на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Менисусът е с повишен сигнален интензитет, като в него се вижда хиперинтензна линия с радиерен ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Скъсването достига до края на венискуса и до ставната повърхност на тибията. Свързана с менискуса се визуализира и малка киста с размер 5мм. МР данни за костно-мозъчен едем в медиалните кондили на фемура и на тибията, както и в главата на фибулата. Изобразените кости са с нормална форма. Наличие на малък ставен излив. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус.  Не се намират изменения в ставния хрущял. Предната кръстна връзка се вижда по цялото си протежение, но същата е с повишен интензитет на сигнала и леко намален напречник – находка предполагаща частично, минимално скъсване с давност. Задна кръстна връзка – без особености. Колатерални лигаменти – нормално изобразяване. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – б.о. .МР данни за малка Бекерова киста. Вижда се обособена течна колекция между сухожилията на м. семимемрбанозус и семитендинозус. Заключение:  МР данни за grade III лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Малка киста на менискуса. Частично скъсване на предната кръстна връзка. Костно-мозъчен едем в медиалните кондили на фемура, тибията и в главата на фибулата. Малък ставен излив. Малка Бекерова киста.
translation:
MR findings: MR findings of degenerative change and tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. The meniscus shows increased signal intensity, with a hyperintense line of radial course corresponding to a tear. The tear extends to the edge of the meniscus and to the articular surface of the tibia. A small cyst measuring 5 mm is visualized in association with the meniscus. MR findings of bone marrow edema in the medial condyles of the femur and tibia, as well as in the head of the fibula. The visualized bones are of normal shape. Presence of a small joint effusion. Normal appearance of the lateral meniscus. No changes are found in the articular cartilage. The anterior cruciate ligament is visualized along its entire length, but it shows increased signal intensity and slightly reduced diameter – a finding suggesting a partial, minimal chronic tear. Posterior cruciate ligament – unremarkable. Collateral ligaments – normal appearance. Retinacula – unremarkable. Quadriceps femoris tendon and patellar ligament – unremarkable. MR findings of a small Baker's cyst. A well-defined fluid collection is seen between the tendons of the semimembranosus and semitendinosus muscles.
Conclusion: MR findings of grade III lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Small meniscal cyst. Partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. Bone marrow edema in the medial condyles of the femur, tibia, and in the head of the fibula. Small joint effusion. Small Baker's cyst.

Interprétation:

Petit épanchement intra-articulaire. Il n'y a pas de kyste de Baker significatif. 

Il y a de légères anomalies de signal iso-intense au sein de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne suggérant des changements mucoïdes dégénératifs. Il n'y a pas déchirure au ménisque interne notée. 

Il y a un léger épaississement du ligament collatéral interne avec un léger oedème au pourtour, en lien avec une entorse de grade I. 

Légère atténuation diffuse des surfaces chondrales au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne en lien avec une légère chondropathie. Il n'y a pas d'atteinte transfixiante ou changement sous-chondral réactionnel associé.

Déchirure légèrement complexe du ménisque externe avec déchirure longitudinale horizontale s'étendant de la jonction de la corne postérieure et du corps méniscal à la corne antérieure de même qu'un aspect macéré à la jonction de la corne antérieure et de la racine antérieure. 

Le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe est intact sans déchirure. Légère délamination à la jonction du tendon du biceps femoris et du ligament fibulo-collatéral.

Légère atténuation des surfaces chondrales au compartiment fémoral-tibial interne en lien avec une légère chondropathie. Foyer de chondropathie de grade III à la surface non portante au versant postérieur du condyle fémoral externe avec fissures chondrales transfixiantes notées sans changement sous-chondral réactionnel associé.

Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure.

L'alignement patello-fémoral paraît dans les limites normales. Enthésophyte à l'insertion distale du tendon du quadriceps et à l'origine du tendon patellaire avec légère enthésopathie et tendinose. Il n'y a pas de déchirure. 

Légère atténuation diffuse des surfaces chondrales au compartiment patello-fémoral en lien avec une légère chondropathie. 

Conclusion:

Déchirure légère complexe du ménisque externe avec composante principale longitudinale horizontale, telle que détaillée ci-haut.

Entorse de grade I du ligament collatéral interne.

Légère chondropathie tricompartimentale diffuse avec foyer de chondropathie de grade III, le long de la surface non portante au versant postérieur du condyle fémoral externe.
translation:
Interpretation:

Small intra-articular effusion. There is no significant Baker's cyst.

There are mild iso-intense signal abnormalities within the posterior horn of the medial meniscus suggesting degenerative mucoid changes. No tear of the medial meniscus is noted.

There is mild thickening of the medial collateral ligament with mild surrounding edema, consistent with a grade I sprain.

Mild diffuse attenuation of the chondral surfaces in the medial femorotibial compartment consistent with mild chondropathy. There is no full-thickness defect or associated reactive subchondral change.

Slightly complex tear of the lateral meniscus with a horizontal longitudinal tear extending from the junction of the posterior horn and meniscal body to the anterior horn, as well as a macerated appearance at the junction of the anterior horn and the anterior root.

The lateral collateral ligament complex is intact without tear. Mild delamination at the junction of the biceps femoris tendon and the fibular collateral ligament.

Mild attenuation of the chondral surfaces in the medial femorotibial compartment consistent with mild chondropathy. Focus of grade III chondropathy at the non-weight-bearing surface on the posterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle with full-thickness chondral fissures noted without associated reactive subchondral change.

The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact without tear.

Patellofemoral alignment appears within normal limits. Enthesophyte at the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon and at the origin of the patellar tendon with mild enthesopathy and tendinosis. There is no tear.

Mild diffuse attenuation of the chondral surfaces in the patellofemoral compartment consistent with mild chondropathy.

Conclusion:

Mildly complex tear of the lateral meniscus with a main horizontal longitudinal component, as detailed above.

Grade I sprain of the medial collateral ligament.

Mild diffuse tricompartmental chondropathy with a focus of grade III chondropathy along the non-weight-bearing surface on the posterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle.

Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala medijalnog
kolateralnog ligamenta, stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa i patelarnog
ligamenta.
Kompletna ruptura prednjeg križnog ligamenta u području hvatišta za femur. Dio vlakana
položen je interkondilarno posteriorno uz medijalni kondil femura, može ograničavati kretnje u

meniska interkondilarno posteriorno uz PCL, promjera oko 9 mm, može ograničavati kretnje u
zglobu.
Patela je lateroponirana, Wiberg 3. Kut lateralne trohlearne inklinacije iznosi 16°.
Primjerena je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice femoropatelarnog zgloba. Manja fisura hrskavice
medijalne fasete patele uz subhondralni edem - hondromalacija 4. stupnja.
Reducirana je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice femorotibijalnog zgloba, izrežnije medijalnog
kompartmenta uz promjene tipa hondromalacije 2. stupnja, a u posteriornom dijelu medijalnog
kondila vidljiv manji defekt artikulacijske hrskavice duljine do 2 mm uz subhondralni edem -
hondromalacija 4. stupnja.
Entezopatske promjene proksimalnog hvatišta lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta, bez znakova
rupture.
Entezopatske promjene hvatišta tetive m. quadriceps za patelu.

intenziteta signala.
translation:
On the series of MR images of the right knee, there is normal morphology and signal intensity of the medial collateral ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, iliotibial tract, and patellar ligament.
Complete rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament at the femoral attachment. A portion of the fibers is displaced intercondylarly posteriorly along the medial femoral condyle, which may limit joint motion.
The lateral meniscus is of normal morphology and signal intensity.
Complex tear of the posterior horn and part of the body of the medial meniscus with a globular-shaped meniscal flap displaced intercondylarly posteriorly along the PCL, measuring approximately 9 mm in diameter, which may limit joint motion.
The patella is laterally displaced, Wiberg type 3. The lateral trochlear inclination angle measures 16°.
The articular cartilage thickness of the patellofemoral joint is adequate. A small fissure of the cartilage of the medial patellar facet with subchondral edema – grade 4 chondromalacia.
The articular cartilage thickness of the femorotibial joint is reduced, more pronounced in the medial compartment with grade 2 chondromalacia-type changes, and in the posterior part of the medial condyle a small articular cartilage defect up to 2 mm in length is visible with subchondral edema – grade 4 chondromalacia.
Enthesopathic changes at the proximal attachment of the lateral collateral ligament, without signs of rupture.
Enthesopathic changes at the attachment of the quadriceps tendon to the patella.
A large knee joint effusion. No popliteal (Baker's) cyst is found.
The other visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

There is peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body, with inferiorly surfacing oblique tear. Intrasubstance degeneration within the posterior horn and anterior horn without additional tear is. The posterior root is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

There is thinning of articular cartilage overlying the medial patellar facet with focal full thickness cartilage denuding. There is generalized thinning of trochlear articular cartilage. There is generalized thinning of medial femorotibial articular cartilage with focal areas of full-thickness cartilage denuding at the periphery of the medial femoral condyle. There is thinning of articular cartilage overlying the lateral tibial plateau.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. Superficial varicosities at the posterior medial aspect of the knee.

3. Popliteus tendinosis without tear.
4. Tricompartment chondrosis most pronounced involving the medial femorotibial compartment consistent with moderate medial compartment predominant osteoarthritis of right knee.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. Superficial varicosities at the posterior medial aspect of the knee.

IMPRESSION:
1. Inferiorly subtle tear involving the medial meniscal body without new meniscal extrusion.
2. Suspected partial-thickness tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament without patellofemoral subluxation.
3. Popliteus tendinosis without tear.
4. Tricompartment chondrosis most pronounced involving the medial femorotibial compartment consistent with moderate medial compartment predominant osteoarthritis of right knee.

report: МР находка: МР данни за изразени дегенеративни промени на дясната колянна става. Ставният хрущял от медиалната страна е износен изцяло. Изобразява се костномозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на фемура и тибията. МР данни за големи остеофити по ставните повърхности на медиалните кондили на фемура и тибията. Сравнително по-малки остеофити се визуалиизрат по ставните краища от латералната страна. Наличе на малък ставен излив. Медиалният менискус е дегенеративно променен и е фрагментиран в областта на задния рог. Медиалният менискус е с висок сигнален интензитет, като голяма част от него е изместена навън от ставната междина. До менискуса и свързана с него се изобразява голяма, мултилокуларна киста с размер около 50мм. Кистата измества встрани ставната капсула. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Ставният хрущял от латералната страна на ставата е сравнително запазен. Кръстните връзки са интактни. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. МР данни за хондромалация на пателата – 3-та степен. Патела бипартита. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Вижда се малка Бекерова киста в поплитеалната ямка. Заключение: МР данни за гонартрозни промени, изразени от медиалната страна на ставата. МР данни за дегенеративна промяна и лезия на медиалния менискус. Голяма киста на медиалния менискус. Хондромалация на пателата – 3-та степен. Малък ставен излив. Малка Бекерова киста.

translation:

There is mild thinning and superficial fibrillation of the cartilage in the medial and lateral compartments. There is no region of full-thickness cartilage loss.

There are intrasubstance degenerative changes involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus without tear. The lateral meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise, the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the semimembranosus, the popliteus muscle and tendon, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament, and the iliotibial band are unremarkable.

Conclusion:

1. Mild degenerative changes involving all three compartments of the knee without region of full-thickness cartilage loss.

2. Intrasubstance degenerative changes of the medial meniscus without well-defined linear tear.

3. Small intra-articular effusion without popliteal cyst.

report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femorotibyal ve patellofemoral eklem yüzeylerinde belirgin olup medyal femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki geniş tam kat kondral kayıp, tibyal plato medyalindeki %50'yi aşan segmenter kondral incelme, patella apeksindeki kondral fissür ve troklear kıkırdak medyali ve orta kesimindeki %50'ye ulaşan geniş kondral incelmeler, subkortikal medüller fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve hipertrofik marjinal osteofitler ile karakterize. Lateral menisküsteki dejenerasyona gövdesi düzeyindeki serbest kenar küntleşmesi eşlik ediyor (milimetrik radyal yırtık açısından şüpheli). Medyal menisküs gövdesi düzeyinde horizontal longitudinal yırtık izleniyor. Medyal menisküs medyale 4,5 ekstrüde. Ekstrüde menisküs iç yan bağı basılıyor ve iç yan bağın çevresi ödemli. Patellar tendonun patellaya ve tibyaya yapışma yerleri düzeyinde kısa segment tendonozis gözleniyor. Install-Salvati oranı 0,6 hesaplanmış olup patella aşağı konumlu. Ekstensör mekanizma bunların dışında korunmuş. Gastroknemyus semimembranozis bursasındaki 6 cm maksimum boyutta sıvı lokülasyonu 1 cm kalınlıkta ve sızdırmıyor. Medyal ve lateral gastroknemius kaslarnın origoları çevresindeki gangliyon kistlerinin büyüğü 1,4 cm toplam boyuta ulaşıyor. Ön çapraz > arka çapraz bağlarda mukoid dejenerasyon gözleniyor. translation: The amount of intra-articular fluid in the knee joint is mildly increased. Tricompartmental degenerative joint disease of the knee is prominent at the medial femorotibial and patellofemoral joint surfaces, characterized by extensive full-thickness cartilage loss at the weight-bearing surface of the medial femoral condyle, segmental cartilage thinning exceeding 50% at the medial tibial plateau, a cartilage fissure at the apex of the patella, extensive cartilage thinning up to 50% at the medial and central portions of the trochlear cartilage, subcortical medullary fibrovascular changes, and hypertrophic marginal osteophytes. Degeneration of the lateral meniscus is accompanied by free edge blunting at the body level (suspicious for a millimetric radial tear). A horizontal longitudinal tear is seen at the body level of the medial meniscus. The medial meniscus is extruded 4.5 mm medially. The extruded meniscus is compressing the medial collateral ligament, and the surrounding area of the medial collateral ligament is edematous. Short-segment tendinosis is observed at the patellar and tibial insertion sites of the patellar tendon. The Insall-Salvati ratio is calculated as 0.6, and the patella is in a low position (patella baja). The extensor mechanism is otherwise preserved. A fluid loculation in the gastrocnemius-semimembranosus bursa measures up to 6 cm in maximum dimension, is 1 cm in thickness, and is not leaking. The largest of the ganglion cysts around the origins of the medial and lateral gastrocnemius muscles reaches a total size of 1.4 cm. Mucoid degeneration is observed in the anterior cruciate > posterior cruciate ligaments. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST

Indication: Left knee pain

report:
MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    [Age] female for right knee pain that is functional impairment. Mild OA on x-ray, but pain persistent/worsening.   .

PRIOR IMAGING: Bilateral knee ultrasound [Date].
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism are intact. The patellar cartilage is intact. The trochlear cartilage is intact. The patellar soft tissues normal.

The TT-TG interval measures 5 mm, within normal limits.

The anterior cruciate, posterior cruciate, medial collateral and lateral collateral ligament is complex, including the fibular lateral collateral ligament, iliotibial band, biceps femoris and popliteus tendons, are intact. No significant anterior tibial translation. Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament.

Medial meniscus is intact.  Articular cartilage of the medial femoral condyle is uniformly reduced in thickness.

Lateral meniscus anterior horn complex radial tear, posterior horn radial tear. Articular cartilage lateral of the femoral condyle is uniformly reduced in thickness.

Small suprapatellar knee joint effusion. 1.5 x 1.5 x 3.9 cm Baker's cyst.

Marrow signal is normal. Soft tissues is normal. Bone-on-bone articulation in the lateral compartment.

INTERPRETATION: 
Lateral meniscus anterior and posterior horn radial tears. Notably, the anterior horn demonstrates a complex radial tear while the posterior horn demonstrates a simple radial tear.

Uniform thinning of the bilateral femoral condyle articular cartilage, likely age-related etiology.

Baker's cyst. Bone-on-bone articulation in the lateral compartment.

There is no retinacular discontinuity. Minimal fluid increase is observed in the suprapatellar bursa and knee joint space. A Baker's cyst measuring 2.5x1 cm is observed in the popliteal fossa. CONCLUSION: Grade II meniscopathy in the medial meniscus. Myxoid degeneration in the anterior cruciate ligament. Grade I sprain in the medial collateral ligament. Baker's cyst in the popliteal fossa.

report: Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femoral tibyal kompartmanda en belirgin ve tam kata ulaşan eklem kıkırdağı kaybı ve dejenerasyonu, subkondral medüller fibrokistik ve fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı orta derecede artmış. Suprapatellar reses düzeyinde yoğun içerikle uyumlu intensite değişiklikleri-septasyonlar izleniyor. Medyale 7 mm ekstrüde medyal menisküs arka kökü tam kat yırtılmış ve arka boynuzu 13 mm kadar medyale yer değiştirmiş. Medyal menisküs dejenere ve gövdesi düzeyinde horizontal yırtık bileşenleri de izleniyor. Lateral menisküs dejenerasyonu serbest kenardaki püsküllenme tarzında yırtıkla birlikte. Tibyal plato medyalindeki geniş kemik iliği ödemi kotuzyonel ya da ince bir subkondral kırıkla ilintili olabilir. İç yan bağın çevresi ödemli ve femoral taraftan yüksek olasılıkla parsiyel yırtılmış. Medyal patellofemoral bağın patellar insersiyona yakın kesimi ödemli ve yüksek olasılıkla parsiyel yırtık eşlik ediyor. Diz eklemi çevresindeki yumuşak dokular hafifçe ödemli. Semimembronozus tendonozisi ileri derecede. Çapraz ve yan bağlar bunların dışında normal. Ekstensör mekanizma bunların dışında korunmuş.
translation: Tricompartmental degenerative joint disease of the knee, most prominent in the medial femorotibial compartment, characterized by full-thickness articular cartilage loss and degeneration, subchondral medullary fibrocystic and fibrovascular changes, and marginal osteophytes. The intra-articular fluid volume of the knee joint is moderately increased. At the level of the suprapatellar recess, intensity changes and septations consistent with complex content are observed. The medial meniscus is extruded 7 mm medially; the posterior root is completely torn, and the posterior horn is displaced up to 13 mm medially. The medial meniscus is degenerate, and horizontal tear components are also seen at the level of its body. Lateral meniscus degeneration with a fraying-type tear at the free edge. Extensive bone marrow edema in the medial tibial plateau may be related to contusion or a subtle subchondral fracture. The surrounding tissue of the medial collateral ligament is edematous, and it is most likely partially torn from the femoral side. The segment of the medial patellofemoral ligament near its patellar insertion is edematous, and a partial tear is most likely present. The soft tissues around the knee joint are mildly edematous. Semimembranosus tendinosis is advanced. The cruciate and collateral ligaments are otherwise normal. The extensor mechanism is otherwise intact.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Recurrent patellar subluxation.
Comparison: Left knee MRI [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic with exception of the patella. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion. Remodeling/flattening of the anterolateral distal femur.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: No tear.
Medial compartment cartilage: Intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal high-grade chondral fissuring and small area of delamination at the medial patellar facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Lateral patellar subluxation. Patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 28 mm, increased.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Progressive lateral patellar subluxation with secondary findings of lateral patellar maltracking, including superolateral Hoffa's fat pad impingement, patella alta, patellofemoral chondrosis, and chronic remodeling of the distal anterolateral femur. Increased TT-TG distance of 28 mm.
2.	No discrete MPFL or medial patellar retinaculum injury. However, the progressive patellar subluxation indicates some degree of MPFL/medial retinaculum deficiency.

report:
Trouvailles : 
Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité. 
Il y a changements dégénératifs modérés à sévères au niveau patellofémoral avec perte de cartilage complet à la facette médiale et à l’apex de la rotule avec changement réactif sous-chondral. Il y a aussi amincissement modéré à la partie médiale et centrale de la trochlée du fémur. Il y a légers changements dégénératifs avec léger amincissement et fibrillation superficielle du cartilage du compartiment interne et externe sans région de perte complète. 
Il y a changements dégénératifs intra-substance impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure oblique de la corne postérieure s’étendant à la surface articulaire inférieure du ménisque. Il n’y a pas de fragment méniscal déplacé. Il y a aussi changements dégénératifs intra-substance impliquant le ménisque externe avec une déchirure horizontale au niveau du corps. Il y a un important kyste para-méniscal multi-loculé adjacent au corps du ménisque. Le kyste mesure 1.3cm AP x 1.4cm transverse x 2.2cm cranio-caudal. Le kyste se retrouve antérieur au tendon du biceps fémoris distal et au ligament collatéral externe et postérieur à la bandelette ilio-tibiale. 
Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité. 
Conclusion : 
1. Changements dégénératifs modérés plus proéminents au niveau patellofémoral. 
2. Changements dégénératifs intra-substance avec déchirure au niveau des ménisques bilatéralement et important kyste para-méniscal du côté latéral tel que mentionné ci-haut. 
3. Petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.
translation:
Findings:
There is a small intra-articular effusion without a popliteal cyst.
There are moderate to severe degenerative changes at the patellofemoral compartment with full-thickness cartilage loss at the medial facet and apex of the patella with subchondral reactive change. There is also moderate thinning at the medial and central part of the femoral trochlea. There are mild degenerative changes with mild thinning and superficial fibrillation of the cartilage of the medial and lateral compartments without a region of full-thickness loss.
There are intrasubstance degenerative changes involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is an oblique tear of the posterior horn extending to the inferior articular surface of the meniscus. There is no displaced meniscal fragment. There are also intrasubstance degenerative changes involving the lateral meniscus with a horizontal tear at the body. There is a large multiloculated parameniscal cyst adjacent to the body of the meniscus. The cyst measures 1.3 cm AP x 1.4 cm transverse x 2.2 cm craniocaudal. The cyst is located anterior to the distal biceps femoris tendon and the lateral collateral ligament and posterior to the iliotibial band.
Otherwise, the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the semimembranosus, the popliteus muscle and tendon, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the iliotibial band are unremarkable.
Conclusion:
1. Moderate degenerative changes, most prominent at the patellofemoral compartment.
2. Intrasubstance degenerative changes with tears of the menisci bilaterally and a large parameniscal cyst on the lateral side as described above.
3. Small intra-articular effusion without a popliteal cyst.

translation: Mild increase in intra-articular fluid of the knee joint. Cruciate and collateral ligaments are normal. The degeneration in the lateral meniscus is not accompanied by a tear. Degeneration in the posterior horn–body of the medial meniscus is accompanied by a radial tear in the posterior horn and a horizontal oblique longitudinal tear at the posterior horn–body junction involving the inferior articular surface, with a displaced fragment into the meniscotibial recess. The extensor mechanism is intact. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal.

translation:
Clinical History:
Right knee trauma.
Findings:
Full-thickness and full-width tear of the mid-third of the ACL associated with bone edema of the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau and of the weight-bearing zone of the lateral femoral condyle with a small regional subcortical fracture.
PCL and medial collateral ligament without abnormalities.
Increased signal of the distal and mid portions of the lateral collateral ligament without signs of definite tear. This is associated with edema of the adjacent soft tissues. The remaining main components of the posterolateral corner without abnormalities.
Menisci appear with preserved morphology and signal, without definite criteria for tear.
Cartilage of the femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments without abnormalities.
Moderate joint effusion with mild synovitis. Laminar amount of intermuscular fluid in the popliteal region.
Quadriceps tendon, patellar tendon, pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Impression:
Full-thickness and full-width tear of the mid-third of the ACL associated with bone edema of the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau and of the weight-bearing zone of the lateral femoral condyle with a small regional subcortical fracture.
Signs of a low-grade sprain of the lateral collateral ligament. Edema of the adjacent soft tissues.
Moderate joint effusion with mild synovitis. Laminar amount of intermuscular fluid in the popliteal region.

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Aucune.

Normal.

Légère chondropatie des compartiments médial et latéral portants avec changements de signal mais sans fissuration profonde.

Normal.

Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.

Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : normal.

Ménisque médial : Normal.
Ménisque latéral : Normal.

Tendons extenseurs : Normal.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normal.
Pes anserinus : Normal.

Coin postéro-médial et postéro-latéral : Normal.

Épanchement articulaire : Pas de liquide significatif.
Kyste de Baker : Petit kyste de Baker non compliqué.

Autres trouvailles significatives :
Amas de calcifications millimétriques du côté postérieur médial de la partie proximale du condyle fémoral médial, situé en partie dans et autour de l'origine dorsale la plus proximale du ligament collatéral médial, et juste en médial du bord médial de l'origine du gastrocnémien médial. Il y a un œdème des tissus mous environnants.

CONCLUSION :
Petit amas de calcifications avec œdème réactionnel des tissus mous en arrière du condyle fémoral médial associé à l'origine postérieure du ligament collatéral médial et à proximité du bord médial de l'origine du muscle/tendon gastrocnémien médial. Il s'agit très probablement d'un dépôt d'hydroxyapatite accompagné d'une inflammation réactionnelle, probablement la source de la douleur. Pour la corrélation clinique, une injection de corticostéroïdes pourrait être réalisée sous guidage échographique si nécessaire.
Pas de signe de déchirure méniscale ou ligamentaire.
translation:
FINDINGS:

Fractures:
None.

Joint alignment:
Normal.

Degenerative changes:
Mild chondropathy of the medial and lateral weight-bearing compartments with signal changes but without deep fissuring.

Bone marrow signal:
Normal.

Anterior cruciate ligament: Normal.
Posterior cruciate ligament: Normal.
Medial collateral ligament: Mild proximal thickening compatible with sequelae of a prior low-grade sprain.
Lateral collateral ligament complex: Normal.

Medial meniscus: Normal.
Lateral meniscus: Normal.

Extensor tendons: Normal.
Patellar retinacula: Normal.
Pes anserinus: Normal.

Posteromedial and posterolateral corners: Normal.

Joint effusion: No significant fluid.
Baker's cyst: Small uncomplicated Baker's cyst.

Other significant findings:
Cluster of millimetric calcifications on the posteromedial side of the proximal portion of the medial femoral condyle, located partly within and around the most proximal dorsal origin of the medial collateral ligament, and just medial to the medial border of the origin of the medial gastrocnemius. There is edema of the surrounding soft tissues.

CONCLUSION:
Small cluster of calcifications with reactive soft tissue edema posterior to the medial femoral condyle, associated with the posterior origin of the medial collateral ligament and in proximity to the medial border of the origin of the medial gastrocnemius muscle/tendon. This most likely represents a hydroxyapatite deposit accompanied by reactive inflammation, probably the source of pain. For clinical correlation, a corticosteroid injection could be performed under ultrasound guidance if needed.
No sign of meniscal or ligamentous tear.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 5 to 6 months of aching sharp constant pain at the front of the knee
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the posterior horn and body with dominant horizontal oblique component. Mild extrusion and displacement into the meniscotibial recess.
Medial compartment cartilage: High-grade cartilage thinning in the central weightbearing femoral condyle and reciprocal tibial surface.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal cartilage fissuring at the medial patellar facet adjacent to the median ridge.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema related to adjacent meniscal pathology.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Mild edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Complex tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with dominant horizontal oblique component. Mild extrusion and displacement into the meniscotibial recess.

2. Moderate medial compartment and minimal patellofemoral chondrosis.

3. Probable lateral patellofemoral maltracking with impingement of Hoffa's fat.

4. Small Baker's cyst.

RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings:
The lateral meniscus is normal. Grade II degeneration is observed in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Signal increases compatible with an interstitial tear are present in the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Increased effusion and an appearance consistent with a plica are present in the lateral recess.

report:

Knorpel: Streifige fokale Signalanhebung des retropatellaren Knorpels am Patellafirst (4/15). Fokal bis tiefgreifende Chondropathie der Trochlea (4/23). Keine wesentliche Chondropathie femorotibial. 
Menisci: Flaue Signalanhebung des Innenmeniskushinterhornes mit V.a. horizontale Rissbildung (6/8). Schräge Rissbildung des Außenmeniskusvorderhornes mit Austritt der Rissbildung an die tibiale Gelenkfläche (5/18). Intaktes Außenmeniskushinterhorn. 
Bänder/Sehnen/Kapsel/Gelenkraum: Intakte Darstellung des vorderen und hinteren Kreuzbandes. Mediales und laterales Kollateralband intakt. Bds. intakte menisceale Aufhängung. Gelenkkapsel nicht verdickt, kein wesentlicher Gelenkerguss. Keine freien intraartikulären Gelenkkörper. Patellarsehne und Quadricepssehne intakt.

Cartilage: Linear focal signal increase of the retropatellar cartilage at the patellar ridge (4/15). Focal to deep chondropathy of the trochlea (4/23). No significant femorotibial chondropathy.
Menisci: Faint signal increase of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus with suspicion of horizontal tear (6/8). Oblique tear of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus with extension of the tear to the tibial articular surface (5/18). Intact posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
Ligaments/Tendons/Capsule/Joint space: Intact appearance of the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments. Medial and lateral collateral ligaments intact. Bilaterally intact meniscal attachments. Joint capsule not thickened, no significant joint effusion. No free intra-articular bodies. Patellar tendon and quadriceps tendon intact.
Soft tissues: Unremarkable.
