tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Prednji križni ligament je blaže inhomognog prikaza i promijenjenog intenziteta signala, moguće
stanje po distenziji - blaža mukoidna degeneracija.
Medijalni i lateralni menisk uredne su morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Primjerena je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice femorotibijalnog i femoropatelarnog zgloba.
Hondromalacija patelarne hrskavice II°.
Patela je medioponirana, Wiberg 2 početno višeg položaja (Insall-Salvati indeks iznosi 1,3).
Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.
translation:
On the series of MR images of the right knee, normal morphology and signal intensity of the collateral ligaments, posterior cruciate ligament, iliotibial tract, patellar tendon, and quadriceps tendon are noted.
The anterior cruciate ligament is mildly inhomogeneous in appearance with altered signal intensity, possibly post-distension – mild mucoid degeneration.
The medial and lateral menisci are of normal morphology and signal intensity.
Adequate thickness of the articular cartilage of the femorotibial and femoropatellar joint is noted.
Chondromalacia of the patellar cartilage grade II.
The patella is medially positioned, Wiberg type 2, initially in a higher position (Insall-Salvati index is 1.3).
No popliteal (Baker's) cyst is found.
The other visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

Trace knee joint fluid. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits.

2. Mild to moderate patellofemoral chondrosis suggesting evolving patellofemoral osteoarthritis.

No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Patellofemoral and medial tibiofemoral compartment chondrosis.

Bones: Previously observed T2 weighted bright lesion located at the anteromedial distal femoral metadiaphysis shows no significant interval change in size. It currently measures approximately 1.1 cm x 1.4 cm x 1.6 cm in size. It has lobulated margins that shows a narrow zone of transition. No adjacent marrow edema is seen. No abnormal soft tissue component, cortical break nor abnormal periosteal reaction detected. Imaging findings are highly suggestive of a nonaggressive bony lesion, top differential diagnoses include a small bone cyst or a small or intraosseous ganglion. Interval increase in edema is also seen at the anterior medial tibia close to the insertion of the meniscal root, possibly due to traction or intraosseous ganglion. No fracture, stress reaction, or other osseous lesion is seen.

Lateral compartment: Mild chondrosis.

Others:

Hoffa's fat pad: clear

Muscles: No abnormal oedema. 

Neurovascular bundle: Normal 


COMMENT
Previously described T2 weighted bright lesion at the anterior aspect of the distal femoral metadiaphysis shows no significant with change compared with prior study, probably represents a nonaggressive lesion such as a small bone cyst or an intraosseous ganglion.

Minimal to mild chondrosis of the tibiofemoral joint and patellofemoral joint are similar to prior study.

Interval increase in edema is seen at the anteromedial tibia adjacent to the insertion of the anterior medial meniscal root, may represent an intraosseous ganglion.

report: Partialläsion des MCL bei durchgängig erhaltener Bandstruktur jedoch deutlich vermehrt umgebender Flüssigkeit. Deutlich Knochenmarködem in der ventrolateralen Femurkondyle am Ansatz des Tractus iliotibialis und anterolateralen Bandes und umgebend Flüssigkeit zum Tractus iliotibialis ohne fassbare Diskontinuität der Bandstrukturen DD bei Partialläsion. Gelenkerguss. Mukoide Degeneration des Innenmeniskus im Pars intermedia und Hinterhorn ohne Rissbildung. Oberflächliche retropatellare Chondropathie. Darüber hinaus keine wesentliche Chondropathie. Diskretes subchondrales Knochenmarködem im dorsomedialen Tibiaplateau DD a.e. degenerativ.
translation: Partial lesion of the MCL with continuously preserved ligament structure but significantly increased surrounding fluid. Significant bone marrow edema in the ventrolateral femoral condyle at the insertion of the iliotibial tract and anterolateral ligament, with surrounding fluid adjacent to the iliotibial tract, without detectable discontinuity of the ligament structures, DD partial lesion. Joint effusion. Mucoid degeneration of the medial meniscus in the pars intermedia and posterior horn without tear. Superficial retropatellar chondropathy. Beyond that, no significant chondropathy. Discrete subchondral bone marrow edema in the dorsomedial tibial plateau, DD most likely degenerative.

Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih
ligamenata, stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta i tetive m.
kvadricepsa.
Blago su trakasto povišeni intenziteti signala prednjeg križnog ligamenta, izraženije pri tibijalnoj
inserciji što može odgovarati tendinitisu, bez jasnih znakova rupture.
Ruptura prednjeg roga lateralnog meniska s manjim izljevom koji se pruža lateralno uz
artikulacijske plohe. Manja perimeniscealna cista.
Medijalni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Hondromalacija II./III. stupnja lateralnog platoa tibije sa stanjenom hrskavicom.
Blagi koštani edem uz interkondilarnu fosu.
Ostale prikazane artikulacijske hrskavice urednih su intenziteta signala.
Manji izljev suprakondilarno te minimalno infrakondilarno, u lateralnom patelarnom retinakulumu i uz
stražnju medijalnu femoralnu plohu.
Fragmentirana Bakerova cista veličine 13 i 9 mm koje su komuniciraju preko uskog vrata.
translation:
On the series of MR images of the right knee, there is normal morphology and signal intensity of the collateral ligaments, posterior cruciate ligament, iliotibial tract, patellar ligament, and quadriceps tendon.
Mildly increased linear signal intensity of the anterior cruciate ligament, more pronounced at the tibial insertion, which may correspond to tendinitis, without clear signs of rupture.
Tear of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a small effusion extending laterally along the articular surfaces. Small perimeniscal cyst.
The medial meniscus is of normal morphology and signal intensity.
Grade II/III chondromalacia of the lateral tibial plateau with cartilage thinning.
Mild bone edema along the intercondylar fossa.
The other visualized articular cartilages are of normal signal intensity.
Small effusion suprapatellarly and minimally infrapatellarly, in the lateral patellar retinaculum and along the posterior medial femoral surface.
Fragmented Baker's cyst measuring 13 and 9 mm, which communicate via a narrow neck.

Patela bipartita tip 3 kao anatomska varijanta.

translation:

Complex tear of the lateral meniscus with a horizontal component in the region of the meniscal body reaching the inferior articular surface, extending into the posterior horn as a shallow radial tear of the meniscal apex.
The medial meniscus is of normal morphology and signal intensity.
Focal cartilage malacia of both patellar facets (chondromalacia grade 1b according to the ICRS classification).
The articular cartilages are of normal signal intensity.
Bipartite patella type 3 as an anatomical variant.
Minimal amount of effusion in the knee. No Baker's cyst is found.
The other visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

report: МР находка: Минимален ставен излив. Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става се изобразяват с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Няма данни за костномозъчен едем. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и в по-голяма степен на тибията е изтънен от страната на медиалното тибиално плато. Двете кръстни връзки се проследяват до залавните си места с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. МР данни за лезии на медиален и латерален менискус – тип 2а. Нормално изобразяване на колатералните лигаменти. Ретинакулуми – без особености. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на меките тъкани на лявото коляно. Заключение: МР данни за лезии на медиален и латерален менискус – тип 2а. Минимален ставен излив.
translation: MRI findings: Minimal joint effusion. The bones forming the left knee joint are depicted with homogeneous structure and signal intensity. No evidence of bone marrow edema. Both cruciate ligaments are traced to their attachment sites with normal shape and signal intensity. MRI evidence of lesions of the medial and lateral meniscus – type 2a. translation:
Clinical History:
Hip contusion, medial sprain of the left knee.
Findings:
No significant bone marrow alterations.
Cruciate ligaments and lateral collateral ligament without alterations. Thickening and increased signal of the superficial component of the medial collateral ligament with partial loss of continuity of its proximal fibers. This is associated with regional soft tissue edema. The remaining components of the medial ligamentous complex are without alterations.
Central increased signal of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus that does not appear to contact the articular surface, without features of a tear. The lateral meniscus has preserved morphology and signal, without signs of tear.
Partial and full-thickness chondral ulcers of the weight-bearing zone of both femoral condyles, without secondary bone changes. Superficial chondropathy of the tibial plateaus. Full-thickness chondral ulcers of the femoral trochlea with mild secondary bone changes. Superficial patellar chondropathy.
Mild joint effusion. Small uncomplicated popliteal cyst.
Quadriceps tendon, pes anserinus tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Mild increased signal of the proximal aspect of the patellar tendon, without signs of tear.
Impression:
Grade II sprain of the superficial component of the medial collateral ligament.
Chondropathy with grade 3 lesions of both femoral condyles and the femoral trochlea.
Superficial chondropathy of the tibial plateaus and the patella.
Mild joint effusion. Small uncomplicated popliteal cyst.
Mild proximal patellar tendinosis.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: Right knee MRI [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis with low-grade interstitial tear involving less than 20% of the cross-sectional area in a similar distribution as the prior study. Mild peritendinitis and edema in the quadriceps fat.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Acute on chronic distal quadriceps tendinitis with low-grade interstitial tearing involving less than 20% of the cross-sectional area.

report:
Uznapredovale goanrtrotske promjene uz opsežan zglobni izljev i umjerenu proliferaciju sinovije.
Zone rekonverzijhe koštane srži u metafizi femura.
Denudacija hrskavice medijalnog kompartmenta FT zgloba te fisure i erozije hrskavica lateralnog
kompartmenta.
Hondromalacija III° obje fasete patele i trohleje femura, uz reduciranu debljinu navedenih
hrskavica te opsežne osteofite FP zgloba - opisano u sklopu navedenih OA promjena.
Prikazana zglobna tijela primjereno su uzglobljena.
Kompleksna ruptura oba meniska uz obostrano ekstruziju oko 5 mm, oba meniska značajno
degenerativno promijenjena.
Potpuna ruptura prednjeg križnog ligamenta.
Stražnji križni ligament u proksimalne 2/3 izrazito edematozan, zadebljan (širine 12 mm), uz
tibijalno hvatište nalazi se više ganglion cisti promjera do 7 mm. - dif. dg. uslijed
uznapredovalih degenerativnih promjena ili parcijalne rupture starijeg datuma.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament je vretenasto zadebljan pri hvatištu na lateralni epikondil femura te
promijenjenog intenziteta signala pri hvatištu na glavu fibule, moguće stanje po ranijoj
parcijalnoj rupturi ili uslijed entezopatskih promjena.
Medijalni kolateralni ligament je vretenasto zadebljan pri hvatištu na medijalni epikondil femura
uz periligamentarni edem, vjerojatno uslijed entezopatskih promjena.
Tetiva popliteusa edemazotna, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala, u smislu tendinopatije.
Uredan prikaz iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.

translation:
Advanced gonarthrotic changes with extensive joint effusion and moderate synovial proliferation.
Bone marrow reconversion zones in the femoral metaphysis.
Cartilage denudation of the medial compartment of the femorotibial joint and fissures and erosions of the cartilage of the lateral compartment.
Chondromalacia grade III of both patellar facets and the femoral trochlea, with reduced thickness of the aforementioned cartilages and extensive osteophytes of the patellofemoral joint – described as part of the aforementioned OA changes.
The visualized articular bodies are appropriately articulated.
Complex tear of both menisci with bilateral extrusion of approximately 5 mm, both menisci significantly degenerative.
Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
The posterior cruciate ligament is markedly edematous in its proximal 2/3, thickened (width 12 mm), with multiple ganglion cysts up to 7 mm in diameter at the tibial insertion. – Differential diagnosis: due to advanced degenerative changes or an older partial tear.
The lateral collateral ligament is fusiformly thickened at its insertion on the lateral femoral epicondyle and shows altered signal intensity at its insertion on the fibular head, possibly representing a prior partial tear or enthesopathic changes.
The medial collateral ligament is fusiformly thickened at its insertion on the medial femoral epicondyle with periligamentous edema, likely due to enthesopathic changes.
The popliteus tendon is edematous with altered signal intensity, consistent with tendinopathy.
Normal appearance of the iliotibial tract and pes anserinus.
The quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament show altered signal intensity at their insertions on the patella, with maintained continuity – enthesopathic changes.
The patellar retinacula are intact.
Popliteal cyst measuring 5 mm in diameter.

translation:
Clinical History:
Right knee pain under investigation.
Obs. Medial collateral ligament injury versus medial meniscus.
Findings:
Joint effusion within physiological limits.
No pathological focal or diffuse bone marrow signal abnormalities.
Edema and fluid surrounding the medial patellar retinaculum and regional patellofemoral ligament with extension toward the medial ligamentous complex, showing mild thickening and discrete increased signal of the proximal aspect of the superficial component with partial disruption. Deep component is continuous, without abnormalities.
Patellar cartilage of normal thickness with subtotal-thickness ulcerations, greater than 50%, on the medial facet.
Increased intrasubstance signal in the central aspect of the femoral trochlea. Cartilage irregularity on the lateral tibial plateau with full-thickness ulceration and subtle adjacent secondary bone reaction. Remaining cartilage in both femorotibial compartments and at the proximal tibiofibular joint is of normal thickness and signal, without focal lesions.
Cruciate ligaments and lateral collateral ligament are unremarkable.
Menisci with preserved morphology and signal, no suspicious criteria for tear.
Distal and medial thickening of the quadriceps tendon fibers adjacent to the superior pole of the patella. Distal thickening and increased signal of the patellar tendon adjacent to its insertion on the anterior tibial tuberosity. Remaining regional tendons are unremarkable.
No popliteal cyst. Muscle planes with adequate trophism and signal.
Impression:
Signs of grade I-II sprain of the superficial component at the proximal level of the medial collateral ligament and marginal involvement toward the medial patellar retinaculum / medial patellofemoral ligament. Patellar chondropathy with focal grade 2-3 ulcerations on the medial facet. Increased intrasubstance signal in the central aspect of the femoral trochlea. Grade 3-4 chondropathy on the weight-bearing surface of the lateral tibial plateau. Mild distal quadriceps and patellar tendinosis.

translation: [DATE]: MRI Knee Left 15ch AA: Clinical information: joint pain left knee, after fall, menisci, without limping or giving way. Diagnostic question: Suspected sprain of the medial knee ligament. Findings: Normal appearance of the medial collateral ligament. Normal appearance of the cruciate ligaments and lateral collateral ligament. Normal appearance of the menisci. Polylobulated cyst posterior to the distal femur, superior to the medial femoral condyle, extending into the popliteal fossa with maximum dimensions 38 x 35 x 20~mm, originating at the level of / distally between the medial gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus: Baker's cyst. Conclusion: - Voluminous retrofemoral Baker's cyst. - Early patellar cartilage disease with isolated fissure on the medial facet of the patella (grade 2), currently with minimal joint effusion. - Limited patellofemoral syndrome.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 58-year-old male with right knee pain. Evaluate ACL. Partial knee replacement.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or contusion. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: High-grade partial tear at the posterior root attachment, with moderate extrusion of the body.
Medial compartment cartilage: Severe chondrosis with full-thickness cartilage loss in the medial femoral condyle and tibial plateau with subchondral edema. Marginal osteophytes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Moderate chondrosis with low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss in the lateral femoral condyle and full-thickness cartilage loss in the central lateral tibial plateau. Marginal osteophytes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Moderate chondrosis, with diffuse cartilage thinning and areas of full-thickness cartilage fissuring in the patella and femoral trochlea. Marginal osteophyte.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Mucoid degeneration of the ACL.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Lateral patellar tilt and translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 22 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Progress tricompartmental moderate osteoarthritis, with severe chondrosis in the medial compartment.
2.	High-grade tear of the posterior root attachment of the medial meniscus, with extrusion of the body.
3.	New mucoid degeneration of the ACL.

Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih
ligamenata,a prednjeg i stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarne tetive i
tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska na degenerativnoj bazi.
Degenerativne promjene lateralnog meniska.
Patela je mediponirana, Wiberg 2, uz blago reduciranu debljinu artikulacijske hrskavice
femoropatelarno.
Reducirana je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice medijalnog kompartmenta femorotibijalngo zgloba
uz hondromalaciju 3. stupnja prema ICRS klasificikaciji, rubno sitni osteofiti - OA promjene.

Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.
translation:
On the series of MR images of the right knee, there is normal morphology and signal intensity of the collateral ligaments, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments, the iliotibial tract, the patellar tendon, and the quadriceps tendon.
Complex tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus on a degenerative basis.
Degenerative changes of the lateral meniscus.
The patella is medially positioned, Wiberg type 2, with mildly reduced thickness of the articular cartilage in the femoropatellar compartment.
Reduced thickness of the articular cartilage of the medial compartment of the femorotibial joint with grade 3 chondromalacia according to the ICRS classification, marginal small osteophytes – OA changes.
Knee joint effusion. No popliteal (Baker's) cyst is found.
The other visualized osseous, soft tissue, and neurovascular structures are of normal morphology and signal intensity.

translation:
Technique: The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

Findings: On evaluation of the anterior compartment, significant bone marrow edema is observed in the lateral facet of the patella, accompanied by erosion of the overlying articular cartilage (ICRS Grade IV). A small erosion is also observed at the corresponding facet of the femoral trochlea. On evaluation of the menisci, cruciate ligaments, and collateral ligaments, no significant findings are observed. A small intra-articular fluid collection is noted. On evaluation of the bone marrow in the distal diaphysis of the femur, a benign enchondroma is noted with a cephalocaudal diameter of 18 mm, without clinical significance.

Conclusion: Post-traumatic degenerative osteoarthritis of the patellofemoral joint.

report: МР находка: Състояние след травма. Многофрагментна фрактура на тибията по срединна линия, с депресия на тибиалното плато и откъсване на интеркондиларните еминенции. Вътреставните фрагметни за разположени интеркондиларно и доразлно до ставната капсула. Наличие на осификации по ставната капсула в близост до двата епикондили на бедрената кост, най-вероятно във връзка с хематома. Няма данни за фрактури на по хода на фибулата, пателата и фемура. Наличие на голям ставен излив, с данни за дегредационни продукти на хемоглобина, както при деградационни продукти на хемоглобина. МР данни за изразен костномозъчен едем в тибията във връзка с фрактурата. Едем на меките тъкани около колянната става. МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус, като той е фрагментиран. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Установява се субтотална руптура на предна кръстна връзка. Последната е с уголемен напречник и с повишен сигнален интензитет. Идентична промяна се визуализра и в задна кръстна връзка. Слабоизразен костномозъчен едем в епикондилите на бедрената кост. Наличие на MPFL лезия- скъсване на медиалния патело-феморален лигамент. Частично скъсване на медиалния колатерален лигамент на залавното му за фемура място. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Няма данни за хондромалация на пателата.
translation: MRI findings: Post-traumatic condition. Comminuted fracture of the tibia along the midline, with depression of the tibial plateau and avulsion of the intercondylar eminences. Intra-articular fragments are located intercondylarly and dorsally to the joint capsule. Presence of ossifications along the joint capsule in proximity to both femoral epicondyles, most likely related to hematoma. No evidence of fractures along the fibula, patella, and femur. Presence of a large joint effusion, with evidence of hemoglobin degradation products. MRI evidence of pronounced bone marrow edema in the tibia related to the fracture. Soft tissue edema around the knee joint. MRI evidence of a lesion of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, which is fragmented. Normal appearance of the lateral meniscus. Subtotal rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament is identified. The latter is enlarged in diameter and with increased signal intensity. Identical change is also visualized in the posterior cruciate ligament. Mild bone marrow edema in the femoral epicondyles. Presence of MPFL lesion – tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament. Partial tear of the medial collateral ligament at its femoral attachment. Quadriceps femoris tendon, patellar ligament – normal appearance. No evidence of chondromalacia of the patella.

translation:
LEFT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings: Grade II degeneration is observed in the lateral meniscus. Grade III degeneration is observed in the medial meniscus, with a tear at the posterior root level, and the medial meniscus appears extruded. An edematous appearance is present around the medial collateral ligament (grade I sprain). The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, and lateral collateral ligament are normal. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. An edematous appearance is observed in the subcutaneous fatty tissue at the anterior prepatellar level of the knee joint. A T1 and T2 hypointense area approximately 9 mm in diameter is observed at the lateral intercondylar level of the femur (focal bone island). No joint effusion is detected. A Baker's cyst measuring 34x13 mm is observed in the popliteal fossa. Additionally, several ganglion cysts, the largest measuring 20 mm in diameter, are observed around the ligaments posterior to the knee joint.

translation:
Clinical History:
Left medial meniscal syndrome.

Findings:
No significant bone marrow signal abnormalities.
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
The lateral meniscus is of preserved morphology and signal, with no signs of tear.
Complex tear with a main oblique horizontal component of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with regional soft tissue edema.
Superficial chondropathy of the lateral femoral condyle. The remaining femorotibial and patellofemoral cartilages are unremarkable.
Mild joint effusion. Small popliteal cyst with signs of rupture with perifascial fluid extending caudally and deep to the pes anserine tendons.
Mild increased signal at the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon. Patellar tendon, pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris, and iliotibial band within normal limits.

Impression:
Complex tear of the medial meniscus with regional soft tissue edema.
Mild joint effusion with a small popliteal cyst showing signs of rupture with perifascial fluid extending caudally and deep to the pes anserine tendons.
Superficial chondropathy of the lateral femoral condyle.
Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis.

translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1 pulse sequences, proton density with fat signal suppression, and T2 gradient echo.

FINDINGS
From the evaluation of the medial compartment, degeneration and subluxation of the medial meniscus are observed, as well as a linear area of pathological signal in its posterior horn. The articular cartilage is satisfactorily evaluated.

In the lateral compartment of the knee, small marginal osteophytes are observed, as well as pathological signal of the lateral meniscus consistent with simple degeneration, without findings of tear. The articular cartilage has satisfactory depiction.

From the evaluation of the anterior compartment, thinning of the articular cartilage in places ICRS GRADE IV is observed, with presence of subcortical bone marrow lesions in the patella. A small fluid collection is observed intra-articularly.

The cruciate and collateral ligaments have normal appearance.

Large varicose venous dilations are observed at the anterior and posterior, especially lateral aspect of the knee.

A small focus of bone marrow edema is observed at the medial tibial epiphysis.

CONCLUSION:
1. Degenerative tear of the medial meniscus and small-scale microtrabecular insufficiency fractures at the medial tibial epiphysis, without depression of the articular surface.
2. Degenerative osteoarthritis of the anterior compartment at the patellofemoral articulation.

[BILATERAL NOTE: two reports filed under this study]

TECHNIQUE: The examination was performed with T1 pulse sequences, proton density with fat signal suppression, and T2 gradient echo. [DATE].

- From the evaluation of the medial compartment, further degeneration is noted, as well as worsening of the subluxation of the medial meniscus with a linear area of pathological signal in its posterior horn. An irregularity of the articular cartilage margin is recognized at the same level.
- In the lateral compartment of the knee, small marginal osteophytes are re-evaluated without change, as well as pathological signal of the lateral meniscus consistent with simple degeneration, without findings of tear. The articular cartilage has satisfactory depiction at the same level.
- From the evaluation of the anterior compartment, unchanged thinning of the articular cartilage in places ICRS GRADE IV with presence of subcortical bone marrow lesions in the patella is re-evaluated.
- Increase of the intra-articular fluid collection.
- The cruciate and collateral ligaments have normal appearance.
- Large varicose venous dilations are re-evaluated at the anterior and posterior, especially lateral aspect of the knee.
- The focus of bone marrow edema at the medial tibial epiphysis is re-evaluated as minimally decreased, while a newly appearing corresponding focus of bone marrow edema is noted at the medial femoral condyle.

CONCLUSION:
1. Worsening of the degeneration of the medial compartment with further subluxation – degeneration of the medial meniscus and chondropathy (stage II) of the articular cartilage.
2. Relatively unchanged small-scale microtrabecular insufficiency fractures at the medial tibial epiphysis, without depression of the articular surface, and newly appearing corresponding ones at the medial femoral condyle.
3. Unchanged degenerative osteoarthritis of the anterior compartment at the patellofemoral articulation.
4. Increase of the intra-articular fluid collection.

report: Aus der Vordiagnostik [DATE] bek. und hierzu progrediente, medial betonte Pangonarthrose mit flächig vollschichtiger Chondropathie beider Gelenkpartner in der Belastungszone mit Ausdünnung und teils Mehrsklerosierierung der subchondralen Kortikalis sowie progredienter ausgedehnter subchondraler Reizreaktion femorotibial. Oberflächliche Chondropathie auch in den anderen Gelenkkompartimenten ohne tiefergreifende Läsion. Außenmeniskus gering mukoid ohne Riss. Innenmeniskus bei mukoider Vorschädigung mit Lappenriss in der Pars intermedia und umgeschlagenen Anteil auf die Meniskussubstanz parafemoral (5/20). Medial ausgeprägte Reizzustand des Kapselbandapparates. VKB gering mukoid. Ansonsten Bandapparat regelrecht. Kleine Plica mediopatellaris. Geringer Gelenkerguss, dtl. chron. Reizsynovialitis, minimal flüssigkeitsgefüllte Baker-Zyste.
translation: Known from prior imaging [DATE] and progressive, medially predominant pangonarthrosis with diffuse full-thickness chondropathy of both articular surfaces in the weight-bearing zone, with thinning and partly increased sclerosis of the subchondral cortex as well as progressive extensive subchondral reactive changes femorotibially. Superficial chondropathy also in the other joint compartments without deeper lesion. Lateral meniscus mildly myxoid without tear. Medial meniscus with myxoid pre-damage and flap tear in the pars intermedia with a flipped component onto the meniscal substance parafemorally (5/20). Medially pronounced reactive changes of the capsuloligamentous apparatus. ACL mildly myxoid. Otherwise ligamentous apparatus intact. Small mediopatellar plica. Small joint effusion, pronounced chronic reactive synovitis, minimally fluid-filled Baker's cyst.

translation: LEFT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: A radial tear is observed in the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is volume loss in the medial meniscus, grade III degeneration, and an appearance consistent with root and complex tear. The meniscus appears extruded by 5 mm. The posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. There is signal increase consistent with mucoid degeneration in the anterior cruciate ligament. The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Mild joint effusion is observed in the knee joint. There is signal increase consistent with tendinosis in the tendon of the medial crus of the gastrocnemius. Marginal and central osteophytic spurs are present in the tibial and femoral bone structures forming the knee joint, with particularly narrowing of the medial joint space and significant thinning of the tibial cartilage at the medial joint level (findings of degenerative arthritis). Additionally, subchondral bone marrow edema at the level of the tibial intercondylar tubercle and subchondral millimetric cysts at the intercondylar level of the femur are observed.

translation:
On a series of native sections through the left knee, moderate degenerative changes of the femorotibial joint are seen in the medial compartment. Zones of erosion and grade IV chondromalacia of the cartilage with a zone of bone edema in the area of the medial femoral condyle.
Adequate visualization of the patellofemoral joint with normal signal intensity of the cartilage of the corresponding articular surfaces.
Zone of bone edema posteriorly in the area of the medial tibial condyle.
Complete rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament in the middle third.
Atypical appearance and depression in the area of the lateral tubercle of the intercondylar eminence at the insertion site of the anterior cruciate ligament with free bone fragments – status after avulsion fracture?
The posterior cruciate ligament shows appropriate signal intensity, with maintained continuity.
The medial meniscus shows altered signal intensity with a complex tear of the body and posterior horn and discontinuity of the posterior meniscal root. Small parameniscal cysts adjacent to the anterior horn. Meniscal extrusion of approximately 4 mm with consequent distension of the medial collateral ligament, without signs of rupture.
Rupture of the anterior intermeniscal ligament.
The lateral meniscus shows appropriate signal intensity, without signs of rupture.
Mild enthesopathic changes at the proximal insertion of the lateral collateral ligament.
Enthesopathic changes of the popliteus tendon.

translation:
MRI: RIGHT KNEE

report:
Non-contrast enhanced MR examination of right knee is performed with the pulse sequences - sagittal T1, PD+FS, and T2+FS, axial T2+FS and coronal T2+FS. And the imagings show : 

> Preserved joint space and alignment of right knee. 
> The continuity and alignment of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) and posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) are preserved without evidence of ligament tear. No evidence of tibial translation. Edematous soft tissue infiltration surrounding the ACL and PCL. Inflammation is favored. 
> Complex high signal intensities are identified in the posterior horn of medial meniscus. In favor of medial meniscus tear.
> Irregular high signal intensities are noted in the lateral meniscus. More in favor of disc degeneration. D/D include intrasubstance tear. 
> Presence of small to moderate  joint effusion.
> Continuity but increased signal intensity at the medial collateral ligament are noted. More in favor of grade I to II MCL strain. 
> No bone marrow edema. 
> Areas of increased signal intensity are noted in the lower portions of the quadriceps and patellar tendons. Tendinitis is considered. 
> Edematous soft tissue infiltration surrounding the knee. 
> The lateral collateral ligament, iliotibial tract,  cartilage, bone, and other structures are intact. 

<Impression> : 
1) In favor of medial meniscus tear in the posterior horn.
2) More in favor of disc degeneration in the lateral meniscus. D/D include intrasubstance tear. 
3) More in favor of grade I to II MCL strain. 
4) More in favor of tendinitis involving the portions of the quadriceps and patellar tendons.  
5) Presence of small to moderate  joint effusion.

Recommend clinical correlation and further evaluation.

report:
MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    5 weeks ago patient felt popping sensation in the right knee during rotation motion. Able to weight-bear at the time of injury and presently tenderness at fibular head. Difficulty flexing the past 90 degrees. Ultrasound revealed effusion with synovial thickening and positive McMurray's test for medial aspect in clinic.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

There are no normal intact fibers of the anterior cruciate ligament in keeping with a complete mid fiber tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. The finding is associated with an anterior tibial drawer measured in the lateral joint compartment of about 8 mm. There is evidence of resolving bone contusions in the anterior lateral femoral condyle with slightly depressed anterior sulcus and resolving bone contusions in the posterior lateral tibial plateau. Findings are consistent with resolving kissing contusions related to a pivot shift mechanism of injury. There is also edema in the posterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau.

Buckling of the posterior cruciate ligament is noted in association with the anterior tibial drawer. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact.

The medial collateral ligament is intact. There is some mild intrinsic signal around the deep fibers of the medial collateral ligament in keeping with a low-grade medial collateral ligament sprain.

The lateral collateral ligament complex is intact including the fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon, the popliteus tendon and the IT band.

There is an undisplaced vertical tear of the peripheral one third of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus extending into the posterior aspect of the posterior body. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment are well-maintained.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

The extensor mechanism is intact and unremarkable. The patellofemoral ligaments are intact and unremarkable. Articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is well-maintained. The TT-TG distance is within normal limits.

There is no significant Baker's cyst or significant knee effusion. There is mild reactive synovitis within the joint.

INTERPRETATION: 

Complete anterior cruciate ligament tear of mid fibers associated with a significant anterior tibial drawer.

Resolving kissing bone contusions in association with pivot shift mechanism of injury.

Low-grade sprain of the medial fibers of medial collateral ligament.

Undisplaced radial tear of peripheral one third of posterior horn of medial meniscus extending into posterior body.

report: Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı patellofemoral kompartmanda en belirgin ve patella apeksi-medyal fasetindeki tam kata ulaşan eklem kıkırdağı kaybı ve dejenerasyonu, subkondral medüller fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar ön çapraz bağdaki mukoid dejenerasyon dışında normal. Medyal menisküs gövdesi düzeyindeki dejeneratif yapı içi intensite artışı yırtık biçiminde eklem yüzeylerine ulaşmıyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Diz eklemi anteriyorunda cilt altı bağ dokusu ödemli.
translation: Tricompartmental degenerative joint disease of the knee, most prominent in the patellofemoral compartment, characterized by full-thickness articular cartilage loss and degeneration at the apex–medial facet of the patella, subchondral medullary fibrovascular changes, and marginal osteophytes. The intra-articular fluid volume is mildly increased. The cruciate and collateral ligaments are normal except for mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament. The degenerative intrasubstance signal intensity increase at the body of the medial meniscus does not reach the articular surfaces in the form of a tear. The lateral meniscus is normal. The extensor mechanism is intact. The subcutaneous connective tissue is edematous in the anterior aspect of the knee joint.

translation:
Clinical History:
Right knee pain.
Findings:
Cruciate and collateral ligaments within normal limits.
The lateral meniscus appears of preserved morphology and signal, with no signs of tear.
Complex tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with a segment that extends into the meniscotibial recess at the level of the body. This is associated with regional soft tissue edema and peripheral bone edema of the medial tibial plateau in a reactive manner. There are no definite fractures.
Cartilage of the femorotibial compartments and the femoral trochlea without alterations.
Diffuse superficial patellar chondropathy.
Mild to moderate joint effusion. There are no pathological popliteal cysts.
Thickening and increased signal of the distal insertion of the quadriceps tendon and the proximal insertion of the patellar tendon, with no signs of tear. Edema of the subcutaneous tissue of the anterior aspect of the knee without regional fluid collections.
Pes anserine tendons, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial band within normal limits.
Impression:
Complex tear of the medial meniscus with a segment extending into the meniscotibial recess. Regional soft tissue edema and peripheral bone edema of the medial tibial plateau in a reactive manner.
Diffuse superficial patellar chondropathy.
Mild to moderate joint effusion with mild synovitis.
Distal quadriceps tendinosis and proximal patellar tendinosis.
Edema of the subcutaneous tissue of the anterior aspect of the knee without regional fluid collections.

Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlenmektedir.Popliteal fossada 7,5x3cm boyutlu baker kisti izlendi.Patella lateral fasette subkondral alanda ödem kartilajda incelme izlendi.Diz eklemini oluşturan her üç kompartmanda santral -marjinal osteofit formasyonu izlendi.Tibia femoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma ekleme komşu kemik yüzlerde subkondral hafif skleroz ödem ve milimetrik kistler izlendi.Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlenmektedir.SONUÇ: Gonartroz, medial menisküste medial ekstrüzyon, volüm kaybı maserasyon ve kompleks yırtıklar, lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati, anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon, suprapatellar bursit, diz ekleminde sinovit, popliteal fossada baker kisti, patella lateral fasette grade III kondromalazi.
translation: LEFT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: The medial meniscus is extruded 5 mm medially from the knee joint space. Volume loss, maceration, and complex tears are observed in the meniscus. Grade II degeneration is observed in the anterior and posterior horns and body segment of the lateral meniscus. Signal change secondary to myxoid degeneration is observed in the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. The distal quadriceps tendons are normal. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Increased fluid is observed in the suprapatellar bursa and knee joint space. A Baker's cyst measuring 7.5 x 3 cm is observed in the popliteal fossa. Edema in the subchondral area and cartilage thinning are observed in the lateral facet of the patella. Central-marginal osteophyte formation is observed in all three compartments of the knee joint. Joint space narrowing, mild subchondral sclerosis, edema, and millimetric cysts are observed in the bone surfaces adjacent to the joint in the medial tibiofemoral compartment. Destruction of the femoral and tibial cartilages is observed at this level. CONCLUSION: Gonarthrosis, medial extrusion of the medial meniscus, volume loss, maceration, and complex tears, grade II meniscopathy of the lateral meniscus, myxoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, suprapatellar bursitis, synovitis of the knee joint, Baker's cyst in the popliteal fossa, grade III chondromalacia of the lateral facet of the patella.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: Radiograph [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Subchondral marrow edema medial tibial plateau without discrete fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate, ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complete tear posterior root medial meniscus with extrusion at the meniscal body.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Reactive changes based on previously noted meniscal tear about the medial collateral ligament which appears intact.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Complete tear posterior root medial meniscus with associated meniscal extrusion with subchondral marrow edema within the tibial plateau without discrete subchondral insufficiency fracture.

Small joint effusion with moderate ruptured popliteal cyst.

report: Diz eklemi içerisinde sıvı artışı saptanmanmıştır. Ekstansör mekanizma normaldir.  Medial menisküste kova sapı yırtığı vardır. Deplase medial fragman interkondiler çentik düzeyine yer değiştirmiştir. Lateral menisküs normaldir. Dış yan bağ fibuler insersiyo düzeyinde ince kalibrededir.  İç yan bağ bütünlüğü korunmuştur. İç yan bağ derin ve yüzeyel komponentlerinde yırtık saptanmamıştır. Ön çapraz bağ kronik rüptüredir  arka çapraz bağ normaldir. Medial ve latreral femorıtibial eklem yüzleri normal sınırlardadır. Femur  tibia medial plato posteriorunda subkortikal  kontüzyona bağlı  medüller ödematöz sinyal değişiklikleri vardır. İç yan bağ bütünlüğü korunmuştur. Posterior oblik ligamant ince kalibrededir. Oblik popliteal ligamantte ödematöz sinyal değişiklikleri vardır. Semimembranöz tendonu tibia insersiyosunda olasılıkla travmatik zeminde interstisyel yırtıklar izlenmektedir. Tendon kalibresi ve intensitesi özellikle medialde belirgin artmıştır. Popliteal fossada Baker kisti vardır. Medial ve lateral femorotibial eklem yüzleri normal sınırlardadır. Kondral defekt yoktur. Patellofemoral eklem patreller taraf lateral fasette kondral fissür izlenmektedir. Troklear kıkırdak normaldir. Gastrokinemiyus medial başı insersiyosunda yırtık izlenmemiştir. Popliteus tendonu normaldir.
translation: No joint effusion is detected within the knee joint. The extensor mechanism is normal. There is a bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus. The displaced medial fragment has migrated to the level of the intercondylar notch. The lateral meniscus is normal. The lateral collateral ligament is thin in caliber at the level of its fibular insertion. The integrity of the medial collateral ligament is preserved. No tear is detected in the deep and superficial components of the medial collateral ligament. The anterior cruciate ligament is chronically ruptured. The posterior cruciate ligament is normal. The medial and lateral femorotibial articular surfaces are within normal limits. There are medullary edematous signal changes due to subcortical contusion in the posterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau. The integrity of the medial collateral ligament is preserved. The posterior oblique ligament is thin in caliber. There are edematous signal changes in the oblique popliteal ligament. Interstitial tears are observed at the tibial insertion of the semimembranosus tendon, likely on a traumatic basis. The tendon caliber and intensity are markedly increased, particularly medially. There is a Baker's cyst in the popliteal fossa. The medial and lateral femorotibial articular surfaces are within normal limits. There is no chondral defect. A chondral fissure is observed on the lateral facet of the patellar side of the patellofemoral joint. The trochlear cartilage is normal. No tear is observed at the insertion of the medial head of the gastrocnemius. The popliteus tendon is normal.

report:
Vidi se radijalna ruptura prednjeg roga lateralnog meniska.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska sa širenjem u stražnji rog meniska.
Hondromalacija medijalne i lateralne fasete patele (4. stupanj).
Bakerova cista dimenzija 25x29x53 mm (APxLLxCC), uz vidljive heterogene T2 hiperintenzitete
uz kaudalni rub, dif.dg. stanje po rupturi.
Vidi se manja količina slobodne tekućine u suprapatelarnoj burzi.
Uredna je morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih ligamenata, prednjeg i stražnjeg križnog
ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Zona rekonverzije koštane srži u distalnoj dijametafizi femura.
Preostali nalaz bez osobitosti.
translation:
A radial tear of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus is seen.
Complex tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus with extension into the posterior horn of the meniscus.
Chondromalacia of the medial and lateral patellar facets (grade 4).
Baker's cyst measuring 25x29x53 mm (APxLLxCC), with visible heterogeneous T2 hyperintensities along the caudal margin, differential diagnosis: post-rupture condition.
A small amount of free fluid is seen in the suprapatellar bursa.
Normal morphology and signal intensity of the collateral ligaments, anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments, iliotibial tract, patellar ligament, and quadriceps tendon.
Zone of bone marrow reconversion in the distal diametaphysis of the femur.
The remaining findings are unremarkable.

translation:
MRI OF THE RIGHT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat signal suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

FINDINGS
On evaluation of the menisci, the cruciate and collateral ligaments, the articular cartilage, and the extensor mechanism, no significant pathological findings are observed.
Small areas of bone marrow edema are observed in the lateral anterior tibia and the medial anterior femoral condyle subchondrally.
The finding corresponds to small foci of bone bruise.
A small joint effusion is observed intra-articularly.

report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Artrosis severa.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones difusas de señal de la médula ósea.
LCA continuo, de calibre aumentado, con alteración difusa de señal sugerente de degeneración
mucinosa.
LCP y colaterales sin alteraciones significativas.
Menisco medial de morfología normal, con rotura degenerativa compleja del cuerno posterior, con
un componente longitudinal oblicuo que se extiende desde la raíz posterior.
El menisco lateral presenta una amplia rotura radial completa en la unión del cuerno posterior y
cuerpo, con amplio defecto meniscal, asociado a maceración y fibrilación de los remanentes.
Adelgazamiento condral difuso de espesor total en el compartimento femorotibial lateral, con focos
de edema óseo subcondral. Alteración de señal e irregularidad superficial difusa del cartílago de
compartimento femorotibial medial, con áreas de adelgazamiento de espesor subtotal y total en la
región posterosuperior de no carga del cóndilo femoral, con tenue foco de edema óseo
subcondral.
Aumento de señal y moderado adelgazamiento condral difuso del cartílago patelar. Irregularidad
difusa del cartílago troclear, con áreas de adelgazamiento y finas úlceras de espesor subtotal y
total en el aspecto inferior de ambas vertientes.
Osteofitos marginales femorotibiales de predominio lateral y patelofemorales.
Acentuado derrame articular, con marcada proliferación sinovial crónica. Pequeños gangliones
quísticos capsulares posteriores en línea media.
Tendones del cuádriceps, patelar, poplíteo, semimembranoso, bíceps femoral, banda iliotibial y
tendones de la pata de ganso de grosor y señal normales.
Grupos musculares de trofismo conservado.
Impresión:
Rotura radial completa en la unión del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco lateral, con amplio
defecto meniscal y acentuados cambios degenerativos del remanente.
Rotura degenerativa compleja del cuerno posterior del menisco medial.
Avanzados cambios degenerativos del compartimento femorotibial lateral. Condropatía
femorotibial medial difusa grado 1-2, con pequeñas lesiones grado 3 en el cóndilo femoral.
Condropatía patelofemoral grado 3-4.
Acentuado derrame articular y sinovitis crónica.
Signos de degeneración mucinosa del LCA
translation:
Clinical History:
Severe osteoarthritis.

Findings:
No diffuse bone marrow signal abnormalities.
ACL continuous, increased in caliber, with diffuse signal alteration suggestive of mucoid degeneration.
PCL and collateral ligaments without significant abnormalities.
Medial meniscus of normal morphology, with complex degenerative tear of the posterior horn, with an oblique longitudinal component extending from the posterior root.
The lateral meniscus shows a large complete radial tear at the junction of the posterior horn and body, with a large meniscal defect, associated with maceration and fibrillation of the remnants.
Diffuse full-thickness chondral thinning in the lateral femorotibial compartment, with foci of subchondral bone edema. Signal alteration and diffuse superficial irregularity of the cartilage in the medial femorotibial compartment, with areas of subtotal and full-thickness thinning in the non-weight-bearing posterosuperior region of the femoral condyle, with a subtle focus of subchondral bone edema.
Increased signal and moderate diffuse chondral thinning of the patellar cartilage. Diffuse irregularity of the trochlear cartilage, with areas of thinning and fine subtotal and full-thickness ulcers on the inferior aspect of both facets.
Marginal femorotibial osteophytes with lateral predominance and patellofemoral osteophytes.
Marked joint effusion, with prominent chronic synovial proliferation. Small posterior capsular cystic ganglia in the midline.
Quadriceps, patellar, popliteus, semimembranosus, biceps femoris, iliotibial band, and pes anserine tendons of normal thickness and signal.
Muscle groups with preserved trophism.

Impression:
Complete radial tear at the junction of the posterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus, with a large meniscal defect and marked degenerative changes of the remnant.
Complex degenerative tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
Advanced degenerative changes of the lateral femorotibial compartment. Diffuse medial femorotibial chondropathy grade 1-2, with small grade 3 lesions on the femoral condyle.
Patellofemoral chondropathy grade 3-4.
Marked joint effusion and chronic synovitis.
Signs of mucoid degeneration of the ACL.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Bone marrow signal is normal. No acute fracture or bone bruise.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. Mild, diffuse synovial proliferation. No Baker cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a complex tear involving the posterior horn and body, with a small flap fragment arising from the posterior horn. Moderate extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage thinning at the weightbearing aspect diffusely.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is a small tear extending along the inner margin of the body and posterior horn.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning is present diffusely.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 8 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Medial and lateral meniscal tear.
2. Mild chondrosis in the medial and lateral tibiofemoral compartments.

report: ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ : Η εξέταση έγινε σε τοµογράφο 3Τ µε ακολουθίες παλµών ΤΙ και πυκνότητας πρωτονίων µε καταστολή του σήµατος του λίπους. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ: Παρατηρείται εκφυλιστική ρήξη του έσω µηνίσκου. Συνυπάρχει οστεοµυελικό οίδηµα στην οπίσθια έσω κνηµιαία επίφυση. Στο έξω διαµέρισµα δεν παρατηρούνται αξιόλογα ευρήµατα. Ο αρθρικός χόνδρος παρουσιάζει ήπια εκφύλιση – αποφλοίωση στην περιοχή του έσω µηριαίου κονδύλου ενώ επιπλέον παρατηρείται εκφύλιση-λέπτυνση του χόνδρου στην έσω αρθρική επιφάνεια της επιγονατίδας. Ενδαρθρικά παρατηρείται ικανή συλλογή υγρού µε υµενίτιδα και της λιπώδη µεταπλασία που συνηγορούν για ανάπτυξη φυλλόµορφου λιπώµατος (Lipoma arborescens). Στην έξω ιγνυακή κοιλότητα παρατηρείται συνοβιακή κύστη BAKER η οποία έχει ενδείξεις ρήξεων του τοιχώµατος µε παρουσία ελεύθερου υγρού στην γαστροκνηµία.
translation:
TECHNIQUE: The examination was performed on a 3T scanner using T1 and proton density pulse sequences with fat signal suppression.

FINDINGS:
A degenerative tear of the medial meniscus is observed. There is coexisting bone marrow edema in the posterior medial tibial epiphysis. No significant findings are observed in the lateral compartment. The articular cartilage shows mild degeneration – delamination in the region of the medial femoral condyle, while additionally, degeneration and thinning of the cartilage is observed on the medial articular surface of the patella. Intra-articularly, a significant joint effusion is observed with synovitis and fatty metaplasia, consistent with the development of lipoma arborescens. In the lateral popliteal fossa, a Baker's cyst is observed with signs of wall rupture and presence of free fluid in the gastrocnemius.

Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Moderate distal quadriceps tendinosis with some low-grade interstitial tearing of the lateral insertional fibers and some underlying edema within the suprapatellar fat.

Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 3 mm.

No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Complex tearing of the medial meniscal body/posterior horn.
2.	Moderate distal quadriceps tendinosis with some low-grade interstitial tearing of the lateral insertional fibers.

report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade III dejenerasyon izlendi.Lateral menisküs anterior posterior hornu gövde kesimde grade I dejenerasyon izlendi.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursada hafif sıvı artışı izlendi.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.SONUÇ: Medial menisküste grade III, lateral menisküste grade I meniskopati, suprapatellar hafif bursit.
translation: LEFT KNEE MRI. Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence. Findings: Grade III degeneration is observed in the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus. Grade I degeneration is observed in the anterior horn, posterior horn, and body of the lateral meniscus. The anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. Distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Mild fluid increase is observed in the suprapatellar bursa. Signal intensities of the bony structures forming the knee joint are normal. CONCLUSION: Grade III meniscopathy in the medial meniscus, grade I meniscopathy in the lateral meniscus, mild suprapatellar bursitis.

report:
MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

> The contour of ACL is not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of tear.
> Interstitial icreased singal of quadriceps tendon on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury..
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
> No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Abnormal signal intensity is noted in proximal tibia and distal femur, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion, major at lateral side and suspicious of subchondral fracture of lateral femoral condyle. (Srs/Img: 4001/3)
> Subcutanoeus infiltration over anterior aspect of right knee.
> Interstitial icreased singal of quadriceps tendon on F/S T2WI, in favor of tendinosis.
> Small spur formation of right knee and mild fraying of articular carilage of right knee.
Impression: 
1. Tear of ACL.
2. R/O Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
3. Synovitis of right knee and suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae.
4. Bone contusion of right distal femur and proximxal tibia, more prominent at lateral side, R/O subchondral fracture of lateral femoral condyle.
5. Tendinosis of quadriceps tendon.
6. Grade 1 injury of PCL.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

report: МР находка: Няма данни за ставен излив. Костите формиращи дясната колянна става са с нормална форма и интензитет на сигнала. Ставният хрущял е интактен. Латералният менискус е с нормална форма и структура. Медиалният менискус е дегеенративно променен в областта на задния рог. Задният рог на медиалния менискус е с висок интентензитет на сигнала. В него се изобразява хиперинтензна лезия с радиерен ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Скъсването достига до края на менискуса и до ставните повърхности на фемура или тибията. Наличие на малка киста до задния рог на менискуса с размер 7мм. Нормално изобразяване на предната и задната кръстни връзки.  Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за дегенеративна промяна и скъсване на задния рог на медиалния менискус – 3-та степен.

report: MRI ΑΡ ΓΟΝΑΤΟΣ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ Η εξέταση έγινε με ακολουθίες παλμών Τ1, πυκνότητας πρωτονίων με καταστολή του σήματος του λίπους και Τ2 βαθμιδωτής ηχούς. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Ο έσω μηνίσκος παρουσιάζει εκφύλιση και ρήξη στο οπίσθιο κέρας αυτού καθώς και στο σώμα με μετατόπιση κατεαγότος τμήματος στην μεσοκονδύλια εντομή (μερικώς "bucket handle"). Ο έξω μηνίσκος, ο αρθρικός χόνδρος, oι πλάγιοι σύνδεσμοι και ο οπίσθιος χιαστός σύνδεσμος, έχουν φυσιολογική απεικόνιση.  Ο πρόσθιος χιαστός σύνδεσμος παρουσιάζει ολική ρήξη στη μηριαία κατάφυση με οριζοντιοποιημένη την άπω μόιρα των ραγέντων ινών. report: Subchondrale knöcherne Impression am dorsolateralen Tibiaplateau (6/24) sowie der lateralen Femurkondyle bereits in der VU vordokumentiert, mit Restbefunden. Ansonsten in den vorliegenden Sequenzen unauffällige Signalgebung der ossären Strukturen. An der lateralen Femurkondyle nach lateral abflachender Knorpelbesatz ohne höhergradige Chondropathie. Ansonsten kein Anhalt für eine Chondropathie. Innen- sowie Außenmeniskus mit regelrechter Signalgebung ohne Anhalt für eine Rissbildung. Bei bei klinisch und anamnestisch vordokumentierter subtotaler Ruptur des vorderen Kreuzbandes das VKB am femoralen Ansatz aufgefasert und verdickt imponierend, soweit mit der externen MR-VU vergleichbar kein Hinweis auf eine weitere Ruptur. translation: Subchondral bony impression at the dorsolateral tibial plateau (6/24) and the lateral femoral condyle, already documented on the prior examination, with residual findings. Signs of inactivity osteopenia, predominantly subchondral and periarticular, exemplarily in the lateral femoral condyle. Otherwise, unremarkable signal intensity of the osseous structures on the available sequences. At the lateral femoral condyle, cartilage thinning laterally without high-grade chondropathy. Otherwise no evidence of chondropathy. Medial and lateral meniscus with regular signal intensity, no evidence of a tear. Given the clinically and historically pre-documented subtotal rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament, the ACL appears frayed and thickened at the femoral attachment; as far as comparable with the external prior MR examination, no evidence of a further rupture. Known rupture of the PCL (6/17). Given the initially documented partial lesion of the lateral collateral ligament, the LCL appears slightly frayed and thickened without definite discontinuity. MCL with intact appearance. Regressing joint effusion with small residual. Intact signal intensity of the patellar and quadriceps tendons. The included soft tissues show unremarkable signal intensity on the available sequences.

translation:
MRI LEFT KNEE

TECHNIQUE
The examination was performed with T1, proton density with fat signal suppression, and T2 gradient echo pulse sequences.

FINDINGS
On evaluation of the medial compartment, a degenerative tear of the medial meniscus is observed, in the presence of marginal osteophytes, erosion of the articular cartilage at the femoral and tibial condyles ICRS grade III, subarticular bone marrow edema on both sides of the joint space, and accompanying joint effusion. The findings are consistent with degenerative osteoarthritis.

In the lateral compartment of the knee, no significant findings are observed.

On evaluation of the anterior compartment, mild degenerative changes are observed with lateral marginal osteophytes on the patella and femoral trochlea, but without cartilage erosion. Intra-articularly, fluid collection is noted which contains small structures of fatty tissue. The finding corresponds to lipoma arborescens. The bone marrow shows benign hyperplasia.

In the popliteal fossa, a venous aneurysm is observed approximately 8 cm in length.

Sprain.

translation: Tricompartmental degenerative joint disease of the knee, most prominent in the medial femorotibial compartment, characterized by full-thickness articular cartilage loss and degeneration and marginal osteophytes. The intra-articular fluid volume is mildly increased. Myxoid degeneration is seen in the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate and collateral ligaments are normal. The lateral meniscus is normal. The medial meniscus is extruded 4 mm medially, with a partial tear at the posterior root and posterior horn degeneration. The extensor mechanism is intact. Mild edema deep to the pes anserinus tendons at the posteromedial corner suggests posteromedial impingement syndrome. The proximal tibiofibular joint fluid is mildly increased.

translation:
Edema of the subcutaneous fat tissue on the anteromedial side of the knee, while the signal intensity of the musculature in the scanned region is normal.
The articular bodies of the femorotibial joint are appropriately shaped and congruent, the articular cartilages appear intact.
Patchy zones of bone edema, predominantly in the area of the lateral femoral condyle and the distal metaphysis-diaphysis of the femur, consistent with a contusion, without signs of fracture.
There is lateral patellar dislocation with a disrupted course of the medial patellar retinaculum consistent with a complete rupture, while the course of the lateral patellar retinaculum is serpiginous, without evident signs of rupture of the latter.
The signal intensity of the bony structure of the patella is normal.
The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are of appropriate signal intensity, with preserved course, without signs of rupture.
Moderate amount of effusion along the medial collateral ligament, which is altered in its proximal course and of altered signal intensity, consistent with a high-grade partial rupture.
The lateral collateral ligament appears to have a preserved course.
The signal intensity of the popliteus tendon is altered in its distal course, consistent with a partial rupture.
The signal intensity of the semimembranosus tendon is also altered in its distal course, immediately proximal to the insertion, possibly consistent with a partial lesion.
The signal intensity of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus is altered, consistent with a horizontal tear.
The lateral meniscus is of appropriate morphological appearance.
The signal intensity of the distal portion of the quadriceps femoris tendon and the patellar ligament is normal.
Moderate amount of free fluid suprapatellarly and retropatellarly as well as in the lateral recess.
Appropriate appearance of Hoffa's fat pad.

report: МР находка: Вижда се контузионен костно-мозъчен едем в долната част на пателата от медиалната страна. Не се намират промени във формата на костите формиращи колянната става. Не се откриват едемни промени на костния мозък във фемура, тибията и фибулата. Ставният хрущял е съхранен. Наличие на малък ставен излив. Кръстните връзки са интактни. лигаменти Колатрални лигаменти – без особености. Ретинакулуми – б.о. МР данни за дегенеративна промяна и лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус. В задният рог на медиалния менискус се изобразява хиперинтензна лезия с радиерен  ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Скъсването достига до края на менискуса, но видимо не се проследява до ставните повърхности на фемура или тибията – увреда 2a степен. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – б.о. Визуализира се малка Бекерова киста с типична локализация с р-р 30/12 мм. Заключение: МР данни за контузионен костномозчен едем в пателата. Няма данни за хондромалация на пателата. Лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 2а. Малък Ставен излив. Бекерова киста.
translation: MRI findings: Contusion-related bone marrow edema is seen in the lower part of the patella on the medial side. No changes are found in the shape of the bones forming the knee joint. Collateral ligaments – unremarkable. Retinacula – unremarkable. MRI findings of degenerative change and lesion in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. In the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, a hyperintense lesion with a radial course is visualized, corresponding to a tear. Conclusion: MRI findings of contusion-related bone marrow edema in the patella. No evidence of chondromalacia of the patella. Lesion in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus – grade 2a. Small joint effusion. Baker's cyst.

Full-thickness and full-width tear of the mid-third of the ACL associated with bone edema / impaction fracture of the posterior aspect of the tibial plateaus and the peripheral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle.
Peripheral tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus.
Mild to moderate joint effusion.

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee sprain

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Fragmentation of the tibial tuberosity, compatible with remote Osgood-Schlatter. Mild bone marrow edema between fragments and the dominant component of the tibial tuberosity likely represents a superimposed osseous stress response. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Increased signal in the body and posterior horn which is not meet criteria for tear and likely represents remnant of vascularity.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 6 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

Sequelae of remote Osgood Schlatter disease with mild superimposed osseous stress response between the tibial tuberosity and adjacent bone fragment.
