report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Arka çapraz ve iç yan bağ normal. Dış yan bağın femoral yapışma yeri düzeyindeki kalınlaşma ve intensite artışı kronik zorlanma ile uyumlu. Ön çapraz bağın intensitesi difüz olarak artmış olup orta kesiminde komplet yırtık mevcut. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzdan gövdesine uzanan longitudinal yırtık arka boynuz düzeyinde vertikal, gövdesi düzeyinde ise oblik seyir gösteriyor. Ön boynuz düzeyinde serbest kenarda radyal yırtık da eşlik ediyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Diz eklemindeki hafif dereceli osteoartrit patella apeksi ve medyal fasetindeki milimetrik kondral fissürler, medyal femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki yüzeyel kondral düzensizlikler ve milimetrik boyutlu marjinal osteofitler ile karakterize. Gastroknemyus, semimembranozus bursasındaki sıvı koleksiyonu 6 cm maksimum boyutlu ve sızdırmıyor. Popliteus tendonu normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.
translation: Mild increase in intra-articular fluid of the knee joint. The posterior cruciate and medial collateral ligaments are normal. Thickening and increased signal intensity at the femoral attachment of the lateral collateral ligament, consistent with chronic strain. The signal intensity of the anterior cruciate ligament is diffusely increased, with a complete tear in its mid-portion. A longitudinal tear extending from the posterior horn to the body of the medial meniscus shows vertical orientation at the posterior horn level and oblique orientation at the body level. An accompanying radial tear at the free edge is also present at the level of the anterior horn. The lateral meniscus is normal. Mild osteoarthritis of the knee joint, characterized by millimetric chondral fissures at the apex and medial facet of the patella, superficial chondral irregularities on the weight-bearing surface of the medial femoral condyle, and millimetric marginal osteophytes. Fluid collection in the gastrocnemius-semimembranosus bursa measuring up to 6 cm in maximum dimension, without leakage. The popliteus tendon is normal. The extensor mechanism is intact. The proximal tibiofibular joint is normal.

translation:
RIGHT KNEE MRI.
Examination protocol: Multiplanar, multisequence.
Findings:
The lateral meniscus is normal. A tear is observed at the root location of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with mild meniscal extrusion. Grade II degeneration is observed in the meniscal body. Marginal osteophytes are seen in the adjacent femur and tibia in the medial joint space. Full-thickness cartilage loss is present in the adjacent femur and tibia in the medial joint space. The anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament, lateral and medial collateral ligaments are normal. The distal quadriceps is normal. The patella is normally positioned. There is no retinacular discontinuity. Fibrillation is observed in the lateral patellar facet. Grade II degeneration areas are observed in the anterior section of the trochlear cartilage. Minimal fluid is present within the popliteus tendon. Signal intensities of the bony structures forming the knee joint are normal.
CONCLUSION: Posterior horn root tear of the medial meniscus with accompanying meniscal extrusion, marginal osteophytes in the medial joint space, medial and tibial chondromalacia.

report:
Interprétation:

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire avec signes de synovite chronique. Il y a un également un kyste de Baker associé à une prolifération synoviale/synovite chronique s'étendant sur environ 5 cm de diamètre cc. Celui-ci s'étend au niveau des bourses du semi-membraneux et de la patte d'oie avec composante de bursite probablement associée. 

Il y a une déchirure complexe du ménisque interne avec déchirure radiaire transfixiante à la jonction de la racine postérieure et de la corne postérieure, et déchirure longitudinale horizontale impliquant la corne postérieure résiduelle, corps méniscal et s'étendant à la jonction avec la corne antérieure. Il y a une extrusion marquée du corps méniscal de façon associée. De plus, il y a une structure légèrement hétérogène et principalement hypointense ovalaire située de façon intime avec le rebord postérieur de la racine postérieure du ménisque interne mesurant 7 x 14 x 7 mm. L'aspect est plutôt en faveur d'une souris intra-articulaire qui pourrait être en partie ossifiée versus un ossicule méniscal (moins probable). L'aspect est moins en faveur d'un ''flap'' méniscal dont le signal demeure légèrement différent du ménisque et sans continuité démontrée avec la corne postérieure. 

Le ligament collatéral interne est intact sans déchirure. Il y a une atténuation modérée des surfaces cartilagineuses au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne avec atteinte transfixiante aux surfaces portantes et petits ostéophytes marginaux. Pas de changement sous-chondral réactionnel associé. 

Le ménisque externe de même que le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe sont intacts sans déchirure. 

Légère atténuation diffuse des surfaces cartilagineuses au compartiment fémoro-tibial externe, plus marquée à la surface portante. Petits ostéophytes marginaux.

Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure. Petit kyste ganglionnaire para-ligamentaire.

L'alignement patello-fémoral est préservé. Le tendon du quadriceps distal est intact sans déchirure. Légère tendinose du patellaire sans déchirure. 

Atténuation modérée des surfaces chondrales au compartiment patello-fémoral avec fissure chondrale partielle le long de la surface articulaire patellaire et atteinte transfixiante le long de la surface trochléaire. Pas de changement sous-chondral réactionnel associé. Petits ostéophytes marginaux. 

Conclusion:

Déchirure complexe du ménisque interne avec composante radiaire transfixiante à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure avec extrusion significative du corps méniscal secondairement, de plus, déchirure longitudinale horizontale de la corne postérieure résiduelle et du corps du ménisque interne s'étendant à la jonction avec la corne antérieure.

Changements dégénératifs/chondropathie tricompartimentaux de grade 3 impliquant les compartiments fémoro-tibiaux interne et patello-fémoral et de grade 1 impliquant le compartiment fémoro-tibial externe.

Petit épanchement intra-articulaire et kyste de Baker avec signes de synovite chronique associée. Bursite du semi-membraneux et de la patte d'oie avec également synovite d'allure chronique associée. 

Souris intra-articulaire potentiellement en partie ossifiée au rebord postérieur de la racine postérieure du ménisque interne. Un ossicule méniscal paraît moins probable. L'aspect est moins en faveur d'un ''flap'' méniscal avec un signal différent du ménisque et sans continuité notée avec la corne postérieure du ménisque interne.
translation:
Interpretation:

There is a small intra-articular effusion with signs of chronic synovitis. There is also a Baker's cyst associated with synovial proliferation/chronic synovitis extending approximately 5 cm in CC diameter. This extends into the semimembranosus and pes anserinus bursae with a likely associated bursitis component.

There is a complex tear of the medial meniscus with a full-thickness radial tear at the junction of the posterior root and posterior horn, and a horizontal longitudinal tear involving the residual posterior horn, meniscal body, and extending to the junction with the anterior horn. There is associated marked extrusion of the meniscal body. Additionally, there is a slightly heterogeneous and predominantly hypointense ovoid structure located intimately with the posterior margin of the posterior root of the medial meniscus measuring 7 x 14 x 7 mm. The appearance is more in favor of an intra-articular loose body that could be partially ossified versus a meniscal ossicle (less likely). The appearance is less in favor of a meniscal flap, whose signal remains slightly different from the meniscus and without demonstrated continuity with the posterior horn.

The medial collateral ligament is intact without tear. There is moderate attenuation of the cartilage surfaces in the medial femorotibial compartment with full-thickness defect at the weight-bearing surfaces and small marginal osteophytes. No associated reactive subchondral change.

The lateral meniscus as well as the lateral collateral ligament complex are intact without tear.

Mild diffuse attenuation of the cartilage surfaces in the lateral femorotibial compartment, more marked at the weight-bearing surface. Small marginal osteophytes.

The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact without tear. Small pariligamentous ganglion cyst.

The patellofemoral alignment is preserved. The distal quadriceps tendon is intact without tear. Mild patellar tendinosis without tear.

Moderate attenuation of the chondral surfaces in the patellofemoral compartment with partial chondral fissure along the patellar articular surface and full-thickness defect along the trochlear surface. No associated reactive subchondral change. Small marginal osteophytes.

Conclusion:

Complex tear of the medial meniscus with a full-thickness radial component at the junction of the posterior horn and posterior root with significant extrusion of the meniscal body secondarily, and additionally, a horizontal longitudinal tear of the residual posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus extending to the junction with the anterior horn.

Tricompartmental degenerative changes/chondropathy, grade 3 involving the medial femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments and grade 1 involving the lateral femorotibial compartment.

Small intra-articular effusion and Baker's cyst with signs of associated chronic synovitis. Semimembranosus and pes anserinus bursitis with also associated chronic-appearing synovitis.

Intra-articular loose body potentially partially ossified at the posterior margin of the posterior root of the medial meniscus. A meniscal ossicle appears less likely. The appearance is less in favor of a meniscal flap, with a signal different from the meniscus and without continuity noted with the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.

report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain for 2 weeks. No known cause.
Comparison: Left knee radiograph dated [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Large T1/T2 hypointense, cortically based lesion along the distal medial femoral diaphysis with a slightly broader zone of transition in expected, likely represents an old nonossifying fibroma.

JOINT SPACE:
Large joint effusion with increased T1 signal compatible with hemarthrosis, with extensive synovial proliferation, including more focal focal synovitis at the posterosuperior joint space. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage thinning, heterogeneity, and fissuring along weightbearing medial femoral condyle tibial plateau.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High grade partial thickness cartilage loss along the medial patellar facet with focal high grade fissuring.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 15 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Sclerotic cortically based lesion along the distal medial femoral diaphysis, likely representing a healed (ossified) nonossifying fibroma. Follow-up radiographs in 3 months recommended to demonstrate stability.
2.	Large knee joint hemarthrosis with extensive synovitis. Given no significant traumatic injury, differential considerations includes pigmented villonodular synovitis (PVNS), coagulopathy, infectious/inflammatory etiologies such as an inflammatory arthropathy or Lyme' s disease.
3.	Medial and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis, as described above.

report:
МР находка: Няма данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става са с нормална форма и сигнална характеристика. Изобразява се посттравматичен костномозъчен едем в латералните кондили на фемура и тибията. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и тибията е съхранен. Няма данни за ставен излив. МР данни за дегенеративни промени  на медиалния менискус предимно в задния рог. Те се представят като хиперинтензна лезия с хоризонтален ход, недостигаща до артикулиращия хрущял. Няма МР 
данни за пълна руптура на менискуса. Латералният менискус е нормално представен. Кръстни връзки – б.о. Колатералните лигаменти са със запазена цялост. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Ретинакулуми – без особености. Заключение: МР данни за постравматичен костномозъчен едем на латералните кондили на фемура и тибията в съчетание с дегенеративни промени в медиалния менискус на лявата колянна става.
translation: MRI findings: No evidence of joint effusion. The bones forming the left knee joint are of normal shape and signal characteristics. Post-traumatic bone marrow edema is visualized in the lateral condyles of the femur and tibia. The articular cartilage of the femur and tibia is preserved. No evidence of joint effusion. MRI evidence of degenerative changes of the medial meniscus predominantly in the posterior horn. They present as a hyperintense lesion with a horizontal course, not reaching the articular cartilage. No MRI evidence of complete meniscal rupture. The lateral meniscus appears normal. Cruciate ligaments – unremarkable. The collateral ligaments are intact. Popliteal fossa – unremarkable. Patella, patellar cartilage – unremarkable. Patellar ligament and quadriceps femoris tendon – unremarkable. Retinacula – unremarkable. Conclusion: MRI evidence of post-traumatic bone marrow edema of the lateral condyles of the femur and tibia in combination with degenerative changes in the medial meniscus of the left knee joint.

report: Stigmata der medial betonten Pangonarthrose mit osteophytären Anbauten an den Femurkondylen bds., Knochenmarksödem in der medialen Femurkondyle und proximalen, medialen Tibia sowie Ausbildung subchondraler Zysten im medialen Tibiaplateau mit einer Ausdehnung von bis zu 5 x 5 mm (5/17). Knochenmarksödem auch in der dorsolateralen Femurkondyle (5/27) bei hier fokal tiefergreifender Chondropathie (4/11). Ansonsten in den vorliegenden Sequenzen unauffällige Signalgebung der ossären Strukturen. Höhergradig geminderter Knorpelbesatz am proximalen Tibiaplateau mit fokal vollschichtige Chondropathie über eine Ausdehnung von 9 x 19 mm (a.p. x ml, 6/8 sowie 5/20); flächig vollschichtige Chondropathie auch an der medialen Femurkondyle nach medial hin. Keine höhergradige Chondropathie im lateralen Kompartiment. Retropatellar geminderter Knorpelbesatz mit betont an der medialen Trochleafacette höhergradiger Chondropathie ohne fokal vollschichtigen chondralen Defekt. Ausgeprägter Substanzdefekt des Innenmeniskus in der Pars intermedia und im Hinterhorn mit aufgefaserter Struktur sowie radiärem Defekt am Hinterhorn (5/25). Kein Anhalt für eine Rissbildung des Außenmeniskus. VKB sowie HKB intakt. Geringer medialer Reizzustand. LCL mit intakter Signalgebung. Kein Kniegelenkserguss. Kleine, gering flüssigkeitsgefüllte Baker-Zyste. Fabella. 2 Chondrome dorsal. Quadriceps- sowie Patellarsehne mit intakter Signalgebung. Unauffällige Signalgebung der übrigen miterfassten Weichteile in den vorliegenden Sequenzen.
translation: Signs of medially predominant pagonarthrosis with osteophytic formations on both femoral condyles. Bone marrow edema in the medial femoral condyle and proximal medial tibia as well as formation of subchondral cysts in the medial tibial plateau measuring up to 5 x 5 mm (5/17). Bone marrow edema also in the dorsolateral femoral condyle (5/27) with focal deep chondropathy here (4/11). Otherwise unremarkable signal intensity of the osseous structures on the available sequences. High-grade reduced cartilage coverage at the proximal tibial plateau with focal full-thickness chondropathy over an extent of 9 x 19 mm (AP x ML, 6/8 and 5/20); diffuse full-thickness chondropathy also on the medial femoral condyle medially. No high-grade chondropathy in the lateral compartment. Reduced retropatellar cartilage coverage with predominantly high-grade chondropathy at the medial trochlear facet without focal full-thickness chondral defect. Pronounced substance defect of the medial meniscus in the pars intermedia and posterior horn with frayed structure as well as radial defect at the posterior horn (5/25). No evidence of a tear of the lateral meniscus. ACL and PCL intact. Mild medial irritation. LCL with intact signal intensity. No knee joint effusion. Small, mildly fluid-filled Baker's cyst. Fabella. 2 chondromas dorsally. Quadriceps and patellar tendons with intact signal intensity. Unremarkable signal intensity of the remaining included soft tissues on the available sequences.

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The medial meniscus shows intrasubstance degeneration in the posterior horn and body, without evidence of underlying tear. The lateral meniscus is intact.

IMPRESSION:
1. Mild quadriceps and patellar tendinosis without tear. No evidence of discrete meniscal, ligament, or tendon tear.
2. Mild to moderate medial femorotibial chondrosis suggesting evolving mild medial compartment osteoarthritis left knee.
